No, what are they called? No, those who are *awwal* (first) from the beginning, they are who they are. Now, those who ascend from below, the seventh one who attains the third rank... seventh, sixth... then sixth, fifth... then below, when they ascend, they are called *Malā'ikat al-Muqarrabūn* because they are coming near. A seven-*darajah* (level) difference remains. Those who ascend from below are coming near to them, so they are called *Malā'ikat al-Muqarrabūn*. Their... their gathering, the *Kurūbiyyīn* are seated from the very beginning. And the *Malā'ikat al-Rūhāniyyūn* are seated from the beginning. Now, after that, those who are ascending from below, they are called *Muqarrab*. Meaning, those who are coming near. Very well, very good point. *Wa yuqālu lahum Malā'ikat al-Muqarrabūn*. They are called... first, the highest are the *Malā'ikah Kurūbiyyūn*, then after them are the *Malā'ikah Rūhāniyyūn* who are in their circle. And after them are the *Malā'ikat al-Muqarrabūn*. *Wa yuqālu li-l-hadd al-'āshir ahl al-barzakh* (and the tenth *hadd* is called the people of the *barzakh*). And it is said that the people of the tenth *hadd*, the *'āshir*, are *ahl al-barzakh*. So the *barzakh* is the tenth *'āshir*, after the *Kurūbiyyīn*. After that, the rank of the *'āshir* will be attained. And for him who is from the *rutbah* (rank) of the *'āshir*, the *'āshir* has not yet been attained. It has not yet been attained. His rank has not yet... when he performs *tawbah* (repentance), then he will attain the rank of the *'āshir*. *Wa yuqālu li-hudūd al-insāniyyah al-musāwiyah* (and it is said of the equivalent human ranks). It is said that the *hudūd al-insāniyyah*... The same... *'ālam al-tabī'ah*, up to *ilā hudūd al-Kurūbiyyīn* (up to the ranks of the *Kurūbiyyīn*). The entire *'ālam al-tabī'ah* ascends. So those who ascend towards them... from the *hadd al-'āshir*... Among the seven *kurūbiyyah*, those who ascend towards them from the entire *'ālam al-tabī'ah*, they are called *Malā'ikat al-Muqarrabūn*. *Wa yuqālu* (and it is said) that the people who are the *'āshir*, they are *ahl al-barzakh*. And their *hudūd* are *musāwiyah* (equivalent). *Wa minhum al-hudūd... fa-āshiruhum...* *wa minhum al-hudūd al-thalāthah* (and among them are the three ranks). It is said that the *jism 'āshir* (body of the tenth)... Where is it? It is below the rank of the *'āshir*. The rank of the *'āshir* is the *barzakh*. And *wa minhum*, from them... "from them" means who? The *ahl al-barzakh*. From those who are the *ahl al-barzakh*, from them are the *hudūd*, three. *Al-mu'āsirūn*, meaning *al-mu'āsirūn li-kulli makānin... mā'idah...* [unclear]. Those who bear witness to every place...

...from the `barzakh`, beyond the `barzakh`... yes, beyond the `barzakh`... from the `barzakh`. They have... they have grasped the `Jadd`, have explained the `Jadd`. That is the `Jadd`. They are explaining that with every Imam... all the spiritual [unclear] is... it remains as the `Jadd`. It is above them, above the Imam. Above which Imam? From every Imam. The `Jadd` that has come above all the 24 Imams, it remains as its `hujjat`. So it has come from `Asas` to `Asas`... Yes? Had the `Jadd` come from the `Asas`? Yes, previously in the `barzakh`, it had come from the `Asas`. `Lisan al-Hikmah`. And `Lisan al-Imamah`. It is also called `Lisan al-Hikmah`. The `Jadd` is the `Lisan al-Hikmah`. This Burhanuddin Saheb... the faith of *al-Isalat al-Awwalin* (the first origins)... does not let them stop, it takes them in this direction. And `Lisan al-Shari'ah`... meaning `Lisan-e-Shari'ah`, the tongue of the `Shari'ah`. `wa khatru mizaan...` (and they set a balance...) `ramzaat`... `alayhim ma 'addadu...` (upon them what they enumerated...) `wa as'asau bi lisan al-sa'il al-da'i al-da'i...` (and they established with the tongue of the questioner, the `da'i`, the `da'i`...) `bi barzakhin bi barzakhin.` (in a `barzakh`, in a `barzakh`.) And the indication... what is the indication? And... they... by other names... apart from it... have written in their special book. So what is in the `Lisan al-Hikmah`? It is the `Jadd`. And in the `Lisan al-Shari'ah`, their soul is reformed.

<!-- lecture 9 -->

In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. The fourth *fasl* (chapter) from the third *bab* (section) from the *Mabda' al-Awwal* (First Principle), from the *Mabda' al-Awwal*, *thumma innahu shaba al-thalith al-munqa'na 'anhu bi al-inbi'ath al-thani al-tali li al-inbi'ath al-awwal lamma takhata'hu wa zanna annahu... takhata'hu... wa zanna annahu wa iyyahu fi hal al-masawat wa inqata'at 'anhu madda... madda... azlamat dhatuhu*. Then, the third *shibh* (likeness), which was given the name... of the second *inbi'ath* (emanation)... Which section is it from? *Khata'*. What is the meaning of *khata'* in the dictionary? *Khata'*. So *takhata'hu*, where is the *hu* referring to? It is referring to *mub'ath al-awwal*. `Lamma takhata'hu` (when he erred concerning him). For him, he committed an error for him. The *shibh al-thalith*, meaning the Third Intellect, `al-munqa'na 'anhu` (whose name), from which... `inbi'ath al-thani` was the name given to it. `Al-tali`, which was following the `inbi'ath al-awwal`, `lamma takhata'hu` (when he erred concerning him). He erred concerning him. His. Him. Meaning, he committed an error regarding the `inbi'ath al-awwal`. And he thought that he and... the `inbi'ath al-awwal` were in a state of equality. And `madda` (substance) was cut off from him. And... and his essence became dark. Not 'and'... When `madda` was cut off from him, then his essence became dark. `Wa bu'ida 'anhu wa sar 'ashiran fi ufuq al-'aql al-tasi'`. (And he was distanced from him, and he became the Tenth in the horizon of the Ninth Intellect). And he was distanced from him, and he became the Tenth, in the horizon of... the Ninth Intellect. `Huwa wa man fi zimnihi...` He and whoever was in his group... that he was distanced from him, meaning he was distanced from the `mub'ath al-awwal`. And he became the Tenth. And he became the Tenth in the horizon of the Ninth Intellect. `Huwa wa man fi zimnihi... ba'da an kana thalithan`. (He and whoever was in his category... after he had been the Third). He and whoever was in his category... in his group... `ba'da an kana`, after he... `thalithan`, after this, that he was the Third. `Wa nazara... ila inhitat rutbatihi wa bu'dihi min 'illatihi`. (And he looked at the lowness of his rank and his distance from his cause). He... here... in the state of heedlessness, he also, when he established the circle... Ninth Intellect... `inbi'ath al-thani`, his circle was also formed. In the horizon of the Ninth Intellect... He was in the horizon of the Ninth Intellect. Meaning, he was below it. In the period of darkness too, when darkness had overcome him, even then his circle was established. And he became the Tenth, in the horizon of the Ninth Intellect. Meaning, after these nine forms, he became the Tenth. The nine forms ended, meaning the nine forms... from his own essence, he became the Tenth. Here it says, "he and whoever was in his category." He and those who were in his category. `'Ashir` (the Tenth) and those in his category. After... he was the Third. `Wa nazara ila inhitat rutbatihi`. And he saw the decline of his rank. The nine spheres who were his companions, they attained the `Kamal al-Thani` (Second Perfection), but he did not. `'Ashir` and his companions... the companions. `Wa man fi zimnihi`. The people of his group... that he had made a claim of equality... with him were also other people. A very large group. `Wa bu'dihi min 'illatihi`. And his distance from his cause. The distance was because of his cause. `Fa'stayqaza 'an al-ghaflah`. (So he awoke from heedlessness). Then he awoke from his heedlessness. Then he awoke from heedlessness. `Fa'stayqaza 'an al-ghaflah`. So he awoke from heedlessness. From heedlessness. `Wa 'alima annahu qad waqa'a fi al-khati'ah wa al-zillah`. (And he knew that he had fallen into error and a slip). Then he knew, verily, that he had fallen into a thing, from his error, and in a slip. From a slip. `Wa ta'ammala ma... ma sababa al-mujiba li-dhalik... ma al-sababu al-mujiba li-dhalik`. (And he contemplated what was the cause that necessitated that). And he contemplated... what is the cause... that necessitates this matter. They attained the `Kamal al-Thani`, why didn't he? `Wa ma al-muqi' lahu fima hunalik`. (And what made him fall into what was there). And what thing... is the cause of his falling into what was there. In this state he was in, why did he come into this state? `Wa aqbala 'ala aqrab al-'uqul ilayhi munajiyan`. (And he turned towards the nearest of the Intellects to him, supplicating). And he came forward... towards the nearest Intellect, supplicating. `Wa li-rahmatihi taliban wa rajiyan`. (And for His mercy, seeking and hoping). And for His mercy, asking... and hoping. Hoping. `Fa-dhakkara... fa-dhakkarahu ta'adiyata tawrihi... fa-dhakara... fa-dhakara`. Then... he reminded. `dhakara` means he remembered. `dhakkara` means he reminded. He remembered, `dhakara` he remembered. `dhakkara` he reminded. `Fa-dhakkarahu tazkiratan`. Then he reminded him... of crossing his boundary. Meaning, the nearest Intellect reminded him. Yes. The Ninth Intellect. The Ninth Intellect. The Ninth Intellect. That is the `akhirihi`, the one he had a mistake with. Then he remembered that he had crossed his boundary. `Wa inkaruhu haddahu al-sabiq 'alayhi kana min istikbarihi`. `Wa inkaruhu haddahu al-sabiq 'alayhi idh jahila wa istakbara`. And his denying his preceding limit, which was over him, when he was ignorant and became arrogant. `Fa-'tarafa bi-khati'atihi`. Then he falls down... except for the remaining intercessions, all would have fallen down. `Fa-'tarafa bi-khati'atihi`. Then he confessed his error. `Wa aqarra bi-zallatihi`. He admitted his slip. `Wa akhadha wa taba wa istakana wa anaba`. (And he took [responsibility], and repented, and became humble, and turned [to God]). And he became humble. And he became a supplicant. He became miserable. Miserable. `Wa tawassala bi-jami'i al-sabiqin 'alayhi ila rabbihi`. And he sought intercession through all those preceding him, to his Lord. His lord... `'Aql al-Awwal` (the First Intellect) or `Mubda'-e-Ta'ala` (the Exalted Originator)? `Ila rabbihi`. The preceding ones... all of them towards their Lord. Towards `'Aql al-Awwal`. `'Aql al-Awwal`. `Wa'staghfarahu`. And he sought forgiveness from him. `Fa-ghufira lahu jami'u dhunubihi`. Then he was forgiven... all his sins. All his sins were forgiven for him. `Wa hannat hadhihi al-'uqul al-mujarradah 'alayhi`. `Wa hanna`. What is the original? `Hannat`. `Hanna`. `Hanna` means... kindness. He became happy. No, to do kindness. Kindness. To show compassion. `Hanna`. `Hannan` is from this. `Hannan`. And why `hannat`? It is feminine for `'uqul`. Yes. For `'uqul`. `Wa hannat`, which is like `hannan`. One who does kindness. `Wa hannat hadhihi al-'uqul al-mujarradah 'alayhi`. And these abstract intellects showed kindness... towards him... upon him. `Wa ramat bi-ashi''atiha ilayhi rahmatan lahu... wa ramat bi-ashi''atiha... bi-ashi''atiha ilayhi rahmatan lahu`. `Ashi''ah` is the plural of what? `Shu'a'`. `Shu'a'`. The plural of `shu'a'` is `ashi''ah`. `Wa ramat bi-ashi''atiha ilayhi`. And... they threw... and they cast their rays towards him. Upon his person, with their rays... towards him. Towards him. The `kainaat` (beings), all of them... As soon as he repented... `Inna Allah ghafurun rahim`. (Indeed, Allah is Forgiving, Merciful). When you ask for forgiveness, Allah does two things. You do one thing, what does Allah do? Two things. His forgiver, is it `Mub'ath al-Awwal` or `'Aql al-Awwal`? The one being addressed will be the one who is the highest. Who is it? We are saying this for his sake. Where did the supplication go? To `Mub'ath al-Awwal`. Towards whom he had committed the `zulm` (injustice). The injustice. And they threw all their rays towards him out of mercy for him. `Wa ra'fatan wa mihnanan bihi... wa ra'fatan bihi min abna'i jinsiha... abna'i jinsiha`. With their own... with their own kind. With their kind, from the `abna'-e-jins` (people of their kind). It was the Tenth Intellect. `Fa-ittasalat bihi al-mawa'id al-qusiyyah wa al-ta'idat al-'ulwiyyah`. (So the distant promises and the higher supports connected with him). And the distant promises and the higher supports connected with him. `Fa-ashraqat dhatuhu ishraqan kulliyan`. (So his essence shone with a total illumination). And his essence was illuminated... His essence shone with a total illumination. `Wa tajarrada min tilka al-zulmati 'aqlan nuraniyyan`. (And he was stripped of that darkness, becoming a luminous intellect). And... he became separate from that darkness... his intellect... becoming a luminous intellect, he became separate from that darkness. `Fa-balagha rutbat al-kamal al-thani`. (So he reached the rank of the Second Perfection). He achieved... the rank of... He achieved the rank of the `Kamal al-Thani`. When the supports came, then he attained the `Kamal al-Thani`. This is for `'Ashir`. Yes. `Wa'ntazama fi silk al-'alam al-ruhani`. (And he was ordered in the string of the spiritual world). And... he was organized... in the string of the spiritual world. `Wa sar min ahil al-'ismah wa maqamat al-rahmah raji'an ila nafsihi qa'inan min jumlat 'alam al-safa' wa qudsihi`. And he reached... the `ismah` (infallibility)... He became infallible... and the stations of mercy. And returning to his self, being from the entirety of the world of purity and its holiness. `Raji'an ila nafsihi`, what does that mean? It is... To his own self... `nafs` is the `'aql al-awwal`. Yes. `Mu'anniyan bima rumiza bihi fi al-kitab al-karim min qawlihi sami'in 'alim`. (Signifying that which was symbolized... in the Noble Book... from the saying of One who is All-Hearing, All-Knowing). Signifying the symbol that was given for him in the Noble Book, from the saying of an All-Hearing, All-Knowing one. This is for him or for `Aashir`? For `Aashir`. The Noble Book... `Ya ayyatuha al-nafsu al-mutma'innah`. (O reassured soul). He used the word `mutma'innah` for `nafs`. `Nafs` in Arabic is used as feminine. `Ya ayyatuha`. `Ayyatuha` is feminine. Not `ayyuha`. `Ayyatuha`. It is feminine. O... `ayyatuha al-nafs al-mutma'innah`. O reassured soul. The `sihah` (dictionary) of `mutma'innah`, what is its original? It's from `itminan` (reassurance). `Alif` and `nun` are extra. `Taman` (reassurance). What is its original? What are the three root letters? Is it a three-letter root or a four-letter root? `Ta-ma-na`. It's from `itminan`. `Ta'-mim-nun`. `Ta-ma-na`. You can check the dictionary. The dictionary... `Taman` (reassurance) is from this. `Mutma'in`. `Mutma'in` is in it. `Mutma'in`, the original is `ta-ma-na`. `Ta-ma-na`. `Itma'anna ya-tma'innu mutma'innun`. `Taman` is from this. "I give you reassurance." `Ya ayyatuha al-nafsu al-mutma'innatu`. (O reassured soul). O reassured soul. Return to your Lord. This is for `'Ashir`. The original is for `'Ashir`. `Irji'i`. Return. `Irji'i` is what kind of verb? It is feminine. It is a command. `Irja'`. Return. `Irji'i`. It is for a female. `Irji'i ila rabbiki`. (Return to your Lord). He used `rabbiki` (your Lord, feminine). So who is speaking this? `Ya ayyatuha al-nafsu al-mutma'innah` is the saying of `'Aql al-Awwal`. Yes. `Ya ayyatuha al-nafsu al-mutma'innah`. From where the command descended, the circle of oneness from `'Aql al-Awwal`, from there it descended. `Ya ayyatuha al-nafsu al-mutma'innah tu-rji'i`. The reassured soul... `'Ashir`. For `'Ashir`. For `'Ashir`. O reassured soul. `raji'an ila nafsihi`, then it would be... `Irji'i`... yes? Previously, `raji'an ila nafsihi` came... return to your own self. After his sins were forgiven, he was given the command to return to his Lord. `Ya ayyatuha al-nafsu al-mutma'innatu irji'i ila rabbiki`. (O reassured soul, return to your Lord). Return to your Lord. `Radiyatan mardiyyah`. (well-pleased and well-pleasing). What does this mean? Pleased with your Lord. `Radiyatan`, you yourself are also... who is `radiyah`? The reassured soul is `radiyah`. She herself is also `mardiyyah` (well-pleasing). For your Lord. `Mardiyyah`, the one with whom the other person is also pleased. You be happy, and the other person, your Lord, should also be happy. You should be happy, and your Lord should be happy. `Radiyatan mardiyyah`. `'Ashir` is happy, and all the higher spheres, `Mub'ath al-Awwal`, are all happy with his repentance. `Radiyatan mardiyyah fadkhuli fi 'ibadi`. (Well-pleased and well-pleasing, so enter among My servants). Then enter among my servants. `Wadkhuli jannati`. (And enter My Paradise). Enter my Paradise. `Jannat` (Paradise) here is what? `Mub'ath al-Awwal`'s paradise. His circle. That is his circle. `Wa huwa idhan Adam al-ruhani al-mukhbaru 'anhu bi-ay al-kitab... ba-ay al-kitab`. It's not `ba-ay`, it's `bi-ayil kitab`. Yes, `ayil kitab`. `Ayil kitab`. `Bi-ayil kitab ba'da tawbatihi wa iyabihi`. `Ayil kitab`. The plural of `ayat` is `aya`. What is this, Arabic? `Ayatun`. How many weak letters does it have? `Alif`, `waw`, `ya`. All three are weak letters. `Alif`, `alif`, `ya`. What is its original root? You will find it in the dictionary. What is its original? It's in the dictionary, `ayatun`. `Ayatun min ayatillah`. What is written in the dictionary? Is it written with `alif`, `alif`, `ya`, or something else? What is its original root? The plural of `ayatun` is `aya-tun`. `Ayil kitab`. `Wa huwa idhan Adam al-ruhani`. (And he is, then, the spiritual Adam). And he... in that case, is also the spiritual Adam. About whom the story of Adam is mentioned, in one sense, it is also `'Ashir`. An indication is made towards `'Ashir`. `'Ashir` is also meant. `Wa huwa idhan Adam al-ruhani`. He is thus the spiritual Adam. The one who informs... `Al-mukhbaru 'anhu bi-ayil kitab`. The one who gives information... for him... the verses of the book. `Ba'da tawbatihi wa iyabihi`. After his repentance and return. And return. `Fa-talaqqa Adam min rabbihi kalimatin`. (Then Adam received from his Lord words). `Fa-taba 'alayhi innahu huwa al-tawwab al-rahim`. (And He relented towards him. Indeed, He is the Accepter of repentance, the Merciful). Then... he received... Adam received from his Lord... words. `Kalimat`. Then... He accepted his repentance. He accepted his repentance, for He is the Accepter of repentance, the Merciful. The `Tawwab` (Accepter of repentance) and `Rahim` (Merciful). When a person repents, He accepts the repentance and also sends mercy. `Tawwab` and `Rahim`. The `kalimat` are these abstract intellects. The `kalimat` are these abstract intellects... the seven. And while the `kalimat`... are these seven abstract intellects. Adam received `kalimat` from his Lord. `Kalimat` means the intercession of the seven intellects. The `kalimat`. And these... are the abstract intellects, seven of them. The `kalimah`. And they are called `kalimat` because of their attribution to the First Intellect. Yes. The one who is named `Kalimah` and `Kalimatullah`... is upon him... the First Intellect. `Kalimatullah`. And these are `kalimat` because they are attributed to him. `Wa huwa al-mawsuf biha duna 'alam al-'aql`. (And he is the one described by it, to the exclusion of the world of intellect). And the one who is described by this name, from amongst the entire world of intellect. The real `kalimah` is him. The rest are attributed to him. `Alladhi qa'imun... Alladhi bihi qam al-'alam... li-nutqihi bi-kalimat al-ikhlas qabl kull natiq`. The one who established the world... was established by this... the utterance of the `kalimat al-ikhlas` (word of sincerity)... before every speaker. And that he was the one who established... it was established in that world... through the means of uttering... the `kalimat al-ikhlas`... along with this. The `kalimah la ilaha illa Allah`. Who said it first? The First Intellect. `Qabl kull natiq`. (Before every speaker). Before every speaker. `Wa huwa shahadatuhu... wa shahadatuhu li-mubdi'ihi fi ibda'ihi`. And that is his testimony... his testimony for his Originator in His origination. With this. `Wa hiya fi al-haqiqah 'ibadatuhu... al-'amaliyyah`. And that, in reality, is his practical worship. A very important point is being made here about worship. The practical worship of the First Intellect, what was it? The gnostic worship, what was it? He is explaining it here. This should be understood well, that... and he explains further. `Wa hiya fi al-haqiqah 'ibadatuhu al-'amaliyyah`. (And it is, in reality, his practical worship). What? Saying the `kalimah`, giving testimony, speaking, is his gnostic worship. Practical worship. Practical. `Wa amma 'ibadatuhu al-'ilmiyyah`. (As for his gnostic worship)... `Wa amma 'ibadatuhu al-'ilmiyyah fa-ma wujida 'alayhi min mubdi'ihi al-ta'ala ila... ilahiyyah wa wahdaniyyah`. As for his gnostic worship, it is what came into existence for him from his Exalted Originator... from His divinity and His oneness. What he thought is, in reality, gnostic worship. And what he uttered is practical worship. Is this not an indication towards contemplation? Knowledge and action. Knowledge and action. That is his. Our knowledge and action are different. We pray `namaz`, so that is practical worship. And in it... to have `khushu'` and `khuzu'` towards Allah Ta'ala is gnostic worship. So `ashraf` (more noble) and `adwan` (lower) are not there in this? In this, it is absolutely... `ashraf` is gnostic worship. Practical worship is `adwan`. Practical worship is `adwan`. Gnostic worship is `ashraf`. `Wa li-dhalika khussa bi-ism al-kalimah duna ghayrihi min al-'uqul al-taliyyah`. (And for that reason, he was specified with the name of "the Word" to the exclusion of others among the following intellects). And for this reason, he was specified with the name of `kalimah`, to the exclusion of his others, meaning the following intellects. He is called `Kalimah` because he was the first to make the `Kalimah` clear. And the gnostic and practical conditions of the `Kalimah` originated from him. `Wa summat hadhihi al-'uqul al-saba' bi-al-kalimat isti'aratan minhu lahum bi-sabab idafatihim ilayhi kama usmu bi-'alam al-'aql wa 'alam al-ibda' wa 'alam al-quds li-idafatihim ilayhi`. And these seven intellects were named `kalimat` by way of metaphor from him for them, because of their attribution to him, just as they were named the World of Intellect, the World of Origination, and the World of Holiness because of their attribution to him. These seven `kalimat`, the seven... have been named. These intellects... seven... with `kalimat`... by way of metaphor... from him... for them... because of their being attributed to him. Just as... they were named... named... the World of Intellect... World of Origination... World of Holiness... because of their being attributed to him. The real `'Alam al-'Aql`... the world of intellect belongs to whom? It is the world of the First Intellect. The World of Origination is what? The world of the First Intellect. The World of Holiness is... and all of them... are attributed to him. If he were not there, there would be nothing. `Wa kawnuhum... ghayra mansubin ilayhi`. And their being... not attributed to him. The First Intellect is not attributed to them. They are attributed to the First Intellect. `Wa bi-ikhtisasihi bi-hadhihi al-asma' duna ma siwahu li-anna al-mafdul yuzafu ila al-fazil wa al-naqis yunsabu ila al-kamil... al-ashhur al-kamil`. `al-ashhur`. He has removed `li-anna al-mafdul` in the middle. The deficient is attributed to the perfect. And because of his being specified with these names to the exclusion of his others. `al-mafdul` (the inferior) is attributed to `al-fazil` (the superior). And `al-naqis` (the deficient) is related to... `al-ashhur al-kamil` (the more famous, the perfect). The more famous, the perfect. The book from which you took this, the original book, if it was before this, from which you are quoting... No, that... the one you took it from... From this one... From this... from this, or from some other book? It's `al-ashhur` here as well. The deficient is attributed to the perfect, which is more famous. `Wa hadhihi al-'uqul al-mujarradah wa in kanat...` `Mujarrad` means what? Abstract. The one on which corporeality... is not imposed. `Mujarrad`. `Jarrada` means he separated it. Subtle intellects that are separate, separate from density. `Wa hadhihi al-'uqul al-mujarradah wa in kanat qad balaghat al-ghayah`. And these are abstract intellects. And although they have reached the utmost limit... from virtue, nobility, splendor, and perfection. `Fa-inna al-awwal qad faqaha wa ta'alaha wa samaha... bi-sabaqiyatihi laha wa fi'lihi wa 'ibadatihi wa 'ilmihi wa 'amalihi`. (Indeed, the First has surpassed them and is elevated above them and has risen high... due to his precedence over them and his action and his worship and his knowledge and his action). Then indeed, the First... has surpassed them... and is elevated above them and has risen high... due to his precedence over them, and his action, and his worship, and his knowledge, and his action. However much they advance, they cannot surpass the one who is above them. Allah's treasures have no deficiency. As much time passes, his joy and bounty will keep increasing. As much as their joy and bounty increase, in the lower spheres, in his circle, his bounties will increase even more. `Alhamdulillah... alladhi manna 'alayna bima kharramahu ghayrana wa ja'alana`. All praise is for Allah... who bestowed favor upon us... with that which He deprived our others of, and made us... `manna` is here. If there were no `tashdid` (gemination), what would you read? You would read `min`. You could read `man`, you could read `min`, you could read `mun`. `Munna` means bestow favor. `Fa-munna 'alayna`. Bestow favor. One who is not familiar with Arabic could read it differently. But `min`, what would it mean? "From". `Man` means "who". `Munna` means... bestow favor. This is in the `du'a` of `Kumayl`. `Fa-munna 'alayna`. And `manna` means what? He bestowed favor. `Munna` means bestow favor. These are Arabic constructions. `Fa-munna 'alayna`. It is from this. All praise is for Allah, who bestowed favor upon us with that which He deprived our others of. `Wa ja'alana... hamalata 'ilmihi`. (And made us... the bearers of His knowledge). And made us the bearers of His knowledge. `Fa-munna 'alayna` is in which supplication? It's in the `Du'a-e-Kumayl`. No, it's in the `Du'a-e-'Arafah`. `Fa-munna 'ala fa-qirina`. `Fa-munna 'alayya`... my... upon me, bestow favor. `Munna`. If he doesn't put the diacritics, `tashdid`... `min` has `pesh`... what would one read? One could read `mun`, one could read `man`, one could read `min`. The meaning doesn't fit. For the diacritics, to understand the meaning, `munna`. And if you say `munna` in Urdu... the one who doesn't understand will think `munna`. `Wa ja'alana min hamalata 'ilmihi`. And made us among the bearers of His knowledge. `Wa khuzzana sirrihi al-maknun`. And the treasurers of His hidden secret. The treasurers of his secret. `Wa salla Allah 'ala nabiyyihi wa alihit tahirin`. (And may Allah's blessings be upon His Prophet and his pure progeny). The Fourth `Bab` from the `Mabda' al-Awwal`, which comprises five `fusul`. The first `fasl`. The fourth `bab` has begun. The fourth `bab`... is from the `Mabda' al-Awwal`, in which five `fusul` are gathered. Among them, the first `fasl`. `Wa idh qad balagha minna al-qawlu ila ma balagha min al-kalam 'ala 'alam al-ibda' fa-nutbi'uhu al-kalam 'ala 'alam al-ajrad... fa-nutbi'uhu... fa-nutbi'uhu al-kalam 'ala 'alam al-ajrad wa ibtida' kawnuhu wa kawnu ma ba'dahu`. And when we have reached... we have reached the speech... When our speech reached... `fa'il` (subject) is `qawl` (speech). When speech from us reached... the thing which the speech reached... about the World of Origination. Then we follow it... with the speech about the World of Corporeality. And the beginning of its being and the being of what is after it. And when you have done what? The World of Life... you have left it out. After the `du'a`, he is clarifying this. And we begin its being, and what is after it. `Fa-nahulu bi-tawfiq Allah Ta'ala wa nazr waliyyihi fi ardihi salamullah 'alayhi wa barakatihi minnahu... fa-nahnu fi ufuqihi sa'irun wa fi ghayatihi balighun ha'irun fa-nahnu mansubun bi-lihazatihi qa'imun min jumlat hasanatihi innahu kana qad... qad in'azala fi zill al-mub'ath al-thani`. We say with the grace of Allah Ta'ala and the gaze of His `wali` (friend) on His earth, may the peace of Allah be upon him and His blessings... from Him... and the grace from Allah Ta'ala and the gaze of His `wali`, from His earth. May Allah's peace be upon him and His blessings... from us... No, with blessings from... `min barakatihi`. `bi-tawfiqillah`, `bi-barakatihi`. And with the blessings of that being, that we are travelers in his horizon, and we are reachers of his ultimate goal, and bewildered. So we are attributed to his glances, standing from the entirety of his good deeds. That it was that... he was separated in the shadow of the `Mub'ath al-Thani`. From the grace of Allah Ta'ala and the gaze of His `wali`, that we, in his horizon, are travelers. We are reachers of his goal. And in his goal, we are bewildered. From the blessings of that being, that we are travelers in his horizon. And we are reachers of his goal, bewildered. And we are seen by his glances. Being from the entirety of his good deeds. That he was separated... and when he was separated... then he was separate. He was separate, `tahqiq`. And when he was separated in the shadow of the `Mub'ath al-Thani`, then he became the Tenth, like a group of spirits. `Wa ba'udat bi-bu'dihi`. Those who were distanced by his distance. Meaning, they did not attain the `Kamal al-Thani`. Meaning, they were in his group, but upon seeing him, they moved away. They acted as he did. `Wa hiya munqasimatun 'ala thalathat firaqin`. And it is divided into three sections. Three groups, three sects. `Firqatun nafati al-ilahiyyah 'anha`. One group negated divinity from itself. From itself. `Wa abnay jinsiha wa athbataha li-mubdi'ihim al-ta'ala`. One group negated divinity from itself and from its own kind, and affirmed it for its Exalted Originator. A group that negated divinity from itself and from its own kind and affirmed it... for its Exalted Originator. So, did three circles form separately from `'Ashir`? Three circles formed. In the middle of all of them. After `'Ashir`, along with him, there were so many people that... who had done what? Who had these three conditions within them. In `'Ashir`'s group, there were three types... three kinds of people. He is describing those three kinds. So they are not independent of `'Ashir`. They are connected. This was before `'Ashir`'s repentance. He negated it for himself as `'Ashir` had negated it. As `'Ashir` had performed `tasbih` (glorification) and `taqdis` (sanctification). One group was that. `Wa takhata'ati al-mub'ath al-awwal wa jahilatuhu kama takhata'athu`. And they erred regarding the `Mub'ath al-Awwal` and were ignorant of it, just as he had erred regarding it. They were ignorant of him. Just as he had erred regarding him... regarding the `Mub'ath al-Awwal`. `Wa jahilu mustamliyatan 'anhu`. This means that this entire... perception (`idrak`) that is happening to `'Ashir`, it is... These are the ones who went astray. Yes. But the one who realized that "I have made a mistake," and darkness came upon him, that is not his personal perception, but everyone who is within his spheres is also perceiving it. A very large group of them... acted as he did. They too, from their own selves, are they seeing it, or are they seeing him, his essence? They are seeing... their own choice... they were exercising their own choice. Just as `'Ashir` exercised his choice, they too exercised their choice. `Mustamliyatan 'anhu`. (Deriving from him). Taking this matter from him, meaning from `'Ashir`. `Mushabbihatan bihi fi subuqihi`. Imitating him in his precedence. Along with that `'Ashir`. `Idh huwa hadduha`. When he is their limit. `Wa hiya mahduduhu`. And they were his limited ones. `Wa hiya zawjuhu wa quwwatuhu al-munfa'ilah`. And she is his spouse and his receptive faculty. She is his spouse, meaning his pair. Adam's wife. `Zola`. Adam is the spiritual `'Ashir`. And the wife is who? `Zola`. She did as `'Ashir` had done. `'Ashir` acknowledged the `Mubda'`, and did `tasbih` of the First Intellect. But he erred regarding the `Mub'ath al-Awwal`. `Zola` also did the same. `Al-muhtawiyyah 'ala ma hawahu min al-tasawwur wa al-i'tiqad wa al-tafakkur`. And the spouse... `al-muhtawiyyah 'ala ma hawahu`. (The one who contains what he contained). Encompassing what he encompassed. The one who is encompassing... for that thing... which he encompassed... that `'Ashir`. From `tasawwur` (conception), `i'tiqad` (belief), and `tafakkur` (contemplation). Just as `'Ashir`'s `tasawwur` was, `i'tiqad` was, `tafakkur` was, so was that of his spouse, `Hawwa'`, which was encompassing. It was encompassing. `Wa al-muzawajatu lahu fi dhalik`. And his spouse... and being his spouse in that matter. Being a partner. `Wa huwa Adam al-ruhani`. And he is the spiritual Adam. And this is called the spiritual Adam. `Kama sabaqa bihi al-qawl`. As the speech has preceded about it. And that is what is symbolized in the Noble Book from the saying of Allah Ta'ala... `Wa qulna ya Adam uskun anta wa zawjuka al-jannah wa kula minha raghadan haythu shi'tuma wa la taqraba hadhihi al-shajarah fa-takuna min al-zalimin`. (And We said, "O Adam, dwell, you and your wife, in Paradise and eat therefrom in [ease and] abundance from wherever you will. But do not approach this tree, lest you be of the wrongdoers."). And that is the truth of that which... the thing that was symbolized in the Noble Book from the saying of Allah Ta'ala... And We said, "O Adam, dwell, you and your wife, in Paradise. And eat from it with ease wherever you wish. And do not approach this tree, lest you be of the wrongdoers." This was one group. `Wa al-firqat al-thaniyah aqarrat bi-al-mubda'i al-ta'ala wa tarakati al-'aql al-awwal wa al-inbi'ath al-awwal wa zannat annaha wa iyyahuma fi hal al-masawat wa al-mumathalah`. And the second group affirmed the Exalted Originator and "left" the First Intellect and the First Emanation, and thought that they and those two were in a state of equality and similarity. And the second group affirmed the Exalted Originator. But they "left"... they did not believe in the First Intellect. They said that all intellects are equal. They saw the state of the First Perfection. And `Kamal al-Thani`, they denied it. And they left the First Intellect and the First Emanation and thought that they and those two, meaning the First Intellect and the First Emanation... they themselves and they... are in a state of equality and similarity. The First Intellect, the First Emanation, and we are all the same. They believe in Allah. Allah created them. This is the second group. They remain in the First Perfection. `Kamal al-Thani`, they do not enter it. `Wa al-firqat al-thalithah minhum man aqamat da'wat... fi dar al-ibda' ankarat wa takabbarat wa saddat wa istakbarat wa lam tuwahhid mubdi'aha wa la iltazamat bi-ahadin min al-'uqul wa hiya ashadd al-firaq kufran... wa a'zamuha surudan wa nukran`. `wa a'zamuha... wa hiya a'zamuha`. `Wa hiya`, the subject and predicate are there. `wa hiya ashadd al-firaq kufran`. This is its predicate. `Wa a'zamuha... wa hiya a'zamuha surudan wa nukran`. And the third group among them... And the third from among them... while... they established the `da'wah` (call) in the Abode of Origination. They denied, and became arrogant, and blocked, and acted arrogantly. And they did not affirm the oneness of their Originator. They did not affirm the oneness... of their originator. And they did not adhere to any of the intellects. And they did not adhere to any of the intellects. They did not say that Allah exists either. We created ourselves. We created ourselves. That is what he is saying. And they did not adhere to... one sect said, as `'Ashir` had done... his spouse. That they acknowledged the `mubda'`, they acknowledged the `'aql`, but they erred regarding `'Ashir`... regarding the `mub'ath al-thani`. They said they are equal. The second sect, what did they do? They said that the `mubda'` indeed exists, but the First Intellect and we are all equal. The third sect, what did they do? They said we are not... Allah did not create us, we created ourselves. From nothing. Three sects were with `'Ashir`. And they did not adhere to any of the intellects. Any of the intellects. From the nine... seven intellects. And they are the most severe of the sects in disbelief. Among the sects, they are the most severe in terms of disbelief. And the greatest among them in terms of opposition and denial. Opposition and denial. And denial. Then this... these three new sects that have formed, they too will have spheres, they will have a `nuqta` (point). So are they different beings, the three `nuqtas`? An immeasurable world. From them, the sect... from which Iblis was born... the last sect... the `nuqta`... the last sect, which denied God... Iblis was born.

...from the chapter of the fourth gate of the first part. And when repentance and turning towards God occurred from the Tenth [Intellect], as was established by his word, deliverance was made necessary for these groups, and they were tasked because he was a chief for them... deliverance was made necessary for these... these groups, and they were tasked because he was a chief for them and a cause for the error of some of them. And when repentance and turning towards God occurred from the Tenth [Intellect], as was established by his word, then it became necessary... deliverance was made necessary. Deliverance was made necessary, deliverance was made necessary for these groups... Of these... these groups... what were the three groups that were mentioned? The Originator, Ta'ala, and the First Intellect, and acknowledging that the First Intellect is separate from the Originator, Ta'ala. That is the acknowledgment of the First Intellect. Look. The equality of the Originator with the First [Intellect]. Equality. It remains. All of us together. The third group was which one? The Originator, Ta'ala... acknowledging the Originator, Ta'ala, then the First Intellect and all are equal, equal. What does it say? The third group... committed Kufr (disbelief), the most severe kind of Kufr. It denied Allah... So you, Mufaddal, are saying, when repentance and turning towards God occurred from the Tenth [Intellect], as was established by his word, and deliverance was made necessary for these... these three groups. And to give trouble... Look here. `Ulzima`, `alzamahum al-mubdi'u`. Here, instead of `ulzima`... make it active. `Alzamahum al-mubdi'u` (The Originator obligated them). Which book is this from, I don't know. In some copies... The original book is not from this... `Alzamahum al-mubda'u`. The Originator made it necessary for him, for the deliverance of these groups. `Wa kallafahu`... And... and he was tasked... these three groups... because he was the chief for them, for them. And a cause... for their error. `Wa sababan li-zalali ba'dihim` (and a cause for the error of some of them). So `zalal` (error) of some of them. `Wa huwa al-mutalabu lahum 'ala tasawwurihi wa i'tiqadihi, wa li-dhalik` (And he is the one responsible for them based on his conception and his belief, and for that reason)... And he is the one responsible for them, for his... for his conception and his belief. `Wa i'tiqad`... and for that reason... `Wa li-dhalik qila: man kasara 'azman fa-'alayhi jabruhu` (And for that reason it was said: "He who breaks a bone, upon him is its mending"). And for that reason it was said that he who... he who broke a bone, upon him is its mending. `Wa uqima fi ma fihim maqama man kana awwalan fi 'alam al-ibda'` (And he was established among them in the station of the one who was first in the World of Origination). So... he was established in it. He was established in it in the station of the First Intellect in the World of Origination. Just as the First Intellect's station was in the World of Origination, his station was among them. The First Intellect, which was the first, in the World of Origination, the First Intellect was at the first station. This, among those people who... for whom... he was made... then he... should correct it. His station became among them, the station of the First Intellect. This was the first group that... `Fa-umira bi-khalasihim` (So he was commanded for their deliverance). And the command was given for their deliverance. The First Intellect did not... Yes. So... and the command was given... 'Aql-e-'Ashir... for their deliverance. And they are explaining here that the first group that was... `Fa-khataba hadhihi al-firaq al-thalathah` (So he addressed these three groups)... So he addressed... these three groups... `Fa-nafaru wa-zajarahum` (But they refused and he rebuked them)... They denied... and he rebuked them... and he stopped them from that thing they were upon, but they did not stop. They did not stop. `Zajara` means he stopped, `inzajara` means to stop. `Wa'azahum fa-saddu wa-istakbaru` (He admonished them, but they turned away and were arrogant). And he advised... he advised them but they turned away and showed arrogance. And they showed arrogance. `Wa-zdadu zulmatan` (And they increased in darkness). So they increased... in... the darkness of... and the... of... So they deserved... `Fa-istahaqqu al-hubut wa al-tasafful wa al-suqut` (So they deserved the descent, the degradation, and the fall). So they became deserving... deserving of descent, and degradation, and the fall... and degradation. The command for descent (`hubut`) was given when? When they were admonished and did not stop. After that, the command for descent was given. `Wa imtazaja ba'duhum bi-ba'din` (And some of them mixed with others). And some of them joined with others, they began to exert influences on each other. Our saying is this, their saying is this, another saying is... `Wa tarakamu ka-tarakum al-ghuyum wa al-sahab` (And they accumulated like the accumulation of clouds and vapors). And they mingled with each other like the mingling of clouds. `Wa taharraku min zawatihim` (And they moved from their own selves). They collided. `Wa taharraku min zawatihim` (And they moved from their own selves). And they moved... And they moved... their selves... from their own selves... their selves. The first motion... the first motion... `Lazima biha al-tul` (Length became necessary from it). Length became necessary from it... from those selves... length. Meaning from that motion. From the motion. Since they moved, length became necessary from the motion. `Wa kana ibtida'u hadhihi al-harakah hararatan wa tali'an wa hamalan` (And the beginning of this motion was heat, and Aries and الحمل [Aries]). And the beginning... was... of this motion's beginning was from heat... from heat. And `tali'` (Aries) and الحمل (Aries). `Wa muntahaha burudatan wa ghariban wa mizanan` (And its end was coldness, and Libra and Mizan [Libra]). And its... its end... is coldness... is coldness and Libra and Mizan. The heat, going on, where does it end? It becomes less and less and turns towards coldness. The end is coldness. `Wa gharibin wa mizanan`. These are the names of constellations. These four constellations are created. Along with length, four constellations are created: `tali'`, `hamal`, `gharib`, and `mizan`. `Thumma taharrakat harakatan ukhra thaniyatan lazima biha al-'ard, wa kana awwalaha rutubatan wa 'ashirun wa jadyun` (Then it moved another, second motion, from which breadth became necessary, and its beginning was moisture and Capricorn and Capricorn). And then they moved... Then they moved a second... another motion, second. Breadth became necessary from it. Breadth became necessary for them because of that. First came length, then came breadth. And the beginning of that motion... was moisture. And Capricorn and Capricorn are two constellations. `Wa muntahaha rabi'an wa yubusatan wa sartanan` (And its end is Cancer and dryness and Sartan [Cancer]). And its end is Cancer and dryness and Sartan. Yes. Cancer. And its end is coldness. Libra. What is... It's written here... `Wa muntahaha rabi'an`. And its end is Cancer. `Wa yubusatan wa sartanan`. And dryness and Sartan. `Thumma taharraku harakatan thalithatan... Talabu an yatadaraku biha zawatahum` (Then they moved a third motion... They sought to remedy their own selves with it). Then... then they moved a third motion. They sought... to remedy their own selves with it. Meaning, the state of length and breadth that came upon them, a kind of alienation arose, they wanted to get out of it. `Wa waqa'u fi al-'umq` (And they fell into the depth). And they fell into the depth. `Wa kanat hadhihi al-harakat bi-qasdin min 'inayat ilahiyyah ka-'aql al-'ashir` (And these motions were with intent from Divine Grace, like the Tenth Intellect). And these three motions... are with intent from Divine Grace. Allah gave them motion with His own special will. The first motion, the second motion, the third motion. Just as the Tenth Intellect is... Just as the Tenth Intellect is, who was entrusted... `Al-muwakkal bihim`... `Wa qassadahum`. His work was entrusted to him. `Fa-qasadahum bi-al-harakah` (So He intended for them with motion)... So He intended... towards them with motion... with motion. `Li ma qama fi fikrihi an Allah khalaqa min al-da'watihi al-hadiyatihi ila umurihi al-marziyyatihi dhalika al-shay' al-mutarakib min al-da'watihi al-hanifiyyatihi wa ma sharakahum fihi al-ashbah al-suwariyyah` (Because of what was established in his thought that Allah created from his guiding call to His pleasing affairs that thing composed from his straight call and what the imaginal forms shared with them in it). And that will not be... will never be... except with a place and a time, and a great trial and a test. `Wa hina'idhin yasdu ma taraffa'a wa safa, wa yartakisu ma dama alazza wa jafa` (And at that time, that which has risen and is pure will be separated, and that which has remained base and harsh will fall back). And the wise say... The people of wisdom say, the Tenth Intellect gave the motions of length and breadth, that is the first intention. From Divine Grace. `Wa li-dhalik qalat al-hukama'`... And for that reason the wise said... Then indeed that thing... it became hayula and surah. They became hayula and surah. The surah, what did it become? Above the other... And... what was mixed became hayula. Then... The surah influences the hayula, doesn't it? The surah... the surah that was formed... in it were some things that gained precedence over it. Its effect was greater, so it became the surah. And the things that were hayula, they were... they were weak, they became hayula. `Fa-al-surah ashaffuhu wa altafuhu` (So the form is its most transparent and its most subtle)... In the mixture itself, the parts that were... more... superior... had more effect, they took the form of surah. The ones that had less effect became hayula. That is what he is saying. `Fa-al-surah ashaffuhu wa altafuhu`. So the form, it is more transparent and subtle. `Wa al-hayula aghmazuhu wa akthafuhu`. From `hayula` and `surah` both. From `hayula` and `surah` both. `Ja'alatha 'alatan fa'alatan ka-al-dhakar`. He made one of them an active instrument, like the male. And it is the world of the spheres. And the world of the spheres. `Wa ashya'an minha munfa'ilatan ka-al-untha` (And things from it that are passive like the female). They became necessary. And they gathered... and they gathered... in the form of the lines of the cross. This is the cross. `Salib`. This... this... length, this is breadth. And below it is depth. `Kama sawwarnahu` (as we have depicted it). Just as... we have... drawn its picture... we have drawn its picture. So that it may be seen. So that it may be seen. `Ju'ilat al-aflak min asfa dhalika al-shay' al-mumtazij al-mutarakim` (The spheres were made from the purest of that mingled and accumulated thing). The spheres were made... from the pure, clean part of that thing... that mixture that was formed, of all the things, of `hayula` and `surah`, from it... the part that was completely pure was taken out and the spheres were made from it. `Wa hum al-firqat al-ula` (And they are the first group)... And they are the first group. What did he say before this? Three groups were formed. They... how were the groups formed? That length, breadth, and depth came upon all of them. The groups that were formed... The first group, what was it made of? `Al-lati wahhadat al-mubdi'a wa sabbahat al-'aql al-awwal wa qaddasathu wa-i'tarafat bi-haqqihi` (The one that affirmed the Oneness of the Originator and glorified the First Intellect and sanctified it and acknowledged its right). The one that affirmed the Oneness of... the Originator, and... glorified the First Intellect, and sanctified... and acknowledged... acknowledged his right. `Li-annaha lamma khatabaha al-'aql al-'ashir ma'a al-firqatayn al-akhiratayn ba'da tawbatihi wa tanassulihi wa taklifihi khalasahum, asarrat bi-israrihima wa-stakbarat bi-istikbarihima wa-nhadarat bi-inhidarihima, fa-sarat min al-kasa'if 'arifatan 'ani al-lata'if` (Because when the Tenth Intellect addressed it along with the other two groups after his repentance, his withdrawal, and his being tasked with their deliverance, it insisted with their insistence and was arrogant with their arrogance and descended with their descent, so it became of the dense things, ignorant of the subtle things). `Sha'arat bi-ma hiya fihi wa-nadimat wa-talabat al-istiqalah wa-al-tawbah` (It became aware of the state it was in and regretted and sought pardon and repentance). Because... what is he saying? Because... that group... which... when the Tenth Intellect addressed... 'aql-e-'ashir... with the other two groups, after his repentance... after his repentance, and his withdrawal and his being tasked with their deliverance... after... after being tasked with their deliverance... they insisted with the insistence of those two... and were arrogant with the arrogance of those two... No, they... the spheres... did not insist. The spheres did not insist. No. They, the two... along with what they did, they did this too. Okay. The Tenth... No, Mumbai... the equality of the Originator with the First, it did not do that, that, "Hey, this... this acknowledgment of precedence..." When it was said to him that... so he said, "We are equal." Yes, they are equal. `Asarrat bi-israrihima`. It insisted... with the insistence of the other two groups. As they were falling, what happened? `Sha'arat bi-ma hiya fihi`. It became aware of the state it was in. `Wa nadimat`. And it regretted. And it regretted. `Wa talabat al-istiqalah wa-al-tawbah`. And it sought pardon and repentance. This was at the time of falling. After falling... the command for descent happened. Now, one group has been saved. One has been saved from sin. At the time of the Tenth Intellect's da'wah, they said, "No, you are speaking incorrectly." The Tenth Intellect and the Originator are equal. There is no difference. You are wrong. After falling, they repented from it. `Fa-lam yumkin dhalika li-kawnihia qad sarat hawiyatan fi al-inhidar` (So that was not possible because it had become one plunging in descent). No, the mistake... who is the mistake with... in the group of... No. Where is the mistake mentioned here? The mistake is not mentioned here. I am saying, in the middle part... from the pages of this book... it is mentioned. It is mentioned here. `Fa-lam yumkin dhalika`. So it was not possible... it was not possible for it to... to fall into... `hawiyatan fi al-inhidar` (one plunging in descent). So it was not possible for it... for that... for its being... that it was falling... `hawiyatan fi al-inhidar` (one plunging in descent). And they emerged from these two groups... the remaining two groups... those who did not acknowledge the First Intellect. Then that group which was also a denier of Allah, from it both groups emerged. The polytheists and the atheists. `Wa ju'ilat`... `min nadamiha wa tawbatiha 'ala hawiyyatiha wa inhidariha` (from its regret and its repentance upon its descent and its fall). Because of its regret and its repentance at the time of its fall and its descent. `Wa hadhihi surat al-ubud` (And this is the form of servitude). And this is the form of servitude. `Al-ard`... is with alif... or with 'ayn? `Al-ard`. Earth. Where humans are born. ... ... ... `Al-ard`. That is `al-'ard` (width/breadth), this is `al-ard` (earth). ... ... ... `Fa-umira bi-khalasihim` (So he was commanded for their deliverance). ... `Min dhatihi` (from its essence). ... ... The earth of Hayat (life)... is... when the command was given. In the beginning, the three groups... when they were created... they were created. What does it say? ... The Tenth Intellect, when it repented, what happened with it? With its repentance, a very big... happened. He repented. `Tabu bi-tawbatihi` (They repented with his repentance). After that, what is it? The invitations of the Tenth Intellect began. When the invitations of the Tenth Intellect began, what did they say? `Labbu nida'ahu` (They answered his call). All of them attained the second perfection. The Tenth Intellect attained it, `tabu bi-tawbatihi` attained it, and `labbu nida'ahu` attained it. After that, he was commanded, "Descend!" As soon as he was commanded to descend, a very large group said, `khata'un kallamam` (a mistake has been made). "A mistake has been made by us." So density has not yet come upon them. The command to descend is an order. Just as there is warning and admonition, what does admonition mean? Through admonition, their repentance would have happened first. Repentance happened later. So, what did they say? `Khata'un kallamam`. Their mistake was on the celestial sphere, and from them the world of Hayat was manifested. Now after that, when the command for descent was given and time passed, density was created. In density, what are these? The spheres, etc. were manifested. The first one is what? The sphere of the celestial sphere. What is its state? Imaginary density. Its density is not like this. Imaginary density. They are the three groups that we are studying. It is like a human being... a human being who wants to build a house. First, what does he do? He makes a plan. He hasn't built the house yet. He has made a plan. Where is that? In his mind. "I will build it like this." It is called imaginary. After that, the sphere of the celestial sphere is of imaginary density. Although it is dense, it is of imaginary density. After that, which one is it? The sphere of the constellations. It is denser than that. After that... the sphere of the sun... and the sphere of Saturn. The sphere of Jupiter, the sphere of Mars, the sphere of Venus, Mercury, the Moon. Seven spheres. And after that, what is it? Mothers (`ummahat`). In mothers, what is it? The sphere of fire. After that... the four mothers. The sphere of fire, after that... the sphere of air, the sphere of water, the sphere... four. The earth... four. From the sphere of the celestial sphere, these three groups were created that we are reading about. That imaginary density came... imaginary density is... for example, the command for descent was given. So, he is descending. But they have become dense. A dense body has been created. There is a difference between a dense body and an extremely dense body. One is dense, one is extremely dense. One is less dense, one is more dense. It is like the parts of the body. We have feet, we have a heart, and... the limbs that... from where the expression is... muscles are there, that is there. So, just as the intention for the limb was made, according to that, its action is.

...in the favor of the Best. And the beginning of the ordering of the world of spheres (*'aalam al-aflaak*) was like the beginning of the creation of man, thing after thing. *Shay'an ba'da shay'in* (Thing after thing). *Fa-awwaluhu munfa'ilun wa mutakawwinun*. *Fa-awwaluhu* (So its first). One second. *Fa-awwaluhu*. *Fa-awwaluhu*. *Fa-awwaluhu munfa'ilun wa mutakawwinun minhu as-Shams* (So its first to be acted upon and to be formed from it is the Sun), *allati hiya mawsulu... nuqtati al-barkar... wa mawsulu qalbi al-insan*. *Mawsulu qalbi al-insan* (connected to the heart of man). *Wa hiya markazu... wa hiya markazu al-hararati al-ghariziyyati al-munba'ithati minha ila ma fawqaha min al-kawakibi... wa tahtaha min al-kawakibi wa al-ummahaat* (And it is the center of innate heat, which is emitted from it to the planets above it... and the planets and the primary elements below it). The fifth chapter, the fourth chapter of the fifth chapter, from the first chapter. And हुई (it happened)... The beginning of the ordering of the 'alam al-aflak (world of spheres) was like the beginning of the creation of man. *Wakaana*, *kaana* is what? A verb. And *ibtidaa'* is...? So *ibtidaa'*. This is what? A predicate. *Ibtidaa'u tartibi 'aalamin aflaki* (The beginning of the ordering of the world of spheres). And the beginning of the ordering of the 'alam al-aflak (world of spheres) was like the creation of man. Little by little. Just as in a human, first a drop of fluid takes form, then it becomes a clot of blood, then from that it becomes flesh, then its limbs are formed, in the same way is the ordering of the 'alam al-aflak. *Fa-awwalu munfa'ilin* (So the first to be acted upon). So, the very first thing to accept an effect... *munfa'ilin* means the one that accepts an effect. *Fa'ala* means "he did," and *faa'il* means "the doer." *Fa'il* means the one in whom the quality of the action is always present. *Infa'ala* means that a quality of action was produced within itself. *Infa'ala*. *Munfa'il*. So, the very first thing to accept an effect and to be formed... from it... from what? From the 'alam al-aflak. Which effect did it accept? Yes? Which effect did it accept? Of the Shams (sun). Its answer is coming. The first to accept an effect, and the first to be formed from it—that is, from the 'alam al-aflak—who was it? The Shams. So, the 'alam... the 'alam al-aflak... it is performing *tadbir* (governance), and the Shams is the one that is accepting that *tadbir*... at the level of the heart? No, being *munfa'il* (acted upon). In the 'alam al-aflak, the very first thing that... whose creation occurred... whose was it? It was the Shams. In the 'alam al-aflak. The creation of the Shams. There are seven *aflak* in it. There are *kawakib* (planets), there are seven *kawakib*. So there are seven *'awalim* (worlds). There are seven in total. And in it there will be many Shams (suns)? No, one Shams. Shams is... there is one Shams, one Qamar (moon). The rest are in the *Buruj* (zodiac). Whatever there is... in the *Buruj*. Whatever has been told to us is that the *falak al-buruj* (sphere of the zodiac) is... all the... these seven... the seven that have a connection with this world... after that, all the... what are they... the *tare* (stars)... the stars are in the *falak al-buruj*. Okay. Is that its composition? Yes, and all the rest... Above it is the *falak al-muhit*. What is the *falak al-muhit* (encompassing sphere)? It is *wahmi* (conceptual). Okay. The most subtle. They call it the Atlas; there is nothing in it. The most subtle... it is subtle, but its density is *wahmi* (conceptual). Conceptual density. After that is the *falak al-buruj*, in which all the stars are. And the planets, where are they? These seven... under it are the seven planets. So, the creation of the *falak al-buruj* is not being discussed yet. No. Only and only... Now, it's just about the *aflak*. Leave the *falak al-buruj*. Okay. The *aflak* will be discussed later. So, what is the order first? *'Aql al-awwal* (the First Intellect). After that, the *Munba'ith*. After that, the seven... *'uqul* (intellects). Then the *'Ashir* (the Tenth). After the *'Ashir*, what order was explained? *Lubbu-n-nidham*. Three... After the *'Ashir*, three... *Ta'awwun, tawbah*. After that... then *khata'un, kal-lamm*. From *khata'un, kal-lamm*, what was formed? The *'alam al-hayat* (world of life). The *'alam al-hayat* was formed. After the *'alam al-hayat* was formed, what happened? Which one... the *aflak* (spheres) started to form. What happened in the *aflak*? First, the *falak al-muhit*. *Falak al-aflak*, *falak al-muhit*. After that... after the *falak al-muhit*, the *falak al-buruj*. And after that, the lower part of the world that is connected to this world, which one is it? That is called the 'alam al-aflak. The stars... the *falak al-muhit* is *wahmi*. That too is *wahmi*. The *falak al-muhit* is *wahmi*. And the *falak al-buruj* has the stars. Which revolve in their own planet... in their own orbit. And these... all the seven stars that come after this... what do they do? They revolve around the Shams. The center is the Shams. Around the Shams, the seven stars revolve. They are planets. One is stars, one is planets. Stars are those that revolve on their own... in their orbit. On their own orbit. And these are the planets. The planets revolve around the Shams. Around the Shams. So, for this reason, this... the mention of the planets... he said that the first formation is of the Shams. Just as in a human, the heart of the human is the first thing to be formed. So what is its mover (*muharrik*)? This which is revolving? That which is revolving around the Shams, and the Shams too... the Shams is the center of all powers. The Shams... in the Shams, it was the first to accept [the command]. Now all things... all its things will descend upon it. From there, all the... the beings that are to come into existence, they will receive it. Why is it in motion (*harkat*)? The motion is from that very thing. That... Yes? The *hararat* (heat) is... what is it? The circle in which... that everything... the Shams... the heat of the Shams is what causes existence. That is why... those things, humans in which they are to take effect... The essential point is that whatever progress happens, it will be through humanity. It is revolving so that human souls receive its effect and make progress, passing through the *falak al-muhit* and going to the *'alam*. This is the essential purpose. And the density has been formed. What is it? The Shams, although it is a ball of light, it is made of density (*kasafat*). Those densities will descend, come into human form, and after coming, they will be elevated. And being elevated, they will go up through the *falak al-muhit*. They are revolving. The *falak al-buruj* is also like that. Only... only the *falak al-muhit* is such that it does not descend into the world, but from there... the rest are for the *falak al-buruj*, for the *falak al-muhit*. All that are above and below, they all descend into human form. They descend into human form and from there they make progress. Motion... their life can also be... Yes. From that very thing it is connected. *Allati hiya mawsulu nuqtati al-barkar* (Which is connected to the point of the compass). That is, it is connected. *Nuqta-e-markazi*, the central point from where the compass... The Shams. All the... the stars... one is planets, one is stars. Stars are called stars. And planets are called planets. *Sayyarah*. The one that revolves. So, all the planets are revolving around it. *Wa mawsulu qalbi al-insan* (And it is connected to the heart of man). And it is connected to the heart of man's heart. *Wa hiya markazu al-hararati al-ghariziyyati* (And it is the center of innate heat). It is the center of the innate heat. That is why... so the world is not... I mean, the earth is not the axis? The earth is the axis. Shams. Humans are on the earth. Yes, but the axis of the *aflak* (spheres), the 'alam al-falak (world of the sphere), is the Shams. Its... 'alam al-aflak's is the *qalb* (heart). *Qalb*. Just as there is a heart in a human, so too, if the 'alam al-aflak is considered a human, its heart is the Shams. Okay, this is what he is saying. *Mawsulu qalbi... mawsul* (connected) it is, to the heart of man. Just as it is in the heart of man, so too, what is the heart of the 'alam al-aflak? It is the Shams. *Wa hiya markazu al-hararati al-ghariziyyati* (And it is the center of innate heat). It is the center of natural... natural heat. *Al-munba'ithati minha ila ma fawqaha min al-kawakib... wa tahtaha min al-kawakibi wa al-ummahaat* (which is emitted from it to the planets above it... and the planets and the primary elements below it). It is emitted from it... that is, from the Shams... towards its... that which is above it... the planets... which planets are above it? Three. Three are above it, three. Zuhal, Mushtari, Mirrikh. Three. And below it are three. Which ones? 'Utarid, Zuhrah, Qamar. And the *ummahaat* (primary elements) also. Its effect is also on the *ummahaat*. 'Utarid, Zuhrah, and? Qamar (moon). Bismillah al-Rahman al-Rahim. Bismillah al-Rahman al-Rahim. The second *surah* from *Kitab al-Anwar*.
It has five chapters. Page 92, the bottom of page 92.
The second *surah* is from *Kitab al-Anwar*. Five chapters are gathered in it. From which, the first chapter, in which are gathered five sections. The first section…
*Yajma'u*.
The meaning of *yajma'u* is… Look. To gather.
To be gathered…
To do the gathering.
To gather.
For "to be gathered," it is *tajamma'*.
What?
The root of *jama'a* is… if it is made transitive from intransitive, the method is…
*Jama'a* means to gather.
It doesn't mean "to be gathered."
And for "to be gathered," what is it? *Tajamma'a*.
To be gathered.
*Yajma'u* – that which gathers five chapters.
It gathers five chapters.
…*alif*…
And the meaning of *ajma'a*? *Ijma'*. To cause to be gathered. For "to be gathered," *jama'a* means to gather. And to cause to be gathered is *ajma'a*. From this comes *ijma'*, everyone's… everyone was caused to gather. And for "to be gathered," it is *tajamma'a*. In the form of *tafa''ul*, which is… intransitive meaning is produced.
*Wa lammā tamma al-alf al-thālith, istaqbala Zuhal tadbīr al-alf al-rābi' bi-murāfaqat al-shams lahu fī dhālika bi-annahu hiya min falak al-qalbahu, fa-sa'alahā al-harāra.*
And when the third millennium was completed, Zuhal (Saturn) faced the administration of the fourth thousand-year period…
…in the fourth millennium, it is mentioned again. What happened in the fourth millennium? What will happen? In the fourth millennium, who will come? Zuhal's administration. Zuhal for the whole year, 51,000 years are of Zuhal. And in it, what will happen? The companionship of Shams (the Sun) will be attained.
In the celestial sphere, it is the heart, right? Shams is the heart. Shams is at the station of the heart.

…and *yubūsa* is.
*Wa takhmīr al-mulūk wa al-dhahab wa al-yāqūt.*
And its quality…
…the leavens of the kings came…
…he did it… *takhmara*, *takhmīr* کرنا (to ferment). *Takhmīr al-mulūk* (the leavening of the kings). The leavens of the kings… came into the world. Their leavens, meaning their seeds were sown. They were not born.
There are three or four words: *khamīra* (leaven/seed), *tawallud* (birth/generation), *takwīn* (formation), and *in'iqād* (conception/coming together). In this…
*Khamīra* means the seed was sown. The seed was sown.
The seed was sown. And *tawallud* means it was born.
The whole of it was… its parts were fully…
It was born.
No, it wasn't born...
After being born…
Its initial part was born. No, the full parts never come.
What is the difference between *khamīra* and *tawallud*?
*Khamīra* means its seed was sown. For example, the seed…
Seed means what thing?
For instance, its example is that there is a tree. A tree is… what happens from it? Leaves come, flowers come, then fruits come, and so on. Then, after that, its seeds, its fruits emerge. From the fruit, the seed emerges. Now what happens? The seed, what is it? The seed is put into the earth. The act of putting it in is called *khamīra*. From it, the tree is born. Its birth is…
That is *tawallud*.
The birth of the tree… the birth of the tree. So it is not necessary that the entire tree is born. The things of the tree that are to be born in this sphere, only they will be born. There are still many spheres left. In every sphere, new things will be born, new things will be manifested from it.
This can be called genetics.
Yes.
Genes were… its genes were laid down.
*Khuld se tukhm-i 'amal ban ke yahān āye the, yahān rahen jaise ke hain wādi-i gulshan men shajar.* (From Paradise, they came here having become the seed of action; here they remain as trees do in the valley of the garden.)
In *khuld*, the seed of action… The seed of action, where was it sown? In *khuld*. Above. It became and came here. Here they remain as they are in the valley of the garden, like a tree. Here, from it, the tree is…

The fragrance of that flower will go; the flower will not go, the seed will not go. Fragrance means what? The form and the sensory soul.
*Bū-i gul ban ke abhī aur kahīn jānā hai. Abhī ashjār men bāqī hain lagne ko thamar.* (Having become the fragrance of the flower, we must now go elsewhere. Fruits are yet to come forth on the trees.)
The trees that are, in them other fruits will come. Then their fragrance will spread.
Other parts will also come.
Other… other trees will come. Then their fragrance will spread.
Until the original is completed.
Until the original is completed. Hazrat Fazlullah Shah Mukarram always used to recite this couplet at the end.
In *takwīn* and *in'iqād* also…
*Takwīn* means *kaun* (being/becoming), its becoming. *Tawallud*… *takwīn*. Its limbs… the vegetative soul was born, then its sensory soul came, the *takwīn* of the sensory soul happened, then the *takwīn* of the rational soul happened, then with knowledge and action it was moved forward. *Takwīn*.
Meaning its development.
Development. The development of the part.
*Takhmīr* means this is what came into the dimensions. In the Realm of Intentions, the kings, etc., were not…
The seed was sown.
…that came into the dimensions.
The seed was sown.
The world of… since the celestial spheres are being formed, so it came into the dimensions.
In it, the… the… the work we had done there, in the Realm of Intentions… in the Realm of Intentions, the kings… there were some entities who… due to their accumulation of good deeds, they… some of their… because of the accumulation of their good deeds, they created kingly qualities, qualities of ownership were created. Because of the accumulation of their good deeds. Because of their good deeds. The reward for good deeds is being received; a siyāsat (polity), here dominion is being received, and… caliphate is being received, here the comforts of the world are being received. The good deeds of that place are what are being useful here. What was done there, its leaven, the leaven of the kings, was made here. Where? On earth.
