Every *qā'im* gets his thousand years from them. From that station, from the *barzakh*. And that is the praiseworthy *barzakh*. You have stated that every seventh one... gathers the previous six. So what is the nature of the second and seventh? In a series of seven, the seventh and the second, what are their two qualities? Strength is gained... In the sixth and seventh... what happens is that the seventh has a special station. That seventh one, what does he do? He has six seats with him. When the six seats are gathered, those six seats... he is... he is made the helper for them. When those six seats are prepared with him, now when the seventh comes, then in reality, the seventh of the first one, for them, what does he become? The second one becomes the resident. Their true resident is who? The seventh of the first one. And just as when there are 49 Imams, who is their real resident? The 49th... the first resident who was there, he becomes their resident. The vicegerent of the universal is universal, and the vicegerent of the partial is partial. One *Imām* establishes the Imamate of the one after him. In one level. After that, when he gathers two ranks, the one with two ranks, like the seventh *Imām* who is there, he establishes the seventh one. Who is his true vicegerent? The seventh one is the true vicegerent. His universal... all seven... that *bū'iyyat* (station)... it has ten ranks. That *bū'iyyat*. The seventh one being there, is one of its ten ranks. Of the rank that the person is, that rank is bestowed upon him. It happens from the *barzakh*. The fourth? The fourth gains strength. It doesn't have *bū'iyyat*. *Shamsiyyat* (sun-like quality) strength is gained. The strength of governance is gained. Suppose we understand that Mawlana Ali ibn Abi Talib was established in the Imamate by Mawlana Abu Talib. But there are successions and many other ranks above, they won't bring up Mawlana Abu Talib's name. There are other ranks too. The rank in which Mawlana Abu Talib was, in a partial way, he established Ali in the Imamate. When Mawlana Abu Talib's rank increased and reached the stages of *fatḥiyyat* (victory), then from the stages of *fatḥiyyat*, you have a different connection. You are not in those stages of Imamate. His rank is higher than yours. The strength of prophecy, messengership... Prophecy, messengership, Imamate, vicegerency. Prophecy... was given to the Messenger. Prophecy was given. With him... And what did he get? Imamate... in that he... the hijab (veil) was... *Wa-huwa al-barzakh al-maḥmūd al-mu'addu li-ahl al-khayr* (And it is the praiseworthy barzakh, prepared for the people of good). And it is that *barzakh*... noble *barzakh*, praiseworthy *barzakh*, which was prepared for the people of good. As for the blameworthy *barzakh*, the discourse will come upon it, the discourse will come upon it in its place, *inshā'allāh Ta'ālā*, if Allah the Exalted wills. And the completion of their number is that they complete 124,000 *ṣūrahs* (forms). The number... The period is 7,000 years. Their number... For going into the *barzakh*, the completion of their number is that they complete 1,24,000 *ṣūrahs*. As for their period, it is 7,000 years. For the completion of their period, it is 7,000 years. They have been in the cycle of unveiling for 7,000 years. In that, they... 1,24,000... *ṣūrahs* will be completed. Then they will all go into the *barzakh*. 1,24,000 *ṣūrahs* in 7,000 years. 4 and 2 are 6, and 1, how many is that? 7. If you add 1,24,000, what do you get? 7. And 7,000 years. In 7,000 years, 1,24,000 *ṣūrahs* are completed. *Fa-'inda wafā'ihā yaqūmu qā'imuhum mustakhrajan min da'wati abīhi ka-istikhrajihim* (Then, upon its completion, their *qā'im* will rise, extracted from the mission of his father, like their extraction). Then, near the completion of that, the 7,000 years, a *qā'im* will rise. Extracted... the *qā'im* of the cycle... the one who completes the 1,24,000 *ṣūrahs*, he is the one who brings out, from his mission, from his father's mission... The father's mission... extracted... a point that he has... The one who has gathered 7,000 years... There are many points with him, of the first *mawr*, of the second *ibdā'iyyah*. One point is what? The point of the *qā'im*. That point of the *qā'im*... he is at the rank of the father. He establishes him. *Fa-yattaṣilu bihī hādhihi al-maqāmāt al-mawqūfah fī al-barzakh* (Then these stations that were stopped in the barzakh will connect with him). And they will be connected... that *qā'im* of 7,000 years... these stations that were stopped in that *barzakh*... 1,24,000... 7,000 years of *ṣūrahs* that are there... The seats are there. Those... who will give them? The second *ibdā'iyyah* will gift them to the *qā'im*. The *qā'im* of 7,000 years. *Fa-yakūnu kullu wāḥidin minhum 'uḍwan min a'ḍā'i haykalihi al-nūrānī al-laṭīf* (Then each one of them will be a limb from the limbs of his luminous, subtle structure). And every one of them will be a limb, from the limbs of his structure... of that human limb, of that luminous, subtle structure. *Fa-yakūnu laṭīfuhu lahum ka'l-rūḥi li'l-jism* (Then his subtle one will be for them like the spirit for the body). And his subtle one, meaning the *qā'im*'s subtle one, will be for them like the spirit is for the body which was for them. They will become the body, he will become the spirit. And with his coming together and theirs, they will have the power to ascend to that lofty rank. And by his coming together, meaning by that spirit's coming together, and by his body's coming together... by that *qā'im*'s coming together... and by all those 7,000 years of *ṣūrahs*' coming together... they will have the power to ascend to that lofty rank. A level... in the circles of the tenth... they will attain one level. They will stop in the *barzakh*... The circles of the tenth are with the second *ibdā'iyyah*. From that, they will attain one rank. *Fa-yaṣīrūna wa-iyyāhu haykalan nūrāniyyan ilāhiyyan* (Then they and he will become a luminous, divine structure). And they and he will become one structure, a luminous, divine structure. *Fa-'inda mufāraqatihi li-jismihi wa-intiqālihi min hādhihi al-dār, yaṣīru 'aqlan qudsāniyyan mujarradan ilāhiyyan qad jarā fīhi mā jarā fī al-'uqūl al-mujarradah al-'āliyah* (Then, upon his departure from his body and his passing from this abode, he will become a holy, abstract, divine intellect, in which will flow what flowed in the high, abstract intellects). And near the departure... his departure from his body and his passing from this house, he will become an intellect, a holy, abstract, divine intellect, in which will flow what flowed in it... which flowed in the high, abstract intellects. *Fa-lā yakūnu baynahu wa-baynahum farqun illā bi-rutbat al-sabq lā ghayr* (And there will be no difference between him and them except by the rank of precedence, nothing else). And there will not be between that *qā'im* and them, who are above him, any difference except for the rank of precedence, other than that, nothing else. A great world this is. That is why they say that the universal is universal, the partial is partial. With the universal, there are... with this *qā'im*, all the believers will also be there. Now, if you say that all the believers ascended, so did they become greater than the future Imams? Or greater than the future *qā'ims*? Now what will happen? He will stop there. The third... the seventh *qā'im* when he comes, then all seven *qā'ims* that are there, they will be attached to the seventh *qā'im*. Here it is stated that the rank of precedence will remain. The rank of precedence... For us, the choice that has been given to us in the world of intention, it is given in such a way that the point we have to reach in the world of intention, to cross that, whether you hurry or are slow, or delay... the limits and the *du'āt* (missionaries) that are there... when they go into the structure of the seventh one, into the structure of the seventh *qā'im*, then there, a hierarchy will be established. There will be a hierarchy of Imams, there will be a hierarchy of believers. With the seventh one. Then after that, when the *qā'im* of the cycle of *sitr* (concealment) manifests, then there he will gather everyone. There, a hierarchy will not be there. That way it is. But the rank of precedence is a different matter. In the world of intention... in the world of intention, if we are behind someone, then we will necessarily remain behind. Unless we made an effort in the cycles... the cycles have the ability to change. One can move forward. In the world of intention, one can also move forward from one's point. *Wa-li-dhālika qāla nāṭiqu al-dawr ṣalawātu'llāhi 'alayh* (And for that reason, the speaker of the cycle, blessings of Allah be upon him, said). And for this reason, the *nāṭiq* of the cycle said, may Allah's blessings be upon you. *Inna li'llāhi Ta'ālā mi'at alf nabiyyin wa-arba'at wa-'ishrīn alf nabiyyin, mushīran ilā hādha al-haykal al-sharīf al-'aẓīm* (Indeed, for Allah the Exalted there are a hundred thousand prophets and twenty-four thousand prophets, alluding to this noble, great structure). And for this reason, the *nāṭiq* said, may the blessings of Allah be upon you, that indeed for Allah the Majestic, for Allah Ta'ala, there are 100,000 prophets and 124,000 prophets, who allude to his noble, great structure. *Wa-ilayhi ashāra al-kitābu al-karīmu bi-qawlihi Ta'ālā* (And to it the Noble Book alluded with His, the Exalted's, saying). And to it, the Noble Book alluded with the saying of Allah the Majestic. *Qul inna al-awwalīna wa'l-ākhirīna la-majmū'ūna ilā mīqāti yawmin ma'lūm* (Say, indeed, the first and the last will surely be gathered for the appointed time of a known day). Say, O Prophet, indeed the first ones and the last ones will surely be gathered for the appointed time of a known day. For the *qā'im* of 7,000 years. The cycle of unveiling, the *qā'im* of 7,000 years, he said for him. It applies to the last *qā'im*. *Fa-huwa 'alā dhikrihi al-salām al-mīqātu al-mujtama'u ilayhi* (So he, peace be upon his mention, is the appointed time to which they are gathered). The last one. Okay. First and last. The last. First going and last coming. *Wa'l-yawmu al-ma'lūmu huwa dawruhu* (And the known day is his cycle). And that known day is his cycle. *A'nī dawr al-kashfi alladhī huwa khamsūna alf sanah* (I mean the cycle of unveiling, which is fifty thousand years). Meaning, it is alluded to the cycle of unveiling, such that it is of 50,000 years. *Wa-bi-dhālika naṭaqa al-kitābu al-karīmu ḥaythu qāla Ta'ālā: Fī yawmin kāna miqdāruhu khamsīna alf sanah* (And with that the Noble Book spoke when He, the Exalted, said: "In a day whose measure is fifty thousand years"). And about this, the Noble Book has spoken, as Allah the Majestic said, that in a day whose measure is 50,000 years. The last... the final cycle of unveiling. *Wa-'inda qiyāmi hādha al-qā'imi 'alā dhikrihi al-salām yaqa'u al-ḥisābu bayna yadayhi wa-ilayhi al-thawābu wa'l-'iqābu* (And at the rising of this *qā'im*, peace be upon his mention, the reckoning will take place before him, and to him belongs the reward and the punishment). Upon the rising of this *qā'im*... of the *qā'im* of 50,000 years... upon his rising, upon whose mention be peace... the reckoning will take place before you, and to you belongs the reward, and to you belongs the punishment. Meaning, in your hands is the share of reward and punishment. *Thumma yastakhriju min da'watihi man yakūnu lahu waladan yakhlufuhu fī maqāmihi* (Then he will bring out from his mission one who will be a son for him, who will succeed him in his station). Then you will bring out from your mission those who will be for you a son who will take your succession in your station. *Wa-yunaṣṣu 'alayhi wa-yantaqilu ṣā'idan ilā martabat al-'aql al-'āshir* (And he will be designated by *naṣṣ*, and he will ascend to the rank of the tenth intellect). And a ruling will be conferred upon you, and he, you... *qā'im*... who? You mean *qā'im*... the *qā'im* of the unveiling. The *qā'im* of the unveiling will confer a ruling upon his son. And he will pass on, ascending, towards the rank of the tenth intellect. Here, the rank of the tenth intellect is mentioned everywhere. The rank of the tenth intellect. *Fa-yakhlufu dhālika al-shakhs al-awwal alladhī ṣāra mudabbiran li-'ālam al-ṭabī'ah* (Then he will succeed that first person who had become the governor of the world of nature). And they will be the successor... you... of that first person. As if he had become... they will be the successor of that first person. Who had become the governor of the world of nature. His governor... he had become the governor of the world of nature. *Wa-yaṣīru 'iwaḍan minhu mudabbiran li-'ālam al-kawn wa'l-fasād* (And he will become, in his place, a governor of the world of generation and corruption). And they will become, in his stead, from his side, the governor of the world of generation and corruption. In a partial way. The *qā'im* of 50,000 years... The *qā'im* of 50,000 years. So seven... where did the 39,000 years go? That is... from the *ṣūrah*. We... we are in the seventh *sitr* (cycle of concealment), and before us, seven unveilings have occurred. So the last *qā'im* of the seventh unveiling, he is the governor of this *sitr*. He is the governor of this *sitr*. *Wa-yaṣīru 'iwaḍan minhu mudabbiran li-'ālam al-kawn wa'l-fasād* (And he will become, in his place, a governor of the world of generation and corruption). And they will become, as a substitute from his side, the governor of the world of generation and corruption. *Wa-yas'adu dhālika ilā rutbat al-'aql al-tāsi'* (And that one will ascend to the rank of the ninth intellect). And they will ascend towards the rank of the ninth intellect. As they had ascended... as they had ascended before this, the one who was before him. As they had ascended, who were before this. *Wa-taraqqā al-'uqūl min rutbatin ilā rutbatin* (And the intellects will ascend from one rank to another). And they will pass on... the intellects... from one rank to another. *Ka-taraqqīhim awwalan 'alā hādha al-namaṭ yakūnu al-amru abadan sarmadan* (Like their first ascent in this pattern, the matter will be forever and ever). Their passing on, one after another, in this very manner, this matter will be forever and ever.

0, 8, 3, 11... 10... there were 10 of these... He has 8. 8... 3 are nasari... 8 and 3 are nasari... There are 4 nasari... there were 10 of these... he has 8... 7, 8, 8 have come. Hibbatullah has one. One has come with us. Bismillah al-Rahman al-Rahim. Al-Fasl al-Thani min al-Bab al-Thalith min al-Suradiq al-Thani. The Second Chapter from the Third Gate of the Second Pavilion. The second chapter, from the third gate, from the second curtain. `wa la yazal 'ala wafa'i kulli saba'at alaf sana qa'imun yaqumu ka-mithli hadha al-qa'im al-mutaqaddim 'alayhi al-qawl ila wafa'i khamsina alf sana.` (And so it continues, upon the completion of every seven thousand years, a Qa'im arises like this Qa'im about whom the statement was previously made, up to the completion of fifty thousand years.) And in this way, it passes, upon the completion of 7,000 years. A Qa'im, one who performs qiyam, is like this Qa'im whose statement has passed, towards 50,000 years. The one who was mentioned earlier, the Qa'im of the 50,000-year cycle of kashf, in the same way, the Qa'im of 7,000 years will also be. After the passing of the Jussa-i Ibtida'iyyah, their farzand, who is the Imam, becomes their khalifah in a juzwi sense. In a juzwi sense. And in the ufuq of the nashi'at, their one nishist is established. And on that nishist, a Qa'im resides, until the 7,000 years of the dawr al-kashf are completed. Then 124,000 suratayn appear during that time, and the Qa'im-i Saba'at Alf (Qa'im of 7,000) is established in the dawr al-kashf. When he is established, the Jussa-i Ibtida'iyyah entrusts the suratayn of those 7,000 years to him. His own farzand. The suratayn of the Imams. Qa'im. Qa'im. He entrusts them to the Qa'im of Saba'at Alf. Mawlana, a question is arising that, regarding the Jussa-i Ibtida'iyyah, you have said that the tadbir-i kull is in your hand. So, for example, the qawanin-i fitrat, that, say, two and two make four, or that two hydrogen and one oxygen combine to make water... so, this is also their tadbir? That is, the tadbirayn that have been appointed in the nashi'at... fire, air, water, earth... rutubat, burudat, yubusat, and hararat have been created. All of it, entirely... Ah, it's there. Because there are also juzwi qawanin, for example, viruses come, plagues come... these... Yes, from that same thing, that which is appointed... viruses and so on, what are they all? They are ajza', which are kharab ajza' (corrupted particles). They become connected with him and stay with him. They come as viruses. That is also a tadbir, isn't it? It is a tadbir, but that is a magnet. In the previous sphere, he maintained his connection with it, so here, that magnet will surely come and meet him. Unless he made a tadbir through some du'a that in the future, he should not acquire that thing, that is possible. The remaining qisasat will definitely happen. Allah Ta'ala forgives His own sins, but the sins of the servants, only the servants can forgive. This is upon them. So now, this has been stated to us, that the Jussa-i Ibtida'iyyah... upon him... his tadbir is over the entire kawr. The entire mawr. The entire kawr. The first Jussa-i Ibtida'iyyah. The Jussa-i Ibtida'iyyah of the kawr. His tadbir dominates the entire kawr. Now, with him, a nishist is formed for his farzand. The juzwi... the juzwi of the juzwi. And in it, when the 7,000 years... when he performs the qiyam of the dawr al-kashf, he goes and sits on one of the seven kursiyan. The 7,000 years of the dawr al-kashf. The 7,000 years of the dawr al-kashf. The Jussa-i Ibtida'iyyah entrusts the a'immah of the 7,000 years to him. From that, his haykal is formed. Whose? The Qa'im of the 7,000 years. So he acquires one kursi. One kursi from the seven kursiyan. One kursi. Which is the essence of the seven. The 7,000 years... the one kursi of 7,000 years. The one kursi of 7,000 years. After that... until the 50,000 years, in this way seven kursiyan are established. `wa qama al-Qa'im al-Sabi'`. And the seventh Qa'im performs qiyam. `wa yakunu lahu`, so it is for you... `wa yakunu lahu qama qiyam al-sabi' fa-yakunu lahu min al-quwwah wa al-sharaf wa al-fazl ma lam yakun li-ahadin taqaddamahu min sittatin mutaqaddim dhikruha`. (And when the seventh Qa'im stands, he will have such power, honor, and grace as none of the preceding six whose mention has passed had). So it is that... I mean, this Qa'im al-Sabi' who is... is he from the 57,000 years? Not 50,000... 50,000... 50,000 is over. There are 7,000 years... 51,000. 50,000 years have already been mentioned. This is not for 50,000 years. It is his mention. `ila wafa'`. `wa qama al-Qa'im al-Sabi'`. And the Qa'im al-Sabi' performs zuhur. Meaning, the last Qa'im of the kashf. The last Qa'im. So it will be for him, power and honor and grace which will not be for anyone else, who has passed before him from the six whose mention has passed. He will not only gather the things of the 7,000 years of his era, but he will also have six afrad who will be the highest. Who will they be? The six qawa'im. Each Qa'im who gathers the 7,000 years. First, they will acquire the things of their own dawr. They will acquire the things... the last 7,000 years, they will acquire all its things. After that, they will... the six qawa'im of the dawr al-kashf... the qawa'im, the Imams... the qawa'im that they got, they will acquire them from the Jussa-i Ibtida'iyyah. Through their barzakh. Through their barzakh. `li-annahu yaqumu lahum maqam al-khalq al-akhar` (because he stands for them in the station of the 'other creation'). Because he, who is the Qa'im... the last Qa'im who will be, they will be established for them in the station of the khalq-i akhar. `alladhi huwa al-ruh li-al-jism` (which is the spirit for the body). Who is like the ruh for the jism. `wa huwa muntaha dawr al-kashf` (and he is the culmination of the cycle of kashf). And the dawr al-kashf culminates in them. He is the muntaha (culmination) of the dawr al-kashf. The ruh for whose jism? The ruh of the jism. Just as the ruh is for the jism... Ah, I see, like that. So in the dawr al-kashf, the Qa'im who is... they are the ruh for the jism. For its jism. For the six qawa'im. They are the jism for it. Ah, I see. `wa 'inda nuqlatihi wa-inqida'i dawrihi ibtida'u dawr al-sitr`. No, it is... this is the mubtada', that is the khabar. `wa 'inda nuqlatihi wa-inqida'i dawrihi ibtida'u dawr al-sitr`. And near his intiqal (passing), that is, the intiqal of that Qa'im al-Sabi', and the completion of their dawr, the ibtida' (beginning) of the dawr al-sitr occurs. `fa-yaqumu waladuhu salamullahi 'alayhi ba'dahu`. And after them, their farzand will perform qiyam. May the salam of Allah Ta'ala be upon him after you. Upon you. `fa-yaqi'u fi al-da'wah zu'fun`. So zu'f (weakness) will occur in the da'wah. Weakness, feebleness. `li-anna dawr al-kashfi qad intaha ila amadih`. Because the dawr al-kashf has reached its amad (term). It has reached its kamal (perfection). `wa balagha al-kitabu ajalahu`. And the kitab has reached its kamaliyyat (perfection). `wa nihayat haddihi`. And the nihayat (end) of its hadd (limit). `wa la yazal yatamada dhalika al-zu'fu shay'an ba'da shay'in`. And in this way, that weakness continues to find permanence, increasing little by little, from one thing to another thing. One after another, the weakness increases. `wa yazdadu khumulan`. And so much so that negligence increases. `wa dusuran`. And your... poverty increases... dusur means... تنگدستی (poverty) `dusur`. `dusur` means tightness. `dusur` refers to a blanket. `dusur` means... darkness. In comparison to the other... `dasara`. `mayl kuchayl` (dirty and soiled). `mudassar` is from the same root. `dasar`. `mayl kuchayl`. The one who wears a blanket. `mayl kuchayl`. `mudassar`. `mayl kuchayl` is said. What? `askarun dasaruhu`. Very... `dasar` means... `dusur`. `dusur`. Laziness, negligence. Yes. Laziness, negligence is created. Laziness and negligence. `dusur`. `khumulan wa dusuran`. It increases. `ila an tantamisa al-da'watu`. Until the da'wah becomes eclipsed. `wa tabqa fi halat tasattur`. And it remains in a state of concealment (`tasattur`). `wa la yatazahharu bi-shay'in minha illa khafiyyatan bayna ahliha wa ramzan wa isharatan`. And nothing of it becomes apparent except secretly, among its people, through symbols and indications. `wa la yakunu 'ilmun zahirun illa 'ilm al-hindisa wa al-nujum wa ghayr dhalika min 'ulum al-riyadiyyah`. And there will be no apparent knowledge except the knowledge of engineering, astronomy, and other mathematical sciences. The engineering. Engineering. These are the special characteristics of the dawr al-sitr. Yes, the special characteristics of the dawr al-sitr. The haqa'iq become hidden. The zahiri 'ulum... the zahiri 'ulum spread. `wa yakunu al-a'immatu salamullahi 'alayhim fi ghayat al-taqiyyah wa al-sitr`. And the a'immah, salamullahi 'alayhim, are in extreme taqiyyah and sitr. `wa takunu aydi al-azdad ghalibatan 'aliyatan`. And the hands of the opponents are dominant and lofty. Why is `ghalibatan`, the feminine form, used here? `Aydi`. The opponents. `Aydi al-azdad`. `Azdad` is masculine, isn't it? It is plural. It's the plural of `yadd`. Yes. `Aydi`... `yadd` is feminine. `yadd` is feminine. `Aydi` is feminine. That is why... but `azdad`... they have intellect (`zawi al-'aql`), don't they? `Azdad` are... `zidd` is the singular, `azdad` is the plural. But it is used as masculine. Here it is feminine... why is `ghalibatan` used? Because of `aydi`. Because of `aydi`. But `aydi`... all the parts of the body are feminine. `Ghayr dhawi al-'aql` (non-intelligent beings) and limbs are feminine. `Aydi`... Besides that, it is also a `jama' mukassar` (broken plural). The rule is that for a `jama' mukassar`... But `aydi`, if it is the plural of a `dhawi al-'aql` (intelligent being), it should be masculine, not broken... The physical limbs... if it's for non-`dhawi al-'aql`, then it is considered feminine. `ghalibatan 'aliyatan`. Dominant and lofty. `wa umuruhum 'ala ahsan-i ha jariyatan ila wafa'i thalathat alaf sana`. And their affairs, that is, the affairs of the a'immah salawatullah 'alayhim, proceed in the best state until the completion of 3,000 years. `wa qama awwal mutaqa'idi dawr al-sitr wa huwa Adam 'ala dhikrihi al-salam`. And the first of the `mutaqa'idin` of the dawr al-sitr performed qiyam, and he is Adam, 'ala dhikrihi al-salam. We were reading with Sayyidna Shah Sahib Muqaddas. There, the understanding was that after 50,000 years, there would be 3,000 years of `fatrat`. So Sayyidna Malik is saying it's not like that. Wherever they have said it, it is because of this phrase here... the last 3,000 years of the dawr al-kashf, they are the `dawr al-fatrat`. In the dawr al-kashf, two types of suratayn appear. One is based on haqiqat, in those 3,000 years. Those are the suratayn of the dawr al-kashf. And those which are such suratayn that will be the future bearers of the concepts of the `dawr al-sitr`, they will come into process. They... that is called the `dawr al-fatrat`. The last 3,000 years of the `dawr al-kashf`. Then he explained that there are 57,000 years. 50,000 of the `dawr al-kashf`, 7,000 of the `dawr al-sitr`. If you multiply 57,000 by 7, how much is it? 399,000 years. If you add 1,000 years, it becomes 400,000 years. Otherwise, the calculation becomes wrong. If there are 7,000 years and 3,000 years, and then 7,000 years, the calculation becomes wrong. Is it `fitrat` or `fatrat`? `Fatrat`. Laziness. There is a `fathah` on the `fa`. `fatrat`. Laziness. `fatrat`. `wa huwa Adam 'ala dhikrihi al-salam`. And he, the first `mutaqa'id`, is Adam, 'ala dhikrihi al-salam. The first `mutaqa'id` of the `dawr al-sitr`. `wa huwa Adamu 'ala dhikrihi al-salam`. `fa-yakunu al-amru bi-khilafi ma kana 'alayhi fi al-thalathat alaf al-mutaqaddimah`. So the affair will be contrary to how it was in the preceding 3,000 years. `wa yustaqbalu saba'at alaf sana`. And 7,000 years will be in the future. In the future. `wa sa-ya'ti 'ala dhalika al-qawlu insha'Allahu Ta'ala`. In the future, 7,000 years will come. And soon the statement on this matter will come. `insha'Allahu`. Insha'Allah. `Al-Fasl al-Thalith min al-Bab al-Thalith min al-Suradiq al-Thani`. `thumma innahu 'ala wafa'i hadhihi al-thalathat alaf sana yuqimu imamu dhalika al-zaman naatiqan`. `yuqimu imamu dhalika al-zaman naatiqan wa huwa Adam 'alayhi al-salam`. `fa-yuqimu lahu hududan wa yuqanninu lahu qawaninan wa yusunnu sununan`. `yusunnu sununan wa yad'u ila 'ibadatillahi ta'ala wa tawhidihi bi-amri dhalika al-imam alladhi huwa sahib al-zaman salamullahi 'alayhi`. `sanna yusunnu`. `sanna yusunnu` means to cause to be enacted. `sanna` means `sunnah jari karna` (to establish a sunnah). `sanna` to `yusunnu`. `yusunnu sununan`. `wa yusanninu`. `wa sannana`. That is also correct. It is in the meaning of its transitive form. `asanna yusinnu`. `sannana yusanninu`. Both are correct. `wa yusunnu sununan`. And he is Adam, 'alayhi al-salam. So after that... what did he say? `yuqimu imamu dhalika al-zaman naatiqan`. The Imam of that zaman will establish... the Imam of that zaman is the naatiq. The Imam of that zaman will establish a naatiq, and he is Adam, 'alayhi al-salam. Who is he? He is not the Imam. The naatiq is Adam, 'alayhi al-salam. The Imams of that zaman, they will establish the naatiq. And who is that naatiq? He is Adam, 'alayhi al-salam. And that Adam, 'alayhi al-salam... Janab Imam Hunayd alayhis salatu was salam. So in kashf, all this will not happen. There will be no nutaqa' in kashf. There will be no nutaqa'. There will be mustawda'in. In kashf, it is the station of mustawda'in. Janab Adam is from the mustawda'in. `wa yuqimu lahu hududan`. And the Imam of the zaman will establish for that Adam, 'alayhi al-salam, hudud. And he will enact laws for you, for Adam, 'alayhi al-salam. And he will establish sunan for you. `wa yad'u ila 'ibadatillahi Ta'ala`. And he will call towards the worship of Allah Ta'ala. He means Adam, 'alayhi al-salam, will call the servants of Allah. By the command of that Imam. By the command of that Imam, who is the Sahib al-Zaman, may the salam of Allah Ta'ala be upon him. What is your name? Mine... Hunayd. Janab Hunayd. Janab Adam's name is Abdullah bin Tayjun bin Taykhum. Shahbad Warith. `wa yashra'u shar'an wa yaza'u wad'an zahiran yaj'aluhu rumuzan wa isharatin ila ma'rifati hududillahi al-ruhaniyyah wa al-jismaniyyah`. And he will establish a shari'ah. He will choose a path. He will enact the shari'ah. He will enact the shari'ah and establish... he will establish a rite, an outward rite. He will make it... he will make it symbols... he will make it symbols and indications towards the ma'rifah of the hudud of Allah, which are ruhani and jismani. `al-dallati 'ala tawhidillahi wa ibtida'i`. Which indicate... those hudud will indicate the tawhid of Allah. `wa ibtida'u dhalika zu'fun sa'irun ila quwwatin`. And the beginning of that matter, of that dawr, will be with zu'f (weakness). It is from weakness. The beginning of that is from weakness. `sa'irun ila quwwah` (moving towards strength). Which moves... the strength that moves. `li-annahu yaqumu maqam al-sulalah`. Because Adam, 'alayhi al-salam, will be established in the station of the sulalah. The station of sulalah. And what is the second station? The nutfah. Then... `alaqah`. Then... `mudghah`. Then... `izam`. Then... `lahm`. Then... `khalqan akhar`. Where is the sulalah? In the father and mother. The essences that gather are the sulalah. What Allah Ta'ala... the essences that are to appear from fire, air, water, and earth, He brings them and deposits them in the father and mother. They are called sulalah. And from that... it is in the mother's womb as well. It is in the mother and the father. In both. The sulalah is in both. It has been explained. `sulalah` means... it comes from `sulul`, which means a chain. The one that is pulled. You said that Allah created Adam 'alayhissalam, but did not create him from mud... The Imam is Hunayd 'alayhissalam. Yes. Allah. He addressed him and commanded him, Janab Adam, as He addressed him in the Holy Qur'an. `wa la yazalu dhalika kadhalika ila an yuqima lahu asasan yakhlufuhu fi ummatihi`. And so the cycle will continue in this way until... until he establishes for himself an asas, who will be his khalifah in his ummah. Janab Adam will establish an asas for himself. `yakhlufuhu fi ummatihi`. Who will succeed... your own... in your ummah. In your ummah. `wa-intaqala ila dar karamihillahi ta'ala`. And he passed away towards the abode of Allah Ta'ala's honor. `wa jarat al-imamatu mutasalsilatan min imamin ila imamin ila wafa'i dawrihi`. Shith. Adam's vicegerent was Habil. Habil passed away. After that, Shith was born. Janab Shith. `wa qama ba'dahu al-naatiq al-thani`. What did the Prophet, 'alayhis salam, say? That for every prophet, there is an enemy. The enemy... for every prophet... `wa li-yaduwwin`. For every prophet, there is an enemy, a devil. And in the `dawr al-sitr`, they appeared precisely for this reason, that their enemy appeared before them. As a defense, what would you say? Abu Lahab was apparent. Abu Lahab, Abu Jahl. And from within, who used to do this? They used to practice hypocrisy. I happened to attend a Shi'a majlis. So I said, "The enemies of the Prophet, salawatullah 'alayhi... I will name them. I will say the name." He said, "Say it, say it." I said, "There was a 'Bu', a 'Bu'." He said, "Then say it, who was 'Bu'? Which 'Bu'?" I said, "There was a 'Bu', there was a 'Bu', there was a 'Bu'." Now everyone started making a noise, "Say it, say it." What was the meaning? Abu Jahl, Abu Lahab, and Abu Bakr. `wa qama Ibrahim 'alayhi al-salam 'an amri imami zamanihi salamullahi 'alayhima alladhi huwa Salih`. The Imam of his time, their... his parents' name is Salih. And the prophet's name... he is also Ibrahim. `wa shar'a`... `wa kana zidduhu al-Namrud bin Kan'an`. And he appointed qawanin and established a shari'ah in which he placed symbols and indications towards the ma'rifah of the hudud of Allah Ta'ala, the ruhaniyyah and the jismaniyyah, which indicate the ma'rifah of the tawhid of Allah Ta'ala and His tanzih, until the completion of the service that was upon him. Here he mentioned tawhid and tanzih; he did not mention tajrid. He did not mention it. With Janab Adam's time, only the word tawhid came. Here both tawhid and tanzih have come. Tawhid. And he established his son... his wasi', Isma'il, 'alayhi al-salam. Tawhid... recognizing the createdness of all the hudud. Tanzih means... to purify Allah from all attributes, from all names. And tajrid means... to abstract. The state of ibda', to pull it away from all creatures. That state cannot be established on anyone. No one has the ability to perform ibda'. To pull that state away from all creatures is called tajrid. `wa-intaqala ila dar karamihillahi wa jarat al-imamatu mutasalsilatan fi 'aqibihi ila wafa'i dawrihi`. And he passed away to the abode of Allah's honor, and the imamah continued in succession in his progeny until the completion of his dawr. `wa qama Musa 'an amri imami zamanihi alladhi huwa 'Ud salamullahi 'alayhima`. `Ud bin 'Udad`. `Ud bin 'Udad`. Fir'awn did as had been done before. `ila wafa'i dawrihi`. Until the completion of his dawr. Until Janab Musa's dawr was completed. `wa qama 'Isa 'an amri imami zamanihi`. And he did as he had done, he and those before him, until his dawr was completed. `wa qama Muhammad 'an amri imami zamanihi alladhi huwa Abu Talib 'alayhima al-salam`. And for him there were two opponents: Abu Lahab and Abu Jahl, may Allah curse them both. Outward opponents. `ila an awfa ma 'alayhi min khidmah`. Until he fulfilled the service that was upon him. Until you fulfilled... until you fulfilled the service that was upon you. `wa akmala qawanina shari'atihi`. That's why the state of the object has come for the `wasi'`. `aqama wasiyyahu`. You established your `wasi'`. The object has come. And for `qama`, an object is not necessary. `qama`, he stood. `qama Amir al-Mu'minin 'Aliyy-ibn Abi Talib salawatullahi 'alayhi ila wafa'i muddatihi`. And `bi-ism` is Imam al-Tayyib, 'alayhis salat wassalam. And `Al-Rahman al-Rahim`... Ma'add and Ma'add. The 14th Imam, Mu'izz, and Ma'add ibn Husayn. The 21st... and Ma'add, who are they? The 14th, Mu'izz, and the 28th Imam. Imam Ahmad. This... has been said about the Imams. `Bismillah al-Rahman al-Rahim`. The 14th Imam, the 28th Imam. Ma'add and Ma'add. Allah... Mawlana Muhammad ibn Isma'il's ranks are being spoken of. Imam al-Tayyib is the 21st Imam. They are of a very high rank. They are also what? They have become the name of Allah. The name of God. `Bismillah`. And `Al-Rahman al-Rahim` are attributes. `Bismillah al-Rahman al-Rahim` has two constructions. What is one construction? `Idafi` (genitive). And another is `tarkib-i tawsifi` (descriptive construction). The `tarkib-i idafi` is much higher than the `tarkib-i tawsifi`. "The name of Allah" or "Allah's attribute." Which is greater, the name or the attribute? The name is greater. "May I be so erased that only You remain. May Your existence be proven by my negation. May I be so erased that only You remain." In `Bismillah`, `b-ism`, the `ism` is Imam al-Tayyib, 'alayhis salatu wassalam. Allah is Mawlana Muhammad ibn Isma'il. And `Al-Rahman al-Rahim`, what are they? They are attributes. Ma'add and Ma'add. Who is Ma'add? The 14th, Mu'izz, and the 28th Imam. Mawlana Ma'add. The 21st Imam is al-Tayyib, and the 28th Imam is Mawlana Ma'add. The 35th, who are they? Mawlana Ahmad. Their line is separate. That is being explained. `wa huwa 'Abdullah ibn Muhammad ibn Isma'il salamullahi 'alayhim jami'an`. May the salam of Allah be upon all of them. `fa-ntarada dhalika ila wafa'i dawrihim bi-Mawlana al-Imam al-Mu'izz li-Din-illah salawatullahi 'alayhi`. So that cycle continued in this way, until their dawr was completed with Mawlana al-Imam al-Mu'izz li-Din-illah, salawatullahi 'alayhi. What will the seventh Qa'im do? He will gather the six before him. `wa qama awwal dawr al-ashhad wa huwa Mawlana al-'Aziz billah salamullahi 'alayhi ajma'in`. And the first of the `dawr al-ashhad` performed qiyam, and he is Mawlana al-'Aziz billah, salamullahi 'alayhim ajma'in. `wa-ntarada dhalika ila wafa'i dawrihim bi-Mawlana al-Imam al-Tayyib Abi'l-Qasim Amir al-Mu'minin salawatullahi 'alayhi wa 'ajma'in`. And that cycle continued in this way, until their dawr was completed with Mawlana al-Imam al-Tayyib Abi'l-Qasim Amir al-Mu'minin, salawatullahi 'alayhi wa 'ajma'in. `wa qama awwal a'immat al-abdal wa huwa waladu Mawlana al-Tayyib 'alayhi al-salam`. And the first of the `a'immat al-abdal` performed qiyam, and he is the farzand of Mawlana al-Tayyib, 'alayhi al-salam. `wa yantaridu al-amru kadhalika ila wafa'i dawrihim bi-sabi'ihim 'alayhim al-salam`. And the affair continues in this way until the completion of their dawr with their seventh, 'alayhim al-salam. `wa qama hujjat-u Qa'im al-Qiyamah 'ala dhikrihima al-salam`. And the hujjat of the Qa'im al-Qiyamah performed qiyam. Upon the mention of both of them be salam. All those... the Imams of the future cycle... after al-Tayyib, he finishes it and then mentions the `Qa'im al-Qiyamah`. `wa wufiyat saba'at alaf al-sana allati hiya dawr al-sitr alladhi huwa al-dunya`. `wa wufiyat`. And the 7,000 years were completed. They were fulfilled. The 7,000 years, which are the `dawr al-sitr`, which is the `dunya`. `kama qala naatiq al-dawr 'alayhim al-salam: 'umr al-dunya saba'at alaf sana`. As the naatiq of the dawr, 'alayhim al-salam, said: "The age of the dunya is 7,000 years." `isharatan ila dawr al-sitr hadha`. Indicating this `dawr al-sitr`. `dawr al-sitr hadha`. This `dawr al-sitr`. Where did the 7,000 years... It's from Adam, 'alayhis salam. The 7,000 years of the `dawr al-tayyibi`... `naatiq al-tayyibi`... its light started from... the 7,000 years. And since this is the seventh... there are seven, so from 57,000, 7,000... here the light was granted. 1,000 years of... have passed. We are also counted in the `shurat`. When will it be completed, Mawlana? When will it be completed? Only Allah knows. The start of this... The naatiqs... they were established first but came later here. Who? Most of them. Like the Prophet, then... your zuhur was... you were the first nur... you are the sixth... the seventh you became. And before... the Imams... despite that, as they say, the first will remain the first. In the dunya, Adam 'alayhis salam was first, Nuh 'alayhis salam... but that is not the basis for precedence. The basis for precedence is not on nur. The basis for precedence is on `awwaliyyat` (primacy). The basis is not shown here. There, the point is who... who reaches the `watan` first? The one who reaches first is the first. And they will all go and gather where? In the `Qa'im`. And where will the `Qa'im` gather? The `Qa'im` who... in the `haykal` of the `Qa'im` of the `Qa'imin`. And where will they gather? In the `haykal` of the `Jussa`. And where will the `Jussa` gather? He is the `jussa` of the `Mawr`. And ultimately, the progress is... towards the `Ashir`. From the `Ashir`, the `Jussa-i Mawriyyah`... its progress, the final progress, is that it will go and... like a `hudhud`... it will take the place of the `Tasi'`. The `nawami` (laws) of the `Tasi'`, `Ashtam`... `Hashtum`... until, going on like this, it... before the `Dahr-i Wahdat`, it will reach the `Jannat al-Ma'wa`. No one can reach `Sidrat al-Muntaha`. 26th Muqaddas Da'i, Shah Sahib, used to say that "He gave so much strength to my wings that I reached the nest. It has been a long time since I left my home."

<!-- lecture 22 -->

... `al-'adad al-athīr` and three, `al-latī hiya qablahā` (which is before it), `al-mutaqaddimah 'alayhā` (that which precedes them). They are from the `a'immah` of men (`a'immat al-nās`), `Salām Allah 'alayhā`. `mawqūfīna fī ufuq al-'aql al-'āshir` (stationed in the horizon of the Tenth Intellect), `kamā sabaqa bihil-qawl fī 'amal al-daur al-fajr`, until the coming of the `Qaa'im 'alayhissalatu was-salaam`. And he is the `Natiq`, the master of the `Qaa'im`, and his station is in the final creation (`khalq al-ākhir`), `alladhī huwa al-rūḥ lil-jism` (who is the soul for the body). `wa ittaṣalat bihī` (and connected to him)... And... and these 7,000 years are of the `daur-i sitr`. `wa thalāthah al-latī hiya qablahā` (and the three which are before it), and the 3,000 years that are before it, `al-mutaqaddimatu 'alayhā` (that which precedes them), are those that occurred before it, in the `daur-i fitrat`. So, it happens that... from their Imams, upon whom be the peace of Allah, who are stationed upon the `ufq`... stationed in the `ufuq-i 'aql-i 'aashir` (`ufuq-i 'aql-i 'aashir`). The Imam who passes away is stationed upon the `'aql-i 'aashir`. Who would be the `'aql-i 'aashir`? The `jus'-i idhā'ī` (supplementary part). `kamā sabaqa`, as has been established by the statement... `a'immah-i daur-i kashf`, their statement is directed towards the `Qaa'im 'alayhissalatu was-salaam`, until their `Qaa'im` appears. Who is the `Qaa'im`? The Imam of Imams is called the `Qaa'im`. `wa huwa al-nāṭiq...` He is the `Qaa'im` of the `daur-i fitrat`. The `Qaa'im` of the `daur-i sitr`. `wa huwa al-nāṭiq` (and he is the Natiq)... And he is the `Natiq`, the `Natiq-i Saabi'`, the `Natiq-i Saabi'`. `al-qā'im wa muqāmuhu fī khalqil-ākhir` (the Qaa'im and his station is in the final creation), who will establish the `qiyāmah` in the station of the `khalq-i ākhir`, the creation of the hereafter. `alladhī huwa al-rūḥ lil-jism` (who is the soul for the body), just as he is the soul for the body. His status is that of the soul. In one sense, what does `Natiq-i Saabi'` mean? Sayyidna Muhammad ibn Isma'il is called the `Natiq-i Saabi'`. But this `Natiq-i Saabi'` here... the original `Natiq-i Saabi'` is the `Qaa'im 'alayhissalatu was-salaam`. But since his rank became very elevated, higher than the `Qaa'im`s of the Imams, therefore, that `nuqṭah` which is the rank of the `Natiq-i Saabi'`, he conferred it upon whom? Upon Imam Maulana Muhammad ibn Isma'il. `alladhī huwa al-rūḥ lil-jism` (who is the soul for the body), just as he is the soul for the body. `wa ittaṣalat bihī hādhihil-maqāmāt al-sharīfah` (and these noble stations became connected to him)... `wal-ṣādis wal-mushtami'`... And... The Prophet `alayhissalatu was-salaam` is the sixth `Natiq`. The rank of the `Saabi'` has become greater than that of the Prophet `alayhissalatu was-salaam`. His rank is after the `Natiq-i Saadis`. Who is the `Natiq-i Saadis`? Sayyidna Muhammad ibn Isma'il is the `Natiq-i Saadis`. And who is the original `Natiq-i Saabi'`? Janaab Qaa'im, who is to appear in the future, is the `Natiq-i Saabi'`. His, the `Natiq-i Saabi'`, in one sense... is the one who gathers all six `nuṭuqā'` (speaking prophets). This is also one meaning. And the `Natiq-i Saabi'` referred to here as Sayyidna Maulana Muhammad ibn Isma'il `'alayhissalatu was-salaam`, he too is a `Natiq-i Saabi'`. He is the gatherer of the six. But your (`'ayn-i 'aẓīmah`) rank is high. You have reached `hijaabiyyah` (the station of veiling), which is higher than the `Natiq-i Saabi'`. The station of `hijaabiyyah`, which is higher than `Natiq-i Saabi'`. You have attained superiority (`faḍīlat`) over all the `mustawda'īn` Imams and the `mustaqirrīn` Imams up to the `Qaa'im`. All of them. For this reason, your... Sayyidna Maulana Muhammad ibn Isma'il is higher and more elevated. Although... the Prophet... one must understand the Prophet, Janaab Payghambar `'alayhissalatu was-salaam`, the station he occupies... what is the final station? `hijaabiyyah`. `maqām-i maḥmūd`, `hijaabiyyah`. He is at the station of `hijaabiyyah`. `'ayn-i 'aẓīmah`'s veil. All the `a'immah-i mustawda'īn` and `a'immah-i mustaqirrīn`, you have superiority over them. Below that, what is one `nuqṭah`? The `nuqṭah` of the `Saadis`. The `nuqṭah` of `Natiq-i Saadis` comes. At that `Natiq-i Saadis`'s `nuqṭah`, who is the `Natiq-i Saabi'`? Janaab Maulana Muhammad ibn Isma'il comes. And the `nuqāt`... after that, there is a `nuqṭah` of the `Natiq-i Saabi'`, which belongs to the `Qaa'im 'alayhissalatu was-salaam`. He was elevated from that `nuqṭah`. Elevated, what did he become? He made `'Ayn-i 'Aẓīmah` his `wazīr` (minister). He made `'Ayn-i 'Aẓīmah` his `wazīr`. And he himself became... the `qiyām` of that entire `daur`. He became the `Qaa'im` of that `daur`. The elevation of `nuqat` happens in this way. They are stationed in the `ufq` of the `'aql-i 'aashir`. Upon the `'aql-i 'aashir`, who is stationed? `ashir` (the tenth) is who? The `'aql-i 'aashir`? `jus'-i idhā'ī`. The `jus'-i idhā'ī` of that `daur` is at the station of `'aql-i 'aashir`. He goes and is stationed there. `kamā sabaqa bihil-qawl`, as has been established by the statement... `a'immah-i daur-i kashf` concerning it... `ilā qiyāmil-qā'im 'alayhissalatu was-salaam` (until the standing of the Qaa'im, peace and blessings be upon him). Until the `qiyāmah`, Janaab Qaa'im `'alayhissalatu was-salaam`... `wa huwa al-nāṭiq al-ṣābi'`... ...`wa huwa al-nāṭiq al-ṣābi'`, and you are the `Natiq-i Saabi'`. You are the one who establishes the station of the `khalq-i ākhir` (final creation). What is the `khalq-i ākhir`? `rūḥ`. Just as he is the soul (`rūḥ`) for the body. Here, Sayyidna Ja'far's mark is present. You have made an `istimbāṭ` (derivation) from it. What does `istimbāṭ` mean? To derive a hidden meaning? You have taken a proof (`dalīl`) from there. From what is the word `istimbāṭ` derived? What is its origin? `qanbat`. No. It is a three-letter word. `nabaṭa`. `nabaṭa`. `nūn`, `bā'`, `ṭā'`. To reveal something hidden. `istambaṭa` means to reveal something hidden. What is its origin? `nabaṭa`. `nūn`, `bā'`, `ṭā'`. To draw water from a well. That is, to derive a proof (`dalīl`) from it. To reveal something hidden. And what else is there? A `faqīh` (jurist), with his own understanding, extracting the esoteric (`bāṭinī`) meaning of the Quran and Hadith. This is `istimbāṭ`. An `'ālim`, with his own understanding, extracting the esoteric meaning of the Quran and Hadith. Like `istambaṭa`, he brought forth an excellent opinion (`rā'yan ḥasanan`). To reveal an excellent and correct meaning. `istimbāṭ` is from `nabaṭa`, on the pattern of `istif'āl`. Did you write a `risālah` on `istimbāṭ`? No, wherever you have taken a `ḥujjat` (proof) in the books, it is written in such-and-such a book, from which it becomes clear to us... and you should mark it. This is not our original mark. As Sayyid Da'ud wal-Ahmad has marked. But the statement of Sayyidna Ja'far, the `latīfah` (subtle point) in the book, you have made an `istimbāṭ` from it. In whichever `anwār` (lights) the `latīfah` was, you... made an `istimbāṭ` from it. Our pointer was towards the original book. You have copied this pointer from there. ...`nafs-i ṣāḥib al-qā'im`. `wa ittaṣalat bihī hādhihil-...` The `nafs-i ṣāḥib al-qā'im`, who is the `rūḥ` for the body... `wa ittaṣalat bihī hādhihil-maqāmāt al-sharīfah` (and these noble stations became connected to him)... and you became connected to these entire noble stations. `ka-ittiṣāl ṣuwar al-mushtami'ati 'indal-bāb bi-nafsil-imām al-mawlūd` (like the connection of the forms gathered near the Bab with the soul of the born Imam). Just as the connection of the `ṣuwarāt` (forms) occurs, which are gathered near the `Bāb`, with the `nafs` of the Imam who is born. `bāb al-abwāb`. `bāb al-abwāb`, near the `bāb al-abwāb`, in which way... what happens? All the `ṣuwar` gather. And after gathering, what happens? The born Imam's... they become connected with the son of the Imam. In the same way, what happened? All the `ṣuwar` that are there... who is your original `muqīm` (resident)? Janaab Qaa'im who is to come, the `Qaa'im` of the `daur-i sitr`. Who are your `muqīm`? The next `Qaa'im`. The `Qaa'im` who came before him is in reality the `muqīm`. And whose partial (`juzwī`) caliph is he? He is the partial caliph of the `jus'-i idhā'ī`. Partial caliph. Whose total (`kullī`) caliph is he? He is the total caliph of the previous one, who is the `Qaa'im` of the `daur-i sitr`, his total... he is his total caliph. All the... in these 57,000 years, whichever `ṣuwarāt` were elevated, those `ṣuwarāt`, after being elevated, gathered with the `a'immah` there. Those `a'immah` then became what? They became connected with Janaab Qaa'im in the same way as the `ṣuwarāt` gather with the `mawlūd-i imām` near the `Bāb`. `fa-yakūnu nafsuhu rūḥan li-hādhihil-maqāmāt` (so his soul becomes a spirit for these stations)... So, it happens that his `nafs`... that is, that `mawlūd`'s `nafs`... the `mawlūd`'s `nafs`... is the `rūḥ` for those stations that have reached there. `fa-taṣīru hiyā wa iyyāhu ṣūratan wāḥidah, haykalan nūrāniyyan, wa 'aqlan qudsāniyyan` (so it and he become one form, a luminous structure, and a holy intellect). So it happens that it and he... his `nafs` and all of them... become one form, a luminous structure (`haykal-i nūrānī`) and a holy intellect (`'aql-i qudsānī`). The `ṣuwarāt` of the 7,000... the `ṣuwarāt` of the 57,000 years... of the `daur-i kashf` and `daur-i sitr`... the `daur-i sitr`'s one `Qaa'im`. The `daur-i sitr`'s one `Qaa'im`. All the `ṣuwarāt` that are there, they all come and become his `haykal-i nūrānī`. Meaning, the `nafs` of the `mawlūd-i imām` and the `ṣuwarāt` of the 57,000 become one thing, one `'aql`. Now, look, where is the question of first and last here? The `daur-i kashf` and the `daur-i sitr`'s first... All the Imams who appeared during the `daur-i kashf` and `daur-i sitr`, with them will also be all the believers. And all the `hudūd` will be there, all the... so, all of them become what? With the `haykal` (structure) of their Imam, they become participants in the `haykal` of the `Qaa'im`. There, what is... an ocean is gathered. Small things are also gathered there. `ḥaykalan`, one `haykal-i nūrānī` (luminous structure) is formed. And `'aql-i qudsānī` (holy intellect) is formed. `tāmm al-a'ḍā'` (complete in limbs)... `tāmm al-a'ḍā'`, all the limbs... meaning, there the arrangement of limbs takes place, the completion takes place. `kāmil al-ḥawāss` (perfect in senses)... `kāmil al-ḥawāss`, perfect in all senses. `as-sab'u ufuq allatī taqaddamatuhu min daur al-kashf` (the seven horizons which preceded him from the daur al-kashf). The seven... the seven horizons... as have preceded him from the `daur-i kashf`. Just as the master of the `daur-i kashf` had a `daur` of 50,000 years. Just as a gathering happened there, here an even greater gathering takes place. `fa-yashtami'ū ilayhi...` So, this `mawlūd-i imām`, who is the first... the first Imam of the `daur-i kashf`. `fa-yashtami'ū ilayhi kāffat ahl daur al-sitr, al-awwalīn minhum wal-ākhirīn` (So all the people of the daur al-sitr will be gathered to him, the first of them and the last of them). The first and the last. `qul innal-awwalīna wal-ākhirīn la-majmū'ūna ilā mīqāti yawmin ma'lūm` (Say, 'Indeed, the former and the later peoples will surely be gathered for the appointed time of a known Day'). `wa yuḥāsibu kulla wāḥidin minhum` (and he will take account of every single one of them), and he will take the account of each one of them. `wa yuwāqifuhum 'alā mā taqaddama min qalīlin wa kathīr` (and he will make them stand upon what has passed, be it little or much). And he will make them aware of what has passed, whether little or much. `wa yatashakhaṣṣu kullu imāmin wa ḥudūdihī bi-ahl dawrihim` (and every Imam and his hudūd will be personified with the people of their daur). And they will be personified, every Imam and his `hudūd` with the people of their `daur`. `kamā qālallāhu ta'ālā` (as Allah Ta'ala has said), as Allah Ta'ala has said. `wa jī'a bil-nabiyyīna wal-shuhadā'i wa quḍiya baynahum bil-ḥaqqi wa hum lā yuẓlamūn` (and the prophets and the witnesses will be brought forward, and a just decision will be passed between them, and they will not be wronged). And brought will be the prophets and the witnesses, and a just decision will be made among them, and no injustice will be done to them. `wa yuwāqifuhum 'alā jamī'i af'ālihim` (and He will make them stand upon all their deeds). `wa yuwāqifuhum 'alā jamī'i af'ālihim` (and He will make them stand upon all their deeds)... `af'ālihim` (their deeds). `kamā naṭaqa bihi al-kitāb al-mubīn mukhbiran min qawlihim` (as the clear Book spoke of it, informing of their saying). And he will make them aware of their deeds. As it has been said in the Noble Book, informing about their statement. `yā waylatanā` (Woe to us!). Meaning who? All those who will be present, at that time they will cry out and say, `yā waylatanā, māli hādhal-kitāb lā yughādiru ṣaghīratan walā kabīratan illā aḥṣāhā` (Woe to us! What is this book that leaves neither a small thing nor a great one, but has accounted for it?). What has happened to this book? The book that will be given, for which we always pray in the `ḥuḍūr` (presence), `Allahumma a'ṭinī kitābī bi-yamīnī wa lā tu'tinīhī bi-shimālī` (O Allah, give me my book in my right hand, and do not give it to me in my left hand). Then what will be said to those who get it in their left hand? `Allahumma lā tu'tinī kitābī bi-shimālī wa lā min warā'i ẓahrī` (O Allah, do not give me my book in my left hand, nor from behind my back). `yā waylatanā`, what a destruction for us! `māli hādhal-kitāb`, what is it with this book, that it does not leave out a small or a big thing, `illā aḥṣāhā` (but has accounted for it), but it has enumerated it. Every sin and every good deed is enumerated. The `du'ā` that is written in this `ṣaḥīfah`... regarding the `du'ā` in the `ṣaḥīfah`... the virtues of `du'ā`... So, in the virtues of `du'ā`... In the old `ṣaḥīfah`s, it wasn't there, the virtues of `du'ā`. I had taken Sayyidna Ghulam Husayn's `ṣaḥīfah`. In it, all the virtues of `du'ā` were there. Sayyidna saheb said, "Leave this book, I want to see it." He kept it with him for three or four days. And after looking at it, he said, "The virtues of `du'ā` that have been described are very special. You should add this to the `ṣaḥīfah`." So, I added it. Then he asked, "Have you written it?" I said, "Yes, I have written it." He said, "Bring it and show me." Then I went and showed it to him. So the virtues of `du'ā` which Sayyidna Ghulam Husayn had... he approved of them. He said, "Write it down." And after seeing it, he made some corrections to it. And in it, what was there in the virtues of `du'ā`? A special part is that a person makes many supplications, but his supplications are not accepted. And then he passes away. So it has been said that when he is presented in the court of Allah Ta'ala, then in his scale of deeds, some of his rewards will be placed. Some rewards will be placed. At that time, he will say, "O Lord, I did not perform these deeds for which I am being rewarded." It will be said, "These were your supplications which you made in the world, which We did not accept at that time. Now We are giving you its recompense." So the servant will say, "I wish that none of my supplications in the world had been accepted, and all the supplications had been kept for this time." He said, "Take this `ṣaḥīfah` out." When the believer sees his magnificent reward, he will say, "O Lord, I wish You had not hastened to accept any of my prayers." And you had kept all my prayers until today. He had kept it until today. Its Arabic text is also there, isn't it? The Arabic text is like this: `wa yaqūlu yā rabbī layta innaka lam tu'ajjil lī shay'an` (And he will say, 'O my Lord, I wish You had not hastened anything for me'). He will say, the believer, "O my Lord, `layta`, I wish that You had not hastened the acceptance of my prayer. `wa akhkhartahu lī kullahu ilā hādhal-yawm` (and You had delayed all of it for me until this day)." And you had delayed it until this day. The servant wants his prayer to be accepted as soon as he makes it. But a time will come when he will say, "I wish my prayer had not been accepted at that time." This born (`mawlūd`) master... so he... is of both the `daur-i kashf` and the `daur-i sitr`. Yes. Qaa'im `'alayhissalatu was-salaam`. ...They are writing in the `dawrīyyah` that there is no `ijtimaa'` (gathering) for the people of `daur-i sitr`. The `dawrīyyah` is not about `daur-i kashf`. No. After that, the `daur-i sitr`'s `Qaa'im`, when he attains the rank of the `Qaa'im` of the `daur-i kashf`, his rank will be 57,000. It may be mentioned further on. ...The seven horizons, those seven horizons that... the seven... in the `daur-i kashf`, the seven that have happened, the `Qaa'im`s... they are being compared to the horizons. The seven horizons... in the `daur-i kashf`, the seven `Qaa'im`s that are there, just as they gathered, in the same way, he will attain this rank. `wa yatashakhaṣṣu kullu imāmin`... Every Imam and his `ḥudūd` with the people of their `daur` will become manifest. So that they may be given their reward (`jazā`) and their punishment (`'adhāb`). Every person... he will see his Imam, he will see his `hudūd`. After that, what is there? `kullu imāmin zamānin wa salāmullāhi 'alā dhikrihī` (every Imam of a time, and peace of Allah be upon his mention)... `al-kitāb al-ladhī lā yughādiru ṣaghīratan walā kabīratan illā aḥṣāhā` (the book that leaves neither a small thing nor a great one, but has accounted for it). So he, `salāmullāhi 'alā dhikrihī`... he is the book... which will not leave out a small or a big thing. Every point will be clear in it. `wa huwa al-rab al-muṯīb wal-mu'āqib` (and he is the Lord who rewards and who punishes). And he is the Lord who gives rewards and who gives punishment. `fa-ḥīna'idhin yaṣīru al-thawābu kullī, wa yaqūmu al-'iqāb al-kullī` (so at that time, the reward becomes total, and the total punishment is established). So at that time, the reward will be given... `thawāb al-kullī` (total reward)... and the punishment will be given, `iqāb al-kullī` (total punishment). `wa sa-ya'tī al-kalām 'alā al-ḥālayn jamī'an`... Yes, in `daur-i kashf`, there is no... reward and punishment... is the `qiyāmah`. Because there the forms are manifest in that way, upon which there are no remaining `qiṣāṣāt` (retributions). In the `daur-i sitr`, in the 7,000 years, the deeds that are like that, from them there is `thawāb` and `'iqāb`. The one who explained about the gathering... he is saying that there is no gathering for `daur-i kashf`. After that, `daur-i sitr`... He is not talking about the 400,000 `daur`. He is just talking about one `Qaa'im`, about the `Qaa'im` of the `daur-i sitr`. The `Qaa'im` of `daur-i sitr` will also encompass the `daur-i kashf`. And then the `Qaa'im` who will come in the future, of the `daur`, will encompass seven `daur-i kashf` and seven `daur-i sitr`. Now, what is said about those whose `thawāb` and `'iqāb` will take place, the people of `daur-i kashf`... their `qiṣāṣ` (retribution) will be given. `qiṣāṣ`... there is no one for whom लेना-देना (`lenā-denā`, give and take) remains. Yes, the `qiṣāṣāt` will take place. `qiṣāṣāt` will take place. The debt (`qarz`) has to be paid. Allah Ta'ala says what? Allah Ta'ala forgives His own sin. Allah Ta'ala does not forgive the `lenā-denā` that is between the servants. The servant will come and forgive, then it will happen. He whose sin it is, he will forgive. Or some path will be made for him. For instance, through `fikākāt` (ransoms). A path is made. That thing reaches the one with whom the enmity was. In that way. So, these are its methods. `fikāk` means what? `fakk`. He freed him from slavery. The `qiṣāṣāt` that were there, of `lenā-denā`, instead of `qiṣāṣ` being taken, in its place, another form of that thing reaches him. That thing... is `fikākāt`. And until that time, some `lenā-denā` remains for someone. In `daur-i kashf`, only those people will come for whom there are no `thawābiqāt` (past liabilities). For whom there is no `qiṣāṣāt`. There is no animosity. There is no `qiṣāṣ`. `wa sa-ya'tī al-kalām 'alā al-ḥālayn jamī'an fīmā ba'du inshā'allāhu ta'ālā` (and the discussion on both states will come later, if Allah Ta'ala wills). And the discourse on both these states will come later, `inshā'allāhu ta'ālā`. `thumma yuqīmu da'watahū ilā an yastakhrija minhā waladan al-ladhī yaqūmu maqāmahū fī iqāmat al-da'wah` (Then he will establish his da'wah until he brings forth from it a son who will take his place in establishing the da'wah). Then he will establish his `da'wah`... until he brings forth from it his son... who... he will be his successor in his place. He... the `daur-i kashf`... `ilā ākhir al-daur` (until the end of the daur). And he will transfer, ascending... to the rank of `'aql-i 'aashir`. `'aql-i 'aashir` is not that, but the `jus'-i idhā'ī`'s station, that is called `ufq`. `ufq-i 'āshir`, in which his station will be, he will be at that station. In `barzakh`. In `barzakh`. `barzakh`... of `jus'-i idhā'ī`. The `barzakh` of the tenth, `'āshir`. `khalafan lahū fī tadbīr 'ālam al-kawn wal-fasād` (as a successor to him in the governance of the world of generation and corruption). Khalifa... successor... in the governance... in the governance of the `'ālam-i kawn wa fasād` (world of generation and corruption). `juzwī tadbīr` (partial governance) is under his charge. `kullī tadbīr` (total governance) is with the `jus'-i idhā'ī` who runs it. His whole `daur`... the `jus'-i idhā'ī` has the governance of what? Of the entire `daur`. Here, until the second `jus'-i idhā'ī` appears. He has governance in his charge... of his own `daur`. `kamā taqaddamahu dhikruhu min al-a'immah al-sābiqat lahū` (as was mentioned of him by the preceding Imams). As has been preceded in mention from the Imams who came before you. `wa hādhal-qā'imu wa dawruhu huwa awwalu dawril-kashf` (and this Qaa'im and his daur, he is the first of the daur al-kashf). And this `Qaa'im`... and his `daur`... is the first of the `daur-i kashf`. He is the last of the `daur-i sitr`, and the first of the `daur-i kashf`. The `Qaa'im 'alayhissalatu was-salaam`. ...The son who is born... he is the `Qaa'im` who... his son... is the `Qaa'im` who is the `awwal daur al-kashf` (the first of the `daur-i kashf`). He is not called the `Qaa'im`. He is the last to be called `huwal-awwal wal-ākhir` (He is the First and the Last). The first son will be the `Qaa'im`, and... the 57,000... No. After the 7,000 years are over, at the end of the 7,000 years, the `Qaa'im` who will appear, he will be the last of the `daur-i sitr`... Imam. And... the first of the `daur-i kashf`. He will encompass both. Your `daur` will be in `daur-i sitr` and also in `daur-i kashf`. `wa hādhal-qā'imu wa dawruhu huwa awwalu dawril-kashf`... As it is said that... your `qiyām` will last for three days in this world. No, it will last for three `dawr`s. What is said in the sermon? Three `dawr`s. ...In `daur-i sitr` also your `qiyām` will be, and in `daur-i kashf` also it will be. At the end of `daur-i sitr` and the beginning of `daur-i kashf`. Both `daur`s will be yours. `thawāb` and `'iqāb` will be given at the end of `daur-i sitr`, and at the beginning of `daur-i kashf`, `nasl-i 'ālam` will appear. `khunūs al-'ālam` (the setting of the world). `khunūs al-'ālam` is at that time when the final `jus'`... of the `daur`... when the `Qaa'im` of the `qawr` will come. The `khunūs al-'ālam` will be then. A 400,000... `daur` will be completed. After that, `khunūs` will happen. `wa hādhal-qā'imu wa dawruhu huwa awwalu dawril-kashf, al-ladhī huwa khamsūna alf sanah` (and this Qaa'im and his daur, he is the first of the daur al-kashf, which is fifty thousand years). And this `Qaa'im` and his `daur` is the first of the `daur-i kashf`, which is 50,000 years. His `daur` is the first, like the first `daur`, and on this pattern (`manhā`), on this very pattern, there will be `daur-i kashf` and `daur-i sitr`, then `daur-i kashf`. `daur-i kashf`. After night comes day, after day comes night. `wa bihī ramaza Sayyidunā Ḥamīd al-Dīn...` Three and seven, ten thousand years. `wa bihī ramaza Sayyidunā Ḥamīd al-Dīn raḍiyallāhu 'anhu ilā hādhal-ma'nā fī risālatihī al-mawsūmah bi-hāwiyah` (and Sayyiduna Hamid al-Din, may Allah be pleased with him, alluded to this meaning in his risalah named Hawiyah)... And with this, Sayyidna Hamid al-Din alluded... `kamā qāla`, as he said in his `risālat al-imāmah`... called `Hāwiyah`. And to this, our master Hamid al-Din alluded, may Allah be pleased with him. Who is Sayyidna Hamid al-Din? `bāb al-abwāb`. With `nūn`... he alluded to it with `nūn`, as he said in his `risālah` whose name is `Hāwiyah`. `wa minal-rumūz al-dāllati 'alā hādhal-amr al-nūn` (and among the symbols indicating this matter is the nun). And from the allusions indicating this matter is `nūn`. The letter `nūn` is the allusion. `Nūn wal-qalam`, as my Lord has said, `Nūn wal-qalam` (Nun. By the pen). Its commentary is being given. `fa-ūri zinādaka bi-ḥallihī li-tanqadiḥa laka al-'ulūm, wa ta'ammal al-'alāmat al-dāllata 'alā al-sittah allatī hiya al-wāwu bayna al-nūnayn al-awwal wal-ākhir` (so strike your flint for its solution so that the sciences may be kindled for you, and reflect on the sign indicating the six, which is the waw between the two nuns, the first and the last)... from the allusions indicating this matter is `nūn`. So, you strike your flint... your mind... put your mind to it. `fa-ūri zinādaka`, strike your flint... so that a spark may be produced. In its solution... so that... the sciences may become clear to you. And reflect on the sign (`'alāmat`) which indicates the six, which is the `wāw` between the two `nūn`s, the first and the last. `nūn`, he says, `nūn wāw nūn`. The `nūn` is 50,000 years. `nūn` is 50. The `wāw`'s are six, the six `nuṭaqā'`. And after that, `nūn` came again, so the `daur` began again. 50,000 years, then six `nuṭaqā'`, then again the `daur`... And `nūn` is also called `dawat` (inkwell) in which the pen is kept, that is also called `nūn`. `wa nūn wal-qalam`. It is also called a fish. Here, `nūn` means `dawat`, in which the pen is kept. `kayfa yaḥṣulu ba'd al-sittah nūn ka-al-awwal` (how is it that after the six, there is a nun like the first?). How does it happen that after the six, there is a `nūn` like the first one? `hādhā minal-rumūz al-'iẓām fa-'rifhu` (this is among the great symbols, so know it). And this is from the great symbols, so understand it. `li-annahu ramaza bil-wāw allatī hiya ṣāḥibat al-jummal sittah 'alā sitti nuṭaqā' fī dawr al-sitr` (because he symbolized with the waw, which has the numerical value of six, the six nutaqa' in the daur al-sitr). Because he used the `wāw`, which in `jummal` (numerology) means six, to symbolize the six `nuṭaqā'` in the `daur-i sitr`. The first of whom is Adam, and the last is Qaa'im, and peace be upon all of them. `wa ramaza bil-nūn al-awwal 'alā dawr al-kashf` (and he symbolized with the first nun the daur al-kashf). And with the first `nūn`, he alluded to the `daur-i kashf`. `wa huwa khamsūna alf sanah` (and it is fifty thousand years), which is 50,000 years. `li-anna al-nūn fīl-ḥisāb al-jummal khamsūn` (because the nun in jummal calculation is fifty). Because `nūn` in the `ḥisāb-i jummal` is 50. `wa bil-nūn al-ukhrā 'alā dawr al-kashf al-ātī ba'da dawr al-sitr` (and with the other nun, the coming daur al-kashf after the daur al-sitr). And with the second `nūn`, to the `daur-i kashf` which will come, which will come after the `daur-i sitr`. `wa hādhal-qā'imu huwa al-ladhī ishārat ilayhi amīr al-mu'minīn 'alī ibn abī ṭālib 'alayhissalatu was-salaam fī qawlihī 'alā ra's kulli 'asharati ālāf sanah qā'imun lil-dawr` (and this is the Qaa'im to whom Amir al-Mu'minin Ali ibn Abi Talib, peace and blessings be upon him, alluded in his saying: 'At the head of every ten thousand years is a Qaa'im for the dawr')... `thalāthatu ālāf sanah ba'da dawr al-kashf wa sab'atu ālāf allatī hiya dawr al-sitr` (three thousand years after the daur al-kashf, and seven thousand which is the daur al-sitr). `wa al-sab'ah allatī talūhā min dawr al-sitr` (and the seven which follow it from the daur al-sitr)... The word `ba'da` (after) here is why our people in India had this concept that `ba'da dawr al-kashf` means what? That after the 50,000 years of `daur-i kashf` are over, there will be 3,000 years. I had told Sayyidna saheb about this, that `ba'da dawr al-kashf`... He said that in the `daur-i kashf`, two kinds of `ṣuwar` (forms) are born. And the two `ṣuwar`, one is of `kashf`'s `ṣuwar`, and one is of the `daur-i sitr`'s thoughts, of that disposition. The 3,000 years, he alluded to that. The last 3,000 years will be like that. And this `Qaa'im` is the one to whom Amir al-Mu'minin alluded... `fī qawlihī 'alā ra's kulli 'asharati ālāf sanah qā'imun lil-dawr fī sūratin` (in his saying: 'At the head of every ten thousand years is a Qaa'im for the dawr in a form'). So they say that from 10,000 years... 3,000 years are after the `daur-i kashf`, and the `daur-i sitr`... are after the `daur-i kashf`, meaning what? That the `daur-i kashf` whose reality is that after it... 47,000 years... and the `daur-i kashf`'s end, two kinds of `ṣuwar` appear. The last 3,000 years... and the seven that follow it are of the `daur-i sitr`. Because they alternate one after the other, like the coming of night and day, until the completion of the `dawr al-a'ẓam` (the Great Dawr), which is the product of multiplying 360,000 years by its like... as he gives the multiplication of 360,000 years by its like. Unit, ten, hundred, thousand, ten thousand, lakh, ten lakh, crore... 12,960 crore years. 12,960 crore years is one `dawr-i a'ẓam`, and the `qawr-i a'ẓam` will happen, and after the `qawr-i a'ẓam`, what will happen? The world will end, and the `qiyāmat-i kulliyyah`... I mean, the world will end, and then, with a bang, creation will emerge from the graves. From the graves, creation will emerge. Before that, creation emerges from wombs. That is `qiyāmat-i juz'iyyah` (partial resurrection). The `qiyāmat-i kulliyyah`, which is called `qiyāmah`, which one is it? It is the `qawrī qiyāmah` (resurrection of the major cycle), when the world will end. And... otherwise, until the `qawr` comes, the `kashf`... `sitr`, `kashf`, `sitr`... this will continue to alternate. ...`wa inḥallat ribāṭāt al-aflāk wa ibtada'at khalqun jadīd` (and the bindings of the spheres were loosened and a new creation began). And `ribāṭāt al-aflāk`... the bonds in the spheres, the force of gravity which is there, that will end. `wa ibtada'at khalqun jadīd` (and a new creation began), and a new creation will be initiated. A new creation will come. That is from the `nafs`? From the wombs (`buṭūn`). `kamā bada'nā awwala khalqin nu'īduhu, wa'dan 'alaynā, innā kunnā fā'ilīn` (As We began the first creation, We will repeat it. [This is] a promise binding upon Us. Indeed, We will do it). As We started the first creation, We will repeat it. It is Our promise. We will surely do it. `thumma al-qā'imu salāmullāhi 'alayhi wa 'alā dhikrihī yuqīmu da'watahū ilā an yastakhrija minhā...` This is the mention of the final `Qaa'im` of the `daur`, he says. Then the `Qaa'im`, `salāmullāhi 'alayhi wa 'alā dhikrihī`, the last `Qaa'im` of the `daur-i sitr`... his mention is being made. `yuqīmu da'watahū` (he will establish his da'wah). He will establish his `da'wah`. He will make the `da'wah` stand. `ilā an yastakhrija minhā waladahū al-ladhī yaqūmu maqāmahū fī iqāmat al-da'wah wa jam' al-ṣuwar wa istikhlāṣ al-nufūs` (until he brings forth from it his son who will take his place in establishing the da'wah, gathering the forms, and purifying the souls). `fa-yantaqilu` (then he will transfer)... they transfer. The `ṣūrat` (form) and the `nafs` (soul), both things advance. And he will pass away. And he will pass away. `ilā dār karāmatillāhi ta'ālā, ṣā'idan ilā rutbat al-'aql al-ākhir` (to the abode of the honor of Allah Ta'ala, ascending to the rank of the last Intellect)... ascending to the rank of `'aql-i 'āshir`. This is the same `'aql-i 'āshir`. The `jus'-i idhā'ī` has ten stations. Among those ten stations, the one that is the `ashirī maqām` (tenth station), he will go and become its khalifah. `khalafan lahū fī tadbīr 'ālam al-kawn wal-fasād` (as a successor to him in the governance of the world of generation and corruption). Khalifah... successor... of his... in the governance... in the `'ālam-i kawn wa fasād`. `kamā taqaddamahu dhikruhu min al-qawm al-sāni al-mustakhrajati min 'ālam al-ṭabī'ah al-sābiqati 'alayhi al-latī qad jarat fī kulli 'aqlin minhum mā jarā fī kulli 'aqlin min nuqabā'i al-a'immah` (as was mentioned of him by the second people who were brought out from the world of nature, who preceded him, in whose every intellect ran what ran in every intellect of the deputies of the Imams)... so they became like them... there is no difference between them and them... `illā bi-rutbat al-sabq` (except by the rank of precedence)... except for the rank of `sabāqiyyah` (precedence). The difference is of `rutbat-i sabāqiyyah`. `wa dawru hādhal-qā'imi huwa awwalu dawril-kashf kal-dawril-awwal` (and the daur of this Qaa'im is the first of the daur al-kashf, like the first daur). And the `daur` of this `Qaa'im` is the first of the `daur-i kashf`. Which is to come, like the first `daur`. This `Qaa'im`'s `daur`, the `daur-i kashf` is the first Imam, the `Qaa'im` is. Last of the three, and first of this. `al-qā'im`. And it will be correct that he is before the `daur-i kashf`... The `daur` of this `Qaa'im` is the first `daur-i kashf`. This is the initial part of `daur-i kashf`. The `daur` of the `Qaa'im`... The `Qaa'im` who will be at the end of `daur-i sitr`, when he appears, but that `Qaa'im` will be counted as the first of `daur-i kashf`. `huwal-awwal huwal-ākhir` (He is the First, He is the Last). And after that, this `daur-i kashf` will run, until `daur-i kashf` comes again and the `daur-i sitr` arrives. Why are the effects of `kashf` not found? The effects of `kashf` are not found... What are not found? The effects... In history or in... culture... They are not found because they were elevated. They became a part of the `daur-i kashf`. Worldly things also? Yes. And... some parts of the earth... now look, the world is very vast. The `daur-i kashf` will have the process of purification going on. Yes. The methods will change. The enemies of religion will not be there. Doctrines... as he explained, the doctrines of the `a'immah` will be taught. There will be no hindrance. `wa intaqala ilā dār karāmatillāhi ta'ālā ṣā'idan ilā rutbat al-'aql al-ākhir khalafan lahū` (and he transferred to the abode of the honor of Allah Ta'ala, ascending to the rank of the last Intellect, as a successor to him)... he will be a khalifah. Khalifah for the governance that needs to be done... `tadbir`, the governance of `'ālam-i kawn wa fasād` is his responsibility, but within his own sphere. The `Qaa'im` of the `kashf`... of the `sitr`'s `daur`... of 57,000 years... The upcoming `Qaa'im`'s governance... The upcoming ones, their governance will be... `tadbir`... they will prepare a khalifah like themselves. The Imam's highest work is what? `wa 'amilū al-ṣāliḥāt` (and do righteous deeds). The most righteous of deeds, the highest work is what? To prepare a successor like himself. The first son is the proof (`ḥujjat`). Yes. Allah's law is that after the Imam, his son will be the Imam. So why is there a need for so much effort? Meaning... Yes. The effort is for them, to make those who do not believe, believe. Okay. Okay. From his side, it's ready. From his side, it's ready. From God's side, it's ready. Yes. Yes. Yes. Parliament? Parliament won't be there. Only one Imam will be there, whose command will run. Throughout the entire world. 50,000 years. The religion of `fiṭrat`, Islam. All the 12 islands will be active then. The religion of Islam. His entire `daur` will be of the Imam. As it has been explained about `sitr`, that in `sitr`, from weakness (`ḍu'f`), strength (`quwwat`) increases. Here until the `sitr` is complete. In `kashf`, from strength, it goes towards weakness. `īmānī quwwat` (spiritual strength) begins. As you finish the `daur`, weakness will come. Then from there, the `daur` will end. A time will come. For `daur-i sitr`, it is said that in the `daur-i sitr`, 3,000 years... from strength, it will go towards weakness. At the end of `daur-i kashf`, the last 3,000 years. From strength to weakness. And after that, in `daur-i sitr`, from weakness to strength. 50,000 years... The duration of the... in it... there will be... there will be... there will be... as it has been stated in the `ṣalāsa-hā`, Zainab Hashim Ibrahim... in their `ṣuwar`... one is `qā'im-i fitrat`. The `qā'im-i fitrat` is one meaning... Yes. The `qā'im-i fitrat`... Hunaid has 3,000 years... 1,000 years... the `qiyām` is in `fitrat`. No. He is the `qā'im` of `fitrat` in one sense. He is the `qā'im` of `fitrat`. Hunaid has 3,000 years... The `Qaa'im` of `daur-i kashf` did not gather... 50,000 in 47 were gathered, three were not gathered. No, no. He gathered the whole 50. Hunaid... in it, the last 3,000 years, the `ṣuwar` that were there, in which the thoughts were of another type, which had come to deviation, those, Imam Hunaid `alayhissalatu was-salaam` gathered them. So the 3,000, the `Qaa'im` did not gather them. The `Qaa'im` gathered the whole 50,000 years of the `daur-i kashf`, the `ṣuwar` which were of the disposition of the `kashf`'s thoughts, he gathered them. And Imam Hunaid... ultimately went and gathered with the `Qaa'im` of `kashf`. Yes. That is, the `ṣalāsa-hā`'s gathering is where? The gathering of `ṣalāsa-hā` is with whom? Janaab `ayn-i 'aẓīmah`. `ṣalāsa-hā` are who? Hunaid, Hashim, Ibrahim, Qasim. The gathering of the three is with Janaab `ayn-i 'aẓīmah`. `Ali`'s... as they explained... `ayn`... `ayn`, `lām`, `yā`. These are all gathered there. The three `ṣuwar` that are there, the `ṣalāsa-hā` that are gathered, are there. And for `Ali`, they have explained that `Ali` and `lā ilāha illallāh` are in opposition. `muqābalah`, meaning what? `tanāsub`, `taqābul` (correspondence). In `Ali`, what is there? One letter has a dot, one is without a dot. In `lā ilāha illallāh`... `lā ilāha illallāh`... it is in opposition to `lā ilāha illallāh`. `nafī` (negation) and `ithbāt` (affirmation). After that, there are three letters in it. In `Ali`, just as in `lā ilāha illallāh` there are three letters, `alif`, `lām`, `hā'`. In `Ali` there are three letters. After that, what are the four in it? There are four words in `lā ilāha illallāh`. In `Ali`, what are the four? The two dots of `yā`. That has also been said. But he has taken five. The `lām` and `yā` have four dots. `lām` has 30 and `yā` has 10. 40. And `ayn` has how many? 70. Seven dots. And the total numerical value of `Ali` is 120. `ayn`, `lām`, `yā`, total is 110. Total मिलाकर (`milā kar`, combined) is 110. `ayn` is 70. Total मिलाकर (`milā kar`) is 110. Now, if we count its `mubā'ithāt` (emanations), from `ayn` come what? `yā` and `nūn`. 51. `yā` and `nūn` are how many? 10 and 50, 60. `lām` has `alif` and `nūn`. How many does that make? 41. 41 and 60, how many? 101. 101. And `yā` has `alif`. 102. No, I think it's 110 means 1... 11, and the dot makes 1. 12. 110 are there. 11 and... the dot's 1... 12. 110 are there. And from 110, they have taken 11, and from the dot, 1... 110...
