He said that... 11 and 1, 12. There are 11, and the zero added makes it 12. Now it is a `nuqṭah` (dot). When it is manifested, it will become the 12th. The 12 Imams... in opposition to that... `ayn-i 'aẓīmah`'s excellence is what? He is the `wazīr` (minister) of the `Qaa'im 'alayhissalatu was-salaam`. The `nuqṭah` will be manifested and become the 12th. The completion of the 12 of `lā ilāha illallāh` will be then.

<!-- lecture 23 -->

*Bismillah*... and may peace be upon his Messenger, Sayyidna Muhammad, and his progeny. *Bismillah al-Rahman al-Rahim*.

*Wa-innama sa... al-safa... innama li-safa'i ahl al-dawr al-kashf wa-izhar al-'ulum al-hikmiyyah 'ala ru'us al-ashhad, kamulat al-surah allati hiya dhalika al-'aql al-nurani wa-al-haykal al-tufsani fi muddat-i sab'at-i alaf-i sanah. Wa-li-kathafat-i ahl al-dawr al-sitr wa-shukukihim wa-takaddurihim wa-kathrat-i imtihanihim, kana kamalu hadhihi al-surah allati hiya huwa qa'im al-qiyamah, salamullah 'ala dhikrihim jami'an, li-'ashar-i alaf-i sanah.*

*Bismillah al-Rahman al-Rahim*. And indeed, for the sake of the purity of the people of the period of unveiling (*Ahl al-Dawr al-Kashf*), and for the manifestation of the sciences of wisdom upon the heads of witnesses, meaning, in an openly declared (`'ala al-i'lan`) manner, the form (`surah`) that was perfected is that very thing which is called the luminous intellect (`Aql al-Noorani`) and the `Haykal al-Tufsani`, in a period of seven thousand years.

He states that in the period of unveiling (*Dawr al-Kashf*), every seven thousand years, one *qaim* appears. And in the period of concealment (*Dawr al-Sitr*), it is after ten thousand years. The three thousand years of the period of interval (*Dawr al-Fatrat*) are also included in the period of concealment. The three thousand years of the `Dawr al-Fatrat` and the seven thousand years of the `Dawr al-Sitr`. Ten thousand years. This is after ten thousand years, and that is after seven thousand years. What is the reason for this? Why is it ten thousand years there, and seven thousand years here? Now, those three thousand years, although they are from the `Dawr al-Kashf`, are included in the `Dawr al-Sitr`—they are in the domain of the thoughts of the `Dawr al-Sitr`. They are included in that.

Three years... Ten thousand years. Three years? Ten thousand. Three years... three years. Ten thousand years it took for that *surah* to be established. To establish it. And here, seven thousand. Its reason is being stated.

The subtle intellect... the `Aql al-Noorani` and the `Haykal al-Tufsani`. The explanation of `haykal` will come later—what is a `haykal`? The perfected form is such that it is the `Aql al-Noorani` and the `Haykal al-Tufsani`, which is the `Qa'im al-Qiyamah`. Seven thousand years... The seven thousand years of the `Dawr al-Kashf`, it is an indication towards the *qaims* of those years. The `Aql al-Noorani` and the `Haykal al-Tufsani`, seven thousand years.

*Wa-li-kathafat-i ahl al-dawr al-sitr wa-shukukihim wa-takaddurihim.* And due to the denseness (`kathafat`) of the people of the `Dawr al-Sitr` and their doubts (`shukuk`) and their turbidity (`takaddur`) and their corruptions (`kharabiyon`) and due to the abundance of their trials (`imtihanat`), so it was that the perfection of that—*kana kamalu hadhihi al-surah*—and the perfection of that `surah` became such a `surah` that is called the `Qa'im al-Qiyamah`. May Allah's peace be upon their mention, all of them. `Li-'ashar-i alaf-i sanah`, ten thousand years. Ten thousand years... This `surah` was prepared in ten thousand years, and that one was prepared in seven thousand years. Due to the abundance of trials (`kasrat al-imtihan`). Abundance of trials, turbidity, and doubts. Every seven thousand years... The `Qa'im al-Qiyamah`, the establishment of the *qaim* occurred seven times in the `Dawr al-Kashf`. A `surah` was established; it was prepared in seven thousand years. In `Dawr al-Kashf`, seven *qaims* came. And in `Dawr al-Sitr`... Seven. Every seven thousand years, one *qaim* comes. Seven *qaims*... 49,000. It is being explained that in the `Dawr al-Kashf`, one *qaim* appeared every seven thousand years. Thus, seven *qaims* came in the `Dawr al-Kashf`. Every seven thousand years, one *qaim* appeared. But in the `Dawr al-Sitr`, one *qaim* comes after ten thousand years. And what is its reason? The seven thousand years are for the three thousand years of the interval. That includes the three thousand years of the `fatrat`.

Now, who came in the `Aakhir Qaim` [final *qaim*]? 49... Now he is clarifying it. The `qaim` is being mentioned. In the `Dawr al-Kashf`, there are seven *qaims*. In the `Dawr al-Sitr`, one *qaim*. Seven thousand years, one. In `Dawr al-Kashf`, seven *qaims*. He explains that in `Dawr al-Kashf`, one *qaim* appeared every seven thousand years. Thus, seven *qaims* came in the `Dawr al-Kashf`. Every seven thousand years, one *qaim* appeared. But in the `Dawr al-Sitr`, one *qaim* comes after ten thousand years. What is its reason? The seven thousand years are... and the three thousand years are of the `fatrat`. That is including the three thousand years of the `fatrat`. Now the final `qaim`, who is on the 49... It is not being stated. He is clarifying that in the `Dawr al-Kashf`, one *qaim* appeared every seven thousand years. So seven *qaims* came in `Dawr al-Kashf`. Every seven thousand years, one `qaim` appeared. But in `Dawr al-Sitr`, one `qaim` comes after ten thousand years. What is its reason? Seven thousand years are for... and three thousand years are of `fatrat`. The seven thousand years are for the `Dawr al-Kashf`, in which there is no turbidity (`takaddur`), no doubts (`shukuk`), and the sciences are spread openly. For this reason, it is seven thousand years there. And why is it ten thousand years here, in the `Dawr al-Sitr`? Because here, the turbidity of the `Dawr al-Fatrat` is present, doubts are present, abundance of trials are present. That is why it is ten thousand years. This is what he is stating.

*Ma'a anna kulla wahidin min hadhihi al-qul... al-mustakhrajah min 'alam... al-mustakhrajah min 'alam al-tabi'ah fi dawr al-kashf li-sab'at-i alaf-i sanah.* Along with the fact that every one of them, these principles (`usul`), which were extracted from the world of nature (`'alam al-tabi'ah`) in the `Dawr al-Kashf`, are for seven thousand years. *Wa-fi dawr al-sitr li-'ashar-i alaf-i sanah.* And in the `Dawr al-Sitr`, it is for ten thousand years.

*Wa-huwa qa'imun... wa-huwa qa'imun qiyamat al-kulliyyatin, ilayhi al-ma'abu wa-al-hisabu wa-ladayhi al-thawabu wa-al-'iqab.* And he is the `qiyamah` (resurrection), `kulli` (universal). To him is the return and the reckoning, and with him is the reward and the punishment. Every seven thousand years there is a `qiyamah`. Whether it is the `Dawr al-Kashf` or the `Dawr al-Sitr`. In `Dawr al-Sitr`, after ten thousand years there is a `qiyamah`. And in your hands is the reward and the punishment. *Wa-huwa al-musharu ilayhi bi-al-ilahiyyah.* And you are the one who has been indicated towards with divinity (`ilahiyyah`). *Fi hadhihi al-dar*, in this abode, in this house. For his own seven thousand years, he is the `Ilah`... that station of `Ilah`. That circle is the central circle. All those who revolve around it are bewildered about it, as to how he achieved this station.

Sir, in your copy, is it `dawr` or `dar`? `Dar`. `Fi hadhihi al-dar`. `Fi hadhihi...`. It's written `dawr`. It's written `dawr`. `Fi hadhihi al-dawr`. `Fi hadhihi al-dawr`. `Dar` is feminine in Arabic. Here it would be `fi hadhihi al-dar`. And `dawr` is masculine. `Fi hadha al-dawr` is written. In both meanings it is correct. `Fi hadha al-dawr`, this can also be. It's copied from a `da'i`'s work. The writer has written `fi hadhihi al-dar`. *Wa-al-musharu ilayhi bi-al-ilahiyyah fi hadhihi al-dar.*

*Wa-huwa al-natiqu bi-dhalika yawma... yawma ijtima' al-khala'iq bayna yadayhi.* And he is the speaker of that matter on the day when the creations will be gathered before him. The speaker... he will be the `Natiq`. Every seven thousand years there will be one `Natiq` who will assume the capacity. The `Natiq`... `Natiq`... It is the position of prophethood. The `Natiq`... he will speak about reward and punishment. Whom to give what reward, whom to give what punishment... in an authoritative position. *Wa-huwa al-natiqu bi-dhalika*. And that `qaim` will speak that matter on the day when the creations will be gathered before him. *Wa-kullu natiqin...* Only the `Imam al-Zamanah` will be the future `qa'im al-qiyamah`. *Juzwiyyah.* And every `Natiq` and every `wasi` and every `Imam al-Zamanah`, he too is in the same way a `qa'im al-qiyamah` (establisher of the resurrection), but in a partial (`juzwi`) sense. Partially. `Qa'im al-qiyamah`. He too is a `qa'im al-qiyamah` in one sense. Every `Natiq`. Because all the people who come in his period (`dawr`), for them he is the punishment. For them... the Prophet was told... what was he told? "Be a witness (`shahid`)." You will be a witness over the actions of all.

*Wa-kadhalika man yatluuhu min babin wa-hujjatin wa-da'in wa-ma'dhunin. Wa-kullu wahidin minhum qa'im al-qiyamah li-intiha... li-intihai man yantahi ilayhi min al-suwar al-mufariqah al-ka'inah 'indahu.* And similarly, the one who comes after him, whether from a `Bab`, a `Hujjah`, a `Da'i`, or a `Ma'dhun`. A `Da'i` or a `Ma'dhun`. `Da'i` is mentioned, `Ma'dhun`. `Imam`, `Bab`, `Hujjah`, `Da'i`, and `Ma'dhun`. And every one of them is a `qa'im al-qiyamah`. *Bismillah al-Rahman al-Rahim*—what was said about it? That the statement `La ilaha illa Allah`—what is in it? What is its quality? There are twenty-eight qualities. Apart from that, what other quality does it have? The statement is between the beginner and the end. That it is. But `La ilaha illa Allah`. `Allah`—how many times has it come in this? `La`—how many times has it come? One time. Lam—how many times has it come? Lam. Lam. In `La` there is one `lam`, in `ilah` the second, in `illa` the third... `La ilaha illa Allah`. In `Allah` there are two `lams`. Five times. This is a quality of the statement. Five times... `alif`—how many times has it come? Five times. Five times. `Ha`—how many times has it come? Two times. Repetition. This is a repetition. The five that came in *Bismillah al-Rahman al-Rahim* came in a different way. The entire splendor of *Bismillah* is present in `La ilaha illa Allah`, but in a different manner. Five are repeated (`mukarrar`), five... which is the highest of the 49 letters? `Alif`. `Alif` is the highest. That is non-repeated (`ghayr mukarrar`). And `lam` is for the repeated (`mukarrar`). `Lam` is for the repeated. So, what do they say in this? When we recite *Bismillah al-Rahman al-Rahim*, the first lesson of spiritual training is to wipe the hand over the face. What does it mean? That the five... five lower (`adwan`) ranks, five higher (`ashraf`) ranks... the connection. The five lower ranks and the five higher ranks... `adwan` are those who, among the four, are the greatest. Leaving the face, how many times do the five come on us? 5 x 5 = 25. How so? The five fingers of the left foot, five in the right, five in the left hand, and five in the right hand. And five in the face. How many does that make? 5 x 5 = 25. In this, the fifth one... in this, the highest... leaving the face, from that, what do you... you don't wipe with your left hand, do you? With the right hand. Of the five, leaving the face, the one that is the highest, you wipe that over the face. What does that signify? What is its meaning? The connection of the lower with the higher. And who are the higher ones? In the face, there is no repetition of the heart. They don't come as repeated. Who are they? Intellect (`'aql`), soul (`nafs`), `jadd`, `fath`, `khayal`. Intellect (`'aql`), soul (`nafs`), `jadd`, `fath`, `khayal`. These five. `Aql` is `Aql-i Awwal`. `Aql-i Thani`. And then their counterparts who are established in the world. `Jadd`, `fath`, and `khayal`—who are these three? Those who are connected to the `Imam` with their confirmations (`ta'yidat`). These five. These do not come as repeated. They have become established; they have achieved the second perfection (`kamal-i thani`). Now in the world, there is no repetition. What does repetition mean? A quarrel? Repetition means... they do not come repeatedly. And the five of the hand, these are repeated. On this hand, on this one, on this one, on this one. Their manifestation occurs in the world. Who are they? `Imam`... This is... when wiping the hand over the face, one should have this concept so that the gnostic form is established. It should be imprinted on your spiritual form. Just wiping the hand won't do anything. With this concept, when you wipe your hand, it gets imprinted on your spiritual form. So, that is what he is saying here. `Bab`, `Hujjah`, `Da'i`... After the Imam, it is `Bab`, `Hujjah`, `Da'i`, and `Ma'dhun`.

*Wa-kullu wahidin minhum qa'im al-qiyamah...* The term `qa'im al-qiyamah` applies to every one of them. *...li-intihai man yantahi ilayhi.* For those people whose end is with them. For that person who returns to them. Upon reaching... for those who reach them. They return to them. *Min al-suwar al-mufariqah*, such forms that leave, that come to be in their presence. *...li-annahu huwa al-qa'imu biha*. Because he is the one who establishes them by that rank. *Wa-kullu wahidin min ha'ula'i qa'im al-qiyamah juzwiyyah.* And every one of these ranks is a `qa'im al-qiyamah` in a partial sense. *Wa-alladhi huwa fawqahu qa'im al-qiyamah kulliyyah.* Where he mentioned `kulli`, above that is `juzwi`. And where he mentioned `juzwi`, above that is `kulli`. *Wa-alladhi huwa fawqahu...* And that person who is above them will be the `qa'im al-qiyamah` in a universal sense (`kulliyyah`). *...'ala ma sabaqa bihi al-qawl.* In the same way that the statement preceded. *...ila an yantahi al-jami'u ila qa'im al-kull al-qiyamat.* Until all of them reach towards such a `qaim` who is the `qaim` of the entire `qiyamah`. *Alladhi huwa sahib al-qiyamat al-'uzma.* Such a one who is the master of the greatest resurrection (`qiyamat al-'uzma`). *Wa-al-batshat al-kubra.* And the greatest seizure. *Kama qala Allahu ta'ala: yawma nabtishu al-batshat al-kubra, inna muntaqimun.* As Allah, the Exalted, has said, "The day when we will inflict the greatest seizure, indeed we are the avengers." As Allah, the Almighty, has said that that will be a day when we will inflict the greatest attack. `Batsh` means attack. We... its meaning is... there are several meanings of `batasha`. When you stand against enemies, what should you say? "When you strike, you strike as tyrants (`jabbarin`)." Attack in the way that tyrants attack. When you are steadfast in the face of the enemy, `batasha`. To seize with force, to attack, to pounce. When you attack, pounce on them. Attack with force. "The day we will inflict the greatest seizure." When we will attack, it will be a great attack. Indeed, we are among the avengers, meaning we will take... a severe revenge. *Fa-subhana man hadhihi al-sunnatu sunnatuh.* *Subhana man hadhihi al-sunnatu sunnatuh.* So glorified is that being... Glorified is that being whose way this is. This way is His way. *Wa-hadhihi al-qudratu qudratuh.* And this power is His power. *Wa-la ilaha illa alladhi awjada mujidu hadhihi al-khala'iq 'ala tabayuni anwa'iha.* *Tabayuni anwa'iha. Wa-al-hamdu lillahi rabb al-'alamin. Wa-salla Allahu 'ala rasulihi Sayyidna Muhammadin wa-alihi al-tayyibin al-tahirin.* And there is no god except that being who created, who is the creator of these creations upon the diversity of their kinds. And all praise is for Allah, the Lord of the worlds. And may Allah's peace be upon His Messenger, Sayyidna Muhammad, and his pure and chaste progeny. He is clarifying that all the points that will appear until the `qiyamah kulliyyah` (universal resurrection) are all present in the primordial initial body (`jussa-i ibda'iyyah`) of the first blueprint (`mawr-i awwal`). The points are present. Their manifestation (`zuhur`) will happen as the time comes. Whoever has the `mawr` for a `qawr` (cycle), the plan (`tadbir`) for that `qawr` rests with him. Whoever accepted the plan of the `Aalam-i Noorani` (luminous world), their plan is with them. So who will manage the `zuhur`? The one who is the `mawr-i awwal`, with whom the plan is, will manage it. If it is for one `qawr`, then the plan will be to the extent of one `qawr`, and that's it. If it's for ten `qawrs`, then the plan will be for ten `qawrs`. If it's for 400 `qawrs`, then the plan will be for 400 `qawrs`. He who has the `mawr`, the plan of the `mawr` will be with him. Whoever has the plan, in the `Aalam-i Noorani`, the way people accepted it, according to that, the plan will be. In the primordial blueprint (`mawr`), the plan is for the `surah` (form) and its completion. The plan rests with him until he prepares a successor (`janashin`) like himself. One like himself. A `kulli` (universal) successor. The plan is his. When he prepares a successor, a `kulli` successor, he will be elevated. Its indication is given for that as well. For both the partial (`juzwi`) and the universal (`kulli`). For the `qawr`, what is it? One like himself. A successor. One like himself does not mean his son. `Juzwi` is through the son. One like himself, when he prepares, he will be elevated. He will be elevated from his station. If he is a `qa'im-i kulli` (universal `qaim`), he will prepare a `qa'im-i kulli` like himself. A `qa'im-i juzwi` (partial `qaim`) will prepare a `qa'im-i juzwi` like himself. If his `qaim` is for 57,000 years, he will have to prepare a `qaim` for 57,000 years. If it is for a `dawr` (period) in which there are 400,000 years, then he will have to prepare one like himself for 400,000 years. Then he will be elevated. Until then, its small points will remain. As the opportunity arises, they will manifest. Their time is appointed. In the `Aalam-i Amr` (World of Command), all the stations were assigned, of the twelve, of the seven. Is it happening in the same way in the `Aalam-i Niyyat` (World of Intention) and the `Aalam-i Jismani` (Physical World)? When the creation of the `Aalam-i Jismani`, the `Aalam-i Tabi'at` (World of Nature) happened, there was a correspondence, the `mawr-i awwal` is alone, but there was a correspondence. So here too, can we... that the Imams also have a correspondence? The `A'immah` have the plan of the `hudud`. With the `A'immah`, there is the plan of the `hujjah`. Does a correspondence of the plan happen? Because it is necessary that whatever is happening in the heavens, its reflection must be on the earth. In the `Aalam-i Niyyat`, when the Imam, peace and blessings be upon him, stepped forward, seeing them, a person came forward who was called the `Bab`. Now, when the Imam manifests, his `Bab` will also manifest. They will manifest together. That original point is there. According to that, the manifestation occurs. When the term `qa'im al-qiyamah` comes up, the `qa'im al-qiyamah` has his individual plan. But wherever the other points are, which are subordinate to him—`'ayn`, `mim`, or your `jadd`, `fath`, `khayal`—they are all shown in a dual capacity. Mawla 'Abd al-Muttalib, the `jadd` of the `qaim`; Mawla Abu Talib, the `fath`; your mothers are the mothers of the `qaim`. All these are... a conjunction (`qiran`) has occurred. So... a correspondence is understood from that. It is possible there. In the plan as well.

*Wa-idh qad intaha bina al-qawlu ila ma intaha, wa-awdahna fi dhalika ma awdahna min zuhur al-qamat al-'arafiyyah al-insaniyyah nabatan min al-ard, kama qala Allahu ta'ala: wallahu anbatakum min al-ardi nabata.* And when the discussion has reached us to where it has reached, and we have clarified in that what we have clarified regarding the manifestation of the gnostic human form (`qamat al-'arafiyyah al-insaniyyah`) as a plant (`nabat`) from the earth, as Allah the Exalted says, "And Allah has caused you to grow from the earth as a plant." *Fa-nuridu an natakallama 'ala wujudihi wa-al-munakahatihi wa-taraqqi nafsihi rutbatan rutbatan, li-yahiqqa al-qari'... kitabana hadha... li-yahiqqa li-qari'i kitabana hadha wujud al-shakhs al-basari aydan mutasalsilan.* So we intend to speak about his existence and from inter-marriages (`munakahat`) and the ascent of his soul (`nafs`) rank by rank, so that it may be confirmed for the reader of this book of ours... the existence of the physical person also in a continuous series. The original is `nakaha`. `Nakaha`. The original three letters are `nakaha`. And from that, what is it? To marry one another. `Tanakuh`. The verbal noun is `tanakuh`. What does the verbal noun mean? To marry one another. It is called `tanakuh`. `Musafahah`. What does `musafahah` mean? To greet one another. `Safaha`. To join hands with one another. What does that mean? `Tasafuh`. The word means "with one another." `Musadaqah`: to be truthful with one another. `Munasabah`: to have a connection with one another. This is an Arabic method. `Munasabah`, `musafahah`, `munakahah`, `musadaqah`. To curse one another. `Muhadathah`: to talk with one another. `Muhadathah`. If it's one person, you don't say `muhadathah`, you say `hadatha`. When two or more people talk with one another, it's `muhadathah`. And from that is `mula'anah`: to curse one another. This is a pattern, an Arabic pattern. There are 17 patterns of the augmented verb forms, and this is one of them. That pattern is used here. `Munakahah`: from marrying one another, and from the ascent of their soul, rank by rank. So that it becomes clear for the reader of our book, the existence of the physical person in a continuous series. *Kama qala Allahu ta'ala*, as Allah the Exalted has said: *wa-laqad khalaqna al-insana min sulalatin min tin. Thumma ja'alnahu nutfatan fi qararin makin.* As Allah the Almighty has said, "And indeed, we created man from an extract of clay. Then we made him a drop in a firm resting place (`qararin makin`)." *Al-ayah*. So that one may know his existence is from two ways, all of them. And how the ascent of souls occurs and the ascent through means. So that one may know that his existence is from two ways. From a plant and also from... and from `munakahat`, from lineage. And how the ascent of souls happens. It happens from a plant, how? Through the `da'i`s, etc., in the gardens. And `munakahat`, how? After that.

*Fa-naqulu: inna tilka al-ashbah al-suwariyyah lamma waqa'at fi al-ab'ad al-thalathah bima kana minha min al-zallati wa-al-khati'ati wa-ba'udat wa-takaththafat wa-takaddarat, 'amadat al-'inayat al-ilahiyyah ila tabdidiha wa-tafriqiha fi al-aflak wa-al-ummahat 'ala ma sabaqa minhu al-qawl.* So we say: indeed those formal apparitions, when they fell into the three dimensions due to what occurred from them of the slip and the error, and they became distant and dense and turbid, the Divine Providence intended to disperse them and to separate them in the celestial spheres and the mothers, according to what has preceded in the discussion. When they became distant, denseness became necessary. The denseness of the spheres became necessary. Because of that denseness and turbidity, they were not fit to remain in the world of spirits. So the command was given: "Descend." This is the Big Bang. When the Big Bang happened, denseness began to appear in them. Sir, is there no clarification here that these are the `shaqi'in` (the damned ones) or... that this is how the world came into being. `Tabdid` is a word used, meaning to scatter them. This was done for a special purpose, for their purification. *Li-tasfu bi-tilka al-imtihanat wa-al-a'rad wa-al-'adhab kama yasfu al-dhahab al-ibriz bi-ta'riqihi fi al-nar.* So that their purification may happen through those trials and tribulations and punishments, just as pure gold is purified by being placed in the fire. The trials and punishments were imposed on them so that just as gold, when you melt it, it becomes pure `ibriz` (gold), in the same way, they too are to be made into gold. They have come into denseness, and this denseness has to be removed. So they are put into trials.

*Thumma ista'rafat li-jam'ihi wa-lammihi ba'd al-'adhab wa-al-imtihan, wa-izharihi ila al-qamat al-'arafiyyah min al-ard nabatan.* Then, after that, it began their gathering and their collection after the punishment and the trial, and its manifestation towards the `qamat al-'arafiyyah` (gnostic form) from the earth as a plant. Before coming here, there were trials? In the spheres, they were cast. In the spheres and the mothers and the rock. The world of life is their veil. *Thumma akhadhat al-'inayah al-ilahiyyah fi ikhraj ma tahayya'a ba'da dhalika bi-tariqah thaniyah, hiya bi-khilaf tilka al-tariqat al-uwla.* Then the Divine Providence took up the task of bringing out that which was prepared after that through a second way, which is contrary to that first way. The spheres, the mothers, and the rock, where things were prepared. After that, from there, they were made to manifest in the world through a special method. The spheres, the mothers... things in the mothers and things in the rock. God forbid, things in the rock... but they do come. So the special things from there are manifested in the world through humanity. So those very things that were processed there came to the earth. They came to the earth and became manifest in one place, with humans. *Thumma akhadhat... thumma akhadha... akhadha fi ikhraj...* Then it took up the task of bringing out that which was prepared after that through a second way. *Hiya bi-khilaf al-tariqat al-uwla.* Which is contrary to the first way. It is other than that. *Wa-aqrabu minha wa-asra'u li-wijdanih.* And it is closer to it and faster for its existence. It is very close to that. The first way, and this is closer than the second. In the mothers, the child also remains. It has the form of a womb. That entire... the spheres, and in them the `janan` (fetus) remains in the mothers, it's been thousands of years. Now it has come into the world. So this is a much faster way. It is closer and faster for its existence.

*Fa-hasarat jamia ma tahayya'a li-al-su'ud wa-al-zuhur, wa-istahaqqat li-dhalika fi al-mawalid al-thalathah, allati hiya al-ma'dan wa-al-nabat wa-al-hayawan.* So it encompassed all that was prepared for the ascent and manifestation. Who did? The Divine Providence encompassed them. For them who... for whom manifestation was to happen in the world, it encompassed them. For them, what did it do? And it became worthy of that matter in the three kingdoms (`mawalid al-thalathah`), which are mineral (`ma'dan`), plant (`nabat`), and animal (`hayawan`). Now Allah wants to make them manifest. So He will make them manifest from the mineral, the plant, and the animal. *Wa-ja'alathu ghidha'an li-tilka al-ashkhas al-zahirah min al-magharat bi-al-jussas al-ibda'iyyah.* And the Divine Providence made that—the mineral, plant, and animal—food for those apparent persons from the caves with the primordial bodies (`jussas al-ibda'iyyah`). *Fa-da'at-ha ila dhatiha.* So the primordial `jussa` called those foods to its own self. The `jussa`... what does `da'at` mean? The primordial `jussa`. The primordial `jussa` called those foods to its own self. *Wa-qtadhat biha.* And the primordial `jussa` ate those foods. *Wa-sayyarat-ha min jumlat-i ajsamih.* And made them, according to the parts of its body. *Lahman wa-daman, jami'an li-al-taba'i al-arba'.* As flesh, as blood, gathering the four natures. The four natures are what? Phlegm (`safra`), black bile (`sauda`), blood (`dam`), and bile (`balgham`). This... is the primordial `jussa` doing this? The body making it and this... No, it's a veil. What is... And that which manifests in the world is a physical veil. Its explanation is being given.

*Wa-huwa altafu ma-qtadhat bihi wa-sta'malathu.* And it is the most subtle of what it ate and used. The food which that human being obtained, and which he ate and made part of his body, was the most subtle of all foods, and the most high and noble. Just as a believer is careful about lawful and unlawful food, so this is the primordial `jussa`. *Li-annaha 'inda-qtida'iha bi-dhalika ta'khudhu al-latif wa-tad'u al-kathif.* Because at the time of eating that, it would take the subtle and leave out the dense. We eat things, in them is both dense and subtle. While eating, it's not felt. But when it exits, it exits with its denseness. *Wa-idha kana waqt al-mulamasah bayna al-rajul wa-al-mar'ah, imtahadha... imtahadha... al-jisman.* When the time of contact between the man and the woman occurs... they meet, the two bodies meet. *Fa-nsalla 'anhuma altafu ma fiha.* Then from them both descends the most subtle of what is in them. Descends... emerges. Emerges from both of their bodies. *Fa-sara sa'idan ila al-dimagh.* It ascends... ascending towards the brain. *Li-an yuqassiruhu.* So that the brain may refine it. The function of the brain is to refine. *Wa-yu'iduhu abyad.* And it makes it white. After it was thick, foul-smelling blood. *Wa-huwa maslulun min jami' a'da' al-jism.* And it is drawn from all the organs of the body. *Saghirih wa-kabirih, 'aliha wa-daniha.* Small or big. High or low. Our Master, the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, says: "In every hair, there is `janabah` (ritual impurity)." For which washing is commanded. Because of this. It's drawn from every hair. *Fa-idha sara... wa-yu'iduhu abyad ba'da an kana daman ghamitan.* Meaning the `gudd` (gland) which... its reference is to that. The `gudd` in the body which is affected by it, and the brain refines it, trains it. *Wa-yu'iduhu abyad ba'da an kana daman ghamitan. Wa-huwa maslulun min jami' a'da' al-jism, saghirih wa-kabirih, 'aliha wa-daniha.*

*Fa-idha sara munqasiran, inhadara min al-zawjayn jami'an ila mustaqarrihi alladhi qad huyyi'a lahu, wa-huwa rahm al-imra'ah.* When it becomes refined, it descends from the couple, both of them, to its resting place which has been prepared for it, and that is the womb of the woman. *Fa-yasiru jumlatun wahidatan.* Here, the question that came up two days ago, that from the woman's body too... from both things... not just that water collects in the man's spine, it also collects in the woman's. From both... it is being clarified from both. It has been made clear. Here, that it is from both, in the womb of the woman... descends from them both. It is `'anhuma`. From both of them it is extracted. `'Altafu ma fihima`. *Alladhi qad huyyi'a lahu wa-huwa rahm al-imra'ah.* And it is the womb of the woman. *Wa-yasiru jumlatun wahidatan.* Then it becomes a single entity. *Jami'atan li-al-arba' taba'i.* Gathering the four natures. The man's nature and the woman's nature, both combine and become one single entity. *Wa-fi zimn tilka al-jumla hayatun hayulaniyyatun kamilatun, fiha ka-kumun al-nar fi 'ud al-zinad.* And within that entity is a complete animal life, hidden in it like the hiding of fire in the wood of a flint. *Wa-hiya al-musammat bi-al-tabi'ah wa-bi-al-khamirah al-ibda'iyyah wa-bi-al-nafs al-namiyyah wa-bi-al-surah aydan.* And it is named `tabi'ah` (nature). And it is that life which is called `tabi'ah`. And that same is the primordial leaven (`khamirah al-ibda'iyyah`). That same is the growing soul (`nafs al-namiyyah`). That same is the `surah` (form). The `surah` means the growing `surah`.

*Fa-idha kanat hadhihi al-jumla kamilat al-taba'i.* So when this entity becomes complete in its natures, *mu'tadilah fi mizajiha*, balanced in its temperament... The temperament is balanced. *Qad udhina laha bi-al-zuhur.* It has been given permission to manifest. *Wa-wafaqat ma'daniyan naqiyyan, tahiran, mu'tadilan.* And it corresponds with a mineral place that is pure, clean, and balanced. Such a place... the womb is such a place. It corresponds with that. *Wa-huwa al-rahm.* And that is the womb. *Fa-istaqarrat fihi.* So it settles there. *Wa-qabalaha al-tali' wa-al-gharib wa-al-'ashir wa-al-rabi'.* And it is faced by the ascendant, the descendant, the tenth, and the fourth [astrological houses]. *Bi-hukm al-kawn.* By the decree of the cosmos. By the decree of the cosmos, for its existence.

*Wa-qad sarat mutahayyi'atan, munfa'ilatan lima yaridu 'alayha, mutakhammiratan fi al-rahm, ba'daha bi-ba'din, ka-takhmir al-anfahati wa-al-laban, al-sa'iri jubunan.* And it has become in a state of being prepared, receptive to what comes upon it, fermenting in the womb, one with another, like the fermentation of rennet and milk, which becomes cheese. *Jubun* is cheese. Cheese.

*Fa-idha sarat hadhihi al-jumla*... This is *Fasl al-thani min al-bab al-rabi' min al-sirat al-thani*. So when this entity is upon this level, *qabalaha al-kawakib fa'ilatan fiha*, the planets face it, acting upon it. *Wa-jtama'a dhalika al-latif al-sha'i' fiha*, and that subtle thing which radiates in it gathers. *Wa-huwa zubdatuha, ka-jtima' zubdat al-laban.* And that is its essence, like the gathering of the essence of milk, which is butter. The essence of milk. *Wa-huwa latif kulli tabi'ah min hadhihi al-taba'i.* And it is the subtle part of every nature from these natures. *Fa-yalta'im wa-yasir jumlatun wahidatan.* So it takes its essence and becomes a single entity. *Thumma inna awwala ma yanfa'ilu min tilka al-jumla allati hiya al-nutfah, nuqtat al-birkar, allati hiya al-qalb.* Then indeed, the first thing that is formed from that entity which is the drop (`nutfah`) is the point of the compass (`nuqtat al-birkar`), which is the heart. The heart is formed first. *Wa-tab'uhu tab'u fi'l al-shams.* And its nature is the nature of the sun's action. *Alladhi huwa al-hararah wa-al-yubus.* That which is heat and dryness. *Wa-huwa al-jadhib li-tilka al-jumlat al-latifah.* And it is the attractor of that subtle entity. *Fa-yasiru baytan laha wa-markazan.* And it becomes a house for it and a center. The heart becomes its house. *Wa-markazan*. And a center. *Thumma yanfa'ilu sa'ir al-a'da' ba'da dhalika al-'azw.* Then the rest of the organs are formed after that organ. First the heart is formed, and after that, all the other organs are formed. *Wa-al-aba' allati hiya al-kawakib hiya al-fa'ilah li-dhalika.* And the fathers, which are the planets, are the agents for that. They cause an effect for this matter. *Wa-al-ummahat, al-hawazin, alladhina hum al-rahm.* And the mothers, the wombs, which are the womb. These are those who are the wombs that nurse. They are the womb. *Wa-ma talahu min al-a'da'.* And what follows it of the organs. *Wa-kullu 'azwin min hadhihi al-a'da' yumiddu ma-nfa'ala min a'da' tilka al-nutfah mumathilan lahu, ittiba' kulli 'azwin min a'da' tilka al-nutfah mithla tab'i 'azwi ummiha.* And every organ from these organs provides aid to what was formed from the organs of that `nutfah`, similar to it, as every organ from the organs of that `nutfah` follows the nature of the organ of its mother. The mother... and the mother is from the spheres. So every organ has a guardian (`mutawalli`). There is a guardian in the spheres for every organ. *La tughadiru wa-la tubayinu fi shay'in minha.* It does not miss nor differ in anything from it. *Wa-jami' ma taqtadihi al-ummu yaftariqu 'ala a'da'iha fi a'da'iha.* And all that the mother eats is distributed among her organs. Among the child's organs. *Wa-kullu 'azwin min a'da' tilka al-nutfah yattasilu bihi qistuhu.* And every organ from the organs of that `nutfah`, its share reaches it. *Min dhalika al-ghidha'.* From that food. *Bi-wasatat-i 'azwi ummiha.* Through the medium of its mother's organ. *Thumma inna sawari tilka al-jumlat al-latifah tumiddu al-a'da' al-'alawiyyah min al-qalb ila al-ra's. Wa-kullu 'azwin bima yastahiqquhu.* Then indeed, the channels of that subtle entity provide aid to the higher organs from the heart to the head, each organ according to what it deserves. *Wa-tumiddu al-a'da' al-sufliyyah min al-qalb ila al-qadamayn.* And they provide aid to the lower organs from the heart to the two feet. *Kama anna al-shams allati hiya qalb al-falak tumiddu lima 'ala'iha min al-kawakib wa-al-aflak wa-lima huwa dunaha hadhwan bi-hadhwin.* Just as the sun, which is the heart of the celestial sphere, provides aid to what is above it of the planets and spheres, and to what is below it, step by step. It is the fourth. Three are above it, and three are below it. Just as the body has its three parts. All of them are aided by it. Three parts are above, and three are below. *Wa-kadhalika shams 'alam al-din, alladhi huwa al-natiq, salamullah 'alayh, yumiddu bi-al-'ulum al-ilahiyyah wa-al-ta'yidat al-malakutiyyah man fawqahu min hududin wa-man dunahu min hudud al-din. Min tahtihi. Wa-sa-ya'ti al-qawlu 'ala dhalika fi mawdi'ihi, insha'Allah ta'ala.* And similarly, the sun of the world of religion, who is the `Natiq`, peace be upon him, gives aid with the divine sciences and the spiritual confirmations to those above him of the `hudud` and those below him of the `hudud` of religion, from below him. And the discussion on this will come in its place, if Allah the Exalted wills. He gives them aid. He is aided by them. From above him... from the `hudud`... and from below him... from the `hudud` of religion. He gives them aid, he helps them. He is aided by them... and he is from below him. And from below him. The discussion on this will come in its place, if Allah wills.

<!-- lecture 24 -->

min al-bab al-rabi`. min al-bab al-rabi`. Min al-... `Kharajatin min al-`... `Kawakib al-sab`... `Summa... summa... min al-kawkab... min al-kawakib... min al-kawakib al-sab'a` (from the seven planets/celestial bodies)... `al-sab'a`. `Summa... min al-kawakib... sab'ati` (of the seven)... `bi-'ayanin min kulli jihhatin`... `shahrin wahidin` (one month)... `hata takhuta min al-sab'ati`. `Wa-tukmiluha fi hadhihi al-muddati`. `Min jasad al-janin...` From the seven celestial bodies, and seven of their `kawakib`. The seven `kawakib` are `Shams` (Sun)... उसके ऊपर... The first `kawkab` is which one? `Zuhal` (Saturn). `Mushtari` (Jupiter). `Mirrikh` (Mars). `Shams` (Sun). `Zuhra` (Venus). `'Utarid` (Mercury). `Qamar` (Moon). And every `kawkab` from these seven `kawakib`... `bi-'ayanin`... the `nutfah` (semen-drop) that is to be acted upon... it acts for one month... `hata takhuta min al-sab'a` (until it traverses the seven). Until he passes through... he grants seven... seven months pass... and seven qualities... `fa-tukmiluha fi hadhihi al-muddati` (and He completes it in this period). And He completes it in this period. `Wa-kharaja mauludan kamilan` (and he comes out a complete newborn)... `ila fushat al-ard` (to the expanse of the earth). `Fi al-shahr al-sabi'` (in the seventh month). Thus, it comes out as a complete newborn... to the surface of the earth in the seventh month. This is because the `tadbir` (governance) is of the `qamar` (moon). The seventh is the `qamar`. After seven months, in the first month, it is the `tadbir` of `Zuhal` (Saturn). In the second, it is of `Mushtari` (Jupiter). Third, `Mirrikh` (Mars). Fourth, `Shams` (Sun). When the `tadbir` of `Shams` occurs, the power of the heart is created in it, and movement is created. The formation of the heart occurs. In the fourth month. In the fourth month. And from there... in the first three months, it is not apparent, except that menstruation stops, that's a different matter. In the first three months, the movement of the heart is not known. When the fourth month comes, the movement of the baby's heart is felt. And after that, the fifth, sixth, and seventh. In the `dawr` (cycle) of the `qamar`, when the effects of the `qamar` are present, the baby can be born. Babies are often born in the seventh month. But the heart is, first of all... In the `dawr` of `Shams`. In the `dawr` of `Shams`. Meaning, the heart becomes complete, and movement begins in it. Then what does he say? `Wa-rubbama 'arada lahu 'aridun fa-lam yakhruj fi al-shahr al-sabi'` (And perhaps a contingency befalls it, so it does not come out in the seventh month). And sometimes, a matter happens to it, so it does not come out in the seventh month. The `maulud` (newborn) is not born in the seventh month. `fa-istaqarra fi batni ummihi ila al-shahr al-thamin` (so it settles in its mother's womb until the eighth month). So it becomes settled... it remains in its mother's womb until the eighth month. `Wa-fihi ya'udu al-tadbiru ila zuhal` (And in it, the governance returns to Saturn). And in it, the `tadbir` returns to `Zuhal`. `Alladhi huwa nahs al-falaki` (Which is the inauspiciousness of the celestial sphere). This is because it is the inauspicious star of the celestial sphere. `Wa-fi'luhu al-burudatu wa-al-yubs` (And its action is coldness and dryness). `Alladhi huwa tab' al-mawt` (Which is the nature of death). And its action is `burudat` (coldness) and `yubs` (dryness). This is because it is the nature of death. `Fa-in zahara dhalika al-janinu fihi, zahara mayyitan` (So if that fetus appears in it, it appears dead). But if that baby appeared, it will appear dead. The eighth month makes it dead. In it... its limbs all become as if paralyzed, due to its `tabi'at` (nature). From `Zuhal`. Due to the `tabi'at` of `Zuhal`. `Fa-in istaqarra fi batni ummihi ila al-shahr al-tasi', sara fi tadbir al-mushtari, alladhi huwa fi al-falaki al-sa'd al-akbar` (But if it settles in its mother's womb until the ninth month, it comes under the governance of Jupiter, which is in the celestial sphere the greater good fortune). And if it became settled... in its mother's womb until the ninth month, then it is in the `tadbir` of `Mushtari`. This is because it is, in the celestial sphere, the `sa'd al-akbar` (greater good fortune). `Mushtari` is called the `sa'd al-akbar`. `nayyirayn` is what they call `shams` and `qamar` (the two luminaries). `Sa'dayn` (the two good fortunes) are `Mushtari` and `Zuhra`. `Zuhra`. And `'Utarid` is what? It is `katib al-falak` (the scribe of the sphere). `Sa'd al-akbar`, `sa'd al-asghar` (the lesser good fortune) are `Mushtari` and `Zuhra`. `Wa-fi'luhu al-hararatu wa-al-linu` (And its action is heat and softness/moisture). And its action is `hararat` (heat) and it creates moisture. It creates moisture. `Allati hiya tab'u al-hayat` (Which is the nature of life). This is because it is the nature of life. Life is created from heat and `lin`. From moisture. This is because it is the nature of life. `Zahara al-janinu hayyan`. `Quds`. `Inna wujuda al-nafsi bi-wujudi mawdu'iha` (That the existence of the soul is by the existence of its substrate). That the existence of the `nafs` (soul) is with... its `mawdu` (substrate). Its surroundings. The qualities of its surroundings should be good. There should be heat, there should be moisture. If it didn't... if all these things were not provided to it properly, then the `nafs` dies. Are there stations of `nufus` (souls)? Yes. Are there stations of `nufus`? The station of `nafs al-namiyya` (the vegetative soul) is in the womb. The mother's womb. And... the station of `nafs al-hissiyya` (the sensory soul) is... when it is born into the world, the `nafs hissiyya`... its effect remains. `Wa-ma'na qawli amir al-mu'minina 'aliyyibni abi talibin 'alayhi al-salam li-l-sa'il alladhi sa'alahu 'an al-namiyyati ma hiya` (And the meaning of the saying of the Commander of the Faithful, 'Ali ibn Abi Talib, peace be upon him, to the questioner who asked him about the vegetative [soul], what is it?). And the meaning of the saying of Amir al-Mu'minin, 'Ali ibn Abi Talib, peace be upon him... to the questioner who asked you about the `namiyya`, what it is. What thing is `nafs al-namiyya`? What thing is it? So what did you say? `Fa-qala` (So he said). He said... `Inna al-nafs al-namiyyata quwwatun tabi'iyyatun` (The vegetative soul is a natural power). That `nafs al-namiyya` is a natural power. It is a power. It is the name of a power. `Asluha min taba'i'i al-arba'a` (Its origin is from the four natures). Its origin is from four natures. Which are the four natures? `Burudat`, `yubs`... heat... heat... `yubs`. `Rutubat`, `burudat`. Four natures. `Wa-ittihaduha 'inda masqati al-nutfah` (And their union is at the place where the drop of semen is deposited). And its union is when the `nutfah` is established. `Wa-mawadduha min nata'iji al-aghdhiyati al-latifah` (And its substances are from the results of refined foods). And its `mawad` (substance)... from where does it obtain things? From where does it get its substance for all its growth? To grow... from where does it get its `mawad`? From refined foods. From refined foods. The refined foods that are there, from them, it gets its `mawad`. The mother eats refined foods, and its essence is drawn and joins the child. `Fi'luha al-numuwwu wa-al-ziyadatu` (Its action is growth and increase). Its action is `numuww` (growth), meaning to move forward. And `ziyadah` (increase), to become more. `Sababu iftiraqiha ikhtilafu al-mawadi` (The cause of its separation is the difference/disagreement of substances). The cause of its separation is... why does it leave? An `ikhtilaf` (disagreement/imbalance) in the `mawad`. What does `mawad` mean? The foods it was getting were not reaching it properly. `Wa-idha faraqat, 'adat ila mawdi'in minhu badat` (And when it separates, it returns to the place from which it began). When it leaves... `nafs al-namiyya`, when it leaves, it returns... to the place from where it had come. From where had it come? From the `qamar` (moon). To that station... it goes away. `Li-anna jami'a ma tahta falaki al-qamari mahkumun ila nuqtati al-ardi allati hiya al-sakhratu wa-yuqalu 'alayha al-namiyyatu al-kubra` (because all that is beneath the sphere of the moon is governed unto the point of the earth which is the rock, and it is called the Greater Vegetative [Soul]). There are great truths (`haqa'iq`) in this. Because everything that is below... the `falak` (sphere) of the `qamar`, from it... all things are below the sphere of the `qamar`... `ila nuqtat al-ard` (to the point of the earth). To the point of the earth. This is because it is the `sakhrah` (rock). In the `qamar`... they place it in its `sadaf` (shell), the `namiyya`? Below the sphere of the `qamar`. Below. `ma taht al-falak...` `allati hiya al-sakhrah` (which is the rock). This is because it is the `sakhrah`. `yuqalu` (it is said)... And it is said to it, `namiyyat al-kubra` (the greater vegetative [soul]). `Wa-minha yatafarra'u kullu namiyyatin sughra` (And from it branches out every lesser vegetative [soul]). And from it emerges every `namiyyat sughra`. As many `namiyat` as there are, they are all below the sphere of the `qamar`. From it... a part of it, which is related to the child, when the world comes into being... from it, a thing which God Almighty... brings out. Is it its own thing or... It is its own thing. It is its own thing which God Almighty, by His `tadbir` (governance)... is not on the sphere of the `qamar`, is it? From the `qamar` to the `sakhrah`. Below the sphere of the `qamar`. `tahta falak al-qamari` (beneath the sphere of the moon). It is called `namiyyat al-kubra`. `Wa-'ala al-haqiqati fa-inna al-namiyyata al-sughra hiya al-hayawan` (And in reality, the lesser vegetative [soul] is the animal). And in truth, `namiyyat al-sughra` is the `hayawan` (animal). `Hayawan`. `namiyyat al-sughra` is `hayawan`, meaning all living beings. `Wa-kadhalika al-hissiyyatu al-kubra min al-muhiti ila falaki al-qamar` (And likewise, the greater sensory [soul] is from the encompassing [sphere] to the sphere of the moon). In the same way, the `hissiyyat kubra` is from the `muhit` (encompassing sphere) to the sphere of the `qamar`. Which `muhit` is it? The highest sphere. From there, the `hissiyyat kubra` begins. To the sphere of the `qamar`. `Wa-al-hissiyyatu al-sughra nafsu al-insan al-natiqat al-mukallaf` (And the lesser sensory [soul] is the rational, obligated soul of the human being). And `hissiyyat sughra` is the `nafs` of the human being. The one who speaks. `Namiyyat sughra` is what? It is the `hayawan`. And `hissiyyat sughra` is the human being. The `nafs` of the human being. `Wa-al-natiqatu al-kubra hududun 'alayhimu al-salamu` (And the greater rational [soul] is the Hudud, peace be upon them). The `nafs` of the `natiqa` has been explained. The `hissiyya` has been explained. Now the `natiqa` is being explained. The `nafs` of the `natiqa`. The `natiqat kubra` are the `hudud`, peace be upon them. `Wa-al-natiqatu al-sughra huwa al-mustajibu` (And the lesser rational [soul] is the respondent). And `natiqat sughra` is the `mustajib` (respondent). The one who takes the holy covenant (`'ahd-i sharif`). The `natiqat sughra`... the `nafs-i natiqa` (rational soul) becomes connected with them. The `nafs-i hissiyya` from the `muhit` to the sphere of `qamar`... it is such a large expanse. Yes, a small part of that sensory ocean is granted to the human being. It is called `nafs-i hissiyya`. `Wa-hadhihi al-ashya'u lam yakun yulsha'u 'anha illa ramzan, wa-min lisanin ila udhnin` (And these things were not disclosed except by a symbol/allusion, and from a tongue to an ear). And these things were not opened up... regarding them, except as a hint. From a tongue to an ear. It was not written down. `Lakin qad sabaqa al-sharhu fi awwal al-kitabi bi-itrah al-rumuzi wa-al-isharati wa-al-i'rab 'an al-haqa'iqi wa-al-ma'ani min ghayri ramzin wa-la ta'wilin` (But the explanation has already come at the beginning of the book, by setting aside symbols and allusions, and expressing the realities and meanings without symbol or allegorical interpretation). But it has been established... the explanation has been established... at the beginning of the book. By leaving aside... the `rumuz` (symbols) and `isharat` (allusions). And to interpret from the `haqa'iq` (realities)... and `ma'ani` (meanings), without `ramz` (symbol) and without `ta'wil` (allegorical interpretation). Without allusions. The questioner had asked that you explain without `ramz` and `ta'wil`. So I have written it... only in the language of `haqa'iq`. The language of `daqa'iq` (subtleties)... the language of `haqa'iq`... the language of `daqa'iq` is even more difficult. `Al-faslu al-rabi'u min al-babi al-rabi'i min al-surati al-thaniyah` (The fourth section of the fourth chapter of the second part). The fourth section, from the fourth chapter, from the second part. `Thumma innahu idha zahara al-mawludu ila fushat al-ard` (Then indeed, when the newborn appears into the expanse of the earth)... `Fushat`... `ila fushat al-ard`. `Fushat`. The paper has what? It has a `pesh` [vowel mark]. What will we read it as? `Fushat`. `Thumma innahu idha zahara al-mawludu ila fushat al-ardi min batni ummihi wa-sara shakhsan tamman kamilan ittasalat bihi quwwatun hissiyyatun min shu'a'i al-shams` (Then indeed, when the newborn appears into the expanse of the earth from its mother's womb and becomes a complete, perfect person, a sensory power from the rays of the sun connects with it). Then indeed, when it appears... the `maulud`... `maulud` means the one who is born... the baby. `Ila fushat al-ard` (to the expanse of the earth). To the expanse of the earth. `Wus'at` (expanse). They say `fus'hat`. From the vastness of the earth... coming out of the narrowness of the mother's womb and is born into the expanse of the earth. `Min batni ummihi` (from its mother's womb). From its mother's womb. And it becomes a person, complete, perfect. Then what happens? A `quwwat hissiyya` (sensory power) connects with that newborn. A sensory power... from the rays of the sun. The `markaz` (center) of the `hissiyya` is the sun. From there, a ray of the sun... a sensory power comes to it. `Allati hiya qalbu al-falaki` (Which is the heart of the sphere). This is because it is the heart of the sphere. `Qalb al-falak` (heart of the sphere). Which one is the heart of the sphere? The sun. `Wa-markazu al-hissiyyati` (And the center of the sensory). And the `markaz` of the `hissiyya`. The `markaz`... the `markaz` of the `hissiyya` is the sun. And the `markaz` of the `namiyya` (vegetative) is the `qamar` (moon). The terms for `tara` (star) and `falak` (sphere) are separate. `Falak`... it revolves. `Falak` means the orbit in which it revolves. The relationship of the `hissiyya` is with the `kawkab` (celestial body). `Markaz`... the `markaz` is where the sensation comes from. The great `markaz` is the ocean. From the ocean, a drop is granted to this child. First, from the `qamar` it is granted, which is the `namiyya`. And from the `shams` (sun), it is granted, which is the `hissiyya`. `Fa-sha'at fi al-badani kullihi` (So it spreads throughout the entire body). So it spreads... the power spreads throughout the body. `Wa-ba'athat fihi al-harakati` (And sends movements into it). And it sends... movements into it. Movement is created in it, a power is created. `Wa-ittahadat min nafsi al-namiyyati` (And unites with the vegetative soul). And it becomes united with the `nafs-i namiyya`. `Fa-sabaghatha wa-sarata shay'an wahidan` (So it dyes it, and they both become one thing). So it colors it. And they become one thing. Meaning, if you mix two different colors, one color is formed. `Wa-sarata shay'an wahidan` (And they both become one thing). They both become one thing. `Kama sa-nu'ammimu wa-an nasimin` (as we will generalize, and from a breeze). And they meet... the two of them meet a `nasib` (portion). From the `qura-i nasim` (lot of the breeze). `Fa-zadat bihi quwwatuhuma` (so by it, their power increases). So it increases... from it... the power of both of them. The power of both of them. The power of the `nafs-i hissiyya`. `Wa-sara ghidha'an lahuma mithla ghidha'i al-ajsami min anwa'i al-at'imati` (and it becomes a nourishment for both of them, like the nourishment of bodies from the types of foods). And that `nasim` becomes nourishment for both of them. Like the nourishment of bodies, from the types of foods. Just as humans... that `nasim` is their nourishment. `Wa-hadhihi haqiqatu qawli amiri al-mu'minina 'alayhi al-salamu li-l-sa'il alladhi sa'alahu 'an al-nafsi al-hissiyyati ma hiya` (And this is the reality of the saying of the Commander of the Faithful, peace be upon him, to the questioner who asked him about the sensory soul, what is it?). And this is that reality of the saying of Amir al-Mu'minin, peace be upon him... to the questioner who asked about the `nafs-i hissiyya`: "What is it?" What thing is it? `Fa-qala` (So he said). `Inna al-nafs al-hissiyyata quwwatun falakiyyatun` (The sensory soul is a celestial power). That the `nafs-i hissiyya` is what? It is a celestial power. What did he say there for the `namiyya`? `Quwwatun tabi'iyyatun` (a natural power). A natural power. This is `quwwat falakiyyatun`. `Tabi'i` is what they call the `falak` of the `qamar`. Below it is the `alam-i tabi'i` (natural world). And the `aflak` (celestial spheres) are the `quwwat falakiyya`. Look at the terms of Imam 'Ali, peace and blessings be upon him. `nafs-i hissiyya`, its source (`mamba`) is the `shams`. `Asluha al-aflaku` (Its origin is the celestial spheres). Its origin is the celestial spheres. `Ittihaduha 'inda al-wiladati al-jismaniyyati` (Its union is at the time of the physical birth). And its union with the human is when? At the time of physical birth. `Maqarruha al-qalbu` (Its station is the heart). Its station is the heart. The station of the `hissiyya` in the body is where? It resides in the heart. `Fi'luha al-hissu wa-al-harakatu wa-al-sawlatu wa-al-ghalabatu` (Its action is sensation, movement, assault/dominance, and victory). Its action is what? To sense. To move. `Sawlat` means... to move forward. And `ghalabah`, to achieve victory. `Sawlat` means to advance with dominance. `Sababu iftiraqiha ikhtilafu al-mawadi` (The cause of its separation is the difference of substances). The cause of its separation... the body separates from the `nafs-i hissiyya`, why? Due to an imbalance in the `mawad`. The `mawad`... the humors that are there... in them, heat, moisture, coldness, and dryness... if dryness increases in this, if coldness increases, then with that excess, if it is in moderation, then the thing is fine. If it goes beyond moderation, if it increases too much or decreases... if heat decreases completely, then what happens? Various illnesses... if coldness decreases or increases a lot, then problems arise. Due to the imbalance of `mawad`. `Wa-idha faraqat, 'adat ila mawdi'in minhu badat` (And when it separates, it returns to the place from which it began). When it leaves... when a person travels, where does he return? To his home. Where is its home? The `nafs-i namiyya`'s home is the `qamar`. And the `nafs-i hissiyya`'s home is the `shams`. It returns to where it came from. `Wa-dhalika maw'izun haqiqun wa-qawlu sayyidina al-mu'ayyadi arwaha allahu ruhahu fi majalisihi` (And that is a true admonition, and the saying of our master al-Mu'ayyad, may God sanctify his soul, in his Majalis). And it is likewise the reality... the saying of Sayyidna Mu'ayyad, `Arwah Allahu ruhahu`. Sayyidna Mu'ayyad... what is his name? Sayyidna Mu'ayyad... Hibatullah ibn Musa al-Shirazi. Sayyidna Mu'ayyad is his `laqab` (title). What is he? He is `Bab al-Abwab` (the Gate of Gates). `Arwah Allahu ruhahu`. He said in one of his `Majalis` (sermons/sessions)... what did he say? `Wa-layta shi'ri lima sulliltum min al-aflaki wa-al-ajrami wa-udrishtum fi mada'iqi al-aslabi wa-al-arhami` (And I wish I knew why you were drawn out from the celestial spheres and bodies, and made to descend into the narrow places of the loins and the wombs). Oh, I wish I knew... why were you extracted? `Sullila` means extracted. From the high places... from the `aflak` (celestial spheres) and `ajram` (celestial bodies)... `Jirm`... the body of the `kawkab`. From the `kawkab`. From the `aflak` and `kawakib`. And you were placed... into the narrow confines... `mazayiq`... what does `mazayiq` mean? The plural of `maziq`. Its root is `diq` (narrowness). And `maziq` means a narrow place. Its plural is `maza'iq`. And you were placed... `udrishtum`, its root is `daraja`. `daraja ba-daraja` (stage by stage). Stage by stage you are made to ascend. Stage by stage you were placed... into the narrow places... of the loins and the wombs. `Wa-ukhrijtum min diqi dhalika al-ghisha'` (And you were brought out from the narrowness of that membrane). And you were taken out... from the narrowness of that membrane. `Ila sa'ati hadha al-fida'` (To the expanse of this abode). Towards the expanse of this abode. `Isharatun minhu 'alayhi al-salamu ila al-nutfati al-muntabiyati 'alayha al-nafs al-namiyyatu al-maslulatu min ghidha'i al-ardiyyati al-ka'inati min al-mawalidi al-thalathati, allati hiya al-ma'danu wa-al-nabatu wa-al-hayawanu al-maslulati min al-ummahaati al-arba'ati, allati hiya al-narru wa-al-hawa'u wa-al-ma'u wa-al-ardu, wa-hadhihi al-ummahaatu quwa al-aflaki` (An allusion from him, peace be upon him, to the semen-drop upon which is enfolded the vegetative soul, drawn from terrestrial nourishment which exists from the three kingdoms, which are the mineral, the plant, and the animal; which is drawn from the four mothers, which are fire, air, water, and earth; and these mothers are the powers of the celestial spheres). An allusion from him, `Arwah Allahu ruhahu`, towards the `nutfah` (semen-drop)... upon which the `nafs-i namiyya` (vegetative soul) is enfolded... that which has been drawn from the nutriments... of the three `mawalid` (kingdoms)... what are the three `mawalid`? `Ma'dan` (mineral), `nabat` (plant), and `hayawan` (animal). This is because it is the `ma'dan` and `nabat` and `hayawan`. That which is drawn from the four mothers... from the four mothers. That which is the fire, the air, the water, and the earth. And these mothers are the powers of the `aflak`. `Wa-ansha'a fika ma'nan batinan zatin dhahira al-ayati muhitan bi-al-ardi wa-al-samawat, isharatun ila hadhihi al-quwwati al-hissiyyati al-muttahidati bi-al-janini 'inda al-wiladati al-jismaniyyati` (And He originated within you a hidden, essential meaning whose signs are manifest, encompassing the earth and the heavens. An allusion to this sensory power which unites with the fetus at the time of the physical birth). And He created within you... a hidden, essential meaning whose signs are manifest. Encompassing the earth and the heavens. An allusion to this sensory power that unites with the fetus at the time of physical birth. Maula, this `dhat` (essence) that was ours in the world of spirits, so... it... what will we call it in the physical world? Are all these things combined, the `nafs-i namiyya`, `nafs-i hissiyya`, `nafs-i natiqa`, do they all combine to form one `dhat`, or... along with the physical density... The `dhat` was the `ashbah nuraniyya` (luminous specters). When they delayed... and... did not accept the `qawl` (word)... when they did not accept the `da'wah` (call), a flaw (`kharabi`) was created in their spiritual existences. When the flaw was created... they took on the form of `nufus`. The `dhat` became the `nafs` (soul). Over there, what was it? `Ashbah nuraniyya`. The word `surat` (form) is not used for it. The word `shabih` (likeness)... its quality is described as `shabih`. From there, it became `nafs`. And the `nafs` also has many... `nafs-i hissiyya` it became. And it fell further, it became `nafs-i namiyya`. It fell further, and it entered into the density of the body. It fell further, and it took on the form of an animal. It fell further, and it went into plants. It fell further, and it went into minerals. They are all `zawat-i ruhaniyya` (spiritual existences). Their forms have all been changed. God Almighty had only created `zawat-i ruhaniyya`. He didn't create minerals, he didn't create plants... did He create them? What did God Almighty create? He only created `zawat`. He bestowed three powers upon them: `ilm` (knowledge), `hayat` (life), and `ikhtiyar` (choice). He gave them `wujud` (existence). Then what did He do? In that existence, what powers are there? He gave them knowledge of that. Then He gave you the choice, that you may use your existence as you wish. These three things were granted. Now, the one who did not use his choice, despite having knowledge, he began to fall. And the one who can remain at his station of exaltation is the one who uses his powers correctly. It began to fall. After falling, it went through various stages. The `zawat`... what did the `zawat` become? `Nufus`. The `nufus` took on the form of `hissiyya`. Then `namiyya` also came. Then it entered into corporeality. So, `najat` (salvation) is what it's called... all... all of them... all things... becoming `ashbah nuraniyya` again. The return of all things to being `ashbah nuraniyya`. They are all... all things are `zawat-i ruhaniyya`. But they have fallen to such a state that we look at them and feel disgust. All are... they are parts of one mother. The part that is with you, you know it. The parts that are not with you, are with others. The `qudrat` (power) of the `Tadbir` (Governer) gathers them. The portion that you received in `Quds` (the sacred realm) is your portion. And what you did not receive is not your portion, it is someone else's portion. The `qudrat` of the `Tadbir` does it. The reader hasn't come. I can't read. The reader is supposed to come. You mean, they fell as one unit, and here they have become four, five, three, four things: `nafs-i namiyya` has come, `natiqa` has come, `hissiyya` has come, then there is our body, then our waste products. These are the stages. Will they go back as one unit, or at different times, will different things... The unit is with the `Mudabbir` (Governer). All your units are with the `Mudabbir`. Where will he gather you? At the `Qa'im` (the Imam) will be your gathering. Then from there... with the `Qa'im`... when they are gathered at the `Qa'im`, your `nufus hissiyya` will be gathered, and... then... when they are gathered there, many other things will also be gathered. There, your unit will be formed. Then a greater `Qa'im` will come, and a unit will be formed there. It is a wondrous `tadbir` of the `Mudabbir`. So, various `nufus` from different stations will go in such a way that one `dhat` (essence) that is capable of ascending, that `dhat`, when it ascends, will become one `dhat`. All of them. The entire `hayula` (prime matter) will become one `dhat`... What did he say? That they were created in the human form. This is a very profound statement. The `qamat-i alifiyya` (the form of the Alif)... the `qamat-i alifiyya`'s form is the same form in which God Almighty created the `zawat-i ruhaniyya`. Now, the human form exists, so what is in a human? There is a head, there are feet, there are legs, there is everything, right? So the one who went last of all, where is he? In the station of the feet. And the `dhat` that reached first, is in the station of the head. So the way it was, in the same way, it will ascend from here. It is there, too. It will become the human form. The human form... the `zawat-i ruhaniyya`... the form of this `khass-i ruhaniyya` will go. In the human form, meaning... the one who arrived first is in the station of the heart, the `sabiq` (precedent one). And the one who came later... is in the station of the feet. All are arranged in the human form. God Almighty, what a wonderful... a single word, think about it. In the human form... in which they were created. When did the human form exist? God Almighty created them... when did the human form exist? Human beings were created much later. What does it mean? Over there, where He created, it was upon the human form that He created them. कहने का मतलब ये है। Now, when you ascend, you will acquire the same form that you had before. But it will be a complete light. But the one who is foremost will be in the station of the heart. Someone will be in the station of the head. And someone will be in the station of the feet. Just like... the cause of creation... Sayyidna Mu'ayyad has said that God Almighty, from `adam` (non-existence), brought into `wujud` (existence). `Adam` is not a place. From `adam`... what did He create? `Shukhusan 'ala shakli al-insan` (persons in the form of a human). In the form of a human... the human form came later, but at that time, God Almighty, by His `muqaddarat` (destinies), created them in this way. The `shakl insani` (human form) has how many parts (`ajza`)? 28 parts. Upon what is `La ilaha illa Allah` based? 28 letters. The head is what? `illa Allah`. The whole body is `La ilaha`. The essence is that, the head. After that, there are what? Three parts. Four parts. Seven parts. And twelve apertures (`jharoka`). What are the twelve? The openings. What are the twelve openings? Two eyes... two... one mouth, and... two ears... two nipples... and two lower orifices... `mawt`. How many are there? Seven. Two nostrils... eight... two nipples... nine and... two lower orifices. How many is that? Ten. Eleven... ten. Then two... nipples... navel... the chest... two openings of the chest. Twelve. So that's twelve. `La ilaha illa Allah`. Then there are three, there are four, and there are seven. `Sabab-i khalq`... Sayyidna Mu'ayyad has written in `Taj al-'Aqa'id`... the cause of creation (`sabab-i khalq`). Why did God Almighty create? Did He want to show some favor? Or did He want to take some work from them? Or did He want to have them worship Him? He refutes it. He refutes it. He keeps refuting it. There are chapters on it. Read `Taj al-'Aqa'id`, it's a wonderful book. Finally, he says that we... we cannot know the cause of God. We can only understand this much, that He showed His `fadl` (grace) and `mihrbani` (kindness), that He brought existence into the world from non-existence. This is the only thing we can understand. He keeps refuting it. This isn't it, that isn't it... He has no need for worship. If you don't take work from them... what is there to take? He has no need for you to take work from them. His `kibriya'i` (majesty) does not increase because of your work. Beautiful words... he has written this, Sayyidna Mu'ayyad. Read `Taj al-'Aqa'id`. Maulana Ghulam Hussain Sahib, and Maulana Zainuddin Sahib. `Namiyya` is the `surat` (form)... no, the `natiqa` is the `surat`, what is it? A thing... which thing is continuously progressing? The body is such that it progresses and then moves ahead, other parts come. Here... is it the `surat` or the `natiqa`? The `nafs-i natiqa`. The `nafs-i natiqa`. It becomes the `surat`. That is the `surat`, and... its release from here is our salvation.

<!-- lecture 25 -->

*Bismillah al-Rahman al-Rahim*. *Al-fasl al-khamis min al-bab al-rabi' min kitab al-anwar* (*The fifth chapter of the fourth section of the Book of Lights*). *Thumma al-mawlud yata'allamu min abawayhi al-nutqa bil... munaaghat, shay'an ba'da shay'in, ila an yasiro fi nutfah balighan nutqihi, bi nutqihi, balighan. Fa idha 'ullima kitabullah ta'ala...*

In the fifth chapter, fourth section... From the second *surat*.

Then, it is that the newborn knows... from his... learns the science. Learns. That the newborn, the child, learns... *min abawayhi* (from his two parents), from his mother and father. And... he speaks. The cooing of an infant. What is the origin of *abawayhi*? How was *abawayhi* formed? From *abawaan*. From *abawaan*. *Abawaan*, meaning mother and father. It is a *mudaf*. *Abawaan* is mother and father. *Abawayn*... because of *min*, it was said *abawayn*. *Min abawayn* (from two parents). And the *hi* that is there is "his". The *nun* was dropped. Because it is a *mudaf*, the *nun* was dropped. *Min abawayhi* (from his two parents). From his own mother and father, he learns speech. *Bil munaaghat* (through cooing).

Meaning, the speech of an infant. Yes. From its babbling and cooing, little by little for him, it happens. *Munaaghat* means... babbling. Yes. Gradually he learns. The infant child that learns, that is called *munaaghat*. Until he reaches... his speech... in his speech... becomes mature. Having become mature, the speech that is... it reaches perfection. Reaches perfection.

*Fa idha 'ullima kitabullah ta'ala, izdada fin nutqi wa kamalihi. Fa idhattasala...* When he was taught... taught... he was taught. *'Ullima* means... *'alima* means to know. And *'allama* means he informed, made aware. Made him an *'alim*. He had him taught. *Fa idha 'ullima* (and when he is taught), when he is made an *'alim*, when he is taught... because of *idha*, the past tense takes on the meaning of the present progressive. *Idha* which is there... past. So, when he is taught the Book of Allah... the book of Allah, the Exalted. So it increases... Allah, the Exalted's book... So it increases... his speech and its perfection.

*Fa idhattasala bil mu'allim al-sadiq, al-mutawallid lil mukatharah ahl al-zahir, wa kassara 'alayhi, wa shawwaqahu ila al-dukhul fi da'irat ahl al-haqq, wa khaza 'alayhim imam dhalika al-zaman 'ahdahu al-karim, wa dakhala fi haram Allah al-amin, jawara nafsahu nuqtat-un min al-nur, wa ta'allaqat tilka al-nuqtatu bi 'amud al-nur, alladhi huwa saarin min Imam al-zaman 'alayhi al-salam.* *'Alayhi al-salam*. *Sadiq al-qawl*.

And when the connection happened... when he connects with the *mu'allim-i-sadiq* (true teacher), the one who is to be born/initiated... against the mixing with the people of the outward (*ahl al-zahir*)... the people of the outward. And he broke him. Meaning, he broke... he broke upon him. Meaning, the *mu'allim-i-sadiq* presents him with a proof. The *mu'allim*. The *mu'allim*. He presents a proof upon him. *Wa shawwaqahu* (and he created a longing in him)... and he creates a longing, he gives him a longing... for entering... for entering the circle of the people of truth (*da'irat ahl al-haqq*). And he takes from him... he takes from him, by the means of the *Imam* of the time... the noble covenant. The noble covenant. And he enters... he enters the sanctuary of Allah, the Secure (*haram Allah al-amin*), and he becomes a neighbor... the *nafs* becomes a neighbor... his *nafs* is neighbored by a point of light. The *nafs* is the object. He is neighbored by a point of light. By a point of light. The subject is *nuqtat-un*. A point of light.

To be a neighbor means, like... a neighbor. There is no union (*ittisal*). He just remains in the vicinity. A point of light. Its station is also this. The *natiqah*... the *natiqah*'s... with the pillar of light. Until his... his end is good. The same thing is repeated. The *natiqah*'s... from the pillar of light. Until his... his end is good. Until his end is good. The point of light remains a neighbor to his *nafs*.

So, a neighbor... so which... which station of the body is it upon? It's not the body's... the body's... It's not a physical thing. The point of light is a luminous thing. It's with the whole body. With the whole body. Its particular station is not... Its origin is the *nafs-i-hissiya* (sensory soul). Okay. *Nafs-i-hissiya*, *nafs-i-natiqah*. *Qalb*. *Jawara nafsahu* (He neighbored his soul). His *nafs* is neighbored by a point of light. *Wa ta'allaqat tilka al-nuqtatu*, and a connection is formed... that point... that point... with the pillar of light. The definition of pillar of light has been given by *Sayyidna*. It's a very lofty definition. On a page... on a page, for three or four pages. And that point becomes connected to the pillar of light. Such that it is flowing... such that it is flowing from the *Imam* of the time. *Imam-i-zaman... 'alayhi al-salam*. *'Alayhi al-salam*. This is the statement of *al-Sadiq*.

*Fa kullama izdada Imam dhalika al-zaman... wa hududihi... fa 'alayhim, min shifati al-taharah wa ta'at wali amrihim, izdadat tilka al-nuqtatu wus'an wa nuran, wa izdada ishraqu tilka al-nafsi wa tajawharuha shay'an fa shay'in.*

And when... the more and more he increases, that person... in benefiting from *'ilm* (knowledge) and *ma'rifat* (gnosis) and *mahabbat* (love) of the *Imam* of the time and his *hudud* (ranks)... and he walks in *'iffat* (chastity) and *taharat* (purity) and obedience... and he obeys the *Wali al-Amr* (guardian of the command)... it increases, that point... that point... in vastness and in light... in light... and it increases... the illumination of that soul. The illumination of that *nafs*. And it becomes more substantial... his *nafs*. Little by little. His substance becomes more... little by little. So this illumination is happening from the pillar of light. From the pillar of light, through the point. Yes. The *nafs-i-natiqah* which he received.

*Wa tilka al-nuqtat-i-nuraniyyah allati... sa'aluhu... liyasu... li surah... allati tasawwur...* And that luminous point, such that it is a form (*surah*). It is a form. The *nafs-i-natiqah* and the *surah* are both one thing. The *nafs* which he received... and when it became connected, that became the luminous form. A form of knowledge and action are both being formed from it. *Allati tasawwaraha*... *Allati tasawwaraha... dhalika al-shakhs al-mustafid min mufidihi*, such that its image was formed... his... that person who is benefiting... from his benefactor... that is the *nafs-i-natiqah*. And that is the *nafs-i-natiqah*. Now there will be a question: what is the *surah*? What is the *nafs-i-natiqah*? So, he has clarified this: *wa hiya al-nafs al-natiqah*. That *surah* is the *nafs-i-natiqah*. *Allati su'ila 'anhu Amir al-mu'minin 'alayhi al-salam*. About which *Amir al-Mu'minin, 'alayhi al-salam*, was questioned. Regarding the *nafs-i-namiyah* it was said it is a *quwwat-un tabi'iyyah* (natural faculty). *Tabi'iyyah*. And regarding the *nafs-i-hissiya* it was said it is a *quwwat-un falakiyyah* (celestial faculty). And here what is he saying? A *quwwat-un 'ilmiyyah* (an intellectual faculty). *Fa qala hiya quwwat-un 'ilmiyyah... jawhar-un shaffaf-un... hayyat-un... wa bud'u ittihadiha... makharr...*

So he said, it is an intellectual faculty... and a transparent substance. Such a substance in which there is no coarseness. The *nafs-i-natiqah* is pure. *'Alimat-un bil quwwati wal fi'l* (knowing in potentiality and actuality). It is one that knows by potentiality and by actuality. By potentiality and by actuality. Only the good things in it... all of them are inside the *nafs-i-natiqah*. The bad things are inside the *hissiya*. Coarseness came in the *hissiya*. Even greater than that, it came in the *namiyah*. Even greater than that, it came in the *jism* (body). The coarseness kept increasing in the parts of the body. Okay. Yes. *'Alimat-un bil quwwati wal fi'l*, one that knows by potentiality and by actuality. *Quwwat-un 'ilmiyyah*. And by action means... practical. Practical. *Hayyat-un bit tab'* (living by nature). One that lives by nature. She is alive. She is alive, she can never die. Once the *nafs-i-natiqah* has been formed, then it cannot be destroyed. This is a principle. What principle was stated? In which it is mentioned: *al-sharru la asla lahu fil ibda'* (evil has no origin in the primary creation). It has a principle. Evil, it has no root in the primary creation. In the primary creation of the world, evil has no origin at all. What is evil? To be distant from good. To be distant from good is called evil. Evil is not a thing. What is a lie? The absence of truth. The absence of truth. What is darkness? What is darkness? The absence of light. The absence of light. So all the bad things, in essence, they are not things. They are a distance... for example, we are sitting in the light. The more we move away, the darkness will increase. So our coarseness is also not a thing? Coarseness is also not a thing, it will be finished. It came as a temporary thing. Because we did not obey there, we delayed, coarseness was created in us. When we move forward in that direction, the coarseness will be finished. Delicacy's opposite is coarseness. Delay in delicacy. Delay in achieving delicacy. So coarseness came. What will we do with coarseness? We will move forward on its path, and the coarseness will be finished. *Al-sharru la asla lahu fil ibda'*. Allah did not create the body. You created it. Your own body. What did Allah create? He created sustenance. What did you do? You... you made it... you made it into things for excretion. You made it into bad things. You are its cause.

All the good things, Allah only created truth. What is truth? That which happened, the event that occurred, is truth. What is a lie? Mixing falsehood into it. Who did the mixing? You did. The truth is in its place.

What is this *ruh* (spirit), Mawlana? *Min amrillah* (from the command of Allah). It is what is in the holy Quran. *Qul al-ruhu min amri rabbi* (Say, the spirit is from the command of my Lord). The command of our Lord. The command of our Lord that is received, the command that is received, so with the command, its support... angels... in their forms, illumination occurs. That is called the *ruh*. *Qul al-ruhu min amri rabbi*. So it is separate from the *nafs* (soul)? *Ruh* is also used for this, for the *nafs-i-natiqah*. For the *nafs-i-natiqah*, *ruh* is also used. When the *nafs-i-natiqah* ascends high, then the command of the Lord (*amr-i-rabb*) is at work. That is called the command of the Lord.

Mawlana, the *natiqah*, the more subtle it is, it is pulling the *hissiya*, which is extremely coarse. This pulling of subtlety and coarseness is like... opposite poles. Subtlety, what it does... the subtle... the *nafs-i-natiqah* is subtle. It wants to make the *nafs-i-hissiya* like itself. Okay. It wants the *nafs-i-hissiya* to become like it. That is salvation.
