Do you remember Sa'di's couplets? What wonderful couplets they are. A rock... it had perfume on it. And... in its... that scent of perfume that you have... yes. In its body, fragrance came. It was asked, how did this fragrance come? It said I spent a few days with fragrance, so fragrance came.

Just like that, when the *nafs-i-natiqah* stays with the *nafs-i-hissiya*... it remains... so slowly, slowly... the *nafs-i-hissiya* also turns into the *nafs-i-natiqah*. *Ay gul ba tu khar zand...* *Ay gul ba tu khar zand namay danat ki namay danat*. That is different.

*Wa qala hiya quwwat-un 'ilmiyyah jawhar-un shaffaf-un hayyat-un bit tab'i, asluha al-nafs al-kulliyyah*. Its origin is what? The *nafs al-kulliyyah* (the Universal Soul). It has become a part of the *nafs al-kulliyyah*. Where is the *nafs al-kulliyyah*? In the world of life (*'alam-i-hayat*), there is a *nafs*. Because in the world of lights (*'alam-i-anwar*)... From *qamar* to *sakhrah*. In the world of lights, there is no *nafs*. There are essences, spirits. What is the *nafs al-kulliyyah*? The *nafs al-kulliyyah*... the *nafs* of the *jism* (body). In the world of life. See, the first thing Allah... did he create a *nafs*? Nowhere is it mentioned. There is no *namiyah*. He created what? He created luminous specters (*asbah-i-nuraniyyah*). Yes. Its... from its delay, the form that was made, that became the *nafs*. Before *i'bat* or after *i'bat*? After *i'bat*. With the command of *i'bat*. Okay. Now where will they all go? Towards the *nafs al-kulliyyah*. *Asluha al-nafs al-kulliyyah* (its origin is the Universal Soul). In the world of life. Now, until it receives the second perfection (*kamal-i-thani*), it will not become a complete light. When it receives the second perfection, that *nafs al-kulliyyah*, then it will be capable of going into the world of lights. This is a partial form... all of this. What came into the dimensions is the body, and what is stationary in the world of life is the *nafs*. The *nafs al-kulliyyah* is there. After that, what is there? The *nafs-i-hissiya* is there, the *nafs-i-namiyah* is there, then the parts of the body are there. One after another they are formed. After man comes animal, after animal comes plant, after plant comes mineral. All of them are essences (*zawat*). But they have changed their forms.

So, the *nafs al-kulliyyah* is not a thing to be received. The way the *natiqah* was received. Its origin is the *nafs al-kulliyyah*. The firmaments are the origin. The moon is the origin. The sun is the origin. Just so, the *nafs al-kulliyyah* is the ocean. This is its part. In the world of life, the ocean of the universal souls that exists, this *nafs* which we receive is a part of it. So all are one unit? All the essences are one unit in the world of life. It is one unit. They are in their places, and it is a world. It is an ocean. It is an ocean, and this is a part of it, a drop of it. It is an ocean. Ocean means the whole. But the drop is also counted as a drop.

So what is the relationship of the pillar of light with this, the *nafs al-kulliyyah*? The connection is from it. The connection of the entire pillar of light is from it. The connection of the *nafs al-kulliyyah* is from the pillar of light. And its connection is from the *'ashir* (*the Tenth*). The connection of the *'ashir* is from... from the *awwal* (*the First*).

*Wa bud'u ittihadiha 'inda al-wiladat al-diniyyah.* And the beginning of its union is at the time of the religious birth. When does the birth in the womb occur, of the *nafs-i-namiyah*. The birth in the world is of the *nafs-i-hissiyah*. And the religious birth means at the time of the noble covenant (*'ahd-i-sharif*), what is it? The *nafs-i-natiqah*.

*Maqarruha al-'ilmu wal haqiqah, mawadduha al-ma'arif al-rabbaniyyah*. *Al-'ilmu wal haqiqah*. Its abode is knowledge and reality. Its abode is knowledge and reality. And its substance... its substance... its abode is knowledge and reality. And its substance is from the divine gnosis. Its support is from the divine gnosis.

Its resting place is knowledge, meaning... that... *nafs-i-natiqah*'s. And reality. And reality. To know that *nafs* and to know its reality is its abode. Its abode. Its place to stay. And its substance is from... its support is from divine gnosis. The more knowledge he acquires, the more it is supported.

*Sababu iftiraqiha, ikhtilafu alat-i-jismaniyyah.* Why does it leave the body? Due to the disharmony of the physical instruments. When the four physical temperaments... become imbalanced. Yes. *Wa idha faraqat, raja'at ila ma minhu bada'at*. When it separates, it returns to where it... from where it began. The *nafs al-kulliyyah* came from where? The world of life. No, the *nafs-i-natiqah*. The *nafs-i-natiqah*. It returns to the *nafs al-kulliyyah*.

This is its departure? Yes. The *nafs al-kulliyyah* is who? It is the essence of *Imam al-Zaman, alayhi salatu wa salam*. His form (*haykal*) is the ocean of the *nafs al-kulliyyah*, and he takes it. So this is the same *sultan*? *Innal awwalin...* What is it? *Innabiyyin al-akhirin...* No... *La tanfudhuna illa bi sultan* (you will not pass through except by an authority). You cannot... *la tanfudhuna illa...* You cannot pass through the regions of the heavens and the earth. And you cannot pass through except by a *sultan* (authority). The *sultan* is what? It is the noble form of the *Imam*. In the noble form, all the forms come and... there is a gathering of all of them. *Fa idha... thumma inna tilka al-nuqtah tansha'u shay'an ba'da shay'in min tilka al-'inayat al-ilahiyyah wa al-mahabbat al-khalisah wa al-a'mal al-saliha.*

Because that point... it grows... it grows, little by little... from the divine emanations... from the divine emanations and... from sincere love... from sincere love and from righteous deeds. And the *nafs-i-hissiya* becomes... its neighbor... its... the *nafs-i-hissiya* becomes its neighbor. *Mujawir* and *mumazij*, the difference between them is very important. *Mujawir* means it stays in the vicinity, *mumazij* means it becomes mixed. The two become one thing. Here it is *mujawir*. Until his departure happens, the *nafs-i-hissiya* remains its neighbor.

So, one thing getting mixed, there can be two forms. One is that a thing gets mixed and loses its identity. And the other thing is that... like *inzimam* (joining). And the second is that it gets mixed but retains its identity. It retains it. So, what is the case here? If sometimes the *nafs-i-hissiya* gets corrupted, and its end is not good, then however much the *nafs-i-hissiya* became pure, it becomes pure. After that, whatever is... that is, the *nafs-i-natiqah* becomes pure and leaves. And with it, does it also pull the *hissiya*? Here, it is only about the *natiqah*. Here it is not mentioned about the *nafs-i-hissiya*. The *nafs-i-natiqah* becomes pure. Okay.

*Wa takun al-nafs al-hissiyyah mujawirat-un laha.* How much of the *nafs-i-hissiya* remains its neighbor? However much of its... followed the *nafs-i-natiqah*. And the *nafs-i-hissiya* becomes its neighbor. How much remains a neighbor? However much it... no. The neighbor remains, it is in its vicinity. It does not mix. Not intermingled. If they were to mix, then both would go to... a good end, or both would go... that is why he is doing what? Until his departure, the *nafs-i-hissiya* remains its neighbor. *Nafs-i-natiqah*... however much it brought the *nafs-i-hissiya* under its control, that much remains a neighbor. What is the benefit of it remaining a neighbor? If it becomes intermingled, then it will become connected with the luminous pillar. Then the term *nafs-i-hissiya* will not apply to it. It will be called *natiqah*. The luminous pillar is related to the *nafs-i-natiqah*. Or those who become like the *nafs-i-natiqah*. That will happen upon departure. If the *hissiya* becomes intermingled, then it will become the *natiqah*.

And the *nafs-i-hissiya* becomes its neighbor, not intermingled. And that point... *allati hiya surah... manutat-un bidhalika al-'amud al-nurani alladhi huwa jarin... muttasilun billah ta'ala... 'aql-i-awwal... 'uqul-i-ibda'iyyah al-mujarradah...*

And that point, which is a form... tied... with that luminous pillar... which is flowing, connected with Allah, the Exalted... from the *'aql-i-awwal* (First Intellect) through all the primary intellects (*uqul-i-ibda'iyyah*), which are incorporeal (*mujarradah*)... incorporeal means... which do not have coarseness.

And from it are all the primary intellects which are incorporeal. Then to the Tenth Intellect (*'aql-i-'ashir*), which is the governor (*mudabbir*) of the world of nature (*'alam-i-tabi'at*). Then to every station (*maqam*) of the lamp (*misbaah*)... the pillar of light is being described. From the world of nature. Every *Imam* of the world of nature has a lamp... it is connected with that. *Al-Natiq wa al-Asas wa al-Imam... 'alayhimu al-salawatu...* And the *Natiq*, *Asas*, and *Imam*, upon them be peace and the best of prayers and salutations. *'Alayhimu al-salam* is there. Upon them be peace and the best of prayers and salutations. *Wa min kulli maqam-in min ha'ula'i al-thalathah ila babihi, al-bab alladhi ramaza ilayhi Amir al-mu'minin salawatullah 'alayh*. And from every station of these three... who are these three? The *Natiq*, *Asas*, and *Imam*. ...to his *bab* (gate). His *bab*, to... the *nafs al-kulliyyah* is the *bab*... the form of the *bab* of the *Imam*. The form is being made. *Alladhi ramaza 'alayhi Amir al-mu'minin salawatullah 'alayh, bil nafs al-kulliyyah*. Such that *Amir al-Mu'minin, salawatullah 'alayh*, alluded to it with the *nafs al-kulliyyah*. To the *bab*. The *bab* is the *nafs al-kulliyyah*.

*...alladhi sa'alahu 'an al-nufus al-thalathah.* Such that he was questioned about the three souls. *Thumma qala... wa ma hiya ya mawlay, al-nafs al-kulliyyah?* After the *nafs-i-natiqah*, what did he ask? What is the *nafs al-kulliyyah*? *Fa qala salawatullah 'alayh: ma hiya ya mawlay, al-nafs al-kulliyyah? Fa qala salawatullah 'alayh, hiya quwwat-un ilahiyyah, jawhar-un basit-un.* Here, in *'ilmiyyah*, what did he say? A *quwwat-un 'ilmiyyah* (an intellectual faculty). And it's a big difference. *Namiyah* is what? *Quwwat-un tabi'iyyah* (a natural faculty). And *hissiya* is what? *Falakiyyah*. *Quwwat-un falakiyyah* (a celestial faculty). And *natiqah* is what? *'Ilmiyyah*. And the *nafs-i-kulliyyah* is what? *Quwwat-un ilahiyyah* (a divine faculty). It is a divine faculty. *Jawhar-un basit-un*. And its substance is widespread... a widespread substance. *'Alimat-un bil quwwati wal fi'l*. It is one that knows by potentiality and by actuality. *Asluha... Asluha al-'aql*. Its origin is the Intellect. The Intellect. Its origin is the *nafs al-kulliyyah*. And its... its origin is the Intellect. Every one has to go towards its origin. The *nafs-i-namiyah*, where does it have to go? Towards the *hissiyah*. Towards the *hissiyah*. No, no. Where is its... *ila ma minhu bada'at* (to that from which it began). Where did it begin? The moon. To the moon. From *qamar* to *sakhrah*. After that, where does this have to go? The *natiqah*... *hissiya*... *hissiya*... *ila ma minhu bada'at*. The sun. The *qalaq-i-shams* (sphere of the sun). And where does this have to go? The *natiqah*... to the world of life. To the pillar of light. The pillar of light. And where does this have to go, the *nafs-i-kulliyyah*? This... to the Intellect. *Asluha al-'aql*. To the world of lights. The Intellect... the one that it came out from. The circle of which... the circle of the Intellect from which we came, we have to go there.

The origin of the *nafs-i-natiqah* is the *nafs al-kulliyyah*. And the origin of the *nafs al-kulliyyah* is the Intellect. Every lower one... for the upper one... the upper one becomes the origin for the lower one. *Wal fi'l. Asluha al-'aql. Minhu istamaddat*. From it, it derived its support. From it, it took its support. *Wa ilayhi da'at*. And it called towards it. It called towards it.

That *nafs al-kulliyyah* took support from the world of Intellect. And... *Wa hiya kalimatullah al-'ulya*. This... Mawlana, *minhu istamaddat*, the *nafs-i-kulliyyah* took support from the world of Intellect. And it called towards it. *Wa hiya kalimatullah al-'ulya*. And it is the supreme word of Allah. *Shajarat al-tuba*. The tree of Tuba. *Nafs al-kulliyyah* has called towards the Intellect. *Shajarat al-tuba*. It is the tree which is Tuba. *Jannat al-ma'wa*. The garden of refuge. It is the abode which is the garden. *'Inda sidrat al-muntaha*. Near the Lote-tree of the utmost boundary. *Sidrat al-muntaha* is what? The *'aql-i-awwal*. Near it is the *jannat al-ma'wa*, where everyone... *wa ma 'ashahu...* There is *shajarat al-tuba*, in which all the trees are planted. *Man 'arafaha, sabaqa wa naja*. Whoever knows it, precedes and is saved. And whoever is ignorant of it... whoever is ignorant of it... is misguided and errs. He loses his way. *Li anna kulla maqam-in fi 'alam al-din huwa muqabilun lil 'aql al-awwal*. Because every station in the world of religion is in correspondence with the *'aql-i-awwal*. What did he say? First, he stated the *'aql-i-awwal*. Then in the world, whoever is... *mustajib* and *mustada'i* is a correspondence to the *'aql-i-awwal*. And here what is he saying? Every *Imam* is in correspondence to the *'aql-i-awwal*. *Mawsum-un bi sidrat al-muntaha*. Named *sidrat al-muntaha*. What is the circle of the *'aql-i-awwal*? The circle of... every circle, the first of which is... after that comes... *sidrat al-muntaha*. *Mawsum-un bi sidrat al-muntaha*. His name is *sidrat al-muntaha*. If you call him *bab*, then the *Imam* is *sidrat al-muntaha*. This is what the *mustada'i* and *mustajib* are. The *'aql-i-awwal* is *sidrat al-muntaha*. Near it is the *jannat al-ma'wa*. Where do we have to go? To the *jannat al-ma'wa*. To the *bab*'s paradise.

*Wa babuhu bab-un muqabil-un lil muba'ath al-awwal*. And his *bab*, his *bab* is in correspondence to the First Emanated Being. Such that its name is... *al-mukanna...* His kunyah is... [unclear]. Yes. The *bab* of the *sidrat al-muntaha* is in correspondence to the *muba'ath al-awwal*. Such that its name is... *al-mukanna 'an martabat bi jannat al-ma'wa*. Alluded to... for its rank, by *jannat al-ma'wa*. By *jannat al-ma'wa*. That is, from the *muba'ath al-awwal*. *Al-mukanna 'anhu 'inda dhalika al-nafs al-kulliyyah*. And alluded to from it at that time with the *nafs al-kulliyyah*. This is the *nafs al-kulliyyah*. The *muba'ath al-awwal*. And the *bab* is here. The *nafs al-kulliyyah*. *Wa kana Amir al-mu'minin salawatullah 'alayh...* We can also call the *'aql-i-awwal* Imam. Yes. In the world of Intellect, it is the Imam. And we can call the *muba'ath al-awwal* the *bab*.

*Wa kana Amir al-mu'minin salawatullah 'alayh, qad kana 'an bab bin nafs al-kulliyyah*. And *Amir al-Mu'minin, salawatullah 'alayh*, had made an allusion from the *bab* to the *nafs al-kulliyyah*. *Wa 'an jannat al-ma'wa 'an maqam-in muqabil-in li hadhihi al-muba'ath al-awwal*. And from *jannat al-ma'wa* to a station in correspondence with this *muba'ath al-awwal*. *Wa kadhalika kullu hadd-in min hudud al-din fa huwa muqabil-un li 'aql-in min 'uqul 'alam al-ibda'*. And likewise, every rank from the ranks of religion is in correspondence to an intellect from the intellects of the world of creation. *Wa sayati 'alayhim al-qawl fi ma ba'd, insha Allah ta'ala*. And the discussion on this will come later, *insha Allah ta'ala*.

*Thumma inna dhalika al-'amud al-nurani jarin min al-bab ila al-hujjah*. Then that luminous pillar flows from the *bab* to the *hujjah*. *Wa min al-hujjah ila al-da'i*. From the *hujjah* to the *da'i*. *Wa min al-da'i ila al-ma'dhun, wa min al-ma'dhun ila Amir al-mu'minin*. And from the *da'i* to the *ma'dhun*, and from the *ma'dhun* to the *Amir al-mu'minin*. And from the *mu'min* to the *mustajib* (respondent). And *ma'n...* means the one who takes the noble covenant. *Kama sabaqa min al-qawl*. As has preceded in the discussion.

*Fa idha aanat nuqlatu 'aql-in min al-mustajibin aw ghayrihim*. So when the time of departure of one of the *mustajibin* or others comes... *aanat* is a past tense verb. What is *aanat*? Feminine. If one does not understand and read, one could read it as *anta*. One could read it as *anti*. One could read it as *antum*. One can read whatever one wants, but if one reads with understanding, it is *aanat*. What is its origin? Is this a noun, a verb, or a particle? In Urdu, it's also *aana*. Mawla *Amir al-Mu'minin, alayhi al-salatu wa salam*, when he explained... Abu'l-Aswad al-Du'ali, he started teaching him *sarf* and *nahw*. He said that first, you should understand that there are how many letters? Twenty-eight. There are twenty-eight letters. The esteemed letters, the one who utters them... what is that? The word. And from those twenty-eight letters, some meaningful words are formed, and some are meaningless. Meaningful words are called *kalimah*, meaningless ones are called *majhul*. And meaningful *kalimah* are of how many types? Three types. *Ism* (noun), *fi'l* (verb), and *harf* (particle). He explained that what is an *ism*? It is the luminous essences. What is a *fi'l*? Their intentions. What is a *fi'l*? Their intentions. And what is a *harf*? The one that creates a relationship between the two. What is a *harf*? The one that creates a relationship between the two, an *ism* and a *fi'l*. That is what he said. How he has explained the entire science of grammar. In the world of life, in the world of lights, it is happening. And then he explained various things in it, what is what. So here, what is *aanat*? It is a verb. *Fa idha aanat*. *Aana* what? When it comes. It approaches. *Aanat*. It becomes near. The departure... the departure of one of the *mustajibin* or others. What did you say? *Kullu fa'ilin marfu'un* (Every doer/subject is raised). What does it mean? Every *fa'il* (doer) has a *pesh* (dammah) on it. *Kullu fa'ilin*. It's a strange meaning. In that luminous world, the one who acts, the one who makes an intention first and moves forward, he is the *fa'il*. He is elevated. *Fa'ilin marfu'un*, he is elevated. In that luminous world, the one who moves forward with speed, he is raised (*marfu'*), he has a *pesh* on him. He is at the forefront. And after that what did he say? *Kullu maf'ulin mansubun* (Every object is established). The one upon whom an effect was made. The one upon whom an effect was made, he is established (*mansub*). He has a *zabar* (*fathah*). And *kullu... majrurin maksurun* (everything governed by a preposition is broken). The one who was pulled by it... who was pulled by it... neither here nor there. What is it? *Maksur*, he has a *zer* (*kasrah*). He became of *zer* and *zabar*.

So, the Arabic language is an original language. Yes. It's not like in the world where every language has evolved. This is... because the foundation of *la ilaha illa allah* itself is on the 28 [letters], so it's obvious that it would be in a language which still exists today. *Bi lisanin 'arabiyyin mubin* (in a clear Arabic tongue). Allah did not mention any other language. He didn't mention English. He didn't mention your Telugu language. May Allah protect them. He mentioned the Arabic language. That is why it happened.

So, these numbers and... digits, words, all of them came with *la ilaha illa allah*. Because all the laws are encoded within it. That's why the entire *kalimah* has everything in it. The light of the *kalimah* of *la ilaha illa allah* has everything in it.

*Fa idha aanat harraka al-'aql al-'ashir dhalika al-'amud al-nurani al-mawsum bil jari*. And when the movement... of the *Imam* of that time... so you all need to understand this very well. And he gives movement, the Tenth Intellect (*'aql-i-'ashir*), to that luminous pillar. The Tenth Intellect means what? Whatever is in the tenth sphere. Either the sphere of the Tenth... The *'aql-i-'ashir*'s relation is towards the *Imam*. The *Imam*. In the same way. *Dhalika al-'amud al-nurani*. That luminous pillar. He gives it movement. *Al-mawsum bil jari* (named "the flowing one"). He makes it flow. *Al-mawsum bil jari*. Which is named *jari*. *Wa ittasalat al-harakat bi Imam dhalika al-zaman*. *Jari* means flowing. The Tenth Intellect is above. The *'aql-i-'ashir*. Then the primary ones. Below it is the Imam. The movement connects with the *Imam* of that time. *Fa 'alima anna tilka al-harakah li naqlati dhalika al-muntaqil*. And he knows that that movement is for the transfer of that departing one. That movement is for the transfer of that departing one. *Wa harraka dhalika al-'amud*. He gives movement, you... to that pillar. To that pillar. *Wa jazabahu ilayhi*. And pulls it towards himself. The one who is departing... who pulls? The *Imam*. He pulls the luminous pillar towards himself. The *Imam* of the time. He gives movement to that pillar. To that pillar. And he pulls... and he attracts him, the one who is departing.

It means that the *Imam* is drawing towards himself. *Wa harraka...* So he moves... the *Imam* of the time gives movement to that pillar. And he attracts... and he attracts him, that departing one, towards himself. But here it is about all the souls, that they are... from the four natures... they are emerging from their changes. But here he is saying that he pulls them from the luminous pillar. That luminous form... the *nafs*. He pulls the *nafs-i-natiqah*. *Wa harraka...* So, only by the sign of the *Imam al-Zaman* it happens. The Tenth Intellect receives the command. Then the *Imam al-Zaman, alayhi al-salatu wa salam*, through him...

*Wa anjazabat tilka al-surah*. And that form is attracted. *Anjazaba* means it was attracted. *Jazaba* means he attracted. *Anjazaba* means it was attracted. This is the intransitive form. *Mut'addi* (transitive) meaning is gone. *Wa anjazabat tilka al-surah bi anjizabi dhalika al-'amud*. And that form is attracted by the attraction of that pillar. *Wa jazabat ilayha tilka al-nafs allati kanat mujawirat-un laha*. And it is attracted towards it, that soul... which was its neighbor. That soul... whose... that soul. *Ilayha*, the pronoun *ha* refers to the *surah*. That soul is attracted towards the *surah*. That soul. *Ilayha*... towards the *surah*. That soul is pulled. That soul which was a neighbor, that also gets attracted. The attraction of that pillar. *Wa jazabat ilayha tilka al-nafs*. And that soul is attracted towards that *surah*. The *nafs-i-hissiya* which was its neighbor. Previously it was stated as a neighbor. With the *nafs-i-natiqah*, the *nafs-i-hissiya* is also attracted and comes along.

Through the pillar of light, the *hissiya* also... The pillar of light only pulls the *nafs...* the *natiqah*. But with the *nafs-i-natiqah*, the *hissiya* also gets pulled along. As a neighbor. There is no *hissiya* left. It has become pure. How much of the *nafs-i-hissiya* does it pull? However much he followed it in the world. However much he obeyed the *nafs-i-natiqah*.

*Fa anjazabat ilayha 'ala hay'at al-jism al-kulli, la yughadiru saghirat-an minhu wa la kabirah*. So it is attracted towards it in the form of the universal body. It does not leave anything small of it, nor anything big. *Wal hamdulillah 'ala ma an'ama 'alayna min ma'rifatih, wa ittasal-i 'ilmina bi 'ilmih*. And all praise is for Allah for the blessing He bestowed upon us of His gnosis, and the connection of our knowledge with His knowledge. *Wa salla Allah 'ala nabiyyihi Muhammad salat-an min nabiyyin, wa 'ala wasiyyihi 'Aliyyin salat-an min wasiyyin, wa 'ala a'immati al-tahirin wa 'ala mawlana al-Imam al-tayyib al-Qasim... ajma'in*.

What has been stated? *Fa 'alima 'inda tilka al-harakah li naqlat dhalika al-muntaqil*. Meaning, so he knew that that movement was for the transfer... *Imam*. The *Imam* of the time is moved. The pillar of light... and the movement connects with the *Imam* of the time. The one who gives the movement is the Tenth Intellect. The Tenth Intellect means... now we will understand it as the Imam. No, no, it is a separate rank. The rank of the Tenth... its تدبیر (governance) is... of the primary creation. The governance of the Fourth. Yes. He gives the movement. And that luminous pillar... its movement connects with the *Imam* of the time. And they understand that that movement is for the transfer of that departing one. So that luminous pillar is moved. The movement became separate, the luminous pillar is separate. *Wa harraka dhalika al-'amud*. Movement is what? They signal that this is... its time of departure has come, it has become pure. Now it is to be attracted. Attracted towards... the form of the *bab*.

So, our... in the pillar of light, does it remain independently or is it through a link with our... elders or... No. In the ocean, what happens? Can a drop be taken out of the ocean? It is an ocean too. It is an ocean, and it is a drop too. Both. The drop can be separated, and the drop can also... its state is... [unclear].

<!-- lecture 26 -->

There are five principles in the first chapter of *Mabda' wa-Ma'ad*. The fifth principle, the sixth principle is a debate. The seventh principle speaks of the reality of the fifth principle. Among them, the first chapter: *thumma inna-l-nafsa 'inda intiza'iha min jismiha... 'inda intiza'iha... in... thumma inna-l-nafsa... 'inda intiza'iha, intizabiha min jismihima... jismiha... min jismiha. fa-tamtaziju... bi-tilka-l-surata... wa-tasirani... bi-tilka-l-surati, bi-tilka-l-surati, bi-tilka-l-surati... wa-tasirani shay'an wahidan, wa-dhatan wahidatan, wa-nuran sha'sha'aniyan, malakutiyan, jibriliyan.*

Then this, that the *nafs* (soul), at the time of its being drawn out… at the time of its being drawn from its body… is this about the believers? The *nafs* which is, yes. The *nafs* that is connected to the body. When it leaves the body, what happens? *tamtaziju* (it mixes). It merges. It merges with its form, with its spiritual form. It becomes connected to the *natiqah* (rational soul). *Wa-tasirani shay'an wahidan* (And they both become one thing). So they both become one and the same thing. In life, they were how? Separate. *Mujawir* (adjacent). *Mujawir*. After death, they become *mumazij* (intermixed). This is a very big difference.

This *nafs* which is in the first sentence, that is the *nafs-e-hissiyah* (sensory soul). *Nafs-e-hissiyah*. The *nafs*, at the time of its departure from its body, merges with that form. So they both become one and the same thing. *Wa-dhatan wahidatan* (and one essence), and one *dhat* (essence), and one *dhat*. *Wa-nuran sha'sha'aniyan malakutiyan jibriliyan.* And a radiant, angelic, Gabrielic light. *Wa-yabqa dhalika-l-jismu farighan muwatan, hatta sara...* [unclear] *...dhalika-l-jawhara-l-nuraniya-l-hayya-l-qadira-l-'alima-l-natiqa-l-sami'a-l-basira-l-dha'iqa-l-sham.*

And that body remains empty, dead. Until it has become that luminous substance (*jawhar-e-nurani*) that is living (*hayy*), powerful (*qadir*), knowing (*'alim*), speaking (*natiq*), hearing (*sami'*), seeing (*basir*), smelling (*shamm*), tasting (*dha'iq*). These are the qualities of the *nafs-e-hissiyah*. The *nafs-e-hissiyah* has all these qualities. And the *nafs-e-hissiyah* leaves the body. A *jawhar-e-nurani* (luminous substance), it's called? Yes. Why is it called a *jawhar-e-nurani*? It has become one with the *nafs-e-natiqah* (rational soul). The qualities of the *natiqah* have come into it. *Thumma inna tilka-l-nafsa wa-l-surata-l-latayni... wa-baqiya-l-jismu dumlatan min-al-dumal... 'adima-l-idrak wa-l-shu'ur. Wa-baqiya-l-jismu...* So the body remains a corpse among the corpses, devoid of perception and feeling. There is nothing in the dead body. The dead body is devoid of all things. Because these qualities were due to the *nafs*. Because of the *nafs*, it was luminous, it was living (*hayy*), it was powerful (*qadir*), it was knowing (*'alim*), it was speaking (*natiq*). When the *nafs* separated, because the *nafs* separated, all its powers ended.

*Thumma inna tilka-l-nafsa wa-l-surata-l-latayni qad sarata dhatan wahidatan yansalikhani bi-suratin a'la minha, fa-yumazijaniha wa-yasirani wa-iyyaha dhatan wahidatan wa-jumlatan wahidatan mujawarina li-nafsi sahib tilka-l-surati-l-lati qad yumazijatiha.* Yes. A special thing to remember is that... the method is that that *nafs* and *surah*... which both... both... have become pure. Have become pure. That *nafs* and *surah* which... whose end was good (*khatima bil-khayr*). He is talking about that. *Sirat-ul-Mustaqim*. Yes. His end was good. His *nafs* has also become pure, and his *surah* was pure to begin with. The *nafs* is also pure.

That which is, was connected to its *hadde aali* (Exalted Limit). I will tell you what it is connected to. The method is that that *nafs* and *surah*... like this... they both become one essence, and they connect, and they merge... one thing has been formed. The *surah* and the *nafs* have become one thing. They connect, both of them, with a form (*surah*) which is higher than them, whose *surah* is higher than it. They go and connect with that. *Fa-yumazijaniha.* So they both... they both intermix with it. They merge. *yumazijaniha* means they merge. *Wa-yasirani wa-iyyaha...* And they become... they and it... they both and it... that is, the higher form (*surah*). They both and the higher form, *dhatan wahidatan* (one essence), one *dhat*, *wa-jumlatan wahidatan* (and one whole), and one whole. *Mujawarina li-nafsi...* *Mujawarina li-nafsi sahib tilka-l-surah*. But they become adjacent to the *nafs* of the owner of that *surah*. *Al-lati* (which) ... has become intermixed with it. What does this mean?

The lower *juz'* (part)... the whole which is the *surah* and the *dhat*, when they have become pure... they go and what do they do? They intermix with the luminous form of their *hadde aali*. They become one. *Dhatan wahidah*. But they remain adjacent to the *nafs* of the *hadde aali*. Okay. To its *nafs-e-hissiyah*, they maintain adjacency.

Will the *hadde aali* die? No. The *hadde aali* doesn't die. The *hadde aali* is alive. Alive. That is, *li-nafsi sahib tilka-l-surah*. So when the *hadde aali* dies, then... If its end is also good, then... He will explain that later. He is explaining the process now. He is talking about the life of the *hadde aali*. The *hadde aali* has... the end is good... no... He will explain what happens after that later. He is explaining the process now. *Wa-yasiru tilka-l-jumla... mujawir...* (and that whole becomes... adjacent...). Adjacent to the *nafs* of the owner of that *surah*. *Al-lati qad...* with which it has become intermixed. Meaning, they are adjacent to the *nafs* of their *hadde aali*, and they merge with its *surah*.

If you call the sun (*shams*) feminine and the moon (*qamar*) masculine, the superiority of the sun is not diminished by that. This is a line of Arabic poetry. But because the sun's rays, they... make the moon luminous. Yes, they make it luminous. But *shams* is used as feminine, isn't it? And *qamar* as masculine. It is a linguistic thing. It's a linguistic thing. For that, there is a line of poetry. It is attached. It deposits it. The moon. And it collects. *'indaha* (with her) is used here. *'indahu* (with him) should be there. What is written there? *yajtami'u 'indaha* (it gathers with her) or *'indahu* (with him)? *'indahu*. Yes? *'indahu*. *'indahu*, right? *wa-yajtami'u 'indahu shay'un*. So it collects with him. What collects with him? The moon. *wa-yajtami'u 'indahu* means it collects with it, a little after a little, from the branches, the moving souls, moving towards the complete meals. And that is the brilliant light on the night of the fourteenth. The fourteenth. The moon of the fourteenth, as they say, right? In that, the light that comes from the sun, in that... the *nufus-e-rihiyyah* (aeolian souls)... *nufus-e-rihiyyah* are included. And the filling of the moon with that light, which is from those *nufus-e-rihiyyah*. Like those who... Are these *nufus-e-rihiyyah* in a clean state or are there impurities (*kudurat*) and such? There are impurities. Those are being... The moon's shining is from the *kudurat*-containing *rihiyyah*. Yes, with some impurities. After that, it becomes... and its shining... its light is... after that, the purification begins, the cleansing begins. In which the luminosity is... which is increasing. The moon's light is also dense (*kasif*), isn't it? And these *nufus-e-rihiyyah* are subtle (*latif*). And that is the brilliant light. And the filling of the moon with that light. Such that it is from those *nufus-e-rihiyyah*. And the completion of that light, *min jami'-il-afaq* (from all horizons), and it becomes complete, that light. From all the horizons. What are the nights of *biz* called? Thirteen, fourteen, fifteen. One day before, one day after... fasting on them is considered *mustahabb* (recommended). The nights of *biz*.

Then the moon returns, and deposits it with the sun. Via the stations of Mercury (*'utarid*) and Venus (*zuhra*). Bit by bit (*shay'an ba'da shay'in*). Venus. Right? *zuhra*? Yes, *zuhra*. Yes, it's correct. Then the moon returns, depositing it towards the sun. It deposits the *rihiyyah*. The *nufus-e-rihiyyah*. It's feminine. Yes. The *nufus-e-rihiyyah*... the subtle vapor (*bukhar-e-latif*) which... The *nufus-e-rihiyyah* and the *bukhar-e-latif* are the same thing? Yes, the same thing. The *bukhar-e-latif* is what is being talked about. In this, the purification is not mentioned. It is depositing it, isn't it? Via Mercury and Venus. So it returns... Then the moon returns, depositing... depositing the subtle vapor (*bukhar-e-latif*) towards the sun, via Mercury and Venus, bit by bit. First, it gives it to Mercury, then to Venus, then from there it reaches towards the sun. The moon is the lowest, above it is Venus, above that is Mercury, and above that is the sun. Bit by bit. *shay'an ba'da shay'in* means bit by bit. Bit by bit. A little at a time, not all at once. As they collect, it keeps sending. Until a month is reached.

This *rihiyyat*, what is inside it? Like, the purification. Meaning, all those things, our sins, they... which did not leave with the rational (*natiqah*) soul, what are they? So the sins are such that all the human beings are... among people. So what is being purified here? The corporeality (*jismaniyyat*) which has come into it, for this reason... when it was buried with it... yes... it was buried with its body, so in it... a gross body (*kal-jism*). Like a body, it has become. *Rihiyyat*. So in them, impurities have developed. Now they are being purified. They become a subtle vapor (*bukhar-e-latif*). A stage of purification. Passing through different stations. The impurities are removed from them. Like a house, there's... the trash that has accumulated... if you... how is a house cleaned? By cleaning out the trash. In it, the things of trash... the things of denseness that have accumulated, they come out. But the purification of that trash is on the self (*dhat*), isn't it? I mean, our characteristics, whatever they are, we ourselves have to clean them. This... what is the meaning of purification in the planets? He will... it has to endure the heat, the various things there, the stages... The sun's light... its radiance, it... what does it do to sin? What good does it do? To have them, instead of the heat of hellfire, they are given the heat of the sun. The sun has a lot of heat. But hell is much greater than it. A thousand times more. Via the stations of Mercury and Venus, bit by bit. Until the nights of *bīḍ* are reached. Until the meeting is complete. And the moon has handed over what it had with it, from the *nufus-e-rihiyyah*, towards the sun. And it has remained empty of that light. Then it delivers the full moon's light. Yes. It gives a little bit every day, then later it delivers it completely. Until it becomes completely empty. Then it returns, handing over, for what is renewed for it from that matter forever and ever (*abadan sarmadan*). The fourth chapter. So when it delivers it completely, the moon to the sun, then it... from the radiant light... Yes... Then the 29th, 30th day... in the last days, the moon's light is not visible. It gets obscured. Because of this. The absence of the *rihiyyah* and its light becoming faint. This, when it happens like this, in three, three days, it happens, this meeting takes place. And then what is remaining there, it... it comes out from it. The days for its coming to the world, for its ascent, and for its coming to the world. From the first to the twelfth of the month, those are for ascending. And then on the fifteenth, it is the zenith (*intila'*). And then from the sixteenth, what is it? The time for coming to the world. It delivers the vapors to the world. The fourth chapter.

And when these *nufus-e-rihiyyah* have reached the precinct (*hayyiz*) of the sun, and it is a quintessence (*khulasa*) of the heat of the instinctive bodies (*ajsam-e-ghariziyyah*), the subtle ones, such that it is a vehicle (*markab*) for the sensory life (*hayat-e-hissiyyah*) and a spouse (*zawj*) for it, and a companion (*qarin*) in the heart, such that it is the center (*markaz*) of the instinctive heat (*hararat-e-ghariziyyah*)... what does it mean? What does it mean? I didn't understand. That is, in the precinct of the sun... The sun, what is it? The quintessence of the heat of all the instinctive bodies. Its light is that. In it, the quintessence of the heat is present. This heat is the vehicle for the sensory life. And it is the center of the instinctive heat.

The sun refines it... What is the meaning of *arraqat-ha*? What does it mean? It causes it to sweat. *'araq* means to sweat. It makes it sweat, it breaks it down, and it ferments it. Until it is conveyed to a station that is suitable for the door of the totality of the subtle, spiritual, noble forms. And when those *nufus-e-rihiyyah* have reached the domain of the sun, and it is the quintessence of the heat of the instinctive bodies, the subtle ones, such that it is a vehicle for the sensory life and a spouse for it and a companion in the heart, such that it is the center of the instinctive heat. The sun refines it, and breaks it down, and ferments it, until it is conveyed to a station suitable for the door of the totality of the subtle, spiritual, noble forms. And the sun has delivered that whole to the level of Jupiter (*mushtari*), which is *Sa'd al-Akbar* (the Greater Fortune), and the spiritualities of Jupiter, and the spiritualities of Venus (*zuhra*), which is *Sa'd al-Asghar* (the Lesser Fortune), such that it has become a pure vessel prepared with the station for the command of the Imam, after it has become pure and refined, and has become a subtle, spiritual, luminous, and radiant whole. It delivers those spiritualities, those which are... which spiritualities? Of Mercury's and the moon's. It delivers them, those spiritualities, which are... which spiritualities are they? Of Mercury and... *mushtari* (Jupiter). Such that it is *Sa'd al-Akbar*. *Sa'd al-Akbar* is which one? *Mushtari*. And *Sa'd al-Asghar* is Venus. Venus (*zuhra*). Mercury is the scribe of the heavens (*katib-e-falak*). Scribe. So it delivers those spiritualities, such that they are the rays of both the *Sa'ds* (Fortunes), upon any of the fruits from the fruits which are eaten, or the waters that are drunk, like the dew... dew... upon the dew, so that پیغمبر (the Prophet) عليه الصلاة والسلام... his birth, how did it happen? From the apple of paradise. Or from the waters that are drunk, like the dew... the dew, on which... which is taken... پیغمبر (the Prophet)... his birth, it is said that he was traveling, and a voice from the unseen came, a spring appeared, "Drink from this." From this, the birth of the Seal of the Messengers (*khatim-ul-mursalin*) will happen. You drank, and after that, from Sayyidatuna Amina, the Prophet was born. And that is the food of the Master of the Era and the *'asr* (age), and the food of the moon and the sun, and the food for the *an'at*... and for it, divine providence is a guardian for that, and a trustee for it, a supervisor over it, until it attains the 'Near Station' (*maqam-e-qarib*), which is the master of the *nasut* and *balawan*. And he and his spouse take it as food, she who is the pure vessel, prepared with the station for the command of that. From receiving the food from that, from the two of them together receiving the food from that. The Master of the Era and the *'asr*... what was that? The Imam of the Time. The Imam of the Time's food is this subtle vapor. It comes from above and falls on their food. It is included in their food. And their wife's... it becomes *sulalah* (quintessence/sperm-drop). Yes. *Sulalah* is what they call it. The parts of a human's emergence, which are brought and placed in the father's pure loins and the mother's womb, are called *sulalah*. When both combine, a *nutfah* (sperm-drop) is formed from it. This is the stage of *sulalah*.

And she is from the most virtuous of women, the most noble of them, and the purest of them. And when they both partake of that thing, the station knows at that time the reality of that thing which is from the decree of Allah from that newborn, and he is gladdened by that. And there enters upon them both from joy and delight and happiness what cannot be described or expressed. And at that time, he gives the good tidings of that matter to the deputy of the station who will succeed him and return to it. And he gives the good tidings of the child who will be born, who will be his successor. And he alludes to his matter, to his matter. And that the deputies of the deputies are gathered with what has become with him from that thing, and what has occurred with his wife from that, so it becomes a single whole, ascending in ranks. And it is made from it... from those fruits... for it, food. It eats from it in its mother's womb. That is, his food is also... in the mother's womb, it is from these *rihiyyat*. So Imam's body is not from the earth... from the *rihiyyat*. They are placed on the fruits. He eats from it, and is nourished by it, and grows by it, because it is a pure, revered, noble whole, free from the impurity (*tams*) that is for other fetuses in their mothers' wombs. That is, the menstrual blood does not come near them. What is the reason? The child's food in the mother's womb is from the menstrual blood. But here, what happens? Their food, of the fetus in the womb, is from this whole, which is the purified *rihiyyah* that has come from the spiritualities. And that whole becomes, its spouse becomes... pure, purified, and it is a pure, purified whole. Free from the impurity of menstrual blood. As Allah Ta'ala has said, *Innama yuridu-Llahu liyudhhiba 'ankumu-r-rijsa Ahl al-Bayt wa-yutahhirakum tathira* (Indeed, Allah desires to remove all impurity from you, O People of the House, and to purify you with a thorough purification). To be from the Ahl al-Bayt, what is the condition? To be free from the impurity of *tams*. One. And for the Ahl al-Bayt, another condition is that they do not eat the wealth of *sadaqah* (charity). The wealth of *sadaqah*. Now, the wives of the Prophet, they say we are from the Ahl al-Bayt. But they used to eat the wealth of *sadaqah*. So how can both things be reconciled? That is why Imam Hasan عليه الصلاة والسلام, a date was kept, he was small, he picked it up and was about to eat it. The Prophet did what? He took out the date, and your saliva was also on it, he took that out too. And said, "*sadaqatun la tahillu li-Ahl al-Bayt*" (*sadaqah* is not permissible for the Ahl al-Bayt). And there, 'Aisha and the other wives who claimed we are from the Ahl al-Bayt, what did they used to eat? They ate *sadaqah* upon *sadaqah*. So much so that when *sadaqah* did not come, when wealth from the treasury did not come, she would make a fuss, riding on a camel and coming... to take it.

Now, this... the *namiyyah* and *hissiyyah* parts of ours that have come after being purified, they are going into the Imam. There, they are meeting with his *natiqah*, meeting with his *namiyyah*, meeting with his *hissiyyah*. Meaning, it's like a... Our part is... that is the *ruh* (spirit). It is the *nasut*. They are... the Imam's being and his *nafs*, they are... it is a command. It is the *ruh*. The body is being formed from it. So those parts are no longer ours; they haven't stayed with us. Our next *namiyyah* that comes... They have been perfected. Your *nafs* is present in the *nasut*, isn't it? In the *lahut*, the *nafs* is present. In the *lahut*, the *nafs-e-hissiyyah* is present. In the *lahut*. Okay, so the new *namiyyah*, the new body that comes... the body of the son of the Imam that is coming, with it, your *namiyyah* is present. And in the end, what happened? With your *namiyyah*, your *surah* and your *nafs-e-hissiyyah* have become connected. The two have merged. In the *lahut*, with the *nasut*, when there is connection... what happened? Three streams came and what did they do? They collected in the ocean. The ocean of the son of the Imam, there your *namiyyah* also collected, your *hissiyyah* also collected, and your *surah* also came. All three things came and collected. When the son is begotten... when the Imam begets a son, then what happens? The father's entire collection... the *surah*... comes and connects with what? With the *nasut*. So all three have collected. Who had not been perfected... The process for all three was done separately. One was for the *nafs*... one was for the *surat-e-ruhani*. One was for the *nafs-e-hissiyyah*. Both merged and went with it. And after that, the process for the *nafs-e-namiyyah* was done separately. It came after purification. After coming, what happened? Upon the begetting of the Imam عليه الصلاة والسلام upon his son, then what happened? Then all three congregated. Of whom? Of an individual we are talking about. Yes. Upon the son of the Imam, they congregated. All three congregated. Meaning, the next time, when we come, our *namiyyah* will be completely new. The one that was not perfected... They will explain, the *dam-e-tirmidhi* will be perfected. They will explain in the next cycle. So the *namiyyah* and *hissiyyah*... they recycle. The first and most superior thing was what? The *nafs-e-natiqah*. That reached the father. And after that, your *nafs-e-hissiyyah*, that reached the father. The *nafs-e-namiyyah* had some defect in it. So it came ascending through perfection. What is it that... the coming Imam's... *nasut* it became. They became included in the *nasut*. Now when this process is happening, that... at the time when the Imam عليه الصلاة والسلام begets his son, then what will happen? All the *suwarat* (forms) and *nufus-e-hissiyyah* (sensory souls), they will... with them, the *nafs-e-namiyyah* will also connect. Then the three will collect in one place. They were separated so that... they would reunite again.

And for this whole, there is a subtle part from it, for it... a subtle part... from the fermentation of the sun and the planets, the beneficent ones, for it. And a gaze from the divine providences. Then there assembles for the *jinni*... the *jumla*'s *zamin* has returned to *jumla*. From it, for it, a subtle part from the fermentation of the sun. So the Imam's body has been formed, the *nasut*. Now for the *nasut*, what is needed? A *nafs-e-namiyyah* and a *nafs-e-hissiyyah* are needed for it. So the *nafs-e-namiyyah* and the *nafs-e-hissiyyah* of the son of the Imam, how do they come? He is explaining that. Okay. The body has been formed. After being formed, the *nafs-e-namiyyah*, how did it come into the child? Now here, for the Imam, for the son of the Imam, their *nafs-e-namiyyah*... This is not a fetus. Yes, how does it come from the celestial bodies? He is explaining that. The most subtle part of the refined *nufus-e-namiyyah*... among the most subtle parts of the refined *nufus-e-namiyyah*... the most subtle part... that comes and what happens? The son of the Imam, for them, that becomes the *nafs-e-namiyyah*. Its most subtle part. The most superior part of it.

So that subtle part becomes a *nafs* for that whole. For that whole means? For that whole, meaning... for that whole which... all the *nufus-e-namiyyah* and them, have collected with it. The *nafs-e-namiyyah* which came from the celestial bodies and from the fermentation of the sun, that part of it... that has become its *nutfah*. The *nutfah*'s station, what has he attained? And when the fourth day came, then the *nafs-e-namiyyah*... the fourth month came, then the *nafs-e-namiyyah* from the sun is obtained by him. The *nafs-e-namiyyah*. On the fourth month. From the sun. The sun's... from the sun, the *nafs-e-namiyyah* comes, and connection occurs with it.

So the *nafs-e-namiyyah* is what? He hasn't explained. He will explain. It's coming. Its most subtle part. In the sun, the most subtle part which... all the *nufus-e-namiyyah* ascended, its most subtle part comes and what happens? The son of the Imam, for them, that becomes the *nafs-e-namiyyah*. Its most subtle part. The most superior part of it. So that subtle part becomes a *nafs* for that whole. And when that whole has completed its term in its mother's womb, a complete, perfect, complete, knowing, powerful, subtle, transparent man appears, prepared by the five senses. And it is a noble substance (*jawhar-e-latif*). A little after a little. In the quickest time. Being مجرد (*mujarrad*, disembodied)... all the powers are *mujarrad*. They are pure. They see, they become seeing, its rays and its lights. Seeing with whose eyes? With the eye of the beloved. With the eye of love. They are from piety and purity and nobility and loftiness, what cannot be described or expressed by any describer.

So from the *nufus-e-namiyyah*... the center of all the *nufus-e-namiyyah*... our parts... the parts of our body are fire, air, water, earth. Our body's parts. And their... body, how is it formed? From the *nufus-e-namiyyah*. And the *nafs-e-namiyyah* which they have received, what is that? The most subtle part which has ascended from the entire universe. Its most subtle part is their *nafs-e-namiyyah*. For the son of the Imam, it becomes the *nafs-e-namiyyah*.

The parts that are in our *nasut*... are they already processed, or are they progressing while in their *nasut*? They have already been processed. Your body has become your soul. They have been, in the celestial spheres, the purification has happened, here too... but when they came into the *nasut* of the Imam, are they continuously being purified or has the purification stopped? The process of purification has ended up there. Here, in the *nasut*, there is nothing. Now if there is anything left... after coming to the world, if anything remains... The give and take remains, doesn't it? In the sun, there is no give and take. Okay. So, towards the Imam. In the world, there is give and take.

<!-- lecture 27 -->

My first name is Thomas, my middle name is Johannes, and my last name is Thomas.

...the fourth lesson. ...When the born one (`mawlud`) reaches the years of upbringing (`sini al-tarbiyah`), and they are four years, from his birth, the gate (`baab`) of his father transfers.
From his birth.
From his birth.
From his birth.
The gate (`baab`) of his father (`abih`) transfers, he with whom were those forms (`suwar`) and souls (`nufus`), the extracted (`al-mustakhrajah`) which had become connected to the soul (`nafs`) of that born one (`mawlud`), who is the Imam, upon him be the best of salutations (`'alayhi afdal as-salam`).
So when the born one (`mawlud`) reached...
When `iza` comes before a past tense verb, it gives the meaning of the present tense. So, "when the born one (`mawlud`) reaches". So when the born one (`mawlud`) reaches...
...the years of upbringing (`sini al-tarbiyah`).
...completes the years of upbringing.
Years of upbringing.
What is the original of `sini`? `Sinin`. `Sinin`. The original of `sinin` is what? `Sanun`. From `sanun` comes `sinun`. The years (`saal`) are `sinun`. And if it is in the state of `zabar` (accusative) or `zer` (genitive), it is `sinin`. `Sinin`. `Sinun`, `sinin`. And because it is `mudaf ilayh` (the second term in a possessive construction), the `nun` of the `mudaf ilayh` is dropped. That's why the `nun` was dropped. What is the original? `Sinin`. `At-tarbiyah`: the years of upbringing. Is `sinin` singular (`wahid`) or plural (`jama'`)?
Plural.
It is plural. In which state is it? Nominative (`fa'ili`)? It is in the state of `zabar` (accusative) or `zer` (genitive)?
Genitive.
Genitive.
In the state of `zabar` and `zer`, `ya` comes. And in the state of `pesh` (nominative), `sinun` is said. Why was the `nun` dropped? Because it is `mudaf` (possessed). It is the `mudaf` of `tarbiyah`. The `nun` in `mudaf` is dropped. So when the born one (`mawlud`) reaches the years of upbringing, and they are four years. When the Imam becomes four years old, from his birth...
...the effects of the sun (`shams`) ...
From his birth. ...he transfers.
The gate (`baab`) of his father.
The `baab` of his father...
The `baab` of his father.
...The `baab` of his father, which is the inner gate (`baab-e-baatin`), he transfers.
Is the `mawlud` himself...
Yes, when he becomes four years old.
The one being talked about, the `mawlud`, isn't he the `baab`?
No, he is not the `baab`. The `baab` of the father.
Whose `baab`?
The `baab` was appointed. Who appointed the `baab`?
The Imam, the son of the Imam, his father appointed him.
They are called the `baab` of the father.
So who is the `mawlud`?
Yes? The `mawlud` is the son. When the son becomes four years old, then your father's `baab`...
...the `baab` of your father, who is the `baab`, transfers.
Is it the `baab` of the Imam who is coming?
No. The Imam's `baab-ul-abwaab`... the son does not have a `baab-ul-abwaab`. The heart (`qalb`) of the son becomes a temple (`haykal`). The `baab` belongs to whom? To his father. The father has two `baabs`: the outer gate (`baab-e-zaahir`) and the inner gate (`baab-e-baatin`). The `baab-e-zaahir` is connected with whom? The `baab-e-baatin`. And the `baab-e-baatin` is connected with whom? The son of the Imam. So when he transfers, he connects with whom? Who...
The `mawlud`...
He becomes connected. It is a general rule (`kulliyah`). `Intaqala baabu abih`. The `baab` of your father transfers.
`Alladhi saarat`.
...who had reached him. Those `suwarat`... those `suwar` and `nufus`. `Al-mustakhrajah`.
`Al-mustakhrajah`, which were extracted...
...which were extracted, gathered (`mushtama'`) in a collective manner (`mushtama' taur se`).
And...
...those `suwarat` and `nufus` which were gathered with the `baab-ul-abwaab`... they reach where? They reach him. `Wa-ttasalat bi-nafsi dhalika al-mawlud`. And they become connected to the `nafs` of that `mawlud`. And it is such that he is the Imam, `alayhi afdal as-salam`. That `mawlud` is called the Imam. `Imamat` is not mentioned.
So, for four years, like you... the Imam is not designated?
From birth, an Imam is an Imam, but there are special circumstances, there are exceptions. But the general rule (`kulliyah`) is that when they become four years old, `nass` (designation) occurs upon them, upon Imam, `alayhi as-salatu was-salam`. The `nass` can be manifest (`jali`) or it can be hidden (`khafi`). Both can happen. Usually, at four years, `nass` occurs upon the son of the Imam.
Are you saying that when he is four years old, the `baab`'s transfer occurs...
Transfer occurs.
...and with the `baab-e-baatin`, all the `suwarat`...
...the `jama'`, they become connected to the `nafs` of the Imam's son.
That `mawlud`...
`Bi-nafsi dhalika al-mawlud, alladhi huwa al-Imam` (with the soul of that born one, who is the Imam). An Imam can have many sons. It connects with that born one who is the Imam.
The `mawlud` is the Imam.
The `mawlud` is the son. He becomes the Imam, `alayhi as-salam`.
The `baab` who transferred, isn't he also an Imam?
He is a `baab`. `Baab-u abih`.
The son's father is an Imam.
`Baab-u abih`. The `baab` of his father.
The Imam's father, his `baab` is the `baab-e-baatin`. He comes and becomes connected to the son of the Imam.
So as soon as this happened, then the `mawlud`'s father, is he no longer the Imam, for example?
His rank is elevated.
Okay, he is elevated, and...
...the one who is the `mawlud` is the Imam, the Imam of the time (`Imam-e-Zamana`), and he starts to take charge slowly, slowly. Slowly, slowly, he starts to take charge. Upon him are the `jadhb` (attraction), `fath` (opening), `khayal` (imagination), and all `ishraqat` (illuminations), and he slowly starts to take charge. The years of upbringing. For example, what did the Prophet, `alayhi as-salam`, say? `Al-Hasanu wal-Husaynu imamaani qaama aw qa'ada` (Al-Hasan and Al-Husayn are two Imams, whether they rise or sit). When did he say this? When he passed away (`intiqal`), it was 3 AH, 4 AH. When they were four years old, seven and eight years old, at that time this saying exists. When they were four years old. This saying also exists. So what does it mean? The special `suwar` and `baab` they had, both their `baabs`, they came and became connected to them. If they are not fully connected, the `suwarat` are with them. They come and become connected.
`Wa-tasiru tilka as-suwaru wan-nufusu al-mushtama'ah fil-haykali al-alfi an-nurani al-insani ash-shan` (And those forms and souls gathered in the thousandfold, luminous, human, glorious structure become...). They become, those `suwar`, which are the forms and souls, which are gathered (`mushtama'`) in the `haykal al-alfi`, the thousandfold, luminous, human, glorious structure. `Wa-yasiru tilka an-nafsu ruhan li-hadha al-haykal` (And that soul becomes a spirit for this structure). `Yasir` or `tasir`? `Yasir`. `Yasir`.
It is `tilka an-nafsu ruhan li-dhalika al-haykal`. `Li-hadhal-haykal`.
And it becomes that soul...
What is `dhalika al-haykal`? What is this `haykal`? The `baab-ul-abwaab` has things that come to him, the `suwarat`. That is called a `haykal`.
Yes.
That is also called `lahut`. The `lahut` connects with the `nasut`. `Lahut` is the `suwarat wa nufus`. Yes. And `nasut` is the `mawlud`, the one which came from above, from the `qamar` (moon).
Okay, so this...
...the one who is the Imam, the `mawlud`, the son of the Imam, he is...
...at the `baab-ul-abwaab`, all the `nasut`, all the souls of the believers, of the `hudud`, of the `abwab`, were gathered. Along with them, the `suwarat` and `nufus` of that era also come and join. Their `nafs-e-natq`...
...what happened? Their bodies' lower parts were there...
...of the people...
...the `suwarat wa nufus` which were higher, they came and then joined in one gathering. It becomes one gathering.
`Muntadiyah bihi wa-hiya 'ala hay'at al-jism`. `Wa-hiya 'ala...`
It is `mushakkalatan`.
`Wa-hiya 'ala hay'at al-jism` (And it is in the form of the body). And it is upon the form of the body. Its human form is what? It is the forms of the `ashbah` (apparitions) which are luminous (`nurani`). `Mutashakkilatan bi-jamii'i a'da'ihi wa 'asabihi wa 'uruqihi wa-jamii'i aalatihi wa ra'sihi wa 'aynihi wa udhunihi wa anfihi wa famihi wa yadihi wa rijlihi wa ghayri dhalik` (Formed with all of its limbs, its nerves, its veins, all its instruments, its head, its eye, its ear, its nose, its mouth, its hand, its foot, and other than that).
And in the form of...
...its organs, all its organs, and its muscles, and its veins and arteries, and its instruments, and its head... from the head, and from the eye, and from the nose, from the mouth, and from the mouth, and from the hand, and from the foot, and apart from that, `wa kullu suratin min hadhihi as-suwar as-sa'irah fi hadhal-haykal`
They are telling seven things. `Ra's` (head), one. `'Ayn` (eye), two. `Udhun` (ear), three. `Anf` (nose), four. `Yad` (hand), five. `Rijl` (foot), six. `Wa ghayri dhalik` (and other than that), apart from that, seven. `Wa kullu suratin min hadhihi as-suwar as-sa'iratu fi hadha...`
`As-sa'iratu fi hadhal-haykali bi-taraddudi at-tawliyah wa nafsuha...` `wa nafsuha al-jabizatu laha fa huma shay'un wahidun wa sinfun wahidun 'ala hay'at al-jism` (Moving in this structure with the frequency of `tawliyah`, and its soul that attracts it, they are one thing and one kind in the form of a body). `Aydan`.
And every form from these `suwarat` which are moving in this `haykal`...
...has been merged.
It has been, and its `nafs`...
...attracting...
The forms are... the forms of people are in the `haykal`. And their `nafs`, which is the `nafs`...
...the souls of the people are in the `haykal`... and their `nafs`, which is the `nafs-e-hissiyah` (sensory soul)... the `nafs-e-hissiyah` which the people have in the `haykal`... and their `nafs`, which `nafs`? `Nafs-e-hissiyah`. The people who are in the `haykal`... `haykal`... the form and soul have come. `Nafsuha al-jabizatu laha`. The soul which is attracting that form. `Fa huma shay'un wahid`. Those two are one and the same thing. `Wa sinfun wahid`. And one and the same kind. `'Ala hay'at al-jism`. On the form of the body. `Aydan`, similarly. `La yughadiru saghiratan wa la kabirah`. And it does not leave a small thing nor a big thing.
`Wa huwa hayyun naatiqun qaadirun 'aalimun masrurun mughbitatun`.
...and it is living, speaking, powerful, knowing, joyous, delighted. `Lakinnahu li-ijtima'i basa'iri ikhwanihi fi dhalika al-majma' ash-sharif, alladhi huwa al-haykal an-nurani, takunu hayatuhu wa quwwatuhu wa qudratuhu wa 'ilmuhu wa hiddatuhu wa dhaka'uhu wa sama'uhu wa basarahu aksaru wa a'zamu wa adkhala wa ashrafu wa ambalu min kawnihi 'ala hiddatihi ad'afan muda'afah li-ijtima'i al-lata'ifi ba'dihim ba'da` (But due to the gathering of the insights of his brothers in that noble assembly, which is the luminous structure, his life, his strength, his power, his knowledge, his sharpness, his intelligence, his hearing, and his sight become more, greater, more profound, more noble, and more exalted than his being in his singularity, many times over, due to the gathering of the subtle entities one with another).
And it is living, it is speaking, it is powerful, it is knowing, it is joyous, it is delighted. Where it was, with the `baab-ul-abwaab`, there too its glory was of the same kind. But now here, in the noble `haykal`, in the son of the Imam's noble `haykal`, when it has come, its glory is much higher. But it, by means of the gathering of all the `ikhwan` (brothers) in that assembly... it is such that it is the luminous `haykal`, its life and strength and power and knowledge and sharpness...
...that soul which came...
...when they come into the assembly, it becomes much more. More excellent, greater, more vast, more noble, and more exalted than its being on its sharpness. `Ad'afan muda'afah` (many times over). By means of the gathering of the `lata'if` (subtle entities) with one another.
`Wa majra dhalika ar-ruhi fi jami'iha, alladhi huwa nafsu dhalika al-Imam al-mansus 'alayhi` (And the flowing of that spirit in all of them, which is the soul of that Imam upon whom designation has been made).
And it flows... It is `yujri` (makes flow), perhaps. `Mujri dhalika ar-ruh`. And the one who makes that spirit flow, in all of them, is he, such that he is the soul of that Imam upon whom `nass` (designation) has been made. That Imam who is `mansus` (designated), he becomes its soul, its whole `haykal`. `Bulughuhum tilka ar-rutbat al-'aliyah wal-manzilat al-janniyyat as-samiyah` (Their reaching that high rank and the paradisiacal, lofty station). And their reaching that high rank and the lofty paradisiacal station. This is the paradise (`jannah`) of this world which they attain in the `haykal`.
`Wa-ttisalu dhalika an-nuri al-ilahi bi-hadhihi an-nufus ittisalan kulliyan` (And the connection of that divine light with these souls, a total connection).
And the connection of that divine light, the one which is coming, with these souls, it becomes a total connection.
From the soul of the Imam, with the souls of all, it becomes a total connection.
`Wa-innama kana ittisalu hadhihi al-lata'ifi bi-nafsi...`
`...al-Imam`
...Is this `mim` or `alif`?
`Mim`.
This is `alif`. Look. The `fa` is on the `lam-alif`.
`Bi-nafsi sayyidihim`.
`Bi-nafsi al-Imam, 'alayhi afdal as-salam, ba'da wafa'i arba'i sinin, li-kawni ad-dini da'amatan lil-qalb` (with the soul of the Imam, upon him be the best of salutations, after the completion of four years, because religion is a support for the heart).
And the connection of these `lata'if` (subtle entities) with the soul of that Imam, peace be upon him, is after the completion of four years. Because religion is a support for the heart.
`Wa-kana al-mustadillu qa'iman la yusharruhu alladhi huwa al-Imam 'alayhi as-salam` (And the seeker of proof was standing, not explained to him by the one who is the Imam, peace be upon him). `Wa la yufaariquhu laysa bi-khaarijin 'anhu, illa ba'da ma'rifati al-naatiq wal-wasi wal-Imam al-'asr wal-hujjah` (And he does not part from him, he is not outside of him, except after the knowledge of the Speaker, the Legatee, the Imam of the Age, and the Proof).
And the `mustadill` (seeker of proof)... a `mustadill` is not called a `mustadill` except after knowing the `Naatiq` (Speaker), the `Wasi` (Legatee), and the `Imam al-'Asr` (Imam of the Age), and the `Hujjat` (Proof). The `mustadill` is taught, what do we teach first in `Haqaiq` (religious sciences)? We mention the Prophet, we mention Ali, and we teach the name of the `Imam al-'Asr`, and the `Da'i` (Summoner) of the time. These four things are necessary. That too is said after four years.
`Wa-kullu wahidin min ha'ula'i al-hudud al-arba'ah wa huwa mansubun li-sanatin ba'da ukhra min al-arba'i sinin` (And each one of these four ranks is attributed to a year, one after the other, from the four years).
So, and every single one of these four `hudud` (ranks), so it is `mansub` (attributed) for one year out of the four years. `Fa-wajaba an la yakuna ittisalu tilka al-lata'ifi illa ba'da wafa'i arba'i sinin` (So it became necessary that the connection of those subtle entities not occur except after the completion of four years).
So it became necessary that the connection of those `lata'if` does not happen except after the completion of four years.
`Wa-tasawwulu mukhaatabaatihi aydan, wa-sammunaha sin al-tarbiyah` (And they imagined his addresses also, and they named them the age of upbringing). `Wa-li-dhalika innama ja'a bi-'ilmi an-nujum huwa nabiyyuna Idris 'alayhi as-salam` (And for that reason, the one who brought the science of the stars was our prophet Idris, peace be upon him).
And for this reason, the `Ahl al-Zahir` (exotericists) do not make a ruling on the age (`sinn`) of the born one (`mawlud`), in his birth, with any ruling, except after the completion of four years. At least four years. After four years have passed, they then say what his age will be. `Wa-sammunaha sinn al-tarbiyah` (And they named it the age of upbringing). They give it the name... the years of upbringing. `Li-anna alladhi ja'a bi-'ilmi an-nujum huwa nabiyyuna Idris 'alayhi as-salam` (Because the one who brought the science of the stars was our prophet Idris, peace be upon him). Because the one who brought the science of the stars was the Prophet Idris, `alayhi as-salam`. `Wa-da'a 'ala hadhihi al-qisa'ah li-hada bi-ma'rifatihi kama dhakarnahu` (And he placed upon this platter for this, with his knowledge, as we have mentioned it).
So he placed it, this story, with his knowledge as we have mentioned. `Wa-kana wad'uhu li-'ilmi an-nujum mu'jizatan ataa biha li-ahli waqtihi li-kawn an-nujum waqtihi` (And his establishing the science of the stars was a miracle he brought for the people of his time because the stars were of his time). The establishing of the science of the stars by you was a miracle which you brought to the people of your era. `Li-annahu kana fi zaman at-taqiyyah was-sitr` (Because he was in a time of precautionary dissimulation and concealment). Because you, in your time, were of `taqiyyah` (precautionary dissimulation) and `sitr` (concealment). `Fa-lamma intaqala al-Imam fi zamanihi 'alayhi as-salam wa-qad kana awsa ilayhi bil-imamah wa-lam yuqbal 'anhu` (So when the Imam in his time, peace be upon him, passed away, and he had willed the Imamate to him, but it was not accepted from him).
When the Imam of his time, peace be upon him, passed away, and he had willed the Imamate to you, but it was not accepted from him. They made you the Imam. `Imam-e-Nus`, the Imam of his time, Prophet Idris, was made the Imam. `Wa-lam yuqbal 'anhu` (But it was not accepted from him). `Fa-qala li-ahli da'wati dhalika al-Imam` (So he said to the people of the `da'wah` of that Imam).
So he said, who? Prophet Idris. He said to the people of the `da'wah`, for the people of `da'wah` of that Imam, " `Hal yakunu fi 'adli Allah Ta'ala an yakhluwa ardahu min hujjatihi?` " (Can it be in the justice of God Almighty that He leaves His earth empty of His proof?).
Can it be in the justice of God that His earth is left empty of His `Hujjah` (proof)? `Fa-qalu: laisa dhalika fi 'adli Allah Ta'ala an yakuna dhalik` (So they said: That is not in the justice of God Almighty, that that should be).
They said that it cannot be in the justice of God that He does this. `Qala: fa-nuridu an na'lama man hujjatu Allah 'alayna al-aan` (He said: So we want to know who is the proof of God upon us now).
You said, so we desire to know who your `Hujjah` is upon us at this time. `Fa-qalu: wa-kayfa as-sabilu ila dhalik?` (So they said: And what is the way to that?).
So they said, what is the way to this? `Wa-wad'a lahum 'ilma an-nujum wa 'allamahum iyyahu` (And he established for them the science of the stars and taught it to them).
So you established the science of the stars for them and taught them that science. `Fa-lamma 'alimu dhalik, qala: iqsimu al-arda arba'atan arba'an` (So when they learned that, he said: Divide the earth into four quarters).
So when they learned that science, you said that divide the earth into four parts, four quarters. `Fa-anzuru fi ayyi al-arba'ah nizratu Allah Ta'ala 'alaykum` (So look, in which of the quarters is the gaze of God Almighty upon you).
So look, in which of the quarters the gaze of Allah is upon you. `Fa-fa'alu dhalik` (So they did that).
So they did that. `Fa-wajaduhu fir-rub'i alladhi hum fihi` (And they found it in the quarter in which they were).
So they found it in that quarter in which they were. `Fa-qala lahum: al-aana khaffafa Allahu 'ankum` (So he said to them: Now Allah has lightened [the burden] for you).
So you said to them, now God has lightened it for you. `Wa-zidu iqsimu hadha ar-rub' alladhi antum fihi arba'an` (And increase, divide this quarter in which you are into four).
And increase it further, divide this quarter, this quarter in which you are, into four parts. `Wa-anzuru fi ayyi hadhihi huwa` (And look in which of these it is).
And look that... the gaze of God, where is it now? In which quarter is he? `Fa-fa'alu dhalik` (So they did that).
So they did it. Then `fa-wajaduhu fir-rub'i alladhi huwa fihi` (and they found it in the quarter in which he was).
So they found it in that quarter where he was. `Fa-qala lahum: zidu iqsimu arba'an` (So he said to them: Increase, divide into four).
So you said to them, increase it further, divide it, divide it into four parts. `Wa-lam yazalu yaf'aluna dhalik hatta afdat al-qismatu ilayhi` (And they did not cease doing that until the division led to him).
And they kept doing it until the division reached you. `Fa-qalu lahu: anta al-aana hujjatullahi fi khalqihi wa shahiduhu 'alayhim` (So they said to him: You are now the proof of God in His creation and His witness upon them).
So they said to you, now you are the `Hujjah` of God in His creation and you are the witness upon them. A story of Mawlana Amir al-Mu'minin is narrated, that a person came, you were in Kufa, on the pulpit, sitting, and he came and said... Mawlana Ali had made a claim that ask me whatever you wish. He came and stood and said, tell me, where is Jibra'il at this moment?
Jibra'il, where is he?
He said, "Let me look at the book of `sunun` (traditions), read from it, and tell you." So you looked here, looked there, looked there, looked there, looked towards the sky, and then said, "You are Jibra'il."
He said, "How did you recognize me as Jibra'il?" He said that I looked towards the earth, towards all directions, behind, ahead, I did not find Jibra'il anywhere. And then I looked towards the sky, I looked in the seven layers of the earth, I did not find Jibra'il. I understood that Jibra'il must be you.
A very good narration about Jibra'il is in it. So he... he shouted and ascended towards the sky.
`Fa-qalu lahu: na'am, nashhadu annaka la-huwa` (So they said to him: Yes, we bear witness that you are indeed he).
Prophet Idris said, "Yes." `Fa-'arafu haqqahu` (So they recognized his right).
So they recognized his right. `Wa-iltazamuhu` (And they adhered to him).
They clung to that person. `Fa-kana wad'uhu salamullahi 'alayhi li-dhalika ka-dhalik` (So his establishing it, peace of God be upon him, for that was like that).
So your establishing that science of `nujum` was in this manner. `Wal-hamdu lillahi alladhi khassa awliya'ahu bi-asrari khilafatihi fi 'ilmi al-Imam` (And praise be to God who specified His friends with the secrets of His vicegerency in the knowledge of the Imam).
And He made them `quwwam` (upholders) of the `ma'arif` (gnostic knowledge) of His `tawhid` (oneness) and `khuzzanan` (treasurers) `li-ghawamidi hikmatihi` (for the depths of His wisdom). And praise be to God who specified His friends with the secrets of His `khalifah` (vicegerent) in the knowledge of the Imam. And He made them strong, `quwwam` (upholders) of the `ma'arif` (gnostic knowledge), `qa'im` (standing), the `quwwam`... meaning `qiyam` (standing)... `quwwam` means one who makes `qiyam` a lot. From the `ma'arif` (gnostic knowledge) of His `tawhid` (oneness), and `khuzzanan`. `Khuzzanan` is the plural of what? `Khazin`. The plural of `khazin` is `khuzzanan`. And the plural of `qa'im` is `quwwam`. `Quwwam`, `khuzzanan`, `li-ghawamidi hikmatihi` (for the depths of His wisdom).
His wisdom...
`Khazin`. What do they call a `khazin`? Cashier. One who keeps the treasury, who collects. `Khazin`... so `khuzzanan li-ghawamidi hikmatihi` (treasurers for the depths of His wisdom).
So the sciences of the Imams, the sciences of `nujum` (astrology), for example, as you said, that in `sitr` (concealment), it's only about mathematics or numbers, the sciences which are there...
These sciences of the Imams are different. They have symbols (`rumuz`) and indications (`isharat`). They are understood through symbols and indications. They appoint symbols and indications, and they understand through them. And many symbols and indications, Sayyidna Dawud, Sayyidna Musa, Sayyidna Sulayman, their conversations... in it, some things have been written. And there are symbols and indications. The one saying it, writing it, understands, and the one in front understands. Others don't understand.
Like we derive everything from "La ilaha illa Allah" through numbers. The numbers are then...
The sciences of `sitr`...
So every thing is related to numbers.
Allah has related it. He created numbers and put the arrangement of everything in numbers.
So then to call this the sciences of `sitr` is somewhat...
What are the sciences of `sitr`? The sciences were from the time of `Baqiyyat-us-suwakh`. In `sitr`, the sciences which, in `kashf` (unveiling), the sciences were manifest. In `sitr`, they have been explained in a hidden (`makhfi`) way. Okay.

Otherwise, it would go somewhere else if you count it like this, 3,000 years, then there would be a big difference." The 3,000-year era of priesthood and astrology was also there. The era of sorcery. The era of priesthood and astrology was at its peak. In it. In the *Daur al-Fitrah*. The *Daur al-Fitrah*. Yes, the 3,000-year *Daur al-Fitrah*. In the era of Sayyidna Adam... no... In the era of Adam, he began the *Daur as-Satr*. After the *Daur al-Fitrah*. Adam *alayhis salam* is the one who began the *Daur as-Satr*. The one who began the *Daur as-Satr* is Sayyidna Adam *alayhis salat was-salam*. In the *Daur al-Fitrah* there was no prophet? In the *Daur al-Fitrah*, there were prophets. In it, the two kinds of thoughts of the people... in the *Daur al-Kashf*, which is 47,000 years... in it, only those who believe in the sciences of realities. Two factions were formed. After 47,000 years were completed, in the last 3,000 years, two types of people emerged. One were the bearers of the previous thoughts of the *Daur al-Kashf*, and the second thought was this science of priesthood and apparent sciences, which was developing. They gave it precedence. As their intentions were, so was their action. Two things happened there. In the era of... those who manifested, the one who gathered them, the gatherer of the *Daur al-Kashf* was Imam Hunaid *alayhis salat was-salam*. And the *Daur as-Satr* is this. Sayyidna Adam. The people of the apparent sciences were the ones who went forward in the *Daur as-Satr*? Yes. The last people of the *Daur al-Kashf* were the ones who went forward in the *Daur as-Satr*. Sayyidna Nasrullah sahib al-muqaddas, with Sayyidna Abdullah Hamid sahib, was asking Sayyidna sahib in the car. "Then the *Qaim* of *Kashf*, where is his station?" Imam Hunaid *alayhis salat was-salam*, when the 3,000 years of the *Daur al-Kashf*, whose bearers were of the realities and forms, then the *Qaim* of the *Daur al-Kashf*'s station was asked. So Sayyidna sahib later said that he became the *Hijab-e-A'la* (Highest Veil). In this way, you take out the books and see. He is the *Hijab-e-A'la*. The *Qaim* of the *Daur al-Kashf*... who is the *Qaim* of the *Daur al-Kashf*? The *Qaim* of the 50,000 years. One has to do research on the *Qaim* of some other... The *nutaqa'* also have... a gathering takes place. A big gathering takes place. So their method is also the same as with the Imams, where *haykal* are formed? No. With the Imams, the *haykal* is a different thing. That thing is different. With the *nutaqa'*, there is a gathering of forms in their assembly. The *haykal* is not formed. When do we say *haykal*? When it comes to the *Babul Abwab*. That is called a *haykal*. All the forms. With the *nutaqa'*, the people of their eras gather. There, the form of the *haykal* is not there. It is a gathering. The term *haykal* has been specifically used for where... The human form. The form of *alif*. When is the form of *alif* established? When all of them gather at the *Babul Abwab*. Otherwise, this is a part. Like a big mirror, if you break it into pieces, then every small piece will be a mirror. Its form can be seen in it. But the original mirror, in which the complete human form is seen, that is only said to be at the *Babul Abwab*. The *haykal* is described there. With the *nutaqa'*... no. The *nutaqa'* who are mentioned are not masters of *Lahut* and *Nasut*. But... the divine speech (*nutq-e-ilahi*)... they are bearers of the divine speech. The rank of divine speech. There, it is above the imamate. The word imamate doesn't come there. You see, there are ranks. What are they? There are ten ranks, how do they go? First, what? *Mustajib*. In the *'Ahd-e-Sharif*.
