Then? *Momin*. Then? *Ma'dhun*. No, *mukasir*. *Ma'dhun*. *Mukasir*. *Ma'dhun*. First *mukasir*, then *ma'dhun*. Then? *Da'i*. Then *da'i*. *Hujjat*. *Bab*. Then *Bab*. The eighth rank is Imam *alayhis salat was-salam*. Ten ranks? The eighth rank. The Imam's rank, what is it? That is... the rank of imamate is described in terms of *Nasut-e-tabi'i*. After that, the Imam who becomes the master of the *haykal*, *Nasut-e-tabi'i* becomes the master of the *haykal*. When the Imam receives the imamate... He has stated, the Imam means the one with *Nasut-e-tabi'i* has attained the *haykal* through the *Babul Abwab*. The Imam has received the imamate. Now this rank is finished. Now his other ranks begin. What are the other ranks after imamate? *Wasayat*. Above that is the divine speech. The ranks are very high. The divine speech... when the imamate has the *haykal*, then the divine speech must have a station. The gatherings of Imams have divine speech. Who are the bearers of the divine speech? One is Sayyidna Ibrahim, Imam Hunaid... Imam Hunaid *alayhis salat was-salam*. Sayyidna Ibrahim *alayhis salat was-salam*, and? Sayyidna Hashim. The three Ha's. Sayyidna Hashim. Hunaid, Ibrahim, and Hashim. Three Ha's. The Prophet *alayhis salam*. And after that, the Prophet *alayhis salat was-salam* in the second rank. So that *Natiq*... one must differentiate between divine speech and *Natiq*. There is a *Natiq*, and there is a divine *Natiq*. There is a difference between the two. Because he has gathered... because with Sayyidna Ibrahim were gathered the forms of the two eras. And he is a luminous *haykal*, based on the saying that has preceded it, above all stations. *Fa-Adam yaqumu maqamat-tanzil*. So Adam *alayhis salam* will stand in the station of revelation (*tanzil*). *Wa Nuh yaqumu muqabilat-ta'wil*. And Nuh will stand opposite the interpretation (*ta'wil*). For the sake of *ta'wil*. Opposite *ta'wil*. *Wa Ibrahim muqabilul-haqa'iq*. Ibrahim will be opposite the realities. *Wa li-dhalika qala fihil-kitabul-karim, wa Ibrahimalladhi waffa*. (And for this reason, the Noble Book said concerning him, "And of Ibrahim who fulfilled"). And for this reason, the Noble Book has said, "And Ibrahim is the one who fulfilled." Meaning, you attained all three ranks. Of revelation, of interpretation. *Ishratan ila hadhihith-thalathir-rutab*. (Pointing towards these three ranks). Pointing towards these three ranks. *Allati huwa hiya*. (Which he is). Such ranks... such that he is the possessor of those ranks. *Wa huwa maqamun karim*. And Sayyidna Ibrahim has a noble station. *Zul-haykalin-nuraniyyil-'azim*. Possessor of the grand, luminous *haykal*. *Wa huwa waladul-imamissabiqi 'alayh*. And he is the son of the preceding Imam. Salih. Ibrahim is the son of Salih. *Wa huwa waladul-imamissabiqi 'alayh al-mujidu al-mushiru ilayh*. Such that he is the one who brought you into being and the one who pointed towards you. *Fa-jtama'at 'indahun-nubuwwah war-risalah wal-wasayah wal-imamah*. So there were gathered with Sayyidna Ibrahim prophethood, messengership, successorship, and imamate. *Nafse Kulli*. What is *haykal*? *Nafse Kulli*. Yes, *Nafse Kulli*. Look, Allah Most High created... this is the subject of *Mabda' wa Ma'ad*... the beginning of the subject is very special. He is the Creator. From non-existence, He brought into existence. What did He create? Forms. No, *uqul* (intellects). *Ashbah nuraniyah* (luminous specters). *Zawat* (essences). Where the word used is *zawat*. *Zawat*. *Ashbah nuraniyah*. The word *nafs* is not used. *Zawat*. *Uqul*. Intellect. These things were created. Now after that, what did He do? He bestowed three things upon them. What things? First of all, life (*hayat*). He gave life. Existence. Existence. Life. After that, what powers are in life, the knowledge (*ilm*) of that. Knowledge. Existence, then knowledge. What powers are in life. Then, free will (*ikhtiyar*). The power of choice. Whether you use those powers or not. He has explained this in great detail. What? Life, existence. Knowledge. And this. No one can take these three things away. This is a gift from God. Neither the Creator takes it, nor can anyone else take it. It is present in every human being. One thing is that they may be dormant for a while, not manifest, that is a different matter. But these three things are within every person. Free will. Freedom. Whether he uses it or not. Now after that, some intellects used it. When they used it, they ascended. They left. Some intellects delayed... in using their free will. They did not use their free will. Who was the one who delayed? The tenth (*'ashir*). Corrupt imagination (*wahm-e-fasid*) arose in him. He delayed. By delaying, what happened? He changed into the form of a *nafs* (soul). From intellect to soul. "*Ya ayyatuhan-nafsul-mutma'innah... irji'i*." (O tranquil soul... return.) He changed from intellect into the form of a *nafs*. A descent. A descent. A descent. He descended from one to another. In the realm of creation (*'alam-e-ibda'*), that thing was not attained by any other. They all did not take on the form of a *nafs*. The word *nufus* is not even used for them. Where did the word *nafs* come from? From the *'ashir*. Because after the delay, after the corrupt imagination, he left the form of an intellect. When he left the form of a *nafs* and entered the intellect, then he became the *'Aql-e-Kulli* (Universal Intellect). The luminous intellect. He entered the realm. And he attained perfection. What do they call it? He attained his own perfection. In which there is no flaw. After this, there is no descent, no falling. This is finished. Now after that, there are many forms of the *nafs*. Someone did it late, someone did it very late, someone did it very, very late. According to that, the forms of the *nafs* were created. One of them is *Nafse Kulli*. The *Nafse Kulli* is the *'ashir*. *Nafse Mutma'innah* (tranquil soul), *Nafse Kulli*. As soon as he realized his mistake, he immediately changed. *Nafse Kulli*. *Nafse Mutma'innah*. Similarly, the souls of the Imams are also called *Nufuse Kulli*. Because they, as soon as, in that realm... when the *'ashir*'s call was made... when the *'ashir*'s call was made in that realm, and with the *'ashir* were his deputies, their call was made, the call of the two, the call of the *qawaim* was made, they immediately accepted it. And there, in the realm of life, a station was established for them. Where? In the realm of life, a station was established. So they are called *Nafse Kulli*. *Nafse Kulli*. Now... the ones with whom... as Sayyidna has explained... from that I understood that now, from the *Nafse Kulli*, there is one soul, the *Nafse Hissiyah* (sensory soul). In that realm, it... it is not there, meaning... there are no dimensions there. In which realm? In the realm of life, there are no dimensions. Where are the dimensions? After that, the dimensions come. Here, the *Nafse Hissiyah* is born. How is the *Nafse Hissiyah* born? From the sun. The *Nafse Hissiyah* is born from the sun. Those who are under the sun, for them the term *Nafse Hissiyah* is applied. It is explained. The center of the *Nafse Hissiyah* is the sun. And the center of the *Nafse Kulli* is what? The realm of life. Or this... Siri'an has asked. The moon. Yes. *Nafse Namiyah*'s is the moon. The *Nafse Hissiyah*'s is the sun. When was the sun created? The sun came into dimensions. It came into dimensions. The realm of life is not in dimensions. So where is the *Nafse Kulli*? It is all in the realm of life. It encompasses. The *Nafse Kulli* is in the realm of life. Its flow is here. The effect... the effects are here. The *Nufuse Kulli* are all in the realm of life. And here, what are they? *Nufuse Hissiyah*. And below the moon are *Nufuse Namiyah*. When the *nafs* changes its form even more, and there is more descent, more falling, then what happens? The body (*jism*) is born. And what was the body? It was a *nafs*. And what was the *nafs*? It was an intellect. It went a long way. Now, in the body... what is in the body? Your heart is also a physical body. And your feet are also physical. Your urinary and excretory tracts are also physical. That is also a part of it. But what a big difference there is in it. What a big difference. On one side is the heart, on the other is the liver, on the other is this, on the other is that. What a big difference. In one body, all things are present. Similarly, there is a difference between *Nufuse Hissiyah* and *Nufuse Kulli*. The *Nufuse Kulli* are there. *Nafse Natiqa* also came from the *'ashir*. *Nafse Natiqa*... *Nafse Natiqa* is what it is called... the spiritual form. The essence (*zat*) you were given, that essence acquired knowledge and action. That is called the *Nafse Natiqa*. The *Nafse Natiqa* is received. The one soul that... the *Nafse Natiqa*, in this sense, is that the form of knowledge and action... who made the form? Your essence made it. And whose creation is the essence? Allah's. And whose creation is the form? Yours. So you will say, "The thing made by us has surpassed the thing given by Allah." You... Allah gave you free will for this very reason, that you should create with your own effort. The thing you create with your own effort will be the real thing for you. Who gave this? Who gave the free will? Who gave the knowledge and action? Allah gave it. The Creator gave it. This... all... in the body too, there are lakhs of things in the body. But the human body, then the animal, then those that do not have vegetative growth (*nafs-e-numu*), then what kind of bodies are there... it's an ocean. So, from the order you have explained, one can infer that a non-believer (*ghair-e-momin*) is a fallen form of a believer's body. A non-believer is a fallen physical form of a believer. The one who did not attain the *Nafse Natiqa*. They have a soul, but not a *Nafse Natiqa*. The meaning of *Nafse Natiqa* is that the form of knowledge and action which is established through the *'Ahd-e-Sharif*... whose starting point is the *'Ahd-e-Sharif*, that form is not present in him. He is a non-believer. So what is the essence? Is it intellect, soul, or body? It's all intellect. The soul and body are just changed forms of the intellect. The return journey is... just as they fell... in sequence they fell... The intellect came into being... in the same sequence they have to ascend. Just as... the body came later, so first the body will go, then after that the soul will go, then after that... The one who... the one who obtained it first, who went first... the hero is the one who left first. He left. The one who made the arrangement first. There is a difference of precedence and succession, that's all. The one who made the arrangement first, he left. He left this realm. After that, the others remained. The *khameer-e-nizamat*... at the time of the *'Ahd-e-Sharif*, one receives the *Nafse Natiqa*. So that is our form, which... yes, it is. The *khameer-e-nizamat*... yes. The *khameer-e-nizamat* you performed before, that *khameer-e-nizamat* is obtained by you at that time. At that time, at the time of the *'Ahd-e-Sharif*, it is obtained. The body of yours which appeared a thousand years ago, it planted a seed at that time. The one who was before has gone, has left. He planted a seed. You are now obtaining that seed. This has been explained. Bismillah al-Rahman al-Rahim. Allahumma salli ala Sayyidina Muhammad.

<!-- lecture 29 -->

This is today's lesson. Bismillah al-Rahman al-Rahim. Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin wa 'ala aali Sayyidina Muhammadin wa barik wa sallim (O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, and grant them blessings and peace). Al-fasl al-thalith min al-bab al-awwal min al-suradiq al-thalith (The third chapter of the first section of the third pavilion). Fa-lamma ijtama'at al-arba' al-rutab fi Ibrahim, wa kana 'ala al-halat al-madhkurah min al-fadl wa al-sharaf, aqama da'watahu ila an istakhraja minha waladahu Isma'il 'alayhim al-salam. Isma'il 'alayhis salam. Wa qad kana wulida lahu Ishaq qabla mawlid Isma'il 'alayhim al-salam, 'alayhima al-salam (And when the four ranks were gathered in Ibrahim, and he was in the aforementioned state of virtue and honor, he established his mission until he brought forth from it his son, Isma'il, peace be upon them. Isma'il, peace be upon him. And Ishaq had been born to him before the birth of Isma'il, peace be upon them, peace be upon them both).

It was first stated that Janab Adam ('alayhissalatu wassalam) was a Natiq of his era. Nuh was a Natiq of his era. When Janab Ibrahim came, what did he do? He gathered Janab Adam's era and he gathered Janab Nuh's era. To call for food...

And Janab Ibrahim gathered both eras. Two thousand... He gathered the era of Janab Adam and the era of Janab Nuh. And four ranks were gathered in you. Which ones? Nabuwwah, Risalah, Wisayah, and Imamah. What does it mean to gather the eras? See, in the time of Janab Nuh, Janab Adam ('alayhissalatu wassalam), as many individuals who were gathered, who had entered the haykal of the Natiq, who had entered the haykal of the Natiq, he gathered all of them.

There are two Ibrahims. Two Ibrahims. One Ibrahim is the Natiq, alladhi waffa (who fulfilled [his covenants]). And another Ibrahim is one about whom it is said, "kana... rajulun yuqalu lahu Ibrahim" (a man called Ibrahim), it has come in the Kalam-e-Pak. Kana rajulun yuqalu lahu Ibrahim (There was a man called Ibrahim). There was a man whose name was Ibrahim. He was a Nabi. The Nabi of your time. So, upon Janab Ibrahim ('alayhissalatu wassalam), the four ranks were gathered. All the suwar of Adam's era and all the suwar of Janab Nuh's era were all gathered by him. And he was called Ibrahim alladhi waffa (Ibrahim who fulfilled [his covenants]). And where there are khilafats, the khilafats which have been further mentioned, the world of khilafats, within that, Janab Ibrahim has a special rank. Thalathaha (three of them). Who are the thalathaha? Maulana Hashim, Maulana Hunayn, Maulana Ibrahim. Janab Ibrahim, Hashim. This is a special khilafah. In the khilafats of the Qa'im ('alayhissalatu wassalam), they have a special rank. Who is the wazir of the Qa'im ('alayhissalatu wassalam)? 'Ayn 'Azim. 'Ayn 'Azim. 'Ayn 'Azim. And the ones who take the khilafah of 'Ayn 'Azimah, who are they? Mim. Janab 'Abd al-Muttalib. Janab 'Abd al-Muttalib. Then Janab Abu Talib. Then Janab... Mim. 'Abdullah. Then there are two qiran (conjunctions/peers). And after that, there is Janab Mim. Jadd al-Qa'im. Jadd al-Qa'im and Jadd... are qiran in the khilafats. They are qiran in the khilafats. And after that, what? Janab Fatimah's... after that is Janab Fatimah. They are his khalifah. Whose khalifah? Of Mim. Now after that... it is not detailed. All the mutimmin have a special rank. Mutimmin. Dawr-e-Muhammadi. Of the dawr of Muhammad ('alayhissalatu wassalam), the mutimmin. And the seventh, every seventh. Every seventh. Who are the sevenths? Janab Maulana Muhammad bin Isma'il. Then after him, Janab Ma'add al-Mu'izz. And Imam al-Tayyib ('alayhissalatu wassalam). Then the 28th, Maulana Ma'add. Maulana Ma'add ibn Husayn. Then 21st... no, 22nd Maulana Ahmad. And then... 42nd Maulana 'Ali. And the 49th is Abu al-Qa'im ('alayhissalatu wassalam). The rank of these seven is very high. But Hazrat Nasrullah Sahib quddisa sirruhu used to say that the rank of these seven is high, but the rank of the atimmah of the dawr of the Prophet ('alayhissalatu wassalam) became so high that a qiran occurred in comparison to the sevenths. A qiran was produced. Whose rank? The atimmah of the dawr of the Prophet ('alayhissalatu wassalam). The people of the first haftah (week) are of a very high rank. With them, with the seventh, a qiran was produced. Meaning both became equal. Sometimes they would take the khilafah, sometimes they would take the khilafah. A qiran was produced. And among the atimmah, the highest rank is that of Maulana Muhammad bin Isma'il. With whom a personality like Imam Husayn is gathered, what can be said of him? The rank of Maulana Muhammad bin Isma'il ('alayhissalatu wassalam) is very high. And that is why they do not fall into the category of taman sinf. His rank is established in the kashf, in the dawr-e-kashf. A very high rank. So now, what is said about these four? Qul huwa Allahu ahad, Allahu s-samad, lam yalid wa lam yulad (Say: He is Allah, the One. Allah, the Eternal Refuge. He neither begets nor is born). He says that among these seven, four are greater. Who are they? Maulana Muhammad bin Isma'il, Imam al-Tayyib. Imam al-Tayyib. Then Maulana Ahmad, then Abu al-Qa'im. Four. These four. They are the greatest. They gathered two ranks each. Maulana Muhammad bin Isma'il gathered only one rank. Maulana Imam al-Tayyib gathered two ranks. Maulana Ahmad gathered two ranks. And the upcoming Abu al-Qa'im will also gather two ranks. But even among them, the rank of Maulana Muhammad bin Isma'il is a special rank. That rank is that of sahib-e-dawr-e-kashf (the master of the era of unveiling). The rank of the dawr-e-kashf is manifest in him. And in what respect is this said? Of the Du'at... He has nutq-e-ilahi and then he has the station of the seventh. Yes? It is Abu 'Ali in the name. Sayyidna Sahib, in the response to my poems, the poems he wrote, in them is Maulana Abi 'Ali. Abi 'Ali is how he has described it. At that time, I also understood Abi 'Ali in that respect. Since Abu 'Ali has become manifest, now his writing is Abu 'Ali. Here, Nabuwwah, Risalah... Yes? The name of our Qa'im is 'Ali. 'Ali. With respect to his name, he said Abu 'Ali. ...mentioned Imamah. In most books, Nabuwwah, Risalah, Imamah and Wisayah are stated. But since the author of Anwar... Anwar is a foundational book. Most Du'at take proofs from it. They have brought Wisayah first and Imamah later. So, what is the nature of the rank? Is Wisayah first or... Wisayah is higher. Wisayah is higher.

So when the four ranks were gathered in Ibrahim, and in that mentioned state, he was of virtue and honor, he established his da'wah until he brought forth from it his son, Isma'il... peace be upon them both, Ibrahim and Isma'il. And it was that his son Ishaq had already been born to him, before this... before Maulana Isma'il. Here... The birth of Ishaq was earlier. Here... Isma'il... The printed book, what does it have? In the printed book, it's the same. Isma'il's birth was earlier. In the Sirah, Maulana Isma'il is earlier. Here, Ishaq is mentioned first. Isma'il is mentioned first. Then Ishaq is mentioned.

So Maulana Isma'il established ('alayhis salam) as Wasi. So he established Maulana Isma'il as a Wasi. And he entrusted to him the rank of Wisayah. And Imamah. By the command of Allah Ta'ala. The rank of Wisayah and Imamah. By the command of Allah Ta'ala. Because he is a maqam ilahi (divine station) and a haykal nurani (luminous temple). Because Maulana Ibrahim is a maqam ilahi and a haykal nurani. And he entrusted to his son Ishaq the rank of Nabuwwah and Risalah. And he made him a khadim (servant) before his brother Isma'il ('alayhim jami' al-salam). And he made Janab Ishaq a khadim in the service of his brother Maulana Isma'il ('alayhis salam). Peace be upon them both, all... all... peace be upon them all. And a hijab (veil) upon him. And he made Janab Ishaq a hijab over Janab Isma'il. And a da'i (summoner) to him. And a caller to him. And he enjoined him... And Maulana Ibrahim enjoined Janab Ishaq to enjoin his son to know the station of Isma'il, and all his progeny. And that the preceding one should enjoin the succeeding one until the time of the rising of their Qa'im. And Ibrahim passed away to the abode of Allah's generosity. And his son Isma'il stood after him, as a Wasi in his station, mustatiran (concealed). And Ishaq stood as his zahir (manifest) hujjah (proof) and a hijab, until the passing of Isma'il drew near. And he entrusted to his son Qaydar the Imamah and the Wisayah. Janab Isma'il entrusted to his son Qaydar the Imamah and the Wisayah. He has written Imamah and Wisayah. On this side it is... Wisayah and... And it continued in succession in the progeny of Qaydar from father to son, as we will clarify, in sha Allahu ta'ala (if God wills). And Ishaq entrusted to his son Ya'qub his rank. And this rank continued to be transferred among them... And Ishaq entrusted to his son Ya'qub his rank. And this rank, which is the rank of the Du'at, continued to be transferred among them until the Qa'im of the progeny of Isma'il received it, as we will clarify, in sha Allahu ta'ala (if God wills). But he didn't mention Lut. Yes. He didn't mention Hazrat Lut. Because Isma'il ('alayhissalatu wassalam) and his progeny ('alayhimussalam) are maqamat ilahiyyah (divine stations), dhu hayakil nuraniyyah (possessors of luminous temples), because they are ahl al-istiqrar (the people of permanence). And Ishaq and his progeny ('alayhimussalam) are hujaj (proofs) and du'at zahirun (manifest summoners). Manifest for Isma'il and his progeny ('alayhimussalam). Manifest... by way of Isma'il and his progeny. Peace be upon them all. And hujubun 'alayhim (veils upon them), manifest according to what the confrontations necessitated, and what the times and periods decreed. So the first of the Du'at and hujub (veils) was Ishaq, and after him Ya'qub, and after him Yusuf. And he entrusted it to Lawa, and Lawa entrusted it to his son Yahuda ibn Lawa. And he entrusted it to Ayyub ibn 'Amus, and he entrusted it to Zariq, and he entrusted it to Yunus ibn Ayyub. And he entrusted it to Shu'ayb ibn Safwan, and he entrusted it to Musa ibn 'Imran, and he entrusted it to Harun, and he entrusted it to Yusha' ibn Nun, and he entrusted it to Finhas ibn Harun, and he entrusted it to Ilyas, and he entrusted it to al-Yasa' ibn Akhtub, and he entrusted it to Shamwil ibn Hali, and he entrusted it to Dawud ibn 'Asa, and he entrusted it to Sulayman... Sulayman has also been written. And he entrusted it to Ash'iya ibn Anzaya, and he entrusted it to 'Uzayr ibn Subaya, and he entrusted it to Zakariyya, and he entrusted it to his son Yahya, and he entrusted it to Zinayal, and he entrusted it to Janab 'Isa ('alayhis salam). And he entrusted it to Sham'un, and he entrusted it to 'Abd al-Masih, and he entrusted it to Marwat al-Rahib, and he entrusted it to Sarjis, and he entrusted it to Bahira al-Rahib... And he entrusted it to Sarjis, who is Bahira al-Rahib. And these are ahl al-istida' (the people of entrustment). And these are the ones who are ahl al-istida', who are the Du'at and the hujaj, and they are from various lineages and relationships, but all of them are related back to Ishaq ('alayhimussalam). But all of them trace their lineage to Ishaq ('alayhimussalam). Peace be upon them all. Because every mustawda' is traced back to Ishaq.

Al-fasl al-rabi' (The fourth chapter)... In the era of 'Isa... in the era of 'Isa, and then the Nabuwwah of the Prophet is with you. The Nabi's Nabuwwah is also with you. Before that, Nabuwwah was with them. In the era of 'Isa, it had come. Bahira the monk. In the era of 'Isa. Then the Nabi's rank also... then again after the Prophet, Muhammad al-Mustafa sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam's rank... It was submerged. It became submerged. Within the Prophet ('alayhissalatu wassalam), it became submerged. Bahira the monk... No, Bahira the monk... there's an Imam... a rank of Nabuwwah... "wa sallama 'ala Marwat al-Rahib" (and he entrusted it to Marwat the monk). He entrusted it to Marwat al-Rahib. And he to Sarjis... Bahira al-Rahib. Marwat al-Rahib entrusted it to Bahira. Nabuwwah... When the Prophet was manifested... a rank of Nabuwwah then... Ubayy ibn Ka'b took it. Ubayy ibn Ka'b.

Al-fasl al-rabi' min al-bab al-awwal. The Prophet ('alayhissalatu wassalam) was manifested from Janab 'Abd al-Muttalib, who was the bearer of the ranks of Imamah and Wisayah. He was manifested from them. And this Bahira the monk, from Janab 'Isa, the chain continued. The Prophet ('alayhissalatu wassalam) has a great distinction. The distinction is that there, two... Janab Hashim ('alayhissalatu wassalam)... Hasham al-sarid (He who crumbled bread [for the poor]). He gathered the ranks. And he gave it to Janab 'Abd al-Muttalib. The rank that he gave to Janab 'Abd al-Muttalib, he gave it completely. The four ranks he bestowed. Janab 'Abd al-Muttalib, what did he do? He divided it into two sections. One part he gave to Janab 'Abdullah, the second part he gave to Janab Abu Talib. Janab 'Abdullah got Nabuwwah, Risalah, Imamah, and Wisayah. When Janab 'Abdullah passed away, all those ranks were gathered in Janab Abu Talib. The four ranks were gathered in you. When the four ranks were gathered, you also divided those ranks in this way: you gave the part of Nabuwwah and Risalah to Janab the Prophet ('alayhissalatu wassalam), and you gave Imamah and Wisayah to Janab 'Ali. Since they were small, all the ranks of Imamah and Wisayah were also gathered in the Prophet. Kafalat-e-'uzma (the great guardianship). The blessing of the great guardianship was obtained. The effect of that great guardianship was so much, it was so powerful that all the mustawda'in who were there, even the mustaqarrin who were with 'Ali, all were overshadowed by him. Because that point at which Hashim's da'wah was accepted, when Janab the Prophet ('alayhissalatu wassalam)... it is mentioned that when the da'wah of 'Ayn occurred, the very first to affirm it were Mim. And it has been specially mentioned, in a dramatic style, how Mim showed khuzu' and khushu' (humility and submissiveness) at that time.

These Ambiya and Rusul, their chain is towards Ishaq, right? Here it says "hadhihi al-rutbah allati hiya rutbat al-du'at ila an tasallamaha qa'im walad Isma'il" (this rank, which is the rank of the Du'at, until the Qa'im of the progeny of Isma'il received it). The Qa'im of the progeny of Isma'il is Janab 'Ali. And the Qa'im of the progeny of Ishaq is Janab Nabi. But it happened with the Nabi, their [succession], not with... But when the Nabi is gathered with 'Ayn 'Azima, then he will gather them.

Al-fasl al-rabi' min al-bab al-awwal min al-suradiq al-thalith (The fourth chapter of the first section of the third pavilion). And the first of the A'immah, who are the maqamat ilahiyyah after Ibrahim ('alayhis salam), was Isma'il ibn Ibrahim. And Janab Ibrahim entrusted it to his son Qaydar, and he entrusted it to his son Nabat, and he entrusted it to his son... Sa'i. Hazrat Zainuddin Sahib quddisa sirruhu has made a chart, it is kept here. No, I can't see it. He must have taken it to Bombay, maybe. Is it in Bombay? He has a complete chart made. From the time of Janab Adam. He entrusted it to his son Ma'dhar, and he entrusted it to his son Mahshar, and he entrusted it to his son Kumayr, and he entrusted it to his son Nazal, and he entrusted it to his son Hizan, and he entrusted it to his son Dariz, and he entrusted it to his son 'Amamah, and he entrusted it to his son Badwan, and he entrusted it to his son Ra'ib, and he entrusted it to his son Mahmud, and he entrusted it to his son al-Dada', and he entrusted it to his son 'Akhut, and it is said he is 'Unuq. And he entrusted it to his son Qaswar, and he entrusted it to his son Tamah, and it is said he is Tabikh. And he entrusted it to his son Mat'am, and he entrusted it to his son Isma'il dhi al-'Awaj, and he entrusted it to his son Barat, and he entrusted it to his son Isma'il dhi al-Mutabi'... Mutabi'. Ya has come. Mutani' is here. Mutani' is also here. And he entrusted it to his son Ibrahim, who is Jami' al-Shaml (gatherer of the assembly). This Ibrahim is different. This is another Ibrahim. An Ibrahim has also come among the A'immah. Jami' al-Shaml. And he entrusted it to his son 'Antar, and he entrusted it to his son Zurayb, and he entrusted it to his son Shahdud, and he entrusted it to his son Muhsin, and he entrusted it to his son 'Illah, and he entrusted it to his son 'Aqba, and he entrusted it to his son Ra'imah, until he entrusted it to his son Muhtamil, and it is said he is Mutahalhil. And he entrusted it to his son 'Awwam, and he entrusted it to his son Mahlam, and he entrusted it to his son Shahib, and he entrusted it to his son Amin, and he entrusted it to his son 'Udad. And he, 'Udad, entrusted it to 'Udad. 'Udad bin 'Udad is famous. Who is his mutimm? Janab Musa. Janab Musa ('alayhis salam). The muqim is Janab Musa ('alayhis salam). 'Udad bin 'Udad. Between Ibrahim and Musa, there are so many A'immah.

And he entrusted it to his son 'Udad... 'Udad. And the time became binding for the manifestation of the Natiq. And the time made it binding that the Natiq should manifest. So he, Janab 'Udad, established from among his Du'at a Natiq. And that is Musa ('alayhis salam). And he is Musa ('alayhis salam). Then he entrusted it to his son 'Adnan. Then Janab 'Udad entrusted it to his son 'Adnan. And he entrusted it... his son 'Adnan to Ma'add. And Ma'add entrusted it to his son Nizar. And Nizar entrusted it to Mudar. And Mudar entrusted it to his son Ilyas. And Ilyas to his son Mudrikah. And Mudrikah to his son Khuzaymah. And the time became binding for the manifestation of a Natiq. And the time made it binding that a Natiq should manifest. So he commanded his da'i to establish 'Isa ('alayhis salam). So he commanded his da'i for the establishment of 'Isa ('alayhis salam)... for the manifestation of 'Isa. The muqim of Janab Adam is Maulana Hunayn. The muqim of Janab Nuh is Maulana Hud ('alayhissalatu wassalam). And from Hud, the lineage runs... "Min Hud Muhammadun fa-ida 'allaahu khusurahu" (From Hud is Muhammad, so when Allah singled him out...). From Janab Hud. And after that... Janab Ibrahim ('alayhissalatu wassalam)'s is Maulana Salih. And Janab Musa ('alayhis salam)'s is Janab 'Udad bin 'Udad. Janab 'Isa ('alayhis salam)'s is Janab Khuzaymah. It's from the Nabi. Hud the Nabi. Hud the Nabi. They are A'immah.

Then Khuzaymah entrusted it to his son Kinanah. And he, Kinanah, entrusted it to his son Nadr. And Nadr entrusted it to his son Malik. And Malik entrusted it to his son Fihr. And Fihr entrusted it to his son Ghalib. And Ghalib entrusted it to his son Lu'ayy. And Lu'ayy entrusted it to his son Ka'b. And he entrusted it to his son Murrah. And Murrah entrusted it to his son Kilab. And Kilab entrusted it to his son Qusayy. And Qusayy entrusted it to his son 'Abd Manaf. And 'Abd Manaf entrusted it to his son Hashim. And he entrusted it to his son 'Abd al-Muttalib. And he entrusted it... Janab Hashim entrusted it to his son Maulana 'Abd al-Muttalib. And the four ranks were gathered with him. And the four ranks were gathered with you, which had been gathered with his grandfather Ibrahim ('alayhis salam). And they are Wisayah, Imamah, Nabuwwah, and Risalah. The ranks below are of the maqamat ilahi, their matter is different. This is clarifying the khilafats, the nutq-e-ilahi.

Al-fasl al-khamis min al-bab al-awwal min al-suradiq... Here it has been stated that for all the Imams of the dawr-e-kashf, the Qa'im who will manifest after a thousand years... Every thousand years... on the seventh... the seventh one... He is equal to one Imam. The one who manifests every thousand years, and then after seven thousand years one manifests, who gathers the thousand. The Qa'im, the Imam who manifests after seven thousand years, that Qa'im and these thalathaha sukra... they are qiran. Meaning the ranks of the dawr-e-sidq are very high. That happens at that time... that happens at that time when the Qa'im ('alayhissalatu wassalam), the upcoming Qa'im of the dawr, will also gather the dawr-e-kashf. The rank of tasbih. This Qa'im... What is the order of the first Qa'im? 'Asr-e-tasbih (The era of glorification). This Qa'im who will manifest, first he will be the one to gather the dawr-e-sidq. He will gather his dawr-e-sidq. Then he will also gather the dawr-e-kashf. When he gathers the dawr-e-kashf... along with the dawr-e-kashf... the seventh... the dawr-e-kashf that was before... when he gathers it, at that time the gathering that will take place in your haykal, that gathering has been mentioned. That at that time, two... will be peers. For seven thousand years... the Qa'im. And it is stated in the khilafats... Wa lamma ijtama'at hadhihi al-rutub al-arba' 'inda 'Abd al-Muttalib, kanat al-shintan minhunna mudkharatayn li-qa'im walad Isma'il, wa huma al-wisayah wa al-imamah. Wa al-shintan li-qa'im walad Ishaq, wa huma al-nabuwwah wa al-risalah (And when these four ranks were gathered with 'Abd al-Muttalib, two portions of them were reserved for the Qa'im of the progeny of Isma'il, and they are the Wisayah and the Imamah. And two portions were for the Qa'im of the progeny of Ishaq, and they are the Nabuwwah and the Risalah). And when these four ranks were gathered with Maulana 'Abd al-Muttalib, two of them were mudkharatayn... joined... for the Qa'im of the progeny of Isma'il. And those two ranks are Wisayah and Imamah. Meaning Imamah and Wisayah will not be separated under any circumstances. They will be together. They won't be separated anywhere. ...to be mudkharatayn for them. Fa-kana min 'adl Allahi ta'ala wa fadlihi 'ala Muhammadin ('alayhissalatu wassalam) wa sharafihi, salawat Allahi 'alayhi, an yakuna maqaman ilahiyyan wa haykalan nuraniyyan. Wa lan yakuna dhalika illa li-man yakunu abuhu kadhalika haykalan nuraniyyan. Wa illa fa-la sabil... fa-la sabil ila dhalik (So it was from the justice of Allah the Exalted and His grace upon Muhammad, peace be upon him, and his honor, the blessings of Allah be upon him, that he should be a divine station and a luminous temple. And that will not be except for one whose father is likewise a luminous temple. Otherwise, there is no way to that). And from the justice of Allah, it is that... regarding the grace upon Muhammad ('alayhissalatu wassalam) and his honor, the blessings of Allah be upon him, that you should become a maqam ilahi and a haykal nurani. And this matter will not be except for that person whose father is also likewise a haykal nurani. Otherwise, if this is not so, then this matter will not happen. There will be no path to it. Meaning your statement is that Maulana Muhammad is a haykal nurani for this reason, that Maulana 'Abdullah is a haykal nurani. It was necessary for the Prophet ('alayhissalatu wassalam) to gather only the ranks of Nabuwwah and Risalah. In this respect. But when Janab 'Abd al-Muttalib, the great guardianship that he entrusted to you, for that, Prophet ('alayhissalatu wassalam)... so all the ranks that were gathered with Janab 'Ali in the spiritual world, he, despite being the bearer of Nabuwwah and Risalah, achieved superiority over all those ranks. He became the deputy of 'Ayn. After 'Ayn, your rank became established. So why did you receive that rank? Because you were a haykal nurani. Your father was Janab 'Abdullah, and 'Abdullah's father was Janab 'Abd al-Muttalib. This is what is being said. This gives the indication that the condition of the father and grandfather, the condition for being a haykal nurani, for the father and grandfather is necessary. But this condition is not necessary, that from the father and grandfather two children cannot be Imams. As from Maulana 'Abd al-Muttalib, two children became Imams, haykal nurani. Both children can be haykal nurani. In the mustawda' is one Imam, in the mustaqarr is one. My question is that after Maulana 'Abd al-Muttalib, for any Imam, this condition is not necessary that only one of their sons be an Imam. Both of their sons can be Imams. So this raises the question that Maulana 'Abdullah will also be a haykal nurani, only then can Maulana Muhammad be called a haykal nurani. So Maulana 'Abdullah, along with Maulana Abu Talib, is a haykal nurani. Here the matter of 'Ayn 'Azima is such that here a special quality has been created in 'Ayn 'Azima. The hijab of 'Ayn 'Azima, when it was manifested... 'Ali says, "ana 'abdun min 'abid Muhammad" (I am a slave from the slaves of Muhammad). I am one of Muhammad's slaves. The station of the one who is waited for is so lofty that due to it, all the ranks that Janab the Prophet ('alayhissalatu wassalam) had obtained of Nabuwwah and Risalah, he not only obtained them and entered upon their ten ranks, but in addition to that, the Imamah and all the Imams, all the Wasi who were gathered with Janab 'Ali, except for the rank of 'Ali, you obtained all the ranks. Right? No rank of the Qa'im remained. Illa thalathah sukra (except the three intoxicated ones). Illa thalathah sukra. And the thalathah sukra are also... they have gone to the Qa'im. There is still a connection. Qaba qawsayn aw adna (a distance of two bow lengths or nearer). Who is adna? Janab 'Abdullah. Qaba qawsayn, who is it? Janab 'Abd al-Muttalib, Janab Abu Talib. And adna? Janab 'Abdullah. This is a new point you have... in other books this has not been mentioned. This is a new... you have presented a new perspective here, that "lan yakuna dhalika illa li-man yakunu abuhu kadhalika haykalan nuraniyyan" (that will not be except for one whose father is likewise a luminous temple). That the Prophet sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam cannot be a haykal nurani unless his father is a haykal nurani. Yes. Because here there is no istida'iyyat (entrustment-ness). Here there is fawqiyyat (superiority) over all the Imams. Due to the kafalah (guardianship). If it were istida'iyyat, then... a rank of Nabuwwah... there in 'alam-e-noor, due to that... this is... This is a condition in the madarij that if Janab 'Abdullah is an Imam haykal nurani, then the rank of Muhammad cannot be given to a son other than a haykal nurani's. It cannot be given to anyone else. A condition has been set. The Imamah... their ranks are different. The Imamah of the two is different, the rutbah is different. And it is further detailed. Just like Hasan and Husayn. Janab Sulayman, the prophet... there too, there is Imamah. Dawud and Sulayman. Fa-kana min 'Abd al-Muttalib, salamu Allahi 'alayhi, an nasaba lahu babayn yatasallamani al-suwar al-muntaqilah al-murtaqiyah min ahl da'watihi, wa ja'ala ahadahuma a'la min al-akhar. Fa-kana al-'ali mujma'an li-suwar al-mu'minin al-bulagha' wa al-hudud al-fudala'. Wa al-thani mujma'an li-suwar al-mustajibin alladhina hadduhum akhdh al-'ahd wa al-wila, al-mustaqimin 'alayhi la ghayr (So it was from 'Abd al-Muttalib, peace of Allah be upon him, that he set up for himself two gates to receive the transferred, ascending forms from the people of his mission, and he made one of them higher than the other. So the higher one was a congregation for the forms of the eloquent believers and the virtuous Hudud. And the second was a congregation for the forms of the respondents whose limit was taking the covenant and allegiance, remaining steadfast upon it and nothing else). The bab al-abwab for Maulana 'Abd al-Muttalib... 'Abdullah ibn Saba. 'Abdullah ibn Saba and Hazrat Salma. Maulana Salma. Hazrat Salma belongs to Janab Hashim. The bab al-abwab, who is it? Your wife, Maulana Fatimah bint 'Amr. She is your wife. She is the babla for you. Janab Hashim appointed a bab al-abwab. The suwar gathered, and where did they become submerged? In his son. His son, Janab 'Abd al-Muttalib. Janab 'Abd al-Muttalib established a bab, who did he establish? His own wife, Fatimah bint 'Amr. She is the bab al-abwab. Where did she become submerged? In his son, Maulana Abu Talib. Janab Abu Talib. And the second bab you established, as you are saying, that is 'Abdullah ibn Saba. Their istima' took place, where did that gather? In Janab 'Abdullah. In 'Abdullah. Janab Abu Talib appointed his bab al-abwab, whom did he appoint? His wife. Janab Fatimah bint Asad. He appointed her. Where did she become submerged? Janab 'Ali's... in the qalb-e-haykal (heart of the temple) of Janab 'Ali. Janab 'Ali appointed his bab al-abwab. Whom? His wife. Janab Fatimah... No. Janab Salman-e-Farsi. His wife... Janab Salman-e-Farsi. Salman-e-Farsi. She will become the qalb-e-haykal for Imam Husayn ('alayhissalatu wassalam). The bab al-abwab of the Imam and the qalb-e-haykal are different. There is a difference between the two that should be kept in mind. Janab the Prophet ('alayhissalatu wassalam) appointed a bab al-abwab for Janab Fatimah. Who is it? Janab Hamzah. No. Janab Khadijah. Janab Khadijah. Where did she become submerged? Janab Fatimah's... In Janab Fatimah ('alayhissalatu wassalam). Janab 'Abdullah appointed a bab al-abwab. Who was it? Aminah. Janab Aminah. Where did she become submerged? In Janab Rasulullah sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam. This thing needs to be understood. The Imam has bab al-abwab, they become the qalb-e-haykal for the son who will be the next khalifah. Becoming qalb-e-haykal is one thing, and being bab al-abwab is another. The Imam appoints his wife as the qalb... as the bab al-abwab. And she becomes submerged in his son. But the bab al-abwab... the istima' takes place... they become the qalb-e-haykal. What did you say? In the Ya Fateru prayer that we recite... Ya Fateru. Ya Fateru. Four Ya Fateru... four Fateru come. One is in the sajdah, a hundred times. In the sajdah, a hundred times. Then on the right cheek, a hundred times. Then on the left cheek, a hundred times. Then in the sajdah, 110 times. So the first sajdah is for Janab Fatimah al-Zahra. Fatimah al-Zahra. The Prophet has said, "The believer is closest to Allah the Exalted when he is in sajdah." When the bab... when the haykal is prepared, with the bab al-abwab, at that time the spiritual realities are closest to Allah Ta'ala. In the da'wah. They are closest to Allah Ta'ala. He is in sajdah. The first sajdah is Janab Fatimah al-Zahra's ('alayhissalatu wassalam). The sajdah on the right side is Janab Fatimah bint Asad. Whose mother? Maulana 'Ali's mother. And whose bab al-abwab? Janab Abu Talib's bab al-abwab. That is the right cheek. The hujjah of 'Ayn 'Azima. The hujjah of 'Ayn 'Azima is your bab, whose submersion is in Mim. This is the difference between the sajdah and the cheek. Then the third is Fatimah bint 'Amr. Who is she? Janab 'Abd al-Muttalib's wife. And the mother of Janab Abu Talib. Then the fourth sajdah, its rank is explained to be 110. Umm al-Qa'im. The mother of the Qa'im. The wife of the Qa'im. Zawjat al-Qa'im ('alayhissalatu wassalam). Her name is also Fatimah. Zawjat al-Qa'im ('alayhissalatu wassalam). 110 times. That you will be superior to the ten ranks. To this Fatimah. To these three. She will be superior to these three, but Janab Fatimah is superior to all.

So Maulana 'Abd al-Muttalib... Fazl al-khamis... Let's read it.

He said that in sajdah, seven parts of the body must touch the ground. Seven parts. So he said seven parts must touch the ground. But if a person is old, he does this. So seven parts don't touch the ground. When he goes into sajdah, seven parts... what are the seven parts? Forehead, nose, two hands, two knees, two feet. Two feet. One face is mentioned. The two hands, two knees, and the toes of the two feet. Seven. He has taken the face as one. So what is in it, their hudud will be... of Janab Fatimah and this Fatimah. Fatimah 'Ayn Ula and Fatimah 'Ayn Ukhra. Their hudud, the order of the da'wah will be complete. In it, seven limbs will be there. Seven of their jawarih. And here, there aren't seven. Only the cheek is touching. The rank is less. The rank is less.

<!-- lecture 30 -->

Bismillah al-Rahman al-Rahim. The fifth chapter. `Wa lamma ijtama'at hadhihi al-rutab al-arba' 'ind Abd al-Muttalib, kanat ithnatan minhunna mudakhkharatayn li-l-qa'im min wuld Isma'il 'alayhis salam, wa huma al-wasayah wa-l-imamah, wa ithnatan li-l-qa'im min wuld Ishaq 'alayhis salam, wa huwa al-nubuwwah wa-l-risalah` (And when these four ranks gathered with Abd al-Muttalib, two of them were reserved for the Qa'im from the progeny of Isma'il, peace be upon him, and they are the vicegerency and the imamate. And two were for the Qa'im from the progeny of Ishaq, peace be upon him, and it is prophethood and messengership). And when these four ranks (`rutbe`) gathered with Sayyidna Abd al-Muttalib, then... ...so two of them... were for the Qa'im from the progeny of Isma'il. And those two ranks are `wasayat` (vicegerency) and `imamah` (imamate). And two ranks are for the Qa'im from the progeny of Ishaq... and they are `nubuwwah` (prophethood)... And they are both `nubuwwah` and `risalah` (messengership). Four stations (`maratib`) were gathered with Sayyidna Abd al-Muttalib. And in those four stations, two ranks were of `wasayat` and `imamah`, with Sayyidna Isma'il. And two ranks... two ranks... and two ranks are `Qa'im min wuld Ishaq` (the Qa'im from the progeny of Ishaq). `Qa'im min wuld Isma'il` is `Ayn-e-'Azimah` (the great essence). And `Qa'im min wuld Ishaq` is the Lord Prophet (`bar-e-Payghambar`). `wa kana fi 'adlillah fadlu Muhammadin wa sharafuhu salawatullahi alaih an yakuna maqaman ilahiyyan wa haykalan nuraniyyan` (And it was in the justice of Allah the virtue and honor of Muhammad, blessings of Allah be upon him, that he should be a divine station and a luminous structure). And they were, in Allah's... In the justice of Allah Ta'ala. In the justice (`'adl`) of Allah Ta'ala... in the virtue... and honor, blessings of Allah be upon him. Blessings of Allah be upon him, that he be a `maqam-e-ilahiy` (divine station) and a `haykal-e-nurani` (luminous structure). `wa lan yakuna dhalika illa li-man yakunu abuhu kadhalika haykalan nuraniyyan` (And that will not be except for one whose father is likewise a luminous structure). They are saying that the condition for being a `haykal-e-nurani`... that this matter does not happen except for a person whose... whose father... whose father is likewise a `haykal-e-nurani`. For `imamah` and for being a `haykal-e-nurani`, it is necessary that the father also be a `haykal-e-nurani`. Otherwise, the gathering of `suwarat` (forms/images) cannot happen. The gathering of the four `maratib` (stations)... Yes. A `haykal` (structure) must be formed for all... in which the gathering of `suwarat` happens. There must be such capacity, such strength (`quwwat`) that all `suwarat` can be gathered with them. That strength... one is receptive, isn't it? The thing... to acquire it... one must have the strength to acquire it. Like in a TV and so on, it's there... to receive. There must be strength to receive. So that strength is not created until it is a `haykal-e-nurani`. Yes. `wa illa...` (and if not...). `wa illa fa-la sabila ila dhalik` (and if not, then there is no way to that). Except that it is not... Rays of sunlight fall everywhere. They fall over the whole earth, the entire universe. But some things are such that they are a mirror (`a'ina`). What does it do? It catches it and throws the rays. And some things, which are... they grasp the sun's rays with strength. That is the quality. `wa illa fa-la sabila ila dhalik` (and if not, then there is no way to that). And if not, then there is no way to it. To it. Otherwise, that `haykal-e-nurani` cannot be formed. If he is not... his father is not a `haykal-e-nurani`, then he himself cannot become a `haykal-e-nurani`. `wa kana min Abd al-Muttalib an nasaba lahu babayn yatasallamani al-suwar al-muntaqilah al-murtaqiyah min a'dad da'watihi` (And it was from Abd al-Muttalib that he established for himself two gates who would receive the transitioning, ascending forms from the numbers of his `da'wah`). And from... Sayyidna Abd al-Muttalib... `salamullahi alaih` (peace of Allah be upon him)... he established... established for you... for him... Sayyidna Muhammad `salawatullahi alaih`... two gates. `an nasaba lahu` (that he established for him)... for himself. For himself. He established for himself two gates. Two gates. And... Both receive... both receive... the `suwarat` (forms)... transferring... transferring... ascending... ascending... from the people of his `da'wah`. From the people of the `da'wah`. `wa ja'ala ahadahuma a'la min al-akhar` (And he made one of them higher than the other). And he made... and he made one of them... from these two... from these two, one of them higher than the other. `fa-kana al-majm' al-'ali majma'an li-l-suwar al-mu'minin al-bulagha' wa-l-hudud al-fudala'` (So the higher gathering was a place of assembly for the forms of the accomplished believers and the virtuous `hudud`). So it became `majm'-e-'ali` (the higher gathering). So it became `majm'-e-'ali`... So the higher gathering, the assembler. The assembler... of the `suwarat`... of the accomplished believers (`mu'minin-e-bulagha'`). Of the accomplished believers... and of the virtuous `hudud` (`hudud-e-fudala'`). `wa-l-thani majma'an li-l-suwar al-mustajibin alladhina ukhidhat 'alayhim 'uhud al-wila' al-mustaqimin 'alayhi la ghayr` (And the second was a place of assembly for the forms of the respondents from whom the covenants of allegiance were taken, who were steadfast upon it, and nothing else). And the second is an assembler... gathering... of the `suwarat` of the respondents (`mustajibin`)... such that their covenant... such that their covenant... To take a covenant (`'ahd`) was... of allegiance (`wila'`). It was to take a covenant. And to fulfill it. The `wila'` of the `mustaqim` (the steadfast). And... `wila'` means love. `Wilayah`. `fa-kanat tilka al-suwar al-mujtami'ah 'ind al-bab al-'ali Abu Talib 'alayhis salam` (So those gathered forms were with the higher gate, Abu Talib, peace be upon him). So... it became... those forms... that are gathered... with the higher gate (`bab-e-'ali`)... Abu Talib `alaihis salam` (peace be upon him). This `bab` (gate), what does it do? The `bab` gathers all the forms (`suwarat`) from the universe and when it is time to instill (`nasb`) them in the son of the Imam, then what happens with that? That `bab` goes and becomes the `qalb-e-haykal` (heart of the structure). It becomes the Imam's `qalb-e-haykal`. Sir, who decides that this `surat` (form) is ready to be included in the `haykal` or not? Imam `alaihis salatu was salam`. And the Imam of Imams, he decides. Who is the Imam of Imams? `Ayn-e-'Azimah` (The great essence). `Ayn-e-'Azimah`. An indication is given that it is ready, at its time, to bring honor to the `nasb` (installation). The command comes from there. `wa kanat tilka al-suwar` (And those forms were...). So these are the `suwarat` that are gathered with the `bab-e-'ali`, Abu Talib `alaihis salam`. `wa-l-suwar allati 'ind al-bab al-dani...` (And the forms that were with the lower gate...). Who is the `bab-e-'ali`? It was mentioned yesterday, at night. With Salman al-Farsi. Abu Talib's... Abd al-Muttalib's... Abd al-Muttalib's `bab-e-'ali`. So they gathered with Abu Talib. Sayyidna Fatimah bint 'Amr. Sayyidna Fatimah bint 'Amr. Sayyidna... Abd al-Muttalib's wife (`zawjah`). Sayyidna Fatimah bint 'Amr. She is the `bab-e-'ali`, and they gathered where? With Sayyidna Abu Talib `alaihis salam`, as the `qalb-e-haykal` (heart of the structure). Sayyidna Abu Talib. Yesterday, at night, it was explained. Yes. And a statement came: `ummuhu, ummuhu, ummuha`. What does it mean? A term. It's a term of the `da'wah`. What term? `ummuhu, ummuhu, ummuha`. What does it mean? His mother, his mother, her mother. This has come for the `bab al-abwab` (gate of gates). `Ummuhu` means the Prophet's (`alaihis salatu was salam`) mother. What is she? Your `qalb-e-haykal`. Not the `bab` (gate). `qalb-e-haykal` was... whose `bab` were you? Sayyidna Abdullah's. Sayyidna Abdullah's `bab al-abwab` was who? Your wife, Sayyidna Aminah. She became the `qalb-e-haykal` of Sayyidna... the Prophet (`alaihis salatu was salam`). `Ummuhu`. His mother. Then `ummuhu`, `ummuhu` meaning Sayyidna Ali's mother. Sayyidna Ali's mother. `Ummuhu`. Fatimah bint Asad. Sayyidna Fatimah bint Asad. She is your mother. `qalb-e-haykal` of whom? Sayyidna Ali `alaihis salatu was salam`. `qalb-e-haykal`. `Ummuha`. Meaning... Sayyidna Fatimah... Sayyidna Khadijah became the `qalb-e-haykal` of Sayyidna Fatimah. `Ummuhu, ummuhu, ummuha`. This has been explained in a special way. And here, Sayyidna Hashim's... what is it? Sayyidna Hashim's `bab al-abwab` is who? Sayyidna Salma. Sayyidna Hashim's `bab al-abwab` is Sayyidna Salma. She became whose `qalb-e-haykal`? Sayyidna Abd al-Muttalib's. Sayyidna Abd al-Muttalib's `bab al-abwab` is who? Sayyidna Fatimah bint 'Amr. She became whose `qalb-e-haykal`? Sayyidna Abu Talib's. Sayyidna Abu Talib's wife, Sayyidna Fatimah bint Asad, she became whose `qalb-e-haykal`? Sayyidna... Ali Murtada's. Sayyidna Ali Murtada's `bab al-abwab` is who? Sayyidna Salman al-Farsi. He became the `qalb-e-haykal` of Imam Husayn `alaihis salatu was salam`. `wa-l-suwar allati 'ind al-bab al-dani 'Abdillah` (And the forms that were with the lower gate, Abdullah). And the `suwarat` that were with the lower gate, who was Abdullah... They gathered with Abdullah. They gathered with Abdullah. `wa li-dhalika kana sharifan 'indallah` (And for that reason, he was noble with Allah). And for this reason, you... were of great honor with Allah. `wa shahara Abd al-Muttalib amrahu bi-l-dhabh` (And Abd al-Muttalib made his matter famous through the sacrifice). And he made famous... Abd al-Muttalib made famous your matter with the sacrifice (`dhabh`). With the sacrifice. You... had seen this dream, or had made a vow that if I have this many children, then I will sacrifice one child. So you... Sayyidna Abdullah was born, so many children were born. Ten, eleven. He had made a vow. So he... you intended to sacrifice. All the people gathered, saying, "You are going to sacrifice your son?" Just as the incident with Sayyidna Ibrahim happened, the same happened with you. So you... you gave sacrifices. Camels were sacrificed. 100 camels were sacrificed, then... then the name of Sayyidna Abdullah came up. Then that is a strange incident. Let's not go into explaining it. So in the end, instead of Sayyidna Abdullah, the name came up for the sacrifice. So you said, "However many times it came up, that many times I will fulfill it." Fulfilling it, you then carried out the sacrifice. `wa nawwaha bi-smihi li-ya'rifa ahl al-haqa'iq fadlahu` (And he made his name renowned so that the people of realities may know his virtue). And he made renowned... your name. And he made your name renowned so that the people of realities (`ahl-e-haqa'iq`) may know... You are saying the real point was that it had to be made famous that Sayyidna Abdullah's sacrifice is happening. Meaning, the meaning of sacrifice is that he is being prepared for that station, the station for which `nubuwwah` and `risalah` (prophethood and messengership) was the station, he is being prepared for that station. So that the people of realities may know his virtue. What is inside them? What do they say? What does Iqbal say? "Within the house, what commotions there are! What does the lamp on the path know?" What is its first line? The first couplet is... `Khirad kya hai?` (What is intellect?). What? What is intellect (`khirad`)? It is called intellect (`'aql`). "What is intellect (`khirad`)? It is a lamp on the path (`chiragh-e rahguzar`), by which a person's sight is illumined (`raushan-basar`). Within the house (`darun-e khana`), what commotions there are! What does the lamp on the path (`chiragh-e rahguzar`) know?" What does it mean? "What is intellect (`khirad`)?" In the old days, there were no lights. There would be a lamp in the house, but for people's coming and going, for going and for coming, on the path that led to the house, a lamp would be placed there. So that those coming and going would have ease in their movement. A lamp would be in the street. So what is intellect (`khirad`)? For the intellect, "What is intellect? It is a lamp on the path (`chiragh-e rahguzar`)." The path's lamp. "By which a person's sight is illumined (`raushan-basar`)." One gets light from it. "Within the house (`darun-e khana`)." Inside the house. What is happening? "Within the house, what commotions there are! What does the lamp on the path know?" What does the intellect know what is happening inside? `wa kana kull wahid minhuma maqaman ilahiyyan wa haykalan nuraniyyan` (And each one of them was a divine station and a luminous structure). So each one of them became... so each one of them became a `maqam-e-ilahiy` (divine station) and a `haykal-e-nurani` (luminous structure). What is the station (`maqam`) of the present Imam? What station is he at? What is the name of the present Imam? Maulana Muhammad bin Ali `alaihis salam`. As was your station (`maqam`) of `jaddiyat-e-'ayn` (being the essence-grandfather), this station, the present Imam is the `jadd-e-qa'im` (grandfather of the Qa'im). `jadd-e-qa'im` `alaihis salatu was salam`. So the station of `jadd-e-qa'im` is very high. Just as he had two sons, so too will this Imam have two sons. Necessarily. It is the custom (`dastur`). So who will be the first? `jadd-e-qa'im`. `jadd-e-'Ali`, `jadd-e-qa'im`. The `jadd-e-qa'im` will have two sons. One will be at the station of Sayyidna Abu Talib, and one will be at the station of Sayyidna Abdullah. The one who is at the station of Sayyidna Abu Talib, from him will come who? Qa'im `alaihis salatu was salam`. And the son who is from Sayyidna Abdullah... the son who is from Sayyidna Abdullah will be Sayyidna Mahdi `alaihis salam`. Sayyidna... Mahdi will have a daughter, what will her name be? Fatimah. It was said, right, to recite the `tasbih` 110 times? Fatimah. Whom will she marry? Sayyidna Qa'im. She will marry him. And from them, Hasan and Husayn will be born. Those at the station of Hasan and Husayn will be born. The same pattern (`naqshah`) that was there will be here. `fa-sallama Abd al-Muttalib rutbat al-wasayah wa-l-imamah ila Abi Talib, wa rutbat al-nubuwwah wa-l-risalah ila 'Abdillah` (So Abd al-Muttalib handed over the rank of vicegerency and imamate to Abu Talib, and the rank of prophethood and messengership to Abdullah). So Abd al-Muttalib handed over... the rank of `wasayat` (vicegerency)... the rank of `wasayat`... to Abu Talib. To Abu Talib. And the rank of `nubuwwah` and `risalah` to Abdullah `alaihis salam`. So they became two Imams. So they became two Imams. `ahaduhuma imamun natiq` (one of them a speaking imam). One of them is an `imam-e-natiq` (speaking Imam)... and he is Abu Talib. Like Husayn bin Ali. Like Husayn bin Ali. `wa-l-akhar samitun wa huwa 'Abdullah ka-l-Hasan bin 'Aliyy` (And the other is silent, and he is Abdullah, like al-Hasan bin Ali). And the other... the other... is silent (`samit`), and he is Abdullah, like Hasan bin Ali. `fa-awlada 'Abdullah Muhammadan` (So Abdullah fathered Muhammad). So Abdullah fathered Muhammad `salawatullahi alaih`. `wa awlada Abu Talib 'Aliyyan` (And Abu Talib fathered Ali). And Abu Talib fathered Ali `alaihis salam`. `fa-lamma anat nuqlatu 'Abdillah, istawda'a abahu 'Abd al-Muttalib...` (So when the time for Abdullah's transfer came, he entrusted his father Abd al-Muttalib...). `nuqlatu`. `Nuqlatu`. It is the `fa'il` (subject). `fa-lamma anat nuqlatu 'Abdillah` (So when the time for Abdullah's transfer came). If someone does not know Arabic, what will they read? They will read it as `falamma anta nuqla`. `anta nuqla` has no meaning. What word is it? What word is it? `Nuqlatu`. Leave that, what is this word? This word, what is it? The one below... `falamma anat`. Is it `anat` or `anta`? It is `anat`. It is not `anta`. It is `anat`. So when the time for transfer... ...came, the time of transfer... of Abdullah `alaihis salam`... he entrusted... he was... ...was entrusted with... his father... his father Abd al-Muttalib for his son... his son Muhammad `salawatullahi alaih`... `nubuwwah` (prophethood) and `risalah` (messengership). You entrusted it as a deposit. It was your thing, because the same pattern happened where? With Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq. You... that which was your thing, you deposited it with Sayyidna Abu Talib. With Abd al-Muttalib. `wa intaqala ila dar karamatillah` (And he transferred to the abode of the honor of Allah). And he transferred to the abode... to the abode of the honor of Allah... the abode of honor. `fa-lamma anat nuqlatu 'Abd al-Muttalib, istawda'a waladahu Aba Talib rutbat al-nubuwwah wa-l-risalah li-waladi waladihi alladhi huwa Muhammad salawatullahi alaih` (And when the time for Abd al-Muttalib's transfer came, he entrusted his son Abu Talib with the rank of prophethood and messengership for his grandson, who is Muhammad, blessings of Allah be upon him). And when he passed away... he entrusted... his son Abu Talib... with the rank (`rutbah`) of `nubuwwah` and `risalah`... his son... his son's son... his grandson. For his grandson, just as he is Muhammad `salawatullahi alaih`. `li-kawnihi fi hadd al-tufuliyyah` (Because of his being in the limit of childhood). Because you were in the limit of childhood. Prophet `alaihis salatu was salam` was small. He was small. He entrusted it to Sayyidna Abu Talib. So Sayyidna Abu Talib, in this way, two of your ranks gathered with him, and he was the custodian (`kafil`) of the rank of `nubuwwah` and `risalah`. Sayyidna Abd al-Muttalib, by virtue of being... a great degree has been given to Abd al-Muttalib, that all four `maratib` (stations), you are their owner. And Abu Talib is the owner of two stations and the other two stations, what is he? He is the custodian. `wa intaqala ila dar karamatillah ta'ala` (And he transferred to the abode of the honor of Allah, the Exalted). He passed away. And he passed away... to Allah's... to the abode of honor. `wa qama Abu Talib 'alayhis salam bi-l-rutab al-arba' ila an balagha Muhammad salawatullahi alaih ashuddahu` (And Abu Talib, peace be upon him, upheld the four ranks until Muhammad, blessings of Allah be upon him, reached his maturity). And Abu Talib `alaihis salam` upheld... the four ranks (`rutbe`). Until he reached... he reached... Prophet `salawatullahi alaih`... his... age of maturity. To maturity. `fa-sallama ilayhi ma istudi'a lahu Abu Talib` (So he handed over to him what had been entrusted to Abu Talib for him). And he entrusted to your care... he entrusted to your care... his uncle Abu Talib... `ma istudi'a lahu` (what had been entrusted for him). That which had been entrusted for you. `wa hiya rutbatan, al-nubuwwah wa-l-risalah` (And it was two ranks, prophethood and messengership). And that rank was... that rank was `nubuwwah` and `risalah`. `wa dhalika anna Muhammadan salawatullahi alaih taraqqa fi rutbatay al-shay' wa-l-shay'an ila an balagha rutbat al-nutq al-ilahi, wa huwa qa'im wuld Ishaq 'alayhis salam alladhi sabaqa al-qawl 'alayhim` (And that is because Muhammad, blessings of Allah be upon him, ascended through the two ranks, thing by thing, until he reached the rank of divine speech, and he is the Qa'im of the progeny of Ishaq, peace be upon him, about whom the saying has preceded). And... that is because Prophet `alaihis salam`... ascended (`taraqqa`)... in the ranks... in the ranks... bit by bit... until he reached... the rank of `nutq-e-ilahi` (divine speech). The rank of `nutq-e-ilahi`. This is the final rank, his `nutq-e-ilahi`. These are lower-level ranks (`rutbe`). `Nubuwwah` (prophethood)... `Imamah` (imamate), `wasayah` (vicegerency). This... are lower-level ranks. Above this, when the higher ranks begin, then in that, `nutq-e-ilahi`... the `maqam` (station) of `hujjab` (proofs). `maqamun mahmudun` (a praised station). Yes. `maqam-e-mahmud`. Because `'ayn` (essence/source) does not come in one form, you know. Some `'ayn` appear, one `'ayn` is of one cycle (`dawr`). One `'ayn` is of seven cycles. According to that, your station of `maqam-e-mahmud` also changes. As will be the station of the `'ayn`, according to that, your `maqam` will be. Like the `khutbat al-tasmeem` (sermon of designation), that at the time of the `khutbat al-tasmeem`, the station of the `'ayn` changes into the form of the `Qa'im`. `ila an balagha rutbat al-nutq al-ilahi` (until he reached the rank of divine speech). Until he reached your rank of `nutq-e-ilahi`. `wa huwa qa'imun min wuld Ishaq` (and he is a Qa'im from the progeny of Ishaq). `wa huwa qa'im wuld Ishaq 'alayhis salam` (And he is the Qa'im of the progeny of Ishaq, peace be upon him). And you are the `Qa'im`... of the progeny of Ishaq `alaihis salam`. `alladhi sabaqa al-qawl 'alayhim` (about whom the saying has preceded). Just as the saying has passed... about them. `wa kana judullahi 'alayhi haykalan nuraniyyan` (And the beneficence of Allah was upon him as a luminous structure). And the beneficence of Allah was upon you. A `haykal-e-nurani` (luminous structure). The Prophet... `haykal-e-nurani`. `wa maqaman ruhaniyyan` (and a spiritual station). A `maqam-e-ilahiy` (divine station). `ijtima'at 'indahu suwar ahl al-da'wat al-zahira wa-l-qa'imina bi-l-ibadat al-zahira wa-l-qa'imina bi-l-a'mal al-saliha min Ishaq bin Ibrahim ila 'Abdillah bin 'Abd al-Muttalib` (with him gathered the forms of the people of the manifest `da'wah` and those who upheld the manifest worship and those who upheld righteous deeds, from Ishaq bin Ibrahim to Abdullah bin Abd al-Muttalib). `salamullahi 'alayhim` (peace of Allah be upon them). And your... with you... gathered... the `suwarat` (forms)... of the people of the manifest `da'wah`... who upheld... the manifest worship (`ibadat-e-zahira`). With the manifest worship... and righteous deeds. And righteous deeds from Ishaq bin Ibrahim to Abdullah bin Abd al-Muttalib. Because the Prophet's work is `tanzil` (revelation) and Ali's work is `ta'wil` (interpretation). This is the basis. So what is `da'wat-e-zahira`? This is before the Prophet. This is `da'wat-e-zahira`. `min Ishaq ila` (from Ishaq to). It came here that at 40 years of age, you were given `risalah` (messengership). `Nubuwwah` (prophethood)... was... I was a prophet while Adam was between water and clay. I was a prophet. So `nubuwwah` was... After traversing 40 stages, at the age of 40, what you were given was `risalah`. You were given `risalah`. `balligh ma unzila ilayk` (convey what has been revealed to you). So `risalah` was granted. What was granted when it was revealed to you? First... `Iqra` (read). `bismi rabbika-lladhi` (in the name of your Lord who). What is it? You all read the Surah. `khalaq` (created). `khalaqa-l-insana min 'alaq` (created man from a clinging substance). Sir, "I have perfected for you your religion," what does this mean? It means all the obligations of the `din` were completed. The command of `wilayah` came last of all. After all the commands were revealed, after the command for Hajj became the last one, then... the `din`... the announcement of `wilayah` was made. So the completion of the `din` happened. It's not about your, I mean, station (`martabah`). That was the final one. We are talking about the three levels. One grandfather and one uncle. He brought his... to Hijab-e-'Ali. Then... Hijab-e-'Ali rose. Three aspects. Remember this, three aspects. It is called `salasa majari` (the three courses). What is it called? `Salasa majari`. Three courses (`dal`). One is that the Prophet (`alaihis salatu was salam`)... Ali said, `ana 'abdun min 'abid Muhammad` (I am a slave from the slaves of Muhammad). I am... one of the Prophet's slaves. This is what? `Majra-e-adna` (the lowest course). One course (`majra`) is what? Of `masawat` (equality). What is that? `ana wa 'Aliyyun ka-hatayn` (I and Ali are like these two [fingers]). I and Ali are like this. `Masawat`. `ana wa 'Aliyyun ka-hatayn`. Like this. In this too, what is it? A level of `masawat`, but how is it? This is on the right, this is on the left. And after that, what is it? Sayyidna the Prophet (`alaihis salatu was salam`) raised you up on the day of the conquest of Makkah. So that is the time of elevation. At the time of the elevation of the Hijab-e-'Ain... one `hijab` (veil) is `adna` (lower), one is `barabar` (equal), one `hijab` is what? `A'la` (higher). `wa li-dhalika kana yaqul, ana da'watu Abi Ibrahim wa ijtima'at al-maqamat al-'aliyah...` (And for that reason he used to say, I am the prayer of my father Ibrahim and the high stations gathered...). This `ana` can be read as `inna` or `ana`. And for this reason he used to say that I am... from the prayer (`da'wat`) of my father Ibrahim. `wa ijtima'at al-maqamat al-'aliyah` (and the high stations gathered). And all the high stations gathered. `wa-l-hayakil al-nuraniyah fi jami' al-adwar min awwal al-thalathah alaf sana` (And the luminous structures in all the cycles from the first three thousand years). And they gathered in all the cycles... And they gathered, the high stations and the luminous structures, in all the cycles. In all the cycles. From... the first three thousand years... The period of `fatrah` is not... this... As it was after the `dawr-e-kashf` (cycle of unveiling). If we read `ba'da` as `badal`, then after the `dawr-e-kashf`. From this... After the `dawr-e-kashf`. He explained that... No, 47,000. 3,000 years are the `dawr-e-fatrah` (period of interval). 47 plus 3 is 50,000. No, that is the real question. Some have explained that the `dawr-e-kashf` is 50,000 years. And in those 50,000 years, the last 3,000 years, in that, two types of `suwarat` (forms) manifested. One type is that which bears the qualities of the `dawr-e-sitir` (cycle of concealment). And one is that which has the characteristics of the `dawr-e-kashf`. 3,000 years. The type that is higher, the type that is superior, that one... the `dawr-e-fatrah` does not impose its characteristics upon it. Those are considered the `suwarat` of the `dawr-e-kashf`. And Imam Junayd `alaihis salatu was salam` has the `suwarat` of the 3,000 years of the `dawr-e-fatrah`, the lower (`adna`) `suwarat`, they gathered with him. And Sayyidna Hashim `alaihis salatu was salam` has... you are saying... so here the `suwarat` that gathered are of the `dawr-e-kashf`, the higher `suwarat`. Probably the higher `suwarat`. `wa kanat bi-jumlatiha` (And in their entirety). So these `suwarat`... `wa kanat bi-jumlatiha haykalan nuraniyyan wa maqaman ruhaniyyan za nasutin ka-manasik al-a'immah 'alayhim al-salam` (And in their entirety, they were a luminous structure and a spiritual station, possessing a human form like the rites of the Imams, peace be upon him). They were possessing `nasut` (human form). Like the `manasik` (rites) of the Imams `alaihim al-salam`. `wa kanat 'Aliyyan 'alayhis salam` (And it was Ali, peace be upon him). `wa kanat 'Aliyyan 'alayhis salam... wa kana qa'im wuld Isma'il 'alayhis salam` (And it was Ali, peace be upon him... and he was the Qa'im of the progeny of Isma'il, peace be upon him). And they were... and it was... Ali `alaihis salam`. This `haykal` (structure) became... this `haykal` became Ali `alaihis salam`. And you were the `Qa'im`... What? `wa kanat`... it was that... 3,000 years, and this is 7,000 years. 7,000, no, 6,000. 6,000 years. `wa kana qa'im wuld Isma'il` (And he was the Qa'im of the progeny of Isma'il). And you were the `Qa'im`... of the progeny of Isma'il. `salamullahi 'alayhim` (peace of Allah be upon them). `wa-l-hamdu lillah 'ala bulugh al-ghayat wa-l-ittila' 'ala khawafi al-asrar al-khafiyyat. Wa salla Allahu 'ala Muhammadin khatim al-nabiyyin...` (And praise be to Allah for reaching the goals and for being informed of the hidden secrets. And may Allah's blessings be upon Muhammad, the seal of the prophets...). He is explaining in the `du'a` (supplication) of the `da'i` (caller). At that time, in the `du'a` of the `da'i` in the `dawr-e-qayim` (cycle of the Qa'im). Sayyidna sahib used to say that a `da'i` wrote, Sayyidna Sulayman wrote, that he explained the `du'as` that were there. He explained them. He did great work. But in some of his books, some things... some new knowledge he kept hidden. When Sayyidna Ja'far came, he explained those hidden things. But from his side, some things that he received from the Imam, he kept hidden. One `da'i` after another kept coming and they... kept their things hidden. They explained the `du'as`, and some things they kept hidden. From their side. This series continues. `wa 'ala alihi al-tahirin al-tayyibin, wa 'ala al-qasimayn min huma al-qasim al-awwal 'Abdillah, 'ala khalqihi ajma'in` (and upon his pure and goodly family, and upon the two Qasims from them, the first Qasim, Abdullah, upon all of His creation). `wa-l-ittila' 'ala khawafi` (and being informed of the hidden secrets). All praise is for Allah for reaching the goal. And for knowing the hidden secrets. And may Allah's blessings be upon Muhammad... `wa salla Allahu 'ala Muhammadin khatim al-nabiyyin wa 'ala alihi al-tahirin al-tayyibin, wa 'ala al-qasimayn min huma al-qasim al-awwal 'Abdillah, 'ala khalqihi ajma'in` (And may Allah's blessings be upon Muhammad, the seal of the prophets, and upon his pure and goodly family, and upon the two Qasims from them, the first Qasim, Abdullah, upon all of His creation).

<!-- lecture 31 -->

Bismillah al-Rahman al-Rahim. Al-Bab al-Thani min al-juz' al-thalith, from the first chapter. Wa lamma kana Amir al-Mu'minin bi-hadhihi al-halah al-lati lam yablughha ahadun ghayruhu, ittasala bihi al-'aql al-'ashir ittisalan kulliyan, ittasala bihi... ittasala bihi al-'aql al-'ashir ittisalan kulliyan. Wa lahazat'hu al-'uqul al-ibda'iyah lahzan sarmadiyan, wa ramat'hu bi-ashi'atiha... bi-ashi'atiha... bi-ashi'atiha. Wa ittasalat bihi al-mawad al-ilahiyah fawqa ma ittasalat bi-kull maqam qablahu wa ba'dahu... siwa al-qa'im 'ala dhikrihi al-salam. And when... `wa lamma kana`... when Amir al-Mu'minin is in this state... Allah Ta'ala has said `kana Allahu 'aliman` (Allah is All-Knowing). `kana` has the meaning of 'is' and also 'was'. `kana Allahu 'aliman`... what meaning will we give to this? That Allah is All-Knowing. If you say 'was', then it would be in the past. So does that mean He is not now? He is. `wa lamma kana Amir al-Mu'minin`... when Amir al-Mu'minin is... when Amir al-Mu'minin is in this state... Allah is on this state, this state which... `al-lati`... such a state that `lam yablughha`... did not reach... `ahadun ghayruhu`... no one reached it except you. The *nuqta* (point) of the *muhtajib* (veiled one) of Amir al-Mu'minin, peace be upon him. Now, what is the station of the *nuqta* of the *muhtajib*? This has been explained before. When `dhu al-sa'y al-ibda'iyah` manifested. Where did it manifest from? From Sarandip. After that, what happened? The *dawr al-kashf* (period of unveiling) began. After the *dawr al-kashf* began, its last *qa'im* of the *dawr al-kashf*... after he came, Amir al-Mu'minin `'ayn al-'azimah`'s *nuqta* is such that its station is higher than all of them. Higher than the station of `dhu al-sa'y al-ibda'iyah`. Such a person has never been born. Due to that, he is stating this. Now, the *nuqta* of the Qa'im, what is it? It has not yet manifested. It is called `inbi'ath al-nuqat` (emanation of the points). The *inbi'ath* of the *nuqta* has not happened yet. Until the *inbi'ath* of that *nuqta* of the Qa'im, peace and blessings be upon him, whose *nuqta* is the most active? The *nuqta* of `'ayn al-'azimah` is active after `dhu al-sa'y al-ibda'iyah`. This is the essential purpose of this.

`ittasala bihi al-'aql al-'ashir`... The Tenth Intellect connected with him. That is, what is meant by the Tenth Intellect? `Dhu al-sa'y al-ibda'iyah`. `ittisalan kulliyan` (a total connection). A complete connection. `wa lahazat'hu al-'uqul al-ibda'iyah` (And the Creative Intellects glanced at him), and they looked, towards you, `lahzan sarmadiyan` (with an eternal glance). A seeing that is always and forever lasting. `wa ramat`... and they cast... `wa ramat'hu`... their rays... and they cast their rays upon you... `wa ittasalat bihi`... and they connected with... you... `al-mawad al-ilahiyah` (the divine substances). What is meant by Amir al-Mu'minin here? `'Ayn al-'azimah`. Who is the *hijab* (veil) of the *muhtajib* (veiled one). The *hijab* of the *muhtajib*... who is... in `alam al-hayat` (the world of life). `wa ittasalat bihi al-mawad al-ilahiyah` (and the divine substances connected with him). And they connected, with that *nuqta*, the divine substances, the divine aids. `fawqa ma ittasalat bi-kull maqam` (above that which connected with every station). Above... more than... that which connected with any station, before you and after you. Neither before you... 'before you' meaning from `dhu al-sa'y al-ibda'iyah` onwards, from the manifestation of `dhu al-sa'y al-ibda'iyah` until the *inbi'ath* of the *nuqta* of `'ayn al-'azimah`, no one received such divine aids as were bestowed upon `'ayn al-'azimah`. Except... now the Qa'im who is to come, his *nuqta* will be even greater than this. `siwa al-qa'im 'ala dhikrihi al-salam` (except for the Qa'im, peace be upon his mention). Except for the Qa'im, peace be upon his mention. `fa-innahu yattasilu bihi fawqa ma ittasala bi-Amir al-Mu'minin` (For it connects with him [the Qa'im] more than it connected with Amir al-Mu'minin). Thus, it connects with you... it connects with you more than that which connected with Amir al-Mu'minin. `li-anna Amir al-Mu'minin minhu... bi-nisbati ilayhi juz'un` (because Amir al-Mu'minin... in relation to him, is a part). Because Amir al-Mu'minin... in relation to him, is a part. With respect to the Qa'im, you are a part. `wa al-qa'im kullun` (and the Qa'im is the whole). And the Qa'im is whole. That is why... `wa kadhalika fa-inna maqamat al-a'immah kull maqam minha juz'i... juz'iyyun` (And likewise, the stations of the Imams, every station among them is partial). `juz'iyyun`. That is why the stations of the Imams... `maqamat a'immah`... every station is partial from those stations. The Imams that there are, they are partial. And who is the whole? Who is the Imam of Imams? Who is the *Imam al-a'immah*? Janab `'ayn al-'azimah`. And Janab `'ayn al-'azimah` is partial in relation to the Qa'im, peace and blessings be upon him, who is to manifest. And the Qa'im, peace and blessings be upon him, is partial in relation to `dhu al-sa'y al-ibda'iyah`. `wa maqam Amir al-Mu'minin kulli` (And the station of Amir al-Mu'minin is whole). The station of Amir al-Mu'minin is whole. Every whole is only whole when there is a part in opposition to it. This is what is being said. `wa qad ramaza Rasulullah sallallahu 'alayhi wa 'ala alihi bi-dhalika haythu qal` (And the Messenger of Allah, may Allah's prayers and peace be upon him and his family, alluded to this when he said): `al-Hasan wa al-Husayn imamani bi-haqqin qama aw qa'ada wa abuhuma khayrun minhuma` (Al-Hasan and al-Husayn are two rightful Imams, whether they rise or sit, and their father is better than them). And the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him and his family, indicated towards this characteristic when he said: Hasan and Husayn are rightful Imams. Both of you are Imams. `imamani haqqin`, rightful Imams. Whether both of them rise or sit. And their father is better than both of them. `wa min hadhihi al-halah zaharat al-mu'jizat al-ilahiyah wa al-ayat al-bahirat al-'azimah` (And from this state, the divine miracles and the brilliant, great signs appeared). And it is because of this state that there manifested from you the divine miracles and brilliant, great signs.

This pointer that they should stand or sit, this is a bit... 'Stand' means to carry out the *qiyam* of the Imamate. In appearance, from the manifestation of the Imamate, whether they perform *qiyam* or whether they do not perform *qiyam* in appearance from the Imamate. So not performing *qiyam* from the Imamate means... I mean, in Imamate... among the people. Ah, in appearance. Yes. In appearance, whether they claim their Imamate or not.
