After that, hearing. *wa nuran fi basari* (and light in my sight). *wa nuran fi lisani* (and light in my tongue). *wa nuran fi sha'ri* (and light in my hair). *wa nuran fi...* skin... *wa nuran fi lahmi, nuran fi dami, nuran fi 'izami, wa nuran fi 'asabi*. (light in my flesh, light in my blood, light in my bones, and light in my nerves). How many? Twelve. Yes. One... ten. Three... ten. Three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten. Yes. After ten, there are seventeen. The seven of `nur` are also there, right? Yes. *nuran min bayna yadayya* (light from between my two hands). Two hands... in front. *wa nuran min khalfi* (and light from behind me). Behind. *bayna yadayya* means in front. In front of the hands... meaning in front. And behind. *nuran 'an yamini* (light on my right). *nuran 'an shimali* (light on my left). On my right side... on my left side. `nur` above, below. *nuran fi qabri* (light in my grave). Seven. Seventeen. The one with seventeen... the number seventeen. In which... ten are there and these seven. And as for... 720 years, 1000 years... 720 years it has to stay. By that time, from above, things will fall from below. When things ascend from below, things will fall from above. And they remain in the earth for a long time. Bones... their explanation has not been given. The portions of bones... thin bones. `Busr` is what? Nerves and veins have remained. `Izam` are hard bones. They remain on the earth for a long time. For a long period. Due to their hardness and their strength. Because of its hardness and its strength. Then they dissolve little by little. And they become vapor... subtle and refined. They dissolve, a little after a little. And they become vapor, subtle and refined. Then they ascend to the mixture, the tempered mixture... they ascend towards the mixture, the tempered mixture. `Mizaj` means fire, air, water, soil... And it pours down... from the parts of the earth... and it solidifies into sapphire... and pearls... and `lulu`. So they solidify... into sapphire and... into pearls. `Lulu` means pearls... `lulu` and `marjan`. So this... the first stage of purification is even before going to the planets, in the form of rain on earth, their purification begins. This... this is for the bones. For the body too, as it was explained at the beginning, that first there are rains, then vapors are formed, then after that they ascend into the planets. They ascend to the planets. And it pours as rain... it rains. Towards the seas... the oceans. The oceans. And... good caves. In the caves and... parts of the earth... so they solidify into sapphire... sapphire... and `lulu`. `Lulu`. And they become... they become... divided... for whom is this? For them... those who are good. The good people. Two kinds were mentioned. One are the masters of gnosis, the second are those of a lesser rank. But all are good people. Whose end was good. And they are... they are divided... towards the crowns of kings... the crown. And to the treasures... their treasures. And to the hands of... people, with their hands. Who are honored. Such things... ordinary soil, stones are not formed, rather they form in such places where they are valued, they are honored. And to the necks of maidens... in the necks... in the necks of... of women... as a necklace. And all of this... this entire thing is from divine providence. It is not from something else. From divine providence and His management. And from His management. And its placing of every thing... of every thing from that in its proper, worthy place. Providence, which is a magnet, pulls every thing and places it where it is worthy. And they always remain preserved, honored, and glorified... beloved among the creatures. Among the creatures. The beloved among all the creatures. Learned among them... and the ignorant... whether he is a learned person or ignorant. All creatures, learned among them and the ignorant. In it what is written? In my book... there is a printing mistake. The entirety of creation, learned among them and the inorant. Whether they are learned or ignorant. And the friend (`wali`) or the one who denies (`munkoo`). For a period of time. For some time. Until the time of its return. Until the time of its return. Until the time of its return. Then they become... in the thousand-year realm (`alam al-alfiyyah`)... a human persona. Human. And then they return... then they return towards the soil... `sahih`... and they ascend little by little, until they manifest in the thousand-year realms. In the thousand-year realms... `shakhsan insaniyya` (a human person). A human person. *wa takhammara min ha laha wa munfa'ala bi taba'i al-kawakib li ru'yati al-anwar al-ilahiyyah wa nazara min ha'i nafusan kal awwala.* (And it fermented from it, for it, and it was acted upon by the natures of the planets through seeing the divine lights, and from it arose souls like the first one.) And it was fermented... from them... for it... and was acted upon... by the natures of the planets... and by the gaze of divine providence... a soul like the first. And it was made ready. And it becomes a human body (`jism insani`). And the heart in it... that which has ascended... it is a portion of flesh. The flesh. And the skin. The skin. And the marrow. The marrow. And the nerves. And the veins. What is becoming the `nafs` (soul) there? The `dil` (heart) which is the `muglak`. First of all, what things does a human have? He has his `nafs`. Yes. And... `nafs`... its... what is `nafs`? `Nafs`, its `suwarat` (spiritual forms) are there, and the physical body is there. What is `zat`? What did Allah create? He created the `zawat` (essences). `Aql` (intellect). All the `uqul` (intellects) were created. All... The form of `uqul` is `zawat`. The `zat`. The `zat`... after creating the `zat`, the form of `aql` was its... its form was very high. But due to `ta'khir` (delay)... the powers that Allah had given us... the strengths he had given... we did not use them. Due to the delay in that, that `aql`... took on the rank of `nafs`. It fell. Its powers became weak. It became `nafs`. After that, in the world, the `nafs` is called `zat`, which Allah created. We have weakened it. That `aql` which was given form... in this world, when the `nafs` comes, after the `nafs` comes... it performs knowledge and action. Through knowledge and action, what is it? The choice that he was given... whether to become good or not. To use Allah's powers or not. He... through knowledge and action, he exercised his choice in the world. When he exercised knowledge and action... in that `nafs`, a form was created. It is called `surat nurani` (luminous form). The `surat nurani` which is... the form of action. That `surat nurani` is... it is above the `nafs zat`. But it is a product of the `nafs`, isn't it? It was created within the `nafs`. The `nafs`... used its choice, and by using it, acquired the right thing. So what happened? A form was created in it, a `surat nurani`. It is called `surat nurani`. This is the perfection of existence. `Surat nurani` is with the `nafs zat`. Its source is `zat`. You... are a `zat`, a `nafs`. From it, you have acquired perfections. The perfections are greater than the `nafs`. `Surat nurani`, which the `nafs` has acquired. When one passes away, that `surat nurani`... what does it do? It separates from the `nafs`. No. But it takes the `nafs` along with it. It separates from the body, but to the extent that the `nafs` has followed it, to that extent, it takes it along with it. It takes it with itself. It goes with it. Both together, what happens? They reach their `hadd 'ali` (higher limit). At the `hadd 'ali`, they reach Imam al-zaman... `Maulana al-muqaddas`'s presence. A form is prepared. How is the `haykal` (temple) prepared? From the `surat nurani` and from the `nafs`. Yes. To the extent that `Farisand-e-Imam` has commanded, the entire `haykal` becomes connected with whom? With `Farisand-e-Imam`. With `Farisand-e-Imam`, it becomes connected. After that, what remains of the body, its state is described here. What is in the remaining body? There is flesh, there are bones... flesh is there... `rag` and `resha` (veins and fibers), all these things are there. They... ascend. They rise from below. After rising... where do they reach? For them, those who... this is not the same process for the physical bodies of the wicked. This is only for the `hudud` (ranks of the hierarchy). For those pure ones whose end was good. They ascend... they go from the `mizaj muntazid` (tempered mixture)... and the rays which are there, you see... they pull them. They reach `qamar` (the moon), seven... they reach there from a place... until they find a permanent place in the `buruj` (constellations). When they find a permanent place in the `buruj`, then from there, they become successors (`khalifa`) to the ones before, and those things fall from above. And these `buruj`... when a `burj`... they make circuits from one `burj` to another, so that there is purification. To the point that... why is there purification in the `buruj`? So that from them... in every `burj`, one has to stay for 30 years. 30 years. And how many are there? Twelve `buruj`. How many years do twelve `buruj` make? 360. 360 years to go, and 360 years to return... 720 years. And from below to ascend above and from above to fall below, it takes them another 280 years. Until a thousand years are completed. A thousand years are completed. And these bones... after that, bones, the process for bones is explained separately. The bones... they remain in many places... honored and revered. After a long time, they manifest. At that time, things from above descend and become manifest. What things? Such that a thousand years pass. After the manifestation, there is its descent into the world. After the descent... in it... why is this circuit made? So that a part of that body becomes so perfected that it takes on the form of the `nafs`. During this period, a part of the body, the part that is the heart, what does it do? It takes on the form of the `nafs hissiyyah` (sensory soul). It has perfected itself. Where has it gone? It has gone into the `haykal`. `Nafs hissiyyah`... and `surat`... `haykal`... `surat nateqah`... `nateqah` (rational) is the `surat nurani`, isn't it? These two have gone into the `haykal`. Now a human has appeared in the world. When he appears in the world, what will be his `nafs`? His heart, in 720 years, or a thousand years, has taken on the form of the `nafs nateqah` (rational soul). And from below, the other parts have ascended. As for `Imam al-Muez`'s saying for `Da'i Kirmani`... the whole part of the heart... no, but a part of the heart which... which pumps blood... the center of it is... that. And other things also keep ascending. A place for the heart is made, the body is formed. Different things keep happening. One after another, things keep increasing. And in this way, he is reborn as a human in the world. But appearing in this way... if he was a believer (`mu'min`), then here too he will be a believer. If he was a denier (`muqasir`), then here too he will be a denier. If he was `ma'dhum`, then here too he will be `ma'dhum`. If he was a `da'i`, then here too a `da'i`. Just as his first... first form was, in that same form he will appear in the world. In that same... because that thing has become ingrained in him. In him... it has become ingrained. That he has to reach that same station where he had reached before. He cannot change. Except that... as they say... now what time is it? 6:30. So it is the sixth hour. The sixth hour. So the sixth hour... now it is the sixth hour. Until 7 o'clock... when it is 7 o'clock, what will happen? A new hour will begin. Until 7 o'clock strikes, at that time... 6 will keep ticking, 6:05, 6:10, 6:12, until... until it is 6:55. When it becomes 7, then we will say, now it is 7 o'clock. The limit of 6 is over. So in the same way, all these things happen. This `aql` (intellect) that Allah Ta'ala created, from that `nafs` (soul) is being formed, from that `zawat` (essences) are being formed... from `zawat`. So these other things, `ghayr dhawi al-uqul` (those without intellect) are there... stones are there... so were they also `uqul` at some point or... they were `uqul`. They were `zawat`. Allah did not create anything other than `zawat`. So their `nafs`... Just as `qalb` (heart) is... `qalb` is a physical thing. It is a physical thing, isn't it? Yes. So why did the body form? Leaving the `nafs`, why did the body form? Because it delayed. It fell behind. The human body was formed. After that, the animal body was formed. After that, then... what kind of things were formed? Snakes were formed, scorpions were formed, all these things were formed. After that, then stones were formed. All these are physical things. `Al-Lama'ana` said that Allah did not create anything other than `aql`. `Al-Lama'ana` did not create stones, did not create... So it means their `nafs`... there is still time for them to be formed. Its meaning... the `ta'khir` (delay) that happened... the delay... the period will be long for them. It will be so long that until... the entire universe is destroyed. So are they in the process of coming, or... were they bodies upon which punishment came and their souls were taken away? Due to delay. The delay that happened from them... in reaching the right thing, all those things fell. The more delay they made, the more they fell. And after the delay, some intentions were formed in them. The intentions changed. Bad intentions were formed, this happened. As they intended, their forms changed accordingly. To the point that the last one is what? `Sakhrah` (rock). Whose state became the hardest. So these... fell with us, but to this day they are stones? Yes... the part of it that... first... accepts... accepts the true thing... whose obedience one is commanded to perform, he obeys. That part, of course, by the justice of God's power, quickly... leaves... the physical world. In the `tahajjud` prayer, what do we pray? That Allah Ta'ala take us from this transient world... to the eternal world. We pray for this very reason. In this world, there are so many things. There is water, there is fire, there is stone, there is this, there is that. There are all these things. Each one... as he intended, his form changed. This is Allah's justice. And Allah did not do it, we ourselves did it. We did it to ourselves. *Al-Fatiha*.

<!-- lecture 37 -->

The two types of Ahl al-Haqq. The first type is, as they say, Ahl al-Ma'arif al-Haqiqiyya (the people of true spiritual knowledge), who are the knowers of true spiritual knowledge and divine sciences and realities, and al-'Ulum al-Ilahiyya (the divine sciences). Before this, and al-A'mal al-Saliha (and righteous deeds). They studied 'ilm (knowledge), they also performed 'amal (action), wal-Muwalat li-Jami' al-A'imma (and loyalty to all the Imams), and towards all... the duty of love which was their right, they fulfilled that right with them. Their discussion is that when they... their kasa'if (gross forms), their lata'if (subtle forms), when they leave their kasa'if, meaning when they leave their body, then what process has been described for that? That their nafs (soul), which is called dhat (essence), which is called the essence, that essence which Allah Ta'ala created in the beginning, what did Allah Ta'ala do? He created the dhawat (essences). That is the origin. All other things are after it. The Dhawat-e-Ruhaniyya (spiritual essences), the Ashbah-e-Nuraniyya (luminous forms), Allah Tabarak wa Ta'ala created them. So those dhawat, in what state were they? They were in the state of 'aql (intellect) in the world of light. In a state of 'uqul (intellects). That, which is, due to ta'khir (delay), the powers that were given to them, they did not use them. They delayed in that. What powers were given? 'Aql, hayat (life)... Hayat. The power of life, and ikhtiyar (choice). At the end, ikhtiyar (choice). The freedom that was given to them, whether to go this way or that way, they did not use it correctly. So what happened to the 'aql? It underwent tanazzul (descent). It became responsible for its own descent. Who is responsible for the 'aql (intellect) becoming a nafs (soul)? Every person themselves. Yes? The essence itself. Yes? The essence itself. He himself is responsible. Every person whom Allah gave choice is responsible because he did not fulfill his responsibility. And that thing fell from above to below due to delay. It took the form of the nafs. The dhawat became the nafs. 'Aql became nafs. Now what? The nafs has to become 'aql. 'Aql-e-Ruhaniyya (spiritual intellect). The first form is to return to one's homeland (watan) and to attain the blessings (ne'mat) and lights (anwar) of the homeland. This is the purpose. Now what happened? The nafs was formed. And the other things within it fell further. What happened? It became a jism (body). The body fell further, so what happened? Different shapes of the body were formed. Some remained in the place of the brain, some in the place of the heart, some in the place of the feet, some in the place of the soles. And they fell further, so what happened? They became haywanat (animals). And they fell further, so what happened? They became nabatat (plants). And they fell further, so what happened? Ma'diniyyat (minerals). All these things. From the luminous world. The ta'khir (delay), because of whom did it happen? Because of oneself. One is responsible for it, for the delay. He did not use his ikhtiyar (choice) in the correct way. After coming into the world, he was born from a mother and father. After being born, what did he do? The discussion is about those who took the 'ahd-e-shari'at (covenant of the shari'ah), obeyed it, and performed good deeds and studied 'ilm (knowledge). Their discussion is in this chapter, and in the chapter before this, which was read yesterday. So what is the discussion about them? That when their nafs separates from them, separates from the body, then what happens? Their nafs, the ikhtiyar (choice) that God's power gave it, it used it throughout its life. It acquired 'ilm and 'amal. From 'ilm and 'amal, that nafs created a form. It is called nafs-e-natiqa (the rational soul) or surat-e-nuraniyya (the luminous form). That nafs, which is, that surat-e-nuraniyya, is the original thing. That nafs-e-natiqa, what does it do? It pulls its nafs towards itself. And both of them separate from its body. What are those two things? The nafs-e-natiqa... its surat-e-nuraniyya is called nafs-e-natiqa, and its nafs. Someone's is so high that the nafs-e-hissiyya (sensory soul) also separates, and the nafs-e-namiyya (vegetative soul) also goes with it. That also happens. And then there are stages (madarij) to it. But he is explaining a general form, that the nafs-e-hissiyya separates from it. After separating, where do both of them go? To hadd-e-'ali (the highest limit). What happens there at the hadd-e-'ali? They merge with its surat-e-ruhaniyya (spiritual form), they are mumazij (commingled). And they are mujawir (adjacent) to its nafs-e-hissiyya. Adjacent to the nafs-e-hissiyya and commingled with its surat-e-ruhaniyya. Meaning, they merge, they both become one. And then when he passes away, the higher ones, passing through stages, a complete gathering (ijtima'-e-kulli) happens at the Bab-e-Zahir (the Outer Gate). Who is the Bab-e-Zahir? The bab (gate) of the twelve jaziras (islands/regions). A complete gathering happens there. When the Bab-e-Zahir passes away, where do they reach? At the Bab-e-Batin (the Inner Gate). Where is the Bab-e-Batin? In the presence of the Imam, 'alayhi al-salat wa al-salam. There, all the things of the jaziras are gathered. What things are being gathered in the presence? Nufus (souls) and suwarat-e-ruhaniyya (spiritual forms). Nufus are being gathered, suwarat-e-ruhaniyya are being gathered at the Bab-e-Batin. There, they go and become attached (munsalik) to them. And during this time, what is happening? These people who passed away, their nufus-e-namiyya (vegetative souls) were buried in the grave. Within three days, those things progress. They become vapors and progress. So where do they progress? The rays of the moon pull them, and their safa'i (purification) happens, their tahdhib (refinement) happens, their tasfiya (purification) happens, meaning, their purification happens. They are purified. Then they descend back towards the moon. And then they descend into the world. What thing descends? The nufus-e-namiyya. The whole process. The rihiyyat (essences) descend. They all descend. They descend onto something that fire, water, air... that fire does not touch. They descend onto such things. After descending, the Imam and his wife consume those things. And from that, from consuming those rihiyyat, the farzand-e-Imam (son of the Imam), the future Imam who is to be, is born. This process should be kept in mind. That where the surat (form) goes, where the nafs-e-hissiyya (sensory soul) goes, where the nafs-e-namiyya (vegetative soul) goes, what the process is, what the process of all other things is. And when the Bab al... when the Imam's father appoints (nass) the son, with the appointment, the Bab al-Abwab (Gate of Gates) with his entire haykal (structure), in which there are... what are there? Surat-e-ruhaniyya (spiritual forms) and in which there are nufus-e-hissiyya (sensory souls). Of the entire world. They all come and gather where? In the haykal of the farzand-e-Imam. Its haykal is formed. It becomes part of that haykal. The Imam's body is called nasut, and this is called lahut. What is in the nasut? Rihiyyat (essences). And in the lahut, in the lahut what is there? Nufus-e-hissiyya and suwarat-e-ruhaniyya. The gathering of all these things. After this, what remains is his body. In the body, there are high things, low things. So its... what has been explained about its position? First, which is, its veins, its flesh, its skin, and fine bones, which are ground up, they all rise as vapors. And after rising, where do they reach? The moon, the rays of the moon pull it. Passing through, they reach the buruj (zodiacal constellations). How many buruj are there? 12 buruj. It passes through 12 buruj. In each burj, how much time do they stay? 30 years. In each burj, 30 years. 12 buruj means 360 years. And 360 years... they traverse the entire buruj, then return to their place, so 360 more years pass. 720 years pass. After 720 years, from the remaining 1000, how many are left? 280. The remaining 280 years are spent in ascending and descending. When they descend, and when they ascend there, then their... so what do they do? Their previous things descend, they end there. As long as their journey continues in the buruj, until that time, they appoint someone as a khalifa (successor). They make someone their khalifa there. And then within a thousand years, they descend into the world. From the same mother and father from whom he had emerged before. And then what is the condition? If he was a mu'min (believer), there are degrees of a mu'min. Whichever degree he was in, his qiyam (station) will be in that same degree. If he was a mukasir, then mukasir. If he was a ma'dhun, then ma'dhun. If he was a da'i, then da'i. Whichever degree it was, his station will be at that same degree. He will appear in that degree, his qiyam will be in that degree. And with him, the only difference is... what does the difference become? In 1000 years, what does the difference become? His dam-e-qirmizi (red blood/heart), his heart, which is, changes into the form of the nafs. Because where did his nafs-e-hissiyya go? With the Imam. With the Imam. So now his new nafs-e-hissiyya that is prepared, how is it prepared? It doesn't come from the previous one, but rather... from the buruj. In the buruj, his heart is purified, its purification happens. And that, which is, undergoes tabaddul ba-nafs (transformation into a soul). It becomes a soul. And that soul, which is, now it makes its qiyam (station) as a mudabbir (governor) of its body. It becomes the mudabbir. So this process will always, always remain. And when the Qa'im, 'alayhi al-salat wa al-salam, appears, it is a vast ocean... when he gathers all the Imams, then that person's first nafs-e-hissiyya, what will it become? It will become the qa'id (leader) of all of them, it will become their Imam. Just as it happened here, so it will... So this process is explained. And after that, what is said? That his nafs-e-hissiyya, his qalb (heart) will become nafs-e-hissiyya. So who will take the place of the qalb? Kabid (liver), then 'aynan (the two eyes). The process is explained. Every... every karra (cycle)... it's called a karra. Every thousand-year cycle is a karra. In a karra, one by one, things are purified, one by one things are purified. And what is said? That the mu'min who is, and in whom there is no... the major evils of the shari'ah are not present. He is mustaqim al-sayr (of upright conduct). This term is used, mustaqim al-sayr. Of correct conduct. The purification of a mustaqim al-sayr happens in how many karrat? 360 karrat. In 360 karrat... he says, in 360 karrat, his entire body becomes pure. What does it mean for the whole body to become pure? The sole of the foot reaches the station of the heart. And a mustajib (respondent), a naqid (critic), remains at the station of the Prophet's knee. Meaning, this many of his things are purified in these 360 karrat. There is a great condition of mustaqim al-sayr in this. Meaning, from whom no such sin has occurred which is gravely haram (forbidden), for which... it is haram for him. The things that were prayed for (manaji)... he does not make his qiyam with them. The condition of mustaqim al-sayr is explained. This entire process is explained. Before this, this same process... because there are several types in it. One type is those who make their qiyam with a'mal-e-saliha (righteous deeds), with ma'arif-e-haqiqi (true knowledge), and with 'ulum-e-ilahiyya (divine sciences). And with righteous progeny (wiladat-e-saliha). And after that, which is, their condition is described, that what happens... [unclear]. Yes? Center of the jazira, miqat. They have to reach there. They have to reach there. Then there... Bismillah al-Rahman al-Rahim. Al-Fasl al-Thani min al-Bab al-Thalith min Bab al-Thalith min Bab al-Thalith (The Second Section of the Third Chapter...). wa 'inda ittisal... wa 'inda kamal hadhihi al-ashkhas wa bulughiha al-hulm, tud'a fa-tujibu wa yu'khadhu 'alayha al-'ahd al-karim. (And upon the perfection of these forms and their reaching maturity, they are called and they respond, and the noble covenant is taken from them). So near the perfection of these forms... which forms are being discussed? Those that descended from the heavens, came from the buruj into the world. They descended from the buruj and came into the world. Those forms are being discussed. wa bulughiha al-hulm (and their reaching maturity). And their reaching puberty, youth. tud'a (they are called). They will be called. They will be called and they will accept. wa yu'khadhu 'alayha al-'ahd al-karim (and the noble covenant is taken from them). And the noble covenant will be taken from them. wa tartaqi fi al-rutub al-diniyya wa ma'arif al-haqiqiyya (and they ascend in the religious ranks and true knowledge). And he will progress in the religious ranks. And they will progress in religious ranks and true knowledge. shay'an ba'da shay'in fi qalilin ba'da qalilin, min ghayri an yudakhilaha shakkun aw ta'taridaha... wa la ya'ridu laha shubhatun. (thing after thing, in a little after a little, without any doubt entering them or... or any uncertainty presenting itself to them). Without any doubt entering them. Or any uncertainty presenting itself. They will be on certainty because their first karra was on certainty. So now when they appear in the second karra, that which is called jini... it is said... that once a point is created, that point cannot be destroyed. What has Allah Ta'ala said? That for good deeds, the reward is ten times. For evil deeds, the reward is one time. A good deed, once established, cannot be destroyed. A good deed is to remain. Evil can be destroyed. A good deed can never be destroyed. A person has done a good deed, its reward remains for him forever. bal takunu jariyatan... (rather, they will be flowing...) The Ahl al-Ilahiyya, Ahl al-Ma'arif al-Haqiqiyya, their discussion is here. Their purification has already happened. The discussion is about them. That such people, when such people come... what happens? They come down from the buruj. wa la ya'ridu laha shubhatun (and no uncertainty presents itself to them), because they had already established certainty before. Doubt will not be created. bal takunu jariyatan fi misrab al-su'ud (rather, they will be flowing in the channel of ascent), rather they will be flowing in the ladder of ascent... salimatan min al-'awa'iq wa al-dawajin ila an yablugha ma laha an tablugha wa mablaghaha al-'azim wa al-maqam al-karim 'inda kawniha wa dhuhuriha bi-mithli ibtida'iha, la qusura laha 'an dhalik al-mablagh wa la nufudha laha 'anhu bal li-kulli wahidin bulughu rutbatihi allati kanat... salimatan min al-'awa'iq (safe from obstacles). Safe from obstacles and from... to push away. From obstacles, from hindrances. To push away, meaning no one can push them away. No one can stop them. Until they reach that which is for them. What is for them to reach. And that is their great destination, as they were in their first manifestation. There is no deficiency for them from that destination. Sayyidna 'Ali ibn Husayn used to say that all the points in that kawr (era/cycle)... in that kawr, all the people who are going to become mu'min... their point is present with the Sayyid al-Ida'iyya. The point. It has not manifested. The point is present. All the ranks, their manifestation is with the Sayyid al-Ida'iyya. All of them in that kawr. All those who are going to manifest. Because the kawr is the mudabbir (governor). The manifestation of that point is remaining. Manifestation is remaining. It has not appeared. But the point is present with him. Just as we have many things in our homes, but one reveals one thing at a time. Then in the next era, he reveals another thing. Similarly, when the time for its manifestation comes, then the measures of the Sayyid al-Ida'iyya are enacted, and in whichever era it has to manifest, it manifests in that era. Its point. Because they are the mudabbir of the entire kawr. Who? The Sayyid al-Ida'iyya. And similarly, he who is the mudabbir of the mawr (sub-cycle), what things are gathered with him? Of the entire mawr. In the entire mawr, all the points of those who are going to progress are gathered with him. And he who is the first Sayyid al-Ida'iyya, and Adam al-Ibda'i... what is with them? With them are all those who are going to progress. All their points are present with Adam al-Ibda'i. fa al-babu ya'udu baban wa al-hujjatu ya'udu hujjatan wa da'i al-balagh ya'udu da'i al-balagh wa da'i al-mutlaq ya'udu da'i al-mutlaqan wa al-mahdud mahdudan wa al-ma'dhun al-mutlaq ma'dhun al-mutlaqan wa al-mahsura mahsuran wa al-mu'min al-baligh mu'minan balighan wa al-mustajib mustajiban wa kullun 'ala halatihi al-ula la ya'duha wa in balagha fi al-'ilm fawqa ma kana balaghahu khadiman. (So the Bab returns as a Bab, and the Hujja returns as a Hujja, and the Da'i al-Balagh returns as a Da'i al-Balagh, and the Da'i al-Mutlaq returns as a Da'i al-Mutlaq, and the Mahdud as Mahdud, and the Ma'dhun al-Mutlaq as Ma'dhun al-Mutlaq, and the Mahsur as Mahsur, and the accomplished believer as an accomplished believer, and the respondent as a respondent, and each upon his first state, he does not transgress it, even if he reaches in knowledge above what he had reached as a servant). And each thing upon its first state, it does not transgress it, even if it reaches in knowledge above what it had reached before. wa qad kana balaghahu... pas la su'uda lahu 'an tilka al-rutbati abadan (and indeed he had reached it... so there is no ascent for him from that rank ever). So there is no ascent for him from that rank ever. I asked Sayyidna Yusuf Najmuddin... they said, "Look, at 6 o'clock..." I had mentioned... what time is it? 6 o'clock. 6th hour. We will call it the 6th hour. Until, as it happens, if it becomes 6:25, 6:30, 6:35, 6:40... all this will be called the 6th hour. Except if it becomes 6:59. After 6:59, the 7th hour begins. Now it is the 7th hour. So the kharq-e-maratib (breaching of ranks) that happens, it does not happen in ordinary forms. The speaker is mentioning that. Kharq-e-maratib means going from one rank to another... the interval is great. Yes? wa al-mahsura mahsuran (*And the Mahsur as Mahsur*). Yes? wa al-ma'dhun al-mutlaq ma'dhun al-mutlaqan (*and the Ma'dhun al-Mutlaq as Ma'dhun al-Mutlaq*). The Mahsur will become Mahsur, he says. And the Ma'dhun al-Mutlaq will become Ma'dhun al-Mutlaq. For everyone. In every degree he was in before, he will come in that degree. wa in balagha fi al-'ilm fawqa ma qad kana balaghahu (even if he reaches in knowledge above what he had indeed reached before). Even if in this karra he has acquired knowledge that is more than before, still he will be established in that same degree. Kharq-e-'adat is possible. For example, a mu'min has ten degrees. A mu'min is in the first degree. Then he appears. So what will happen? It is possible he will come into the second degree, but he is a mu'min. The degree is of a mu'min. Then, after he traverses ten degrees, then he will go and set foot in the degree of a mukasir. And to traverse those ten degrees, it is possible he has to come in ten karrat. The details are not mentioned. wa la yazaluna kadhalika... (and they will not cease to be thus...). A degree or two degrees. He has said this. A degree, or two degrees. For this mu'min. For whom is `darajatayn` (two degrees) mentioned? For a shahid (martyr). Yes. But in those ten ranks, he cannot breach them. He was a Bab with the Sayyid al-Ida'iyya before, so here he will be a Bab. He is saying this. But progressions are in their own place. The example of 6 o'clock and the 6th hour and the 7th hour. The 7th hour cannot be established until all 60 minutes of the ranks are traversed. Yes? wa la yazaluna kadhalika kulla waqtin hatta yusaffa nafsun wa sa'adat ila al-mustafa, inba'atha fi jismiha al-mutakhallif nafsun ukhra bi-tadbir al-mudabbirat wa nazr min al-ayat al-ilahiyyat. (And they will not cease to be thus at every moment until a soul is purified and ascends to the Chosen One, there is sent forth in its remaining body another soul by the governance of the governors and a glance from the divine signs.) wa tilka al-nafs al-munba'ithatu 'adwun min a'da'i dhalika al-jism. (And that soul which is sent forth is a member from the members of that body). And that soul which is sent forth is a member from the members of that body. Meaning, in place of the nafs, who takes its place? He explained it. It becomes worthy of ascent. `darajatan aw darajatayn` (a degree or two degrees) he mentioned. Sometimes what happens? For the shuhada' (martyrs), their heart and their liver, both become nafs. For the martyrs who are martyred, this is their state. wa tilka al-nafs al-munba'ithatu 'adwun (and that soul which is sent forth is a member). It is one member. From the members of that body. qad istahaqqa al-su'ud (it has become worthy of ascent). It has become worthy of ascent. fa-yundharu ilayhi wa yu'na bihi hatta yustakhraja minhu nafsan 'ala mithali dhalika al-jism. (So it is looked upon and cared for until a soul is extracted from it in the likeness of that body). So it is looked at and cared for until a soul is extracted from it, from the spiritual essence which is appropriate for it, fa-yakunani dhatun wahidatan 'ala ma sabaqa bihi al-qawl. (so they become a single essence according to what the word has preceded). So they both become one essence, as the saying has preceded. wa ha'ula'i hum alladhina 'arrada 'anhum al-kitab al-karim bi-qawlihi ta'ala, qad aflaha al-mu'minun, alladhina hum fi salatihim khashi'un, wa alladhina hum 'an al-laghwi mu'ridun, wa alladhina hum li al-zakati fa'ilun, wa alladhina hum li furujihim hafidun, illa 'ala azwajihim aw ma malakat aymanuhum fa-innahum ghayru malumin. fa-man ibtagha wara'a dhalika fa-ula'ika hum al-'adun. (And these are they to whom the Noble Book alluded with His saying, Exalted is He: "Successful indeed are the believers, who are humble in their prayers, and who turn away from vain speech, and who are active in deeds of charity, and who guard their chastity, except from their wives or what their right hands possess, for then they are not to be blamed. But whoever seeks beyond that, then those are the transgressors.") And these are all those people... such that the Scripture has alluded to... that success is for those believers... those who perform their prayers with humility. `buniyat al-salatu 'ala arba'ati as-humin` (Prayer is founded upon four pillars). Prayer is founded upon four pillars/shares. What is as-hum? Sahmun, share. On four shares/pillars. The four pillars of prayer. First is al-wudu' (ablution). Wudu', then al-ruku' (bowing), al-sujud (prostration), al-khushu' (humility). Prayer is founded on four things. Wudu', ruku', sujud, and khushu'. What does khushu' mean? That when a person prays, at the very least, the first degree of khushu' is that whatever he recites, its meaning is in his mind. What is he reciting? What is he supplicating to Allah Ta'ala for? This is its first degree. alladhina hum fi salatihim khashi'un. And such people who turn away from vain talk. And such people who give zakat. And such people who guard their private parts, except from their wives or what their right hands possess. aw ma malakat aymanuhum (or what their right hands possess) refers to slave girls. fa-innahum ghayru malumin (for then they are not to be blamed). So they are not to be blamed. fa-man ibtagha wara'a dhalika fa-ula'ika hum al-'adun (But whoever seeks beyond that, then those are the transgressors). And the person who seeks beyond this... those are the people who transgress. wa innama balaghu hadhihi al-mabaligh al-sharifa... fa-lam yakun lahum an yukhalifu shay'an mimma intadhama fi hadhihi al-aya. (And they only reached these noble stations... so it was not for them to oppose anything of what is contained in this verse). And when they reached these noble stations... it is for whom? If they had opposed anything... from what is contained in this verse. In this verse, the things which have been commanded to do and not to do, those who take care of this, they reach these stations. That a part of their body becomes a soul. This is about them. The nafs is not formed for them, they go into quarantine. He is saying the same. Those who protect this verse, this is for them. Those who did not reach these noble stations... And when they did reach these noble stations... the station that they reached, the nafs was created for them. For whom? It was not for them to oppose... idh hiya simatuhum fi al-dhahir wa al-batin la simata li-ghayrihim. (as it is their mark, in the outward and the inward, there is no mark for others). Because this is their sign, in the outward and the inward. There is no sign for anyone other than them. This is the state of mustaqim al-sayr. Mustaqim al-sayr he has said, no such thing should be there which the shari'ah has strictly forbidden. Drinking alcohol... and adultery, and all these bad things. ja'alana allahu mimman khussa bi-hadhihi al-simat wa la 'adala bina 'anhum... (May Allah make us among those who are distinguished by these marks, and may He not turn us away from them). The word 'adala has several meanings in Arabic. 'Adala means justice, and 'adala also means 'he turned away'. This is also a meaning. Make us, O Allah, among those who are distinguished by these signs and do not turn us away from them, by the right of the Prophet and his pure family, and may Allah's blessings be upon all of them. Yes? wa la 'adala bina 'anhum. Bismillah al-Rahman al-Rahim. [unclear]

<!-- lecture 38 -->

Bismillah al-Rahman al-Rahim. The Fifth Chapter. And they gave precedence to the statement on the *ma'ad* (hereafter/return) of the two types of the People of Truth (*Ahl al-Haqq*). And they applied the statement to the *ma'ad* of the *sulaha'* (righteous ones) from among the *Ahl al-Zahir* (people of the outward/literal).

Yes, *zarabayn*. What does *zarabayn* mean? Two examples. Two. So what is the method? How is it... *zarabayn*. *zarabayn*. Added. *Zarabun*: a type. *Zaraban*: two types. This is in the nominative case (*pesh ki halat*). And in the accusative and genitive cases (*zabar aur zer ki halat*), what is it? *Zarabayn*. Now, since here what is it? Is it the genitive case or the accusative case? Genitive case. Genitive case. Why? It is *mudaf*. It is *mudaf ilayh* (the object of a possessive construction). It is *mudaf ilayh*. *Zarabayn*. *Ma'ad zarabayni Ahl al-Haqq*. The *ma'ad* of the two types of the People of Truth (*Ahl al-Haqq*). So this is *mudaf ilayh*. It is the *mudaf ilayh* of *ma'ad*. And *Ahl*, *Ahl al-Haqq*, is its *mudaf*.

...and when all... when it was given precedence... all... it was given precedence... it was given precedence, the statement... on the *ma'ad*... on the two examples of the people of truth... the two... of the two types of the people of truth... on the two types... so they take that statement to the *ma'ad* of the *sulaha'* from the *Ahl al-Zahir*, from the outward ones. The statement of the *suraha'* (explicit ones). Those people from among the *Ahl al-Zahir* who hold on to the outward matter. *Mawaddat* (love) has not entered them, nor *ita'at* (obedience), but they follow the outward rulings (*ahkam*). The statement is regarding them. So we say... That is, it's not in the Hadith Sharif. It is in the Hadith Sharif. A good end (*khatima bil-khayr*). They follow the outward rulings. For them. They believe in the Prophet of the *Shari'ah*. And... well, they follow the Islamic rulings. For them.

This includes the *Ahl al-Tashayyu'* (Shi'a) as well. Yes, they all are included, whoever they may be. Whoever it is. There is *wilayah*, isn't there? Yes? There is *wilayah*. Whose *wilayah* is it? It is only of the Prophet. They have the *wilayah* of Ali. After that, the chain of command (*hukm*) was broken for them. But what is it? They don't trouble anyone, they are not... It's a path of universal peace (*sulh-e-kul*). Their mention is here. The *sulaha'*. *Ma'ad sulaha'* (the hereafter of the righteous).

Indeed, the chaste, virtuous, pure man from the People of the Outward (*Ahl al-Zahir*) who establishes the pillars of Islam, who has no enmity towards anyone from the People of Truth (*Ahl al-Haqq*), and no... *ghaylatan*. *ghayla*. No, no... *wa la ghayla*. *wa 'aylatun* is written. It should be *'alayhi*. Huh? *wa la 'aliyyatan*. They haven't done the research (*tahqiq*) on this word. Let me see it for a moment, let me explain it properly, then it will be known. Or rather, they have put a *zer* (vowel marking 'i'), a small *zer*. *Wa la ghilatan*. Then *ghulut* will become *lam-waw*. *ghayl*. Meaning its... enmity... *ghayl* can mean enmity. We will have to look it up. *Wa la ghilatan*. *Wa la ghilatan*. And no hypocrisy (*nifaq*). And no injustice (*zulm*) towards anyone among the people. And no falsehood (*mayn*). And no lying (*kidzb*). And no betrayal (*khiyanah*). *Khiyanah*... *wa la khiyanah*. This *khiyanah* is finished. The one who is adherent (*al-multazim*) to the *wilayah* of the *Natiq* (speaker/prophet) of the era and his *Wasi* (legatee/successor), and whoever recognizes from among their pure progeny...

Their mention is here. So we say that a man who is chaste (*'afif*), and virtuous (*khayyir*), pure (*tahir*), meaning he is pious. Indeed, the chaste man (*inna al-rajul al-'afif*), one with continence (*'iffat*), who has not been involved in fornication and bad deeds. Indeed, the chaste man (*inna al-rajul al-'afif*). A chaste, pious person. *Al-khayyir*: the one who is good, who does good. *Al-tahir*: the pure one. From the *Ahl al-Zahir*. The one who establishes the pillars of Islam. The one who establishes the pillars of Islam. It is not so that there is enmity towards... with whom? With anyone from the *Ahl al-Haqq*. From the *Ahl al-Haqq*. The one who holds enmity towards the *Ahl al-Haqq* is not him.

And no rancor (*wa la ghilatan*). And no... hypocrisy. ... no hypocrisy. What is... there is. And there is no hypocrisy. No hypocrisy, and no injustice towards anyone from the people. And no falsehood (*mayn*). And there is no... *mayn* also has the same meaning. Enmity. Enmity. And no lying (*wa la kidzb*), and no... betrayal. And no betrayal for anyone. And no betrayal (*wa la khiyanata*). It ends here. And no betrayal. And what? *Al-multazim* (the adherent), the one who adheres... The one who is attached to the *wilayah* of the *Natiq* of the era and his *Wasi*. And his successor. Meaning, he believes in the *Natiq* of the era, has *wilayah* for him, and has *wilayah* for his *Wasi* as well. The rulings of the Prophet that... the outward rulings that have reached him, and he has *wilayah* for the *Wasi*. And whoever recognized his progeny, from the progeny of those two, who are pure. As many as they recognize. [unclear] until the eleventh. In Sunnism, there are many such individuals who accept the *Wasi* from the sayings of the Prophet. And... Muhammad Husayn Sahib, what was his name? Mir Sahib, Mir Sahib who used to teach. Hmm. When he... in our *majlis*... he used to come, we used to hear him speak. He would always say, "The true religion is this." And whoever recognized... and their pure progeny... progeny of the pure ones. The pure progeny (*awlad al-tahirin*). From the pure progeny (*awlad al-tahirin*). It is *tahirin* here. Yes, *tahirin*. *tahirin*. And few is the existence of that. And few is the existence of that. And very few... and very little is their existence. Such people are very few, he says. For indeed he... For indeed he, when he is steadfast on that... when he is steadfast on that, and his death approaches, the spiritualities (*ruhaniyaat*) of the sun and Venus move him. *mawt* (death) is the subject (*fa'il*). *Mawtuhu*. The death approached. *Harrakathu*. *harrakathu*. The spiritualities of the sun and Venus move him. Who is the subject of *harrakathu*? The spiritualities. The spiritualities. *hu* is the object (*maf'ul*). *Harrakat hu*. They give motion to him. Who gives? The spiritualities of the sun and Venus.

So when... so when he is steadfast in that condition... meaning, his end is in that condition. He took from the Hadith Sharif and did not have gnosis (*ma'rifat*) of the Imam of the time. So for him... his death approached. His death approaches and the spiritualities of the sun and Venus move him. And his soul (*nafs*) spreads in his body. And his heat becomes cold and his blood freezes. He is separated from... he is separated from that which he had conceptualized of good deeds that he used to do. And he leaves behind... that which he had conceptualized. He... of good deeds... such as he used to do. He used to do. Meaning Allah the Exalted... *naqir* and *qitmir* (terms for the smallest specks), whatever a person... any person does good, whether he is a believer or a hypocrite, or even if a disbeliever does a good deed, Allah the Exalted does not let it go to waste. He keeps it. Good is never destroyed.

Evil (*sharr*) is what is destroyed. *Al-sharru la asla lahu fi al-ibda'* (Evil has no root in the primordial creation). In reality. Evil, in its creation, has no root. Because what was there, was good. And what is evil called? Distance from good. As much as... what is light called... what is darkness (*zulmat*) called? Being far from light (*nur*). The farther you go from light, the more darkness increases. If you stay close to the light, you will get some light. If you go farther from it, then it will get even farther until darkness comes. That's why it's said, *Al-sharru la asla lahu fi al-ibda'*. Evil, in its creation, has no root. It did not happen there. It is created because of you. Corporeality (*jismaniyyat*), in which there is density (*kasafat*), why was it created? It was created because of us. It was not there. In Sindh, I was teaching a lesson on these truths (*haqa'iq*). So he said that Allah created... He created them in such a way, created them luminous, created them in such a way. So when Allah Miyan created them, where were we at that time? We were... where were we?

Hazrat, this saying of our Imams, that... without *wilayah*, if someone... prays day and night in the Haram Sharif, and sits between the door of the Ka'bah and the Maqam, even then no thing is accepted. Meaning, here Allah the Exalted is giving the reward (*ajr*) for every thing. And there, the Imams' saying is that no thing is accepted. That no thing... That is, without the love of Ali, there will be no salvation (*khalasi*) for you. Here too, what... but this is also a principle, that good (*khayr*) can never become non-existent (*kal-'adam*). This principle is also established. And good can never become non-existent. Evil will become non-existent. If you have done even a small good deed, it cannot become non-existent. It is something that remains. So this... this principle is... yes... *Inna al-hasanat yudhhibna al-sayyi'at* (Indeed, good deeds do away with misdeeds). *Hasanat* (good deeds) eliminate *sayyi'at* (misdeeds). That is also there. No, you are saying that without the *wilayah* of Ali, how can it be? If a person spoke the truth, but does not have the *wilayah* of Ali. He spoke the truth. Having the *wilayah* of Ali is a separate issue. With that, his end will not be good (*khatima bil-khayr*), he will not be able to cross the *Pulsirat*. That is a different matter. But the good deed he has done, its reward will surely be given. It will pull him towards itself, towards the *wilayah* of the *Wali*, in the end. It is something that pulls him towards itself, that takes him. Now, the mention is of those people who did not have enmity towards Ali, who... who... there are many people who do not have enmity towards Ali. They accept the Prophet, they accept Ali. That is also the case. But they have not done such deeds that are forbidden (*haram*) or against the *Shari'ah*. They have not shown enmity towards Ali. They don't have enmity towards Ali either. They love them, they love them. There are such people too. So now, those who love them, they have such... things have reached them, that's why they love them. But they practice universal peace (*sulh-e-kul*). So what will be their end? So the point is that their soul (*nafs*) will spread in their body.

What is a... a... the... this is a sign of not being able to cross the *Pulsirat*. The kafir's soul also spreads in the body. His body also spreads. *wa tabrudu...* Yes, but this is... this is for those who are in Barzakh, it happens in Barzakh. Their return (*wapas*) will be quick. There will be a difference. And he is separated from that which he had conceptualized... But what will happen? He will leave it... What is it? That which is his conception of good deeds separates from him. It becomes a luminous form (*surat-e-nurani*). As he used to do. There are many people who distribute among the poor, do this, do that. They do not hold enmity. They do not hold enmity towards the *Ahl al-Haqq*. And they don't have enmity with Ali, they don't have enmity with the Imams. They go about their own work. So the reward for their good deeds will surely be given to them. This is the point.

And what he preserves of the Book of Allah, and love for His Messenger and his Wasi, peace be upon him, and mercy for the children of his kind, and chastity and purity, and modesty and shame, and fear of Allah the Exalted. And that which was protected by him, he had memorized the book of Allah. And love for His Messenger. Allah's book, they remember it. What do they do? With *tajwid*... they recite with *tajwid*, they memorize it, they become *hafiz*. That is not something that will go to waste. And love for His Messenger. Love for His Messenger. And his *Wasi*. And mercy for the children of his kind. And رحمت for the children of his kind. His own... on humans, he looks with a gaze of mercy. For them. And chastity and purity... and purity. And there is modesty and shame. And fear of Allah the Exalted. And fear of Allah the Exalted. And that concept ascends... that concept ascends with the spiritualities (*ruhaniyaat*) of the moon... *fa'il* (subject) will be there, right? And that concept ascends with those spiritualities to the moon. And that concept will ascend... that concept... with those spiritualities... towards the moon. And it becomes with it... those spiritualities, which spiritualities are they? The spiritualities of the sun and Venus, it was mentioned above. The angels that are appointed to the sun, appointed to Venus. With them, that concept goes towards the moon. And it becomes with it... with it (*'indahu*). The moon. *wa yasiru 'inda...* yes, yes... with him... with her. The moon is masculine. Masculine. So it should be written *'indahu*. Yes, *'indahu*. So it should be *'indahu*. Then it becomes with him. Or if it refers to the spiritualities, then... it should be with her (*'indaha*). There, what is... then it is. And it is... The sun and Venus are both feminine. No, it hasn't reached there yet. Hasn't reached yet? It hasn't reached? Look here. With those spiritualities... with the moon. With those spiritualities, to the moon. They go towards the moon. And it becomes with it... so if it is from the spiritualities, then *'indaha* should be taken. If it is the moon, then it should be *'indahu*.

So they become with him. So they become with him, there at the moon. It should be *'indahu*. Then it hands it over to the sun. It will be handed over... who will hand it over? The moon will hand it over. Yes, then it hands over... *tusallimu*. *thumma yusallimu*. ...to the sun. Then it hands over... I will make a copy... then it hands it over to the sun. Then the moon hands it over to the sun... to him. It hands him over... that concept. Who? Towards the moon it goes. Yes, then that moon hands over that concept... towards the sun. Towards the sun. And it enters its sphere. And it enters... in its heat... in its sphere. In its sphere. And it ferments it... and it ferments it and purifies/perfects it. And it remains there... and it remains there until Allah the Exalted gives permission... until Allah the Exalted gives permission for it... for the return... for the return. And that... and that body... In the moon, nothing is happening. Whatever is happening is in the sun. The purification and... is in the sun. And Venus hasn't come yet. Yes, no. ...the spiritualities of Venus, with them, it goes to the moon. The spiritualities take it away, from the sun and Venus. I am saying, if it is explained in detail somewhere else, then we can see there. And that body dissolves, bit by bit. And that body dissolves, bit by bit. And that body... the concept has gone. What remains is the body. That body dissolves, a little after a little. This... the permission to return, whose return is it? Of the concept. It is of the concept.

Until its permission for return is given... that is, of that concept. For that concept, the command for return is given. Now, where does the return happen? He will explain later. He is explaining the state of the body. And that body dissolves, a little after a little. And it ascends as vapor. Then it ascends as vapor. And it enters the temperament and the mixture. And it reaches... it reaches the temperament and the mixture. And it dissolves as rain. And it becomes rain. And it becomes a thing by means of edible things, the pure ones... and drinks... of the pure ones and drinks that are sweet. And smells... and smells that are fragrant. And it is nourished by humans. And it appears as a sperm-drop. And... and it dissolves as rain. It becomes rain. And it reaches towards a thing... towards a thing, from edibles... in foods and drinks... in things that are pure. And... and in drinks that are eaten... that are sweet. And in things that are smelled... things that are smelled... that are fragrant. that are fragrant. And... and it obtains nourishment... and a human obtains nourishment from it. A human obtains nourishment from it. And it appears as a sperm-drop. And it appears as a sperm-drop. And it ascends through the ranks. And it ascends through the ranks until it appears as a person. And it progresses through the ranks. And it progresses through the ranks until it appears as a person. And at its exit from its mother's womb... from its mother's womb... that form connects with it. That form. Then, near its exit from its mother's womb... from its mother's womb... that form connects with it. Such as was in the sun from that concept by means of Venus and the moon. Such as was... such as was in the sun... with the sensory soul... this concept is also obtained by it. Because with the exit from the womb, the sensory soul is given to a person. The vegetative soul, where is it found? When the sperm-drop is formed. Where does the vegetative soul reside? Sun... moon, moon. In the moon. The sensory soul is in the sun. The station (*maqar*) of the vegetative soul is the moon. Before he was born, where was the vegetative soul? In the moon. The sensory soul? In the sun. When... when the sperm-drop is placed in the mother's womb, the vegetative soul connects to it from the sphere of the moon. When the birth happens in the world, the sensory soul's connection with it is from where? From the sun. Now this one... the concept... at its exit... near its exit from... by human... who is meant by human? His parents. If the parents are believers... No, it could be any human. If he still has a connection with his parents, then that could also be. He can come into the world and choose the truth. There is no restriction on him here. Human. Any human. And it appears as a sperm-drop. And it progresses through the ranks until it appears as a person. And at its exit from its mother's womb, that form connects with it. The form. A form connects with it. Such as was in the sun, from that concept. By means of Venus and the moon.

And that body dissolves, bit by bit, meaning the process of the body is that it all happens through this... it's the same... it's the same process... No, the body's matter... the process will remain the same, won't it? The dissolution of the body that occurs, in what way does it occur? He has not explained the details here. He just said it enters the temperament and the mixture. It resides in fire, air, water, and earth. From there, it becomes rain and falls, he has said. The mention of going into the *buruj* (celestial spheres) is not mentioned here. The mention of going into the *buruj* is not mentioned here. Venus and the moon are a path... and it is completed by the sun. The *buruj* are above that. The *buruj* are above Venus and the moon. There... The first sphere is what? The sphere of the encompassing (*falak-e-muhit*). Yes. First, there is the world of lights (*'alam-e-anwar*). Then, the world of lights, then the sphere of life (*falak-e-hayat*). The world of life. Then after that, the sphere of the encompassing. And from the sphere of the encompassing, what is it? Where does materiality (*maddiyyat*) begin? From the sphere of the encompassing. From the sphere of the encompassing, and above that, there is no materiality. Materiality... it is also materiality, but it is of what kind? Illusory (*wahmi*). Materiality is illusory. After the sphere of the encompassing, there is the sphere of the *buruj* (zodiacal constellations), in which materiality is greater. Then after that, Saturn, Jupiter, Mars, Venus, Mercury, Moon. The seven stars. After that.

And there also connects with it from the sensory soul what it deserved to be connected with. And... and it connects... and what connects... with that concept... what is... what is it... with that concept. Yes. And it connects with that... with that sensory soul... And it connects with his... his... and his... the sensory soul. And they both mingle... and they both mingle... and they both mingle, meaning the sense and the... the concept... the form. The sensory soul and its form. And they both mingle, his sensory soul... Then... they both mingle... who are the two? The two are what? His sensory soul. What are the two things? One is the concept. The form and the sensory soul. And they both mingle, his sensory soul, such as was in his body... then they both mingle, that sensory soul, such as was in his body... Now the body which dissolved, bit by bit, in it, the sensory soul that remained... the sensory soul and the vegetative soul which did not progress, which remained in his body, which was dissolving, that and the concept and its... this sensory soul that remains... that both of them mingle. The sensory soul, where was it with the body? So that with the existence of the soul, he could... the punishment, a little bit that was supposed to be, he could experience it. On his body. And the remaining sensory soul became pure. That... both of them come and mingle. The first one's sensory soul... a little bit that remained. Sensory soul here means the vegetative soul, perhaps he has taken it as such. What is it? The vegetative soul which remained.

And they and it become one thing. And they... and they and it... become one thing. And sometimes... and sometimes nothing of the sensory soul connects with it except that concept. But sometimes it happens that nothing connects with it... from the sense... from the sensory soul, except that concept. And upon the measure of... upon the measure of the concept is the will for it... upon the measure of the will, there is for it the design and planning of Allah the Exalted. The design and planning. Allah the Exalted... from it some sensory... were... flaws have arisen. In the body, it was present with it. What... what has been told? That when a person's concept... of the *du'at-e-kiram*, the concept of the pious ones becomes elevated, then with it their sensory soul also goes. Some people are of the opinion that the faculties of the brains... the faculties of the brain, the power of the brain, that also ascends with them. It develops. Meaning, its... according to the grave. To the extent that he has controlled himself upon the rulings of the *Shari'ah*. It is said, the faculties of the brain, the powers of the brain, they also go. And the vegetative soul also ascends completely. Now, it depends on the person. With someone, the vegetative soul remains. Whatever portion remained. It's possible that a little of the sensory soul has ascended. It's possible that some remnant of the sensory soul has remained with the body. Due to which the punishments of the grave are upon it. All these things. As the person is, as his planning will be in life, according to that, he will get his recompense. Now here, two types are being mentioned. Some people are such that for them... with their body... with their body... the sensory soul is not found. The body ascends. So what is... what is found with it? It comes and... the first one's... and then this second sensory soul, which is to be found, that is also found.

And his soul spreads in his body. Okay, where did we read this? ...according to what that person deserves. And on the measure... which that person deserved... because for the... because the scale of justice is established. The scale of justice is established. And for his purity... for his purity and what is in it of good deeds... and due to his purity and what is in it of good deeds, that concept returned to him... it returned to him... that concept... such as... such as it had separated, by his state... separated from it, from a state... in a state of death... from a state... such as he was upon it at the separation from his body... his body. ...at the separation from his body. And greater... and greater, and more glorious, and more noble... and due to his purity and what good deeds were in it... a person returns... that concept returns to him... the concept. Such as he had separated... from it... from a state of death... from a state more... which would be greater than his first state. The concept that went, that concept... where did it go? It went to the sun, it was purified, this happened, that happened. Now, when the concept returned to him, it did not return as the concept it was before, but it returned in a state that was greater and more purified. Yes. Yes, like the fermenting. It's still not mentioning the *natiqah* (rational soul). Not yet, not yet. Still... still, in this return too, there is no... Only... the concept. The concept is there... and it is the initial form of the *nafs-e-natiqah*. The concept. ...such as he was upon it at the separation... It returns greater. When he separates from his body... greater... which Allah took his soul and his body... and greater, and more glorious, and more noble. For that is a type of reward. For that is a type of reward. Like the one who travels, leaving... his abode... his family. And establishes... a traveler... in exile... until he earns... wealth. Then he returns with this state, more abundant than the first state. That person who... leaves behind... leaves behind his abode, his family... and... and remains a traveler... stays like a traveler... in exile... until he earns wealth. Then he returns... in such a state which is more abundant than his first state. A traveler is going, this one's body also traveled to the sun. And after traveling to the sun, what happened? From there, he brought some wealth. The wealth which is... after making an effort, he brought wealth from there. Then he returns... a state... in his first state... which is more abundant than his first state.

And the concept of... and the concept of one other than him... from the disobedient and the rebellious... from the disobedient and the rebellious, at its separation... at its separation from his body and his soul by death, there is no return for it... there is no return for it to them ever... rather, the one who travels from his family and his abode... and his beloved... and does not intend to return... and does not want to return to them at all. ...according to what his hands have put forth. And the concept... and the concept of one other than him... of the disobedient, from the sinners and the rebellious... from the disobedient and the rebellious... at the time of its separation from his body and his soul... and from his soul, at death, which is... their concept and their soul... the soul is... what is the saying? Their... that concept... that concept's... its... its return... to those two, ever. To those two, meaning his body and soul. Yes. Body and soul. It is God's mercy. Like the one who travels... that person who travels from his family... from his family, from his abode, and from his beloved... and does not return... and does not want... and does not intend... and does not intend to return to them ever. He does not return. One has to leave everything. And that is a type of punishment. And that is one type of punishment. It is one type. It is one type. We seek refuge in Allah from His punishment. May Allah protect us from His punishment. And the evil of its consequence. And from its evil consequence. And praise be to Allah who has favored us over many of His servants. What's written in it? ...what... I'll make another copy later. Okay. And all praise is for that Allah who has given us فضیلت over many... many of his servants. ...over many of his servants... from His *awliya'* (saints). And He made us among those who adhere to the *awliya'*. And the people of guidance. And blessings of Allah be upon His Messenger, Sayyidna Muhammad, and his pure family and peace.

Al-Fatiha.

<!-- lecture 39 -->

Bismillah al-Rahman al-Rahim. The fourth chapter of Siraj al-Thalith gathers five sections, the first section of which... The fourth chapter, from the third Siraj, which gathers five sections, the first section of it. `Wa lamma intaha bina al-qawl ila ma intaha wa awzaha'na` (And when the speech brought us to that which it reached, and we had clarified). `ma sabaqa min al-izah`... When our speech was completed, towards its completion, and we clarified... No. `Wa lamma intaha bina al-qawl...` (And when the speech brought us...). Meaning, when the speech brought us to that thing to which it brought it. And we clarified... and we clarified `ma sabaqa min al-izah` (what preceded from the clarification), whatever preceded from clarifying... `intiqal al-awliya wa taraqqihim` (the transition of the `awliya` and their progress) `wa intihaihim fi abwab al-jinaan` (and their arrival at the gates of paradise), and their arrival at the gates of paradise. `Thumma tawfiyat al-sulaha min ahl al-zahir` (Then the fulfillment of the righteous from the people of the manifest). Then the fulfillment of the righteous from the people of the manifest. `Wa nuridu an nutbi'a dhalik al-kalam 'ala al-azdad` (And we intend to have that speech followed by [a discussion] on the opposites). And we intend to... bring after it the opposite speech upon the opposites (`azdad`). Now, we have described the `bulughat`, we have described the `mumineen` (believers), then we have described the `sulaha` (righteous). Now we are coming to the `azdad` (opposites). `Wa nuridu an nutbi'a dhalik al-kalam 'ala al-azdad` (And we intend to have that speech followed by [a discussion] on the opposites). And we intend to bring that speech after, upon the opposites. `wa ma yantahuna ilayhi min qawm al-fasad` (and what the people of corruption arrive at). And to which the people of corruption arrive. `wa ma yasiruna ilayhi min 'adhab wa sharr al-khwab` (and what they proceed towards of torment and the evil of dreams). And what reaches them of... and what they arrive at, those... the opposites... `azdad`... from torment and the evil of dreams. `Fa naqulu bi-'awnillah ta'ala wa ma tawallihi fi ardih salamullahi 'alayhi. Inna al-mawt idha ja'a wahidan minhum, harrakahu hina'idhin sar al-jawzahar al-zulmani al-falaki alladhi huwa al-'uqdatan li-annahuma al-mighnatis lil-khabith wal-khasis` (So we say with the help of God Almighty and what His `wali` undertakes in His land, peace of God be upon him: Verily, when death comes to one of them, it is moved at that time by the flowing of the dark, celestial `jawzahar`, which is the two nodes, for they are the magnet for the wicked and the vile). So we say with the help of God and what their `wali` undertakes, in their land, God's peace be upon them, that verily, death, when it comes to any one of them... `Ja'a` is a past tense form. Past tense. But when `idha` comes, it takes on the meaning of the present-future. `Lam`... when it comes, it comes upon the present tense, `lam`. But when `lam` comes upon the present tense, its meaning becomes past tense. When `idha` comes upon the past tense, its meaning becomes present-future. This is Arabic. `Inna al-mawt idha ja'a wahidan minhum` (Verily, when death comes to one of them). When death comes to any one of them, `harrakahu` (it moves him)... this is for the `azdad`. `harrakahu hina'idhin` (it moves him at that time). It gives motion to him... it gives motion to him at that time. `sar al-jawzahar al-zulmani` (the flowing of the dark `jawzahar`). The moving... the moving `jawzahar-e-zulmani` from the celestial sphere. The `jawzahar` that has been placed below the celestial sphere of the moon. Which are they? The `'uqdatan` (two nodes). `Ras` and `dhanab` (head and tail). `Ras`... `harrakahu` (it moves him). It gives motion to him. The `jawzahar` gives motion to that one person. To that `zidd` (opposite). At that time. What gives motion? `Sar al-jawzahar...` (the flowing of the `jawzahar`...). The flowing of the substances of the dark `jawzahar`. `Sari`... The atmosphere... `sari` meaning "flowing," "that which flows," "that which is in motion." Here, the meaning of `sari` is taken as `hawa` (air), `jaw` (atmosphere). No, not `jaw`. `Sari`, `sara`. `Sari` means "flowing." The atmosphere. `Sara`, `sara`, meaning `sarab al-layl` (the mirage of the night). Here, `jawzahar-e-zulmani` is in the `maful` case, isn't it? The doer is... No, this is `mudaf` (possessed), `mudaf` (possessor). `sar al-jawzahar al-zulmani al-falaki` (the flowing of the dark, celestial `jawzahar`). It gives motion. Who gives motion? What flows from the `jawzahar`. For the `mumineen` (believers), what is there? And for good people, what is there? `'Umud al-nur` (pillar of light). From where? It is that which comes from `aql-e-awwal` (the First Intellect). `'Umud al-nur`. `'Umud al-nur`. What is its connection? The connection of `'umud al-nur`? `bayn al-mubdi' wal-mubda'i kalima` (Between the Originator and the originated is a word). The `kalima` is between the `mubdi`' and the `mubda'`. The `kalima` of `la ilaha illallah`. Its connection is with that. With `'umud al-nur`. The connection of `'umud al-nur`... The `mubdi' ta'ala` (the Exalted Originator), its connection is with the `aql-e-awwal`. And wherever anyone establishes his connection with that `'umud al-nur`... you have clarified it very well in the section on `'umud al-nur`... he is connected to every person who is on the `ahd-e-sharif` (noble covenant). The connection of `'umud al-nur` is established with him. That is called `'umud al-nur`. In opposition to it, God Almighty has established `jawzahar-e-zulmani al-falaki` (the dark, celestial `jawzahar`). It is `taht-e-falak-e-qamar` (beneath the celestial sphere of the moon). Why was it given such a high place? It did not come into the `sakhra` (rock). It is not related to the `sakhra`, but rather remained above. Because it is made from the `ajza` (parts) of such people who were elevated but who started the... but then ended in `khabasat` (wickedness). So for them, this is `'adlan min Allah ta'ala` (justice from God Almighty). They were placed beneath the celestial sphere of the moon. They were not made to reach the `sakhra`. And remaining there, they carry out all their `tadabir` (ploys). The `jawzahar-e-zulmani`. In opposition to `'umud al-nur` is the `jawzahar-e-zulmani`. One is `'umud al-nur`. Its opposite. The `jawzahar-e-zulmani al-falaki`. This is also `wahmi` (imaginary/conceptual). The `'uqdatan` are also `wahmi`. The substance is `wahmi`. `'Umud al-nur` is also `wahmi`. It starts, doesn't it? The substance starts. Below that... yet, it is called `wahmi`. They are called `wahmi` `'uqdatan` (nodes). It is as if they are both `'uqda` (nodes). One is `ras` (head), one is `dhanab` (tail). Is `ras` more `khabith` (wicked) or is `dhanab` more `khabith`? `dhanab`. `dhanab` is more `khabith`. There are only two things. Either your `ittisal` (connection) is with `'umud al-nur`... if not... The connection of the `mumineen`. Those who are `ashab-e-khair` (people of good), whose end was good, their `ittisal` is with `'umud al-nur`. Those whose end was not good, their `ittisal`... with this `jawzahar-e-zulmani`. So here, if... if one is not on `'umud al-nur`, then automatically, they go there. They go there, to `jawzahar-e-zulmani`. There's no... space in between. `Sari` can also be taken to mean `quwwat` (force). The force of `jawzahar-e-zulmani al-falaki` pulls them. Just as they are both nodes... `li-annahuma` (because they both)... because they are both magnets for the `khabith` (wicked) and the `khasis` (vile). For the `khabith` and the `khasis`. `Fa-yashi'u nafsuhu fi jismihi` (And his soul spreads in his body), and their soul spreads in their body, `wa yajmudu damuhu` (and his blood freezes), and their blood freezes `fa-yabrud` (and it becomes cold). And `wa yasiru nafsuhu wa jismuhu shay'an wahidan` (and his soul and his body become a single thing). And his soul and his body become a single thing. The dark form pulls. `zulmani falaki`... The `jawzahar-e-zulmani al-falaki` pulls. All the wicked forms are gathered there. It is doing its work. The work of the `jawzahar-e-zulmani` is to put the soul into the body. No. It pulls it. It pulls it. No, it's not the word for pulling here. Magnet. `Sar`, `sar al-jawzahar`. `Harrakahu` (it moves him). It gives motion at that time, `sar...` It has been explained previously that after giving motion, his body... his soul spreads into his body. That is its effect. Its effect is that the soul spreads into the body. The soul spreading into the body, what is that? The body... what is true `taraqqi` (progress)? The body becoming soul, that is `taraqqi`. And the soul becoming body, that is `tanazzul` (decline). The `nafs` (soul) is a higher thing, it goes and gets trapped in `maddiyat` (materiality). And the `nafs`'s... essentially, what is the thing? What did God create? `Aql` (intellect). The initial description, it is the most important description. God Almighty created intellects. We, because of our `ta'khir` (falling behind), turned that `aql` into `nafs`. And with further `ta'khir`, the `nafs` turned into `jism` (body), into `maddiyat`. And then `maddiyat` has many types. There is `jism-e-insani` (human body), `jism-e-haywani` (animal body), and `jism-e-nabatati` (plant body), other forms. As a person falls, `maddiyat` increases accordingly. `wa yasiru nafsuhu wa jismuhu shay'an wahidan` (and his soul and his body become a single thing). Until now, the soul was separate, its body was separate. But now what happens? It becomes... his soul... his soul and his body become a single thing. `wa yastahilu ba'duhu ba'dan` (and one part of it is transformed into another). And it wants that its parts be transformed from its other parts. `wa yufariqu ma kana qad tasawwarahu min 'ulum al-zulmaniya al-muhlika` (And it separates from what it had conceived of the dark, destructive sciences). And they leave those two, whatever his conception was from the dark, destructive sciences... `Yufariquhuma` (the two separate). Meaning, the soul and the body separate. Three things. One is the `jism` (body)... `nafs`... a soul. One `surat` (form). The `surat-e-zulmani` (dark form), three things. The soul and the body fall apart. The `surat`, the form that he had created from his knowledge and actions, separates from it. Just as the knowledge... a good knowledge or a bad knowledge. And this is a bad knowledge. So the bad knowledge, the conception he had, that dark conception separates. That is what is stated. `wa yufariquhuma` (and the two separate). And those two separate from... who are those two? The soul and body. The soul and the body. From what he had conceived of it, from the dark sciences, which are destructive. `wa ma tasawwarahu fi ahl al-haqq min al-kufr` (and what he had conceived about the people of truth of disbelief). `wa ma akannahu lahum min al-'adawati wal-baghda'i wal-nukr` (and what he had concealed for them of enmity, hatred, and aversion). And what he had concealed for them... for the people of truth... of enmity, and of hatred, and of aversion. The disliked matters. For them, meaning for the people of truth. Yes. `lahum`, meaning for the people of truth. What he concealed... he concealed that conception of them. For those people of truth.
