They don't go into good stones, like the stones of a mosque, the stones of the Ka'bah; all those are excluded. They go into those when ascending. And when descending, they enter bad things.

*wa fi jumlatil-qawl, inna li-kulli darkin min hadhil-adraki sab'una naw'an* (And in summary, for each *darak* of these *adrak*, there are seventy types). And in summary, for every *darak* from these *adrak*, there are seventy types. 70 types. *sab'ina qamisan wa sab'ina naw'an* (seventy shirts and seventy types). Seventy shirts and seventy types. He is explaining clearly. 4900.

So Mawla, this... 4900 types they pass through.

This mineral state and so on, which are fallen things, they have come in two ways. One is that while falling, their intentions were so bad that they became stones. And the second is that they ascended and then fell. Many people are such that they return from one *darak*. Some from two *darak*, some from three *darak*. Understand? Some people return from seven *darak*. After seven *darak*, some people are such that they reach the punishment of the *a'raf*. Their return is from there. According to that, he is saying here that there are 70, 70... 7 x 7 is 49. 4900 levels. There are types. There are 70 shirts. Meaning in one *darak*, there are 4900 manifestations. He is saying this. And from them, there are 70 types. Meaning in one shirt, there are 70 types. 70 x 70. In every shirt there are 70 types, 70 *naw'*. 70 types. In every shirt, there are 70 types. In one *darak*, among those *adrak*, there are 70 types. *Naw'* means kinds. 70 kinds. In one *darak*, there are 70 shirts. Then in every *darak*... there are seven *darak*. In every *darak*, there are 70 shirts. And 4900. No, in one *darak*... I am talking about one *darak*, not seven. In one *darak*, there are 70 types. And in each *darak* there are 4900 types. In one *darak* there are 70 types. There are 70 shirts. In every shirt there are 70 types. *Qamis* means... a different garment. Meaning one animal to another animal. Stages, grades.

And the *qamis* is considered one type. For example, he said... What *darak* is it? For example, the *darak* of the birds of the land and sea. This is one *darak*. Inside it, there are 70 shirts.

*wa billahi ta'ala wa bi-jami'i ikhwanina min dhalika bi-haqqi Muhammadin wa alihit-tahirin, salawatullahi 'alayhim ajma'in* (And with Allah Ta'ala, and for all our brethren from that, by the right of Muhammad and his pure progeny, the blessings of Allah be upon them all). By Allah we seek refuge. Allah, and all our brethren, by the right of Muhammad and his pure progeny, the blessings of Allah be upon them all. In the shari'ah, the animals whose meat is forbidden, it is forbidden for this reason, that they are in the descending *darak*. They are in punishment. And those who are ascending, eating them is permissible. That is why.

We seek refuge... Allah... all our brethren... from these matters by the right of Muhammad and his pure progeny.

*al-fasluth-thani minal-babil-khamis fis-suradiqith-thalith* (The second section of the fifth chapter, regarding the third pavilion). The third section of the fifth chapter. Second section of the fifth chapter, from the third pavilion. *thumma innahu yughmadu ba'da dhalika bi-azdadi al-maqamat al-ilahiyyah wa al-rusul wal-anbiya, fa tunfa ila arba' al-ard al-kharijah min haddil-i'tidal, allati hiya ghayr maskunatin* (Then after that, he is immersed with the opposites of the divine stations, and the messengers and the prophets, and they are exiled to the four corners of the earth which are outside the boundary of moderation, which are uninhabited). Then he is made to enter after that, with the opposites of the divine stations, the messengers and the prophets. Then he is sent, then he is sent towards the four corners of the earth, which are outside the boundary of moderation. Where the climate is extreme. *allati hiya ghayru maskunatin* (which are uninhabited). Such that they are uninhabited. *li-anna biha ahwalan 'azimatan* (because in them are great horrors). Because there are great and dire calamities there. Because there are great calamities there and great difficulties. *ahadaha nahiyatush-shimal* (one of them is the northern region). One of them is the northern region. It is the direction of the north. The northern part. Such that it is the place of the star *Jady*. And it is a land that is frozen, dark, shadowy, frightening, terrifying, dark. The sun is absent from it... The sun is absent from it for six months. For six months, the sun does not rise there. *wa biha yunsabbu barduz-zamharir* (and in it is poured the cold of the *zamharir*). And there... is poured the intense cold of the *zamharir*. *Al-mujmidul-murhiqu al-muharriqu* (the freezing, the exhausting, the burning). The one that freezes, the one that annihilates, the one that burns.

*Zamharir* is a wind. It's a mist. The intense mist of cold. The real one is *shams*... *zamharir* is the mist of cold. And *asir* is the mist of heat. *Zamharir* is the mist of cold. *wa biha kawnu azdadi maqamati 'alayhimus-salam fi hayawanatin hayilatin kas-sukhuri al-jamidati* (and in it is the existence of the opposites of the stations of the Imams, peace be upon them, in terrifying animals like frozen mountains). And in it is the existence of the opposites of the stations of the Imams, peace be upon them, in terrifying animals, like frozen mountains that are frozen. And the animals there are, they are sent there, that they seem like a frozen mountain. *la hiraka fiha ghayra harakatir-ra'ashi min shiddatil-bardi wal-yubsi* (there is no movement in them except the movement of shivering from the intensity of the cold and dryness). There is no movement in them except the movement of shivering. Resembling minerals. From the intensity of cold and dryness. And it is being punished by the cold of *zamharir*. There is no sensation in them... Yes, but there is sensation. This is a form of an animal. A mountain. It's a rock in the shape of an animal. Now all the... who have gone into the mineral stage, there is no sensation in them. But here, sensation has been created again, without which it wouldn't work. It is being punished, right? It is being punished by the cold of *zamharir*. Here, only the *mutakallifin* and great enemies reach this punishment in the periphery. Otherwise, most just return from the seventh *darak*.

*wa hiya mu'azzabatun bi-bardiz-zamharir, muta'allimatun bi-bardihil-lafi'i li-ghayatil-'alam* (and it is being punished by the cold of the *zamharir*, pained by its piercing cold to the utmost degree of pain). Pained by the piercing cold. Being given pain by the piercing cold, to the utmost degree of pain. *'alimatun bima hiya fihi min 'alimil-'azabi wa shadidil-'iqab* (knowing what it is in of painful punishment and severe chastisement). Knowing what it is in of painful punishment and severe chastisement. The northern part.

*thumma nahiyatul-junubi, wa hiya madarus-suhayl* (Then the southern region, and it is the orbit of Suhayl [Canopus]). And then the southern region, which is the orbit of the star Suhayl. And it is day there for a full six months. *wa biha yunsabbu hararatul-asir* (And in it is poured the heat of the *asir*). And there is poured the heat of the *asir*. The heat of the *asir*. *Asir* is the sphere of fire. *wa hiyal-harul-muharriqatu wa sumumul-muhliqatu* (and it is the burning heat and the annihilating poison-winds). And it is a burning fire and poisonous winds that are annihilating. *wa biha 'azabu azdadi ar-rusuli wal-anbiya'i fi hayawanatin kibarin shuwaihatil-khalqi ka-amthalil-jibali la hawasun laha zahiratun, bal tuhissu bima sihiya min 'azimil-'azabi wa 'azimil-'iqabi* (And in it is the punishment of the opposites of the messengers and the prophets, in large animals of ugly creation like mountains, with no apparent senses, but rather they sense the great punishment and great chastisement they are in). First, what was said? The opposites of the *mutakallifin*? In the first, in the north, the opposites of the stations of the Imams. Of the Imams. Opposites of the stations of the Imams. And here they are saying... Opposites of the *mutakallifin*. No, no... The opposites of the messengers and prophets. Shumal has the opposites of the Imams... and the south has the opposites of the messengers and prophets. And in it is the punishment of the opposites of the messengers and prophets in large animals of evil creation, as tall as mountains. They have no apparent senses, but they feel the great punishment and great chastisement they are in. And their assistants.

And there is the punishment of the opposites of the messengers and prophets. And their learned ones, who are rebellious against the messengers and prophets, who spread enmity against them. In animals that are terrifying, smaller than those animals, stationed on those mountains, that are established on those mountains. They do not descend to the earth, nor do they turn from it to the right or to the north. As if they are shackled, chained, pained by the severity of the intensity of the punishment and chastisement they are in, knowing what they are in of punishment and severe chastisement. Knowing what pain they are receiving, from what sin they have received it.

*thumma nahiyatush-sharqi minal-ard min haythu tatlu'ush-shams, wa hiya jibalun shamihatun wa'iratun 'aliyatun takadu tubuluhu thuraha ila kurratil-asir* (Then the eastern region of the earth from where the sun rises, and it has lofty, impassable, high mountains whose peaks almost reach the sphere of the *asir*). And then the eastern region of the earth, from where the sun rises. And it has lofty mountains, which are impassable, high, whose peaks almost reach the sphere of fire. They are so high that they are somewhat close to the sphere of fire. *wa fiha 'azabu a'wani azdad al-rusul wal-anbiya'* (and in it is the punishment of the assistants of the opposites of the messengers and the prophets). And in it is the punishment of the assistants of the opposites of the messengers and the prophets, and the learned ones. Who are rebellious against the messengers and the prophets, the ones who spread enmity against them. In animals that are terrifying, smaller than those animals.

*thumma nahiyatud-duburi wa hiya maghribush-shams* (Then the western region, and it is the setting place of the sun). Then, the direction of the west. And it is the place where the sun sets. And in it is a sea, dark, terrifying, vast, turbulent, and it is called the Sea of the Jinn. Its waves are like mountains. This Pacific Ocean is what it is. Its waves are like mountains. *biha 'azabu a'wani azdadi al-maqamati 'alayhimus-salam* (In it is the punishment of the assistants of the opposites of the stations, peace be upon them). And in it is the punishment of the assistants of the opposites of the stations of the Imams, peace be upon them. And their learned ones... No, the punishment is lighter for the assistants. Assistants. Here it is the assistants. North and south. Yes. Assistants. North has the opposites of the *maqamat*. And in the south are the opposites of the *rusul*. And in the east are the assistants of the opposites of the *rusul*. And in the west are the assistants of the opposites of the *maqamat*. *wa fihi 'azabu a'wani azdadi al-maqamat 'alayhimus-salam, wa 'ulama'ihim al-muzkharrifin lin-nasi al-qawla wal-balaghata wa qad 'adu hayawanatin mutashakilatan qara fi qa'ri dhalikal-bahri ya'kulu ba'duhum ba'dan wa yasulu ba'duhum 'ala ba'din ashadda al-'azabi wa a'zama al-'iqabi, 'alimin bima hum fihi min dhalikal-'azab* (And in it is the punishment of the assistants of the opposites of the stations, peace be upon them, and their learned ones who embellish speech and rhetoric for the people. And they have returned as misshapen animals in the depths of that sea, eating one another and attacking one another with the most severe punishment and greatest chastisement, knowing the punishment they are in). They have returned as animals, misshapen, in the depths of that sea. They eat each other and they attack, some of them upon others, with the most severe punishment and the greatest chastisement, knowing what punishment they are in.

*wa kullama istawfa ahlu kulli nahiyatin min hadhihin-nawahil-arba'i 'azaba tilkal-'ida ila nahiyatin min hadhihin-nawahil-arba'i hatta yakulu 'azabuha fi jami'in-nawahi, 'azanaAllahu wa jami'a ikhwanina min dhalika bi-haqqi Muhammadin wa alihit-tahirin* (And whenever the people of each region from these four regions complete the punishment of that period, they are returned to another region from these four regions until their punishment is in all the regions. May Allah protect us and all our brethren from that, by the right of Muhammad and his pure progeny). And all of them complete, the people of... When the people of one side complete... from these four regions, the punishment of that side... the four regions... they are returned to one side from these four regions, from one region. Meaning, from one place to another, they are turned. The punishment is in all four regions. The punishment is not on one side, but they keep turning in all four regions. The punishment of the periphery is in all four directions. When the people of one side complete from these four regions... until they complete the punishment of those regions... northern, the soul is turned, then to the southern punishment, then to the eastern, then to the western punishment. May Allah protect us and all our brethren from that.

*wa hadha hakikatu qawli Sayyidina al-Mu'ayyadi, 'ala Allahu qudsuhu, fis-sab'in min majalisihi al-hikmati minal-mi'atil-ula haythu qala: wa man mada 'ala ghayri hadhihin-nisbati zallat 'anil-markazin-nurani qadamuhu wa inqata'at 'an wilayati awliya'illahi ta'ala 'ala qadr 'uluwwi martabatihi wa sumuwwi ismuhu* (And this is the reality of the saying of our master al-Mu'ayyad, may Allah sanctify his soul, in the seventieth of his Majalis al-Hikmah from the first hundred, where he said: And whoever proceeds upon other than this proportion, his foot has slipped from the luminous center, and his connection to the *wilayah* of the friends of Allah Ta'ala is severed, according to the loftiness of his rank and the exaltation of his name). And this is the reality of the saying of Sayyidna Mu'ayyad, may the sanctity of Sayyidna Mu'ayyad be exalted, in his 70th Majalis, from his hundred Majalis, from the first hundred of the 70th Majalis, where you said, "And whoever has passed, whoever has passed upon other than this proportion, then he has slipped, then his feet have slipped from the luminous center, and it has been cut off from the *wilayah* of the Friends of Allah Ta'ala, his hold. *fa sara mun'akisan, taratan fi mukaqasati harral-asiri wa taratan bi-bardiz-zamhariri wa taratan fil-ghutati fi qa'ril-buhuri* (And so he became inverted, at times in the afflictions of the heat of the *asir*, and at times in the cold of the *zamharir*, and at times plunging into the depths of the seas). So he became inverted, sometimes in the calamities of the heat of the *asir*, and sometimes in the cold of the *zamharir*, and sometimes in passing through the depths of the seas. *intalaqu ila zillin dhi thalathi shu'abin la zalilin wa la yughni min al-lahab* (they proceed to a shadow with three branches, neither cooling nor availing against the flame). They walk until in the darkness of three branches, three branches, which is of three branches. There is no shade there, and they are not free from the flame of the fire. *wa la yazaluna kadhalika fi hadhal-'azabi ila ayyamil-ba'thi fi zillin dhi thalathi shu'abin* (And they do not cease to be thus in this punishment until the days of resurrection in a shadow with three branches). And they always remain in this same punishment. They pass from one punishment to the three-branched punishment. In the peripheries. There, above, it was mentioned that what is it? Yes, it is the same. The three valleys. The length, breadth, and depth.

*wa huwa al-'azabul-adna ila an ya'udu ila rub'il-maskuni ila an taquma al-qiyamah 'ala dhikrihis-salam* (And it is the nearer punishment until they return to the inhabited quarter, until the Resurrection is established, upon its mention be peace). And it is the nearer punishment. For a time, until the Resurrection is established. Until the establishment of the Resurrection. *'ala dhikrihis-salam* (upon its mention be peace). Upon whose mention is peace. *thumma 'uidu ilar-rub'il-maskuni* (Then they are returned to the inhabited quarter). After that, they are returned to the inhabited quarter. From these four peripheries, they emerge and come to where there is no habitation, and from there they are brought to such places where there is habitation for humans. *Rub' al-maskun* means where in that quarter, in that one-fourth part, where humans live. They are brought there. In the west. No, they are turned back. From the four peripheries, they are taken out and brought into the population of the world. They are brought there.

*thumma 'uidu ilar-rub'il-maskuni alladhi huwa lahum fi janbi dhalik jannatun wa jannatun bil-mizaji wal-muntaziji ila an yazharu bi-'alamatil-alfiyyati wa yuhzaruna bayna yadayhi lil-hisabi, fa yustaqbaluna bil-'azabil-akbari* (Then they are returned to the inhabited quarter, which for them, in comparison to that, is a garden and a paradise, through the temperament and the mixture, until they appear with the signs of the millennium and are brought before Him for the accounting, and then they are met with the greater punishment). Then they are brought to the inhabited quarter. In such a way that it is, for them, in comparison to the four peripheries, a paradise. How are they brought? Through temperament and mixture. Rain falls, and wind blows. Until they appear with the signs of the millennium. And they are brought before you for the accounting. They are brought. And then they are met with the greater punishment. So far, whatever there was, it was the nearer punishment. Seven levels and the punishment of the four peripheries. This is the nearer punishment. Now comes the turn of the greater punishment. *'azanallahu minhum* (May Allah protect us from them). *'azanallahu minhum bi-haqqi Muhammadin wa alihit-tahirin* (May Allah protect us from them by the right of Muhammad and his pure progeny). By Allah we seek refuge from this matter.

<!-- lecture 44 -->

From the fifth chapter of *Futuh*, from this book, `fa amma'l-atba'u min al-umud wa'l-ra'aya` (as for the followers from the pillars and the subjects). `atba'`. `fa amma'l-atba'u min al-umud wa'l-ra'aya` (as for the followers from the pillars and the subjects). To follow. Following. `Atba'`, followers, those who accept. `fa amma'l-atba'u min al-umud wa'l-ra'aya` (as for the followers from the pillars and the subjects). `fa minhum man ya'udu min ba'di'l-adrak wa minhum man yukmiluha` (and of them are those who return from after the perception and of them are those who complete it). `wa 'ala qadri jiddiyati kulli wahidin minhum li ahli'l-haqq` (and according to the measure of the earnestness of each one of them for the people of truth), `wa qadri a'malihi yakunu nayluhu min al-'adhab` (and according to the measure of his actions is his attainment of punishment). So, as for the followers, from the pillars and the subjects, so from among them are... The pillars... they will oppose... anyone who comes forward will be ready to do it. And the subjects. So from them are those who turn back. Among them are those who also turn back. Among them are those who also turn back from the perceptions. From the perception. And from them are those who also complete those perceptions. And according to the measure of their earnestness, each one among them is for the people of truth. And according to the measure of their actions, their receiving is from the punishment. `fa idha istakbala man yustakbalu bihi minhum al-ruju'u sa'idan` (So when the return is faced by those of them for whom it is faced, ascending), `li yubtada'a bihi fi anwa'i'l-ma'adin al-nafi'ati li'l-bashar` (so that it may be initiated with it in the kinds of minerals beneficial to mankind). When they come forward, they accept. When it comes before them. When they come before them, `min man` (from whom). Those people from whom it comes before... to return, climbing. The return is possible. The return is written for it. That the business with them is finished. Now they return. So what is it? The return that is from it, climbing. Climbing. First of all, in it, in the kinds of minerals that are beneficial for mankind. It is initiated with it in the kinds of minerals that are beneficial for mankind. So in such minerals are they placed that are `halal`, that are good. Minerals. `thumma fi anwa'i'l-nabat alladhi huwa ghayru mahzur` (then in the kinds of plants which are not forbidden). Then in such kinds of plants that are not forbidden. It is not stopped. It is not stopped. They are not forbidden from eating it. While falling, they will come into bad plants. While climbing, the good... the beginning is with good plants. This... the ones who are falling, for them, there is no condition of action. Meaning that... The punishment, the punishment is in... they are giving `qisas`. They are giving retribution. Their cycle of punishment is ongoing. They are in punishment. Okay. So now upon them, any of Shari'ah's rules, like... Shari'ah's rules are not there. What Shari'ah in that? The rules of Shari'ah are upon a person of intellect. Not upon animals. Yes. It's upon humans. The people, among the people who are falling, upon them, who are in punishment. You are speaking about humans. Yes, humans, yes. Now for them, there is punishment there, there is no return for them. There is no grasp. Right now they are in the period of `qisas`. Retribution is being taken from them. They are being given punishment. When their punishment is complete, then they will return. `illa ma sha' Allah` (except what Allah wills). So during the punishment, if they commit a major sin, murder... No, that is taking old retribution. Okay. `thumma fi anwa'i'l-hayawan al-muhallalah` (then in the kinds of permitted animals). Then they come... come before... into the kinds of animals that have been made permissible. `thumma yasta'miluhu man yajibu lahu isti'maluhu` (then he uses it for whom its use is obligatory). Then... they use it who... for whom its use is obligatory. `min waliyyin wa ziddin` (from a friend or an adversary). From a friend or from an adversary. `fa yakunu lahu ma'baran` (so it becomes a passage for him). So it becomes a passage for them. `hatta yakhruju fi'l-khama al-alfiyyah` (until they emerge in the fifth millennium), `wa yu'radu 'alayhim al-balaya` (and tribulations are presented to them). So until... `thumma yasta'miluhu` (then he uses it). They emerge in the fifth millennium. It was said. And tribulations are presented to them. `thumma yasta'miluhu` (then he uses it). What will be its meaning? That permissible animal... He uses that permissible animal. The one for whom it is obligatory to use it. The one who has to go through `qisas` from a certain place. He goes into the kinds of permissible animals. `min waliyyin wa ziddin` (from a friend or an adversary). The `qisas` for whom... No, the `qisas` is finished, isn't it? If the permissible animals... in the fifth millennium who... His emergence has to happen. For the emergence of that person, whether it has to happen from a friend or an adversary. His... so it becomes a passage for him. If it has to happen from an adversary, then... they are not in punishment. There is a degree of punishment. Meaning, due to some of his good actions, he is brought into permissible animals. But the punishments are not complete for him. So he goes to the adversary. When the punishments are complete, he goes to the friend. It is a natural process. `fa yakunu lahu ma'baran` (so it becomes for him a passage). So it becomes a passage for him. For the friend or the adversary. A place to pass through. `hatta yakhruja` (until he emerges), `fi'l-khama al-alfiyyah` (in the fifth millennium). Until he emerges in the fifth millennium. `wa yu'radu 'alayhi'l-balaya` (and tribulations are presented to him). And tribulations are presented to him. Who presents them? The one whose... Imam `alayhi's-salam`, whose invitation is established in the universe. He presents the invitation to them in his various ways. It is a great and strange invitation. So are they all made to understand that what their `mabda` is, what their... No, they don't need to be made to understand all that. They are invited towards the truth. They are called for the truth. In this form. With some other method, they are called. This is for those people who are returning. Returning. They are given a chance to come towards the truth. `li man kana ankara min al-hudud` (for one who had denied the `hudud`). For those people to whom tribulations are presented, who deny the `hudud`. He had denied the `hudud`. From the `hudud`. `wa yu'radu 'alayhi'l-balaya` (and tribulations are presented to him). And upon him, the `wilayah` is presented of that person whom he had denied from the `hudud`. `fa in qabila naja wa dakhala fi jumlati ahli'l-haqq` (and if he accepts, he is saved and enters into the company of the people of truth). And so if he accepted, he found salvation and entered the company of the people of truth. A clean slate. After accepting it, that thing is fixed. After that, it is said that water is poured on the slate. It becomes clean. Then whatever you want, you can write. So this is the state of a clean slate. That now all things are finished from him. Then faith is presented to him. Now if he accepts it, the first state, the state of *kamal-e-awwal* (first perfection) arrives. `fa in qabila naja` (and if he accepts, he is saved), `wa dakhala fi jumlati ahli'l-haqq` (and enters into the company of the people of truth). So if he accepted, he found salvation and entered the company of the people of truth. `wa in aba wa'stakbara 'ada saqitan ka ma sabaqa min qawlihi fi asnafi'l-'adhab` (And if he refuses and is arrogant, he returns falling, as has been preceded from his statement concerning the kinds of punishment). And if he denied and showed arrogance, he will turn back falling, as it was established from his statement in the classes of punishment. `wa 'ala dhalika yakun munha ila qiyami'l-qa'im 'alayhi'l-salam` (And upon that will be its end until the rising of the `Qaim`, peace be upon him). And on this same state, its end is until the rising of the `Qaim`, `alayhi's-salam`. `fa idha ana zuhuruhu wa qiyamuhu zaharat bi zuhurihi` (So when his appearance and his rising draw near, it appears with his appearance). `ana`, `inna`, `anna`, `la'alla`, `ka'anna`, these give `nasb` to the `ism`. `an`, `in`, `an`, `in` means if. `an` enters upon the `mudari'`. And after that is... `anna`. `anna` means he moaned. From `anna` comes `anin`. This is `ana`. `ana` means it came. `fa idha ana zuhuruhu` (so when his appearance came). `ana` means to be near. His appearance and his rising. And his rising appeared with his appearance. When the `Qaim` `alayhi's-salam`'s appearance is near, `zaharat bi zuhurihi` (it appeared with his appearance), `jamee'u'l-khala'iq min haddi Adama 'alayhi's-salam ila 'ahdi dawrihi 'alayhi's-salam` (all of creation, from the limit of Adam, peace be upon him, to the era of his cycle, peace be upon him). Salam `alayhi wa `ala dhikrihi` (peace be upon him and upon his mention). It appears with his appearance, all of creation from the limit of Adam `alayhi's-salam`'s time until his, your era. `salamullahi wa 'ala...` (Allah's peace be upon and upon...). `salamullahi 'ala dhikrihi` (Allah's peace be upon his mention). `fa la yabqa ahadun min jamee'i atwari'l-mustafa min muti'in wa 'asin` (so no one remains from all the stages of the chosen one, from the obedient and the sinner). `illa zahara ba'da yasiruhu ila'l-ard` (except that he appeared after his journey to the earth). `thumma ila'l-mizaj wa'l-muzdajat` (then to the temperament and the compounded). So no one remains from the stages of the chosen one, from the stages of the chosen one... the six stages of the chosen one. The one who is obedient or is a sinner. Except that he appears after his journey to the earth. To the earth. Then towards the temperament and the compounded. `thumma fi'l-aghdhiyati wa zuhurihi'l-nuqatan` (then in the nutriments and his appearance, the two drops). Then in the foods. `wa zuhuruhum nuqafan` (and their appearance as drops). And their appearance as drops. `wa'taraqqihim fi'l-maratib` (and their ascent in the ranks). And their ascent is in the ranks. `ila an yuzhiru shakhsan 'ala halatihim al-ula al-mad'uwwah` (until they appear as a person upon their first state, the one invited). `ila'l-haqq` (to the truth). And their ascent in the ranks, until they appear as a person upon their first state. `al-mad'uwwah` (the one invited). The one who was invited. The one who was invited to the truth. And they are in that state. In their same state. To the truth means... The fallen form of a believer. To the truth... All believers and non-believers, everyone. Everyone will be invited. Everyone's appearance will happen. First state means... *Kamal-e-awwal*. The first state. Upon their first state, `al-mad'uwwati ila'l-haqq` (the one invited to the truth). The one in which the invitation was given to them towards the truth. When the invitation was first given towards the truth, upon that same state they will be invited. The state they were in. When they accepted the invitation of truth in that state, upon that state they will be. `wa hum 'ala silsilah halatihim min shaykhukhatin wa shababiyyatin wa sughurin wa kuburin wa sababin wa inkarin wa dhalika kulluhu 'ala halatihim al-ula allati du'iya fiha` (and they are upon the chain of their states, of old age, youth, smallness, bigness, cause, denial, and all of that is upon their first state in which they were invited). And they are in that state which is the state of old age or of youth or of acceptance or of cause, every one in that state, that first one. In which he was invited. `fa aba wa'stakbara wa 'asa wa zada` (and he refused and was arrogant and disobeyed and added). So he denied, was arrogant, and disobeyed and added to it. `la yutraku 'ala halatin saghiran wa la kabiran` (he is not left in a state, small or big). He is not left in that state, whether small or big. `wa la` `shadkhan` `wa la` `zadkhan` `wa la `zadkhan`...` `wa la fi shay'in min al-alwan allati hiya abyadu wa zurqatun wa sukhumatun wa sawadun, sawa'un bi sawa'in` (and not in anything of the colors, which are white, and blue, and blackness, and black, equal to equal). And not in anything of the colors, such that he is white. The people of color will come. Such that they are white or `zurqah` or blue. `sukh` `zurqah`. `sukh` and `sukhuma`. `sukhuma` means what? And or they are black. Or black. Just as they were before, so they are now. `thumma yashkhasu kullu nabiyyin wa wasiyyin wa imamin wa haddin li ahli 'asrihi` (then every prophet, successor, imam, and `hadd` for the people of his era is personified). Then every prophet and successor and imam is personified. For the truth. Personified. Then every prophet and successor and imam and `hadd` is personified for the people of his own time. `ka ma akhbara 'anhu'l-kitab al-karim min qawlihi'l-mawla al-sami' al-'alim, "wa ji'a bi'l-nabiyyin wa'l-shuhada' wa qudiya baynahum bi'l-haqqi wa hum la yuzlamun"` (as the noble book has informed about it from the saying of the master, the all-hearing, the all-knowing, "And the prophets and the witnesses will be brought, and it will be judged between them with truth, and they will not be wronged"). And as the Kitab-e-Karim has informed, from the word of Allah, the Master, and prophets will be called and the witnesses, and judgment will be passed between them with truth, and they will not be wronged. `wa qawluhu ta'ala...` (And His, the Exalted's, saying...) During the time of the prophets, whoever the people are, all of them, in one Day of Judgment, will be called. What do the prophets bear witness to? No, not prophets. Prophets... The Quran Sharif also has it that the prophets will be called, and their deeds will be witnessed. Whether he did good deeds or bad deeds. `wa'sh-shuhada'` (and the witnesses). `wa qudiya baynahum bi'l-haqq` (and it will be judged between them with truth). And judgment will be passed between them with truth. `wa hum la...` The witnesses here means... `wa ji'a bi'l-nabiyyin wa'l-shuhada'` (and the prophets and the witnesses will be brought). The ones who bear witness. Every `maqam` is appointed as a witness over the people of its time. He will be a witness. The matter of `maratib`... According to the `maratib`... He is also brought as a witness. The literal meaning is not that of `maqamat`. That is, the `maqam`... The meaning of `shuhada'`... a `salih` person of a higher `martaba`. In the sense of a `maqam`... `shahid` is not in the sense of a literal witness here. That one who... the people of his time, he was appointed as a witness over their actions. `martaba`... `man` is a witness over all of creation. Who is a witness? The `nabiyyin` and `shuhada'` between them... `wa qudiya baynahum`. Between the `nabiyyin` and the `shuhada'`? No. `wa qudiya baynahum bi'l-haqq` (and it will be judged between them with truth). Between all of those people. `nabiyyin`, `shuhada'` and all those who will be gathered. The people whom... what actions they did in their time, the bad deeds they did, the good deeds they did, he will be a witness to that. Both the prophet and the `shuhada'` will be witnesses. And Allah will judge between them with truth. And they will not be wronged. Allah will bring the prophets and witnesses, and Allah will judge between those people with truth. Between the prophets and the witnesses, a judgment will not be happening. They are present. They are witnesses. `wa qudiya baynahum bi'l-haqqi wa hum la yuzlamun` (and it will be judged between them with truth, and they will not be wronged). And they will not be wronged. `wa qawluhu ta'ala hikayatan 'an ijtima'ihim, "qul inna'l-awwalina wa'l-akhirin la majmu'una ila miqati yawmin ma'lum"` (And His, the Exalted's, saying, narrating about their gathering, "Say, 'Indeed, the former and the latter will surely be gathered for the appointed time of a known day'"). And Allah the Exalted's statement, narrating about their gathering, narrating... "Say, indeed the first and the last, will certainly be gathered at the appointed time of a known day." `thumma inna kulla wahidin min maqamat wa'l-hudud yunafishu ahla 'asrihi'l-qa'im fihim wa'l-mab'uth ilayhim wa yuwafiquhum 'ala ma kana minhu wa minhum min takdhibihim lahu wa 'inadihim wa mu'adatatihim wa 'ala jami'i af'alihim wa aqwalihim qalilatiha wa kathiratiha` (Then indeed, each one of the stations and the `hudud` will dispute with the people of his era, the one قائم among them and the one sent to them, and he will confront them concerning what came from him and from them, of their belying him and their stubbornness and their hostility, and concerning all of their actions and their sayings, the small and the great of them). Then indeed, every one from the `maqamat` of the Imams, the `hudud`, he will debate with the people of his time. He will admonish. He will argue. He will dispute with the people of his era. He will admonish the people of his era. The one who is established among them, and the one who was sent towards them. And he will make them stand and face what happened from him and from them. What happened from that `maqam` and from them. What dealings happened between them. He did so much persuasion, he did not do persuasion. He will make them stand for that. From their belying him, his lie. Their belying that Imam. And their denial and their hostility and their enmity. And concerning all their actions and sayings, whether small or great. `fa yakunu ijtima'uhum fi 'arasati'l-qiyamah` (so their gathering will be in the plains of resurrection). And their gathering, the gathering of all of them, will be in the fields of `qiyamah`. In the plains of `qiyamah`. `wa huwa khatt al-istiwa' al-gharbi alladhi huwa ard al-ma'arib` (and it is the western line of the equator, which is the land of Ma'rib). And that is the western line of the equator, which is the land of Ma'rib. Land of Ma'rib. `li anna qiyam al-qa'im 'alayhi'l-salam yakunu hunalik` (because the rising of the `Qaim`, peace be upon him, will be there). Because the rising of the `Qaim` `alayhi's-salam` will be there. `wa ya'tuna jami'u'l-khala'iq ilayhi min jami'i'l-jaza'ir yahra'un` (and all of creation will come to him from all the islands, rushing). And all of creation will come to you from all the islands, rushing. `la yabqa minhum saghiratun wa la kabiratun illa yadiqu bihi mawdi'uhu alladhi huwa fihi wa watanuhu alladhi rubbiya fihi` (no small or big among them will remain except that his place in which he is will become constricted for him, and his homeland in which he was raised). There will not remain among them any small or big, except that the place will become constricted for him. The place in which he is. And his homeland in which you were raised. And that will be your homeland. In which you will be raised. That is, it will become constricted for him. `wa yakhruju` (and he emerges). It means that when all gather, the collective gathering will happen, the place will become constricted. This is how all the people from the world will come. Only specific people will come. The ones for whom the time for `qiyamah` has come, they will come to that place. The whole world cannot come. Yes. `wa watanuhu alladhi rubbiya fihi` (and his homeland in which he was raised). And your homeland in which you will be raised. The `mawdi'` (place) is such that you are in it, and that is your homeland in which you have been raised. `wa yakhruju 'inda qiyamihi 'alayhi's-salam kullu wahidin min awla'ika'l-khala'iq mujifan ilayhi musri'an ladayhi ila an yuhdara bayna yadayhi` (And at the time of his rising, peace be upon him, every one of those creations will emerge, hastening to him, hurrying to him, until he is brought before him). It means that the entire world, how will it gather in Ma'rib? The entire Arab world also cannot gather. The believers of the world... For whom it is their lot... The creation. `khala'iq` does not only mean humans. `khala'iq` includes everything, animals and everything. The `khala'iq` for whom... the dealings are to be had during `qiyamah`. They will gather. And they will emerge at the time of your `qiyamah`, peace be upon him. They will emerge at the time of your `qiyamah`. Every one among them, from these `khala'iq`. Hurrying towards you. And rushing towards you. Until they are present before you. `ka ma qala Allahu ta'ala, "hatta idha futihat ya'juju wa ma'juju wa hum min kulli hadabin yansilun"` (as Allah the Exalted said, "Until, when Ya'juj and Ma'juj are released, and they, from every elevation, will descend"). As Allah the Exalted has said, until the... it will be opened, Ya'juj and Ma'juj, and they from every height will be running. `al-hadab ay al-muttafa' min al-ard` (the `hadab` i.e., the elevated part of the earth). That is, the high ground. `waqtaraba'l-wa'du'l-haqq fa idha hiya shakhisatun absaru'lladhina kafaru` (And the true promise has drawn near. Then behold, the eyes of those who disbelieved will be staring). Because Ya'juj and Ma'juj are `azdad` (opposites). And their followers are those who disbelieved. `wa ma'budahum alladhina 'abaduhu min dunillahi ru'asa'uhum al-muqimuna lahum maqama a'immati'l-haqq al-naziluna fi manazilihim` (and their objects of worship, those whom they worshipped besides Allah, their chiefs, who established for them the station of the Imams of truth, who descended into their ranks). And the promise of truth will draw near. So when it... Their eyes... And when Ya'juj and Ma'juj will be personified, their eyes will be staring fixedly. The eyes of those people who disbelieved. Their eyes will be in wonder. They will be amazed at what matter has happened. How it has happened. Because Ya'juj and Ma'juj are the `azdad`. And their followers are those who disbelieved. And their objects of worship whom they worshipped besides Allah, their leaders. The `azdad`'s leaders. Those who established for them the station of the Imams of truth. In the station of the Imams of truth. Those who stood in opposition to the Imams of truth and their followers followed them. Those who descended into their ranks. In the ranks of the Imams of truth.

<!-- lecture 45 -->

Bismillah al-Rahman al-Rahim. Al-Fasl al-Rabi'. Bismillah al-Rahman al-Rahim. Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin wa 'ala aali Sayyidina Muhammadin wa barik wa sallim. Al-Fasl al-Rabi' min al-Bab al-Khamis min al-Surat al-Thalith. The fourth chapter, from the fifth section, from the third *Surah*. *Fa-idha-jtama'at al-khala'iqu bayna yaday al-Qa'im, salamullahi 'ala dhikrihi, wa-tashakhkhasa kullu wahidin min al-hudud wa-al-a'immah wa-al-awsiya' wa-al-nutaqa', salamullahi 'alayhim, li-ahli zamanihi wa-'asrihi*. Bismillah al-Rahman al-Rahim. And when the creatures, all the people, are gathered… were gathered… *idha*… will be gathered. Will be gathered. Before this, *idha*... *idha*... It gives the meaning of the future tense. So when they will be gathered… the creatures… before the Qa'im, upon whose mention be blessings and peace, and Allah Ta'ala's peace be upon his mention. And every one of them from the *hudud* will be individualized… from the *hudud*… and the *a'immah*, and the *awsiya'*, and the *nutaqa'*, peace of Allah be upon all of them, for the people of their time and their era. *wa-waqafahum 'ala jami'i af'alihim* (and he will make them stand before all their deeds). And they will make all the people of their time aware of all their deeds, *wa-a'malihim* (and their actions), upon their actions. *wa-istaqarra kullu wahidin minhum bima sana'a umira bihi*. *wa-istaqarra kullu wahidin minhum bima sana'a umira bihi*. *wa-istaqarra kullu wahidin minhum bima sana'a*. And it will be settled… And every one of them will be settled with that which he did, for which he was commanded. *fa-duribat a'naquhum*. *fa-duribat a'naquhum*. Then they will strike… Their necks will be struck. Their necks will be struck. All of them. *wa-ursilat 'alayhim narun*. Is there no subject mentioned here? *fa-duribat a'naquhum*. Whose necks? Whose? Where is the plural for *hum*? The *azdad* (opposites) of the people of that time… There is no mention of the *azdad*. Just now, the sentence came: *li-ahli zamanihi wa-'asrihi*. It must be the *azdad*. *fa-duribat a'naquhum*. Their necks… their necks will be struck, all of them. *wa-ursilat 'alayhim narun fa-ahraqathum bi-ajma'ihim*. And a fire will be sent upon them, and that fire will burn them all, in their entirety. *fa-istahalu fi al-waqt*. And they will be scattered at that moment. *mustahil* will become. Their state will change at that moment. *fa-saru bukharan*. *fa-saru bukharan*. And… from the two knots, fire will descend, and that fire will be such that at that very moment, they will be finished and become vapor. They will become vapor. Vapor means at that very moment, they will become vapor. *thumma yas'adu dhalik al-bukhar ila al-'uqdatayn*. Then that vapor will ascend towards the two knots. *li-annahuma yajdhibanahu*. These are new things… what is it… new, new things which had not reached our understanding. This is how one is annihilated and becomes vapor. Like laser, atom bomb, and this… atom bomb… and new, new things have come out that can annihilate an entire area in one go. *fa-saru bukharan*. Then they will become vapor. *thumma yas'adu dhalik al-bukhar ila al-'uqdatayn*. Then that vapor will ascend towards the two knots. Because… because they, the two knots, attract it, due to *al-munasabah al-khabithah allati baynahuma* (the foul affinity that is between them). Due to a special affinity, a foul affinity that is between that vapor and the two knots. *fa-idha saru fi al-'uqdatayn wa-sara taht al-ard*. And when they enter the two knots, and they [the knots] are beneath the earth… And when they reach the two knots… when they reach the two knots and they are beneath the earth… when they are in motion, coming and going, they will come beneath the earth. *jadhabat al-sakhrah*. *jadhabat al-sakhrah*. Then from those two knots, the *sakhrah* will acquire it. Meaning, it will acquire the vapor. The vapor that the two knots absorbed, now that vapor will go into the *sakhrah*. *jadhabat al-sakhrah allati hiya asfal al-ard*. And which is in the lowest part of the earth. *jadhabat al-sakhrah dhalik al-bukhar*. The *sakhrah* will absorb that vapor, *bi-al-munasabah allati baynaha wa-baynahu* (due to the affinity that is between it and him), due to an affinity that is between the vapor and the *sakhrah*. There are things like that in the *sakhrah*... Due to affinity, it will pull all those things. The concept of *taht al-ard* is not established. *Taht al-ard* means... opposite the Ka'bah. Meaning, in the lower part of the Ka'bah. The lower part. Not in the north, but in its south. So this is only mentioning the *qiyamah* (resurrection/end) of the *dawr* (cycle). The *qiyamah* of the *dawr*. So the other *qiyamahs*, of the *kashf* (unveiling)... It will be even more. Meaning, the process is this. Yes, the process is this. This is the process of *qiyamah*. There is no mention of the *'uqdatayn* (two knots) in the *dawr al-kashf*. In the *dawr al-kashf*, nothing of it will remain. Because in the *dawr al-kashf*, it will all be finished. All the components of the *'uqdatayn* will have gone into the *sakhrah*. The *'uqdatayn* have been there since when? Since the time of creation. Allah created them at that time and placed the *'uqdatayn* there. Their effects will not be there. Their effects will have diminished. The satanic things that are there will not be able to work. Their arising has ended. And when they do not arise, they cannot do any work. *wa-sara taht al-ard 'an al-'uqdatayn*. And they, the two knots, are beneath the earth, and that *sakhrah* absorbs them, that *sakhrah* which is in the lowest part of the earth, it absorbs that vapor due to an affinity between the vapor and the *sakhrah*. *fa-yatadakhalu fi azda'iha wa-masamiha ila an yasira dhalik al-bukhar fi wasatiha*. And then that vapor enters the parts of that *sakhrah*... in its parts... in its body, in its inner parts, and in its pores, in its pores, until it reaches... that vapor reaches its center. In the center of that *sakhrah*. *thumma yanfa'ilu bi-mashi'at al-mudabbir li-dhalika*. Then a kind of reaction takes place, a matter occurs by the will of the *Mudabbir* (Director) for that matter, *fa-yu'idu ashkhasan kullu shakhsin 'ala halatihi*. Then He brings back individuals... This reaction happens, and He brings back individuals. They are turned back. Every person to his state, just as he was, on that matter on which he was... in the time of the *Sahib al-Zaman* (Master of the Age) with opposition. So they reach... they end up in the center of the *sakhrah*. Where are the individuals formed? They are brought back from there. They emerge. Where is the mention of emerging? They don't emerge. They are there. In the center of the *sakhrah*. In the *sakhrah* itself, their individuality is transformed. They reach the center of the *sakhrah*. In the *sakhrah*, in the same form they had in the world, they enter in that very form. In the same form. The state of *qamat al-alfiyyah* (the stature of the millennium). So they end up in the center of the *sakhrah*. In that same form, which is the state of *qamat al-alfiyyah*, in which they had adopted opposition during the time of the *Sahib al-Zaman*, they end up in the center of the *sakhrah*. *wa-hadhihi al-sakhrah mithalu qidr al-sufr*. And this *sakhrah* is like a pot of brass, *allati asfaluha salbun amlas*. such that its bottom is hard and smooth. Hard. *wa-wasatuha mutajawwif*. And whose middle part is hollow, has a cavity. *ka-wasat al-qidr* (like the middle of a pot), like a pot. *wa-jami'u hijarat dhalik al-wast kibritiyyah*. And all the stones of that middle part are sulfuric. Your... sulfur... sulfrous. *wa-alladhi huwa laha ka-al-saqf*. And that which is like a roof for them... is such that it is a roof for them. And the floor is also... The roof is like what? *sakhratun saldah*. A hard rock. Meaning, the bottom part of the pot will be on top, and the top part will be at the bottom. The bottom is hard, and the top is also hard. Meaning, just as the earth is round... it is round. The only difference is that the middle part has rock. The bottom part is also rock, and in the middle... in the middle is its lava. In the middle is lava. Sulfuric. Sulfuric lava. *wa-huwa alladhi huwa laha ka-al-saqf*. This is like a roof for them. *sakhratan saldan*. Such that it is a hard rock. *fa-hiya min jami'i jihatiha mulamlamah*. And it, that rock, is surrounded on all its boundaries, having become a rock that is hard. `mulamlamah`. `mulamlamah`. `mushtami'ah` (gathered/compacted). It is written below its meaning, `mushtami'ah`. `saldan malasan`. A hard part that is smooth... smooth. *wa-al-tajwifu fi wasatiha*. And the cavity is in its middle. The hollow part is in its middle. Meaning the `jawf` (cavity) is in the middle. `jawf` means... its stomach. *wa-innama fi asfaliha masamun*. And indeed, in its lower part, there are pores. In the *sakhrah*, the pot, there are holes. *wa-manafidh*. And openings, holes. *li-yasubb dhalik al-bukhar*. So that that vapor may exit. *al-mutasa'id ilayha*. Ascending to it, from those pores. *wa-'ala jumlat al-qawl fa-innaha ka-bayt al-hammam*. And in the totality of the statement, it is like a bathhouse, a `bayt al-khala'` (toilet/bathhouse). *al-harr*. Such a `bayt al-khala'` which is called a hot `bayt al-khala'`. `mulamlam min jami'i jawanibiha*. Which is closed from all its sides. *wa-hiya al-musammat fi al-kitab al-karim bi-sijjin*. And this is what is named in the Noble Book as Sijjin. Which is called Sijjin. *wa-innama wada'at al-hukama' bayt al-hammam 'ala mithaliha*. And indeed, the wise ones established the bathhouse on its example. On that same pattern. *na'udhu billahi minha*. We seek refuge in Allah from it. We seek refuge in Allah, we seek refuge from Allah Ta'ala from that thing. *fa-al-waqid*. From that *sakhrah*. *fa-al-waqid min tahtihi*. So the fuel is from beneath it. *ka-hararat al-shams*. Like the heat of the sun. *allati tukhmiha min tahtiha*. Such a sun that heats that *sakhrah* from beneath it. *hazwan bi-hazwin*. In the same manner, just as the sun's motion is. *wa-'inda masirihi hadhihi al-shukhus hunalik*. And when those individuals who are there... Upon reaching... *masir hadhihi al-shukhus*. Upon the arrival of those individuals there... meaning these ones who had been individualized and had come into the center... When they are in the center... *yu'ayinuna biha man qad taqaddamahum min amthalihim*. They help... They see it. `mu'ayanah` (observation). They observe that matter, those who have preceded them, people. *fa-yastahhiquna ma hum fihi min al-'iqab*. Then they become deserving of the punishment they are in. *wa-li-ayyi sababin kanu*. And for what reason were they put into the *sakhrah*? *wa-li-ayyi halatin uridu dhalik al-butah*. And in what state were they made to enter that crucible? The name of the *sakhrah* is also *butah*. *fa-yaqulu ba'duhum li-ba'din: ya waylatana qad kunna fi ghaflatin min hadha bal kunna zalimin*. (Then some of them will say to others: "Oh, woe to us! We were indeed in negligence of this; rather, we were wrongdoers.") Then some among them will say to others, "What a destruction for us, that we were in negligence of this matter. Rather, indeed, we were among the wrongdoers." *fa-yuqalu lahum: innakum wa-ma ta'buduna min dunillah hasabu jahannam antum laha waridun*. (It will be said to them: "Indeed, you and what you worship besides Allah are the fuel of Hell. You will be coming to it.") Then it will be said to them, "Yes, you were in this state. *wa-ma ta'budun*. For this reason, that you worshipped besides Allah... It will be said to them... *innakum* (indeed you). That you people... *wa-ma ta'buduna min dunillah* (and what you worship besides Allah). And that which you used to worship besides Allah... those people too. *hasabu jahannam*. They, and those people too. You people, and those people whom you used to worship besides Allah, *hasabu jahannam* (fuel of Hell). They will become the fuel of Hell. *antum laha waridun*. Indeed, you will be thrown into that Hell, into that *sakhrah*. `hasabu jahannam`, which part? The middle part. Sijjin, where the lava flows. *fa-yaqulu a'wanuhum: law kana ha'ula'i alihatan ma waraduha, ay a'immata haqqin*. (And their helpers will say: "Had these been gods, they would not have entered it." That is, Imams of truth.) Then it will be said... Then their helpers will say, "How good it would have been... if... if these were your gods, *ma waraduha* (they would not have entered it). They would not have entered that *sakhrah*." That is, if they were true Imams. If they were true Imams. *wa-kullun fiha khalidun*. (And all of them will abide therein forever.) And every one of them will remain in it forever. *lahum fiha zafirun wa-hum fiha la yasma'un*. (For them therein is sighing, and they will not hear.) There, they will be like... taking breaths. `khalidin fiha abadan` is not there. `khalidin fiha`. For whom did `khalidin` come? *ula'ika hum sharr al-bariyyah. innalladhina kafaru min ahl al-kitab wa-al-mushrikina fi nari jahannama khalidina fiha*. `abadan` did not come. They will remain forever. Meaning, for a duration. It's not for eternity. It has taken out `abad` (eternity). After that, *innalladhina amanu wa-'amilu al-salihat... ula'ika hum khayr al-bariyyah... lahum jannatun tajri min tahtiha al-anhar khalidina fiha abadan*. (Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds... those are the best of creatures... for them are gardens beneath which rivers flow, abiding therein forever.) It brought `abadan` for the good ones. For the good ones. So `abad` (eternity) is for whom? *khulud al-abad* (eternal abiding) is in Paradise. And *khulud al-'aridi* (temporary abiding) is what? In Hell. The concept of purification is also there. `abad` is not there. The verse from Ayat al-Kursi... *ula'ika ashab al-nar hum fiha khalidun*. No, no. *innalladhina kafaru min ahl al-kitab wa-al-mushrikin*. It has come in that. *khalidina fiha* and *khalidina fiha abadan*. *lahum fiha zafirun*. There, for them... they... for them in that *sakhrah*, in that Sijjin, there is `zafir`. `zafir` means sighing. Screaming and shouting. The taking of breath up and down. `zafir` is the sound that comes out. *wa-hum fiha la yasma'un*. (And they will not hear in it.) In this state, they will remain there, that they will not hear. *wa-'inda maghib al-shams wa-masiriha taht al-ard*. And when the sun sets and its path is beneath the earth, *kullu laylatin, tuhmi al-sakhrah*. every night, it heats the *sakhrah*. *fa-tu'hiju kama yuhmi asfal al-qidr*. And it gives off steam, just as... it becomes incandescent. ...heats... it will heat it, just as the bottom of a hot `deghchi` (pot) is heated. So this heat, is it from the sun? The punishments are sent through the sun's rays. The *sakhrah*'s lava is there, and with the sun's rays reaching it, the heat increases even more. Like a hot pot, when it is heated from below with fire, the heat increases. In the same way, the heat of the sun increases it. *kama yuhmi asfal al-qidr min waqd al-nar... min waqid... min waqid al-nar az'afan muda'afatan*. Like the bottom of a pot, when it is heated by fire, it becomes manifoldly hotter. *wa-ma massalnaha hadha bi-dhalika taqriban*. And we have given this example of that for the sake of approximation, as an estimate. *wa-'indama yahmi asfal al-sakhrah*. And when the bottom of the *sakhrah* gets hot, *ishta'alat tilk al-hijarah al-kibritiyyah*. Then those sulfuric stones ignite. *al-zanjibiyyah... al-zaranjibiyyah... al-phitkari... al-kalsiyyah*. Calcareous ones. *al-zujajiyyah*. `zujajiyyah`... what is... what is `zaj` called? Glass... the ones made of glass... crystals. The ones made of glass... *naran*. Becoming fire. *wa-sara ula'ik al-mala'in yataqallabuna fi wastiha*. `yataqallabun`. And those accursed ones will become... at that time... the accursed ones will be tumbling up and down in its middle, like boiling water that goes up and down. ...in its middle, in the middle of Hell, in the middle of Sijjin. *wa-hum yastaghithuna*. And they will cry for help. *fa-la yughathun*. But they will not be helped. *fa-hadha al-qawl yakhtassu bi-azdad al-nutaqa' wa-al-awsiya' wa-al-a'immah wa-sa'ir hududihim, salamullahi 'alayhim ajma'in*. And this saying is specified for the antagonists of the *nutaqa'*, the *awsiya'*, the *a'immah*, and all their other *hudud*, peace of Allah be upon them all. `wa-sa'ir azdadi sa'ir hududihim`. And the antagonists of all their other *hudud*. And the enemies of their *hudud* as well. Peace of Allah be upon them all. So this punishment that is happening, it is in a personal state, and in them there is the vegetative faculty, the sensory faculty, and the forms too. The foul forms that came from above. The ones that came from above. They are all upon them with their entire body. With their entire... their senses, their consciousness, everything. The totality of their entire being is present in it. Previously, what was separated in the two knots is no more, now the entire being is there. The entire being has come. *salamullahi 'alayhim ajma'in*. *al-munasibin lahum*. Such antagonists who were hostile, who were antagonistic, who were enemies to them. *al-mudda'in manazilahum*. Those who claimed their ranks. *wa-kibar atba'ihim al-mu'inin lahum 'ala zulmihim*. And their great followers... the `mu'inin`... who were helpers for them in their oppression. *al-muta'assibin ma'ahum*. Those who were fanatically with them. *al-salikin maslakahum*. Those who walked on their path. *al-muwaswisin li-du'afa' al-'uqul*. Those who whispered doubts to the weak-minded. *al-mustahzi'in bi-ahl al-haqq*. And those who mocked the people of truth, who insulted them, who made fun of them. *fa-amma al-huhud wa-al-ru'a' al-tabi'un lahum*. As for the foolish and the rabble who followed them. They are the followers, those who came after them. *fa-yu'adu bihim min akhiri naw'in min al-idrak*. Then they will be returned from the last type of perception. So they will be turned back from the last type of perception. Those people who are not knowledgeable... they will be returned from the second, third level. They will be turned back. This is for those who do it knowingly. These are the ones who are similar, who do it knowingly. The antagonists... They don't have understanding... It's better for them to be without understanding here. They will get out quickly. Their intentions were not bad. They were just in the crowd, following the herd. They just went along. *fa-yu'adu bihim min akhiri naw'in min al-idrak*. Then they will be turned back from the last type of perception. From the last type of perception. And the seven perceptions that were mentioned, from those seven perceptions, they are turned back before that. They are not put into the punishment of the peripheries or the punishment of the *sakhrah*. Or from the perceptions before that, they are taken. *kama sabaqa bihi al-qawl*. As the saying has preceded. It's very big. It's big. [unclear] They told... He will appear and his rule will be there. ...a word. Like science says, it is elliptical, round, and in motion. And the proofs that are brought are wrong. The shape... metaphorical shape has been made for understanding. A shape has been made here, of the Earth. The detail is that the Earth is a plane and is flat, and on its other side is *Sakhrah*. Or it is *Sijjin*, which is *Jahannam-e-Kubra* (the Great Hell). And the center of the Earth's surface is Ka'batullah, the Ka'bah, and Baytullah. And on the other side of the Earth's surface is *Sakhrah*, whose lowest part is the abode of the *Ahl-e-Tabut*. The Earth has four corners, which are called the *atraf-e-zamin* (extremities of the Earth). And it is here that the *'adhab-e-atraf* (punishment of the extremities) befalls the opponents. And the *atraf-e-zamin* are adjacent to *Sakhrah*. *Atraf-e-zamin* are adjacent to *Sakhrah*. And the extremities... on the *atraf-e-zamin* are located the *manafiz* (vents) of *Sakhrah*. And in the *atraf-e-zamin*, it is so severely cold that it is impossible for a bird to fly past there. Besides these mentioned *manafiz*, which are in the *atraf-e-zamin*, there are many *manafiz* in the *rub'-e-maskun* (inhabited quarter) as well, the biggest of which is *Durdur*, which is located in the sea between China and India. And the flow of all rivers is in this direction. It is said that from this *manfaz*, various kinds of sounds emanate. *Na'udhu billahi minha* (We seek refuge in Allah from it). *Sakhrah*, whose shape is like a *qidr*, meaning like a *deg* (cauldron), like a *degchi* (pot), its lowest part... whereas in the shape... whereas it is shown in the shape... it is shown. That is the most wretched part, which is the abode of the *Ahl-e-Tabut*. When the sun, while revolving, comes in front of the Earth, it is daytime for the people of the Earth. And on the other side, for the *Ahl-e-Sakhrah*, it is night. And when the bright sun rises upon the *Ahl-e-Sakhrah*, it is daytime there and night for the people of the Earth. But in this day and night, the *Ahl-e-Sakhrah* experience a *qiyamah* (calamity). In the day of the *Ahl-e-Sakhrah*, there is intense heat there, and in their night, there is intense cold, which is beyond measure. And when the revolution... when... when it happens upon them, the state of the *'adhab* (punishment) increases a hundredfold. When the punishment is upon them, the state of the punishment increases a hundredfold. *Na'udhu billahi min dhalika* (We seek refuge in Allah from that). Regarding this Earth and *Sakhrah*, this point is to be remembered: that Bari Ta'ala did the *khilqat* (creation) of *Sakhrah* before the Earth. And in the Kalamullah Majid, *Sakhrah* has been given a separate individuality, where Earth, *Sakhrah*, and the sky, all three have been mentioned separately in a single *ayah*. Around this Earth and *Sakhrah*, nine *aflak* (celestial spheres) and seven *kawakib* (planets) are revolving. The *aflak*, whose lines are imaginary, their revolution is on a plane. And the *kawakib-e-saba'* (seven planets), they are circular, and their revolution is of both circular and axial types. An important point that Sayyidna al-Malik states at this time is this: that beneath the surface of the Earth, *Sakhrah* is spread out like a *qidr*, like a *degchi*. But where there is the Ka'batullah, Maqam-e-Ibrahim, Ghadir, the places of the Rawda-e-Aqdas, there, on the other side of *Sakhrah*, in that place, there is no *Sakhrah*. Rather, there is a state like a void. In this void is the abode of all the *arwah-e-nuraniyyah* (luminous souls) and the *arwah-e-hasanah* (good souls). And contrary to this, *amyal*, *wadi-e-shaytan*, *jamarat-e-thalathah*, are such places where there is a great multitude of *arwah-e-khabithah* (filthy souls). *La'anahumullah* (May Allah curse them). And upon *haqir*'s (the humble one's) question, that above Ka'batullah and these mentioned holy places, in the upper part, the part opposite the *aflak*, what is there? So he said that there is air. And this thing is not found in books. *Amma* (however), the pores of these places exist, but their location, meaning the location of the pores, should not be considered to be in the *aflak*. Rather, they are free from the *hudud* (limits), and they are all spiritual and imaginary, meaning not physical. At that time you were saying, Sayyidna al-Malik is saying... You... hands are needed. Yes, at this time you... He is not saying that it is *baydwi* (elliptical). Rather, the maps have been shown as *baydwi*. In all the books, a *baydwi* map has been shown. [unclear] 1773, he has stated this, that along with being *baydwi*, it is also *musattah* (flat). Earth. Earth, along with being *baydwi*, it is also *musattah*. The *kibr* (pride) had three types of people... One was *nadimin* (the remorseful). From the *nadimin*, what was made? The *aflak*. The *nadimin*... *shayatin* (devils) from them... *ummahat* (mothers)... *ummahat* means fire, air, water, earth's ball. And those who were *musirrin* (insistent), from them *Sakhrah* was made. And then, when 51,000 years passed... 51,000 years... the revolution of the *aflak*, and fire, air, water, earth passed... then from that, the Earth was created, upon which we perform *namaz*. There were three *ummahat*... then the *aflak* were made, then *ummahat* were made, then *Sakhrah* was made. It is mentioned that first there were possibly seven *jismi* things. It is mentioned like this... that from... from the *nadimin*... from the *nadimin* what were made? The *aflak*. From the *aflak* what was made? Before the *nadimin*... *falak-e-muhit*. Now after that, those who were delayed (*ta'khir*), in them the form of *nafs* (soul) was created. *ya ayyatuha al-nafsu al-mutma'innah* (O, soul at peace)... The tenth (*'ashir*) was called *nafs-e-mutma'innah*. Such a *nafs* that, having become content, is now going to enter the domain of the *'aql* (intellect). Through delay, from *'aql* came *nafs*. The form of *nafs*. Now the final, the *'ashir*, when it became *nafs-e-mutma'innah*, it will go and take the place of the *'aql* in the *'alam-e-anwar*. It will take the place of the final *'aql*. Now those *nufus* (souls) that remained after the *nufus* who were delayed, and the command came... *ihbitu* (descend!). Fall down. As soon as the command came... Among them, what was made first? The *falak-e-muhit* (All-Encompassing Sphere). How was the *falak-e-muhit* made? It is imaginary (*wahmi*). Now, relative to others, its delay was greater. This *nur* is close to material *nur*. Which one? Of the *buruj* (constellations). In the *falak-e-buruj*, what are there? Stars. There are stars. And what do these call them? Planets. Where did its *jussa* manifest? In Sarandip. The first *jussa* manifested in Sarandip. At the beginning of the cycle, why does a *jussa* manifest? Because before that, the universe is destroyed. Now the manifestation of the new *jussa* is not from the human race, but from the earth. Now after that, when one cycle ends... ending of a cycle means what? Now which... are we in? The first one. After that, we are in... in the seventh cycle of *satr*. Six cycles of *satr* have passed. We are in the seventh cycle of *satr*. So this earth is only 4 lakh years old? If something is said to be older than 4 lakh years on earth, then I think that is not believable. That's what it says. In research, it is said that things are crores of years old, billions of years old. The things... The old minerals are there. The entire earth was analyzed. The earth was non-existent. The earth is new, so it cannot be older than 4 lakh years. The animal... is not older than 4 lakh years. But the things are there. How will the things remain? It will be all water. Nothing will remain. That... it will get mixed with air and fly away. The things... where will it go after flying? It cannot be annihilated. Life... animal life, human life, is within 4 lakh years. And the entire animate and inanimate things of 4 lakh years... now we are in its final part. Now the *jussa* that will manifest... the *jussa* that will manifest... The 400th... from Sarandip which *jussa* manifested? 399 cycles... 399 cycles have passed. 399 cycles have passed. So from Sarandip, which *jussa* manifested? The 400th cycle. Now the one that will manifest... it is the collector of 399 cycles. It is in *jami'-e-arba'*. The next one that will come, it will be... it will gather the 400. The *jussa* that will be, it will gather the 400. They are going on, the 400. It will gather the 400. So its greatness will be such that its manifestation will be in the Khana-e-Ka'bah. Before this... in these 400, no cycle has manifested at any time. The first one manifested. Now in this period, in the 400 cycles that have passed, in it, 40 *jussas* are such that have manifested over ten cycles each. Cyclical... over ten cycles. How many will there be? In the *mawr*? 4 lakh *jussas*. Among them, who is the greatest? The first one. The one that manifested at the beginning of the *mawr*. The first one. So the *mawri jussa* has a very great wisdom. And who will be greater than that? The one that manifested at the beginning of the first *mawr*. His greatness is such that no one can reach him. And if anyone is equal to him, it will be the final *jussa* when the world is about to end, his *zuhur* will be. No one can reach him. Now, in 399 cycles, the 400th *jussa* will manifest in the Khana-e-Ka'bah. And the cyclical *jussas* have been mentioned. They are at various places, some at the station of Ghadir, some at the station of Rawda, some at... Najaf, Karbala... at some station, at some station. Those are their manifestations. All the *jussas* that have manifested before are respected. We visit them. But Sarandip is not like that. Because it is of the present time. It is not counted among the holy places. The manifestation of Janab Adam is mentioned from that place. Now we do not count it among the holy places. The previous *jussas* that manifested are holy places. Its reason is that in that era, the people who manifested were mostly of Arab manifestations. The *mihrab* of Kufa. And after that... the one who comes as the final of the second *mawr*, what will he do? He will gather his *mawr*. Everyone has a sphere. He will gather his *mawr* and where will he reach? Where will his seat be? With the one of the first *mawr*. Which is the first *mawr*? When the world began, the first *jussa-e-ibtida'iyyah* of the first *mawr*. In his court... court, for that, what word has been used? *ufuq* (horizon). He will reach his *ufuq*. What will happen there? His second seating will be established. Second seating. The first seating was his, this is his second seating. And with him will be what? All... the *qa'im* of the time, what is there with him? The *jussas* are gathered. The *jussas* are gathered there. And a *jussa*... the cyclical *jussa* comes, what happens? Its seating is established there. And the *jussa* of the *mawr*... what does it do? The two *jussas* that are gathered with it, it gives them to the *sahib-e-mawr* of the next coming *mawr*. Who is his successor? Who is the successor of the one of the first *mawr*? The *jussa* of the next coming *mawr*. He is his true successor, his complete successor. The cyclical *jussa* is not the successor, but the *mawri jussa* is the successor. Now the one who will manifest in the Khana-e-Ka'bah in the coming 400th cycle, whose *khalifah* is he in reality? He is the *khalifah* of the one above him, of this *jussa*, but partially. Of the previous cycle. In reality, whose successor is he? Of the previous cycle. Of the first *mawr*. Of the second *mawr*. The *sahib-e-jussa-e-ibtida'iyyah* of the second *mawr*, he is the highest, isn't he? He will become his successor, that too partially. Partially. Partially, he will become the successor. Until 4 lakh *jussas* are completed. Now when the 4 lakh *jussas* are over, the third *mawr* will come, and he in reality will be the successor of this second *mawr*. He is preparing for him. Who? This *sahib-e-mawr*... for whom is he preparing? For the next one. He is preparing a *mawri jussa* like himself. This is it. A *da'i* prepares a *da'i*. A *mad'u* prepares a *mad'u*. The method that is fixed for it.

From al-Mabda' wa'l-Ma'ad. Okay. The Fourth Suradiq is finished. Thirty-fourth Suradiq. Yes, Bismillah al-Rahman al-Rahim. Yes, the Fourth Suradiq from the book al-Anwar. It gathers five abwab. The first bab among them gathers five fusul. The first fasl among them is the Fourteenth Suradiq from the book al-Anwar, which gathers five abwab. And the bab al-awwal among them gathers five fusul, and the first fasl among them... Narjaʿu ilā siyāqihi al-qawl min ḥaythu intahā min al-qawl (We return to the flow of the discourse from where the discourse ended) by the Qa'im. And that is, when he, upon whom be remembrance and peace, appears, wa-waqaʿa al-ḥisāb wa-istaqbala bi-ahli al-ʿiqāb wa'l-ʿadhāb (and the reckoning occurs, and he confronts the people of punishment and torment) fa-ḍāʿafa al-thawāb ahli al-thawāb (then the reward for the people of reward will be multiplied.) Now we return towards the discourse... Kalam (discourse). Siyaqah means of making the discourse flow. The meaning of 'saqa' is to make something move. Siyaqah means making the qawl (discourse) flow. Ilā siyāqat al-maṣdar (towards the flowing of the source/infinitive). Maṣdar (infinitive) means to make it flow. Chalana (to make flow). What is a maṣdar (infinitive)? That in which the Urdu "na" comes. Khana (eating), peena (drinking), chalana (making flow). Siyaqah. Towards the flowing of the qawl (discourse)... to the flowing of the qawl from where we had ended it, our qawl... in the state of the Qa'im. In the state of the Qa'im, 'alayhi al-salam. And that is the matter... that is the matter, that he, when... when you appear... when you appear... when idhā comes, the meaning becomes that of the mudari' (imperfect tense). Iḍā ẓahara. Ẓahara is madi (perfect tense), but when idhā comes, it becomes mudari'. When lam comes, it is mudari' but the meaning becomes that of the madi. When you appear, upon you be zikr and salam, and the hisab (reckoning) will occur. And hisab will occur. Then, the ahl-e 'iqab (people of punishment) will receive 'adhab (torment). No. ...wa-istaqbala bi-ahli al-ʿiqāb wa'l-ʿadhāb (...and he confronts the people of punishment and torment). And they will meet the ahl-e 'iqab with torment. They will turn their attention to. They will turn their attention with the ahl-e 'iqab towards the 'adhab. And the thawab (reward) will be more for the ahl-e thawab (people of reward). Then... then... Fa (then)... then, more will be... then the thawab will be more for the ahl-e thawab. Who are these ahl-e 'iqab? The bad people who will be the azdad (opposites). When they are made to reach the 'adhab, made to reach saqar (hellfire). That will happen. So it won't just be that, but rather, the ahl-e thawab, those who have done good deeds, their thawab will increase. Their thawab will be multiplied. Fa-qāma al-daʿwah ilā an yastakhrija minhā man yakūnu maqāmuhu fī iqāmat al-daʿwah wa-takhallafa fī man fī ḍimnihi ilā rutbat al-ʿaql al-ʿāshir (So he established the da'wah so that he may extract from it one whose station will be in establishing the da'wah, and he will succeed among those within his fold to the rank of the Tenth Intellect, al-'aql al-'ashir). Al-'aql al-'ashir. ʿaqlan tāmman kāmil an nūrāniyyan aḥad al-ʿuqūl al-ibdā'iyyah (a perfect, complete, luminous intellect, one of the Primordial Intellects). And he will establish the da'wah... so that one will emerge from your da'wah... He will establish the da'wah. And he will establish the da'wah, so that from his da'wah will emerge... yastakhrija minhā (he will extract from it). He will extract from it... he will extract from his da'wah one who will establish his maqam (station)... in the iqamat al-da'wah (establishment of the da'wah). So they will be transferred. They will be transferred... they will pass away... bi-man fī ḍimnihi (with those in his fold)... with those in his fold... to the rutbat al-aql al-'ashir (rank of the Tenth Intellect). Whatever is in the 'aql al-'ashir. Your 'aql al-'ashir is... that is, the rank above you has ten maratib (levels). Those ten maratib... with them is the jussa-i ibda'iyyah (Primordial Corporeality). 'aql al-'ashir means jussa-i ibda'iyyah? Jussa-i ibda'iyyah. So its point is the most exalted. The jussa-i ibda'iyyah, its exaltation... the jussa-i ibda'iyyah that is there, a seat will remain with them. This is a principle that no person can be promoted until their successor is born. Now, what kind of successor should it be? A juzwi (partial) successor... promotion doesn't happen from a juzwi successor. This is the principle. The successor must be kulli (universal). Then their promotion happens. Now there is the jussa-i ibda'iyyah. The Imam's qiyam (rising) happened. So what happened? Can the Imam go and become the deputy of the jussa-i ibda'iyyah? No. They are juzwi. The Qa'im 'alayhi al-salat wa al-salam is a successor of the jussa-i ibda'iyyah, a juzwi one. Who will be its successor, of the jussa-i ibda'iyyah? One like the jussa-i ibda'iyyah. `Lā yukhlifu aḥadun illā mithluhu` (No one succeeds except one like him). This is its... no one succeeds universally as a khalifah except a person like him. When the jussa-i ibda'iyyah comes, then its khalifah... however many... in the dawr (cycle) of the jussa-i ibda'iyyah, how many qawrs are there? Four... four lakh. A qawr has 400,000 dawrs. Each dawr is 400,000 years. However many individuals there are, all of them will go and stay in its ufuq (horizon). All of them will be juzwi. Who will be the kulli? Such a jussa-i ibda'iyyah. When it appears, it will go and become its successor in a kulli manner, and that jussa-i ibda'iyyah will be exalted. This same thing is established at every level. There is an Imam. Who is the Imam's khalifah? The second Imam. The seventh Imam came, his rank was exalted. Who will be the khalifah of that seventh Imam? A seventh Imam just like him. He is the khalifah kulli. The smaller Imams, those of a lesser rank, a one-rank Imam, they cannot become its khalifah kulli. They will be khalifahs, but in a juzwi manner. They cannot be kulli. And Sayyidna Sadiq would say to Sayyidna Jumali, "Where you say 'juzwi', the meaning should be 'kulli'. And where you say 'kulli', there 'juzwi' should be kept in mind." That is, juzwi is also with it. Like... ʿaqlan tāmman kāmil an nūrāniyyan (a perfect, complete, luminous intellect). In the likeness of a perfect, complete intellect, which is complete and luminous. Aḥad al-ʿuqūl al-ibdā'iyyah (one of the Primordial Intellects). Like one of the ʿuqūl ibdā'iyyah. So the jussa-i ibda'iyyah will be promoted. The first... the most excellent one will go and take the place of the 'aql 'ashir. You are talking about your final dawr? The final dawr. He said, 'aql 'ashir, 'aql tasi'. The ninth will take the place of the eighth. The eighth, the seventh. The seventh... where will it go? To the sixth. The sixth to the fifth's place.
