At the time of passing, what remained of the sensory soul and the vegetative soul, they become one. The sensory soul... the vegetative soul... it has been said for the believer that his vegetative soul goes into his body. The sensory soul is with the form. What remained of the sensory soul that is remaining, it ascends... it ascends with the form. It becomes the vegetative soul. It remains in the grave. The sensory and vegetative... the sensory one progresses. They are one. The one that did not progress, the sensory one... first, the sensory and vegetative were one. First, the vegetative came. Where? In the sperm-drop. Then the vegetative, progressing and progressing, when it manifested in the world, it became sensory. The vegetative and sensory became one. When the passing happened, then what will happen is that the lower part is the vegetative one, and the higher part... ascends with the form. The lower part of the sensory one merges with the vegetative. With the vegetative. The one that ascended with the form, it ascended. And the process of the vegetative one is that... then the sensory and vegetative, which are one, go through the process. They go through. And it will become lofty as vapor, towards the temperament and the blended. From whom? The bones. Then they will return to the earth. Then they will return to the earth. *Fa yan'aqidu fi'l-ma'adin yaqutatan wa durran wa lu'lu'an wa jawahira sharifatan thaminatan makhzunatan...* (And solidifies in the mines as rubies, pearls, and precious, valuable, stored-up jewels...). Thus they will become in the mines... they will solidify in the mines, becoming rubies, and pearls, and... and precious jewels that are valuable, and stored... stored by the kings. Upon their noblest state, that which they will be, and its most honorable. And it is the most noble of them. *Fa idha ana wafa'u al-kawr al-a'zam, intahanat tilka al-jawāhir wa sa'adat fa sārat kawākiba khālifatan li sab'ati al-kawākib wa'l-burūj al-ithnā 'ashar* (So when the fulfillment of the Great Cycle arrives, those jewels are ground up and ascend, and become planets succeeding the seven planets and the twelve constellations). This is a long matter. But sir, it's not understood that however precious the mine may be, a bone is still a bone. It has progressed and become a part of the *hadqah* (physical body of a Hudud). However precious a jewel it becomes, that [original state] would be greater than it. Greater than what? Meaning, the part of the *hadqah* that it was, its bone, is certainly greater than a jewel. So then it is becoming a jewel, meaning it is going backward. Because from mineral comes plant, from plant comes animal. It is becoming a mineral. That thing is... those bones, etc., it takes a very long time for them to be transformed. Because they have to manifest where? They have to manifest with the *Jussa-i-Ibda'iyyah*. Their manifestation is with the *Jussa-i-Ibda'iyyah*. The bones. Yes. So they are kept in the mines. So that the manifestation happens there. Meaning, they are preserved. If they come late... they come late, but the entire... the complete purification happens, and they come. At the *Jussa-i-Ibda'iyyah*, they assemble. In this Great Cycle, there is no more dissolution for some. That will remain as it is. But the food, whatever it will be, it will... it will not be subject to dissolution again. The old bones from before the Great Cycle, they are given a place now, to come and take the place of the body that has gone. The old Great Cycle. It's a very big process. So when the fulfillment of the Great Cycle arrives... What does *kawr* mean? The small cycle. 12,960 crore... the cycle of 4 lakh. Yes. The cycle of 4 lakh. So when it becomes close... the manifestation of the Great Cycle becomes close, then they are ground... those jewels are ground, and they ascend. Thus they become planets, succeeding the seven planets and the twelve constellations. Now they have to go up. So in that much time... in that much time, what is the duration of the 4 lakh cycle? The small cycle... what is the duration of the cycle? It has been stated. It is stated. That now they have to go and gain the successorship of the seven planets. The seven planets that will fall in the 4 lakh cycle, then these will ascend, so they won't fall. They won't fall. At that time, when the Great Cycle is ending, what will descend from above, they are the bones of the *Hudud*. And they are the planets and constellations, they will become dust, and from that dust, the bones will be created. They will be created. *Fa sarat kawakib* (so they became planets). Thus they will become planets. Succeeding the seven planets and the twelve constellations. Succeeding the seven planets and the twelve constellations. Preserving their places. Preserving their places. Going there... The things that will fall, the bones will fall... the bones will take their places. The bones of the *Hudud*. The places. Before which the bones had gone, they will fall, and these bones will ascend. The places, meaning the places of these bones. The places. The bones... the places of the planets. The planets. Yes. Preserving their places. The bones. The pronoun *-hā* goes back to the planets, doesn't it? Yes, the statement is... *fa sārat kawākib khālifatan li sab'ati al-kawākib* (so they became planets succeeding the seven planets). So they will become planets, succeeding the seven planets and the twelve constellations. Preserving their places. The bones... the bones... the people who... the bones... that is, what is falling... the bones are ascending. On the place of those that will fall, they will be preserved. The bones. No, their... the pronoun *-hā* goes back to the planets. Yes, the statement is... *fa sārat kawākib* (so they became planets). So they will become planets... *khālifatan li sab'ati al-kawākib* (succeeding the seven planets). So they will be successors to the seven planets and twelve constellations. *Hāfizatan li amākini-hā* (preserving their places). Preserving their places. Whom are they guarding? These bones that will ascend. These bones that will ascend, those constellations from which things will fall, on their places they will be guarding. They will guard. They will take their place. Arranged according to their ranks. They are arranged according to the rank... according to their ranks. And the first ones will fall. And they will remain as successors to them there, in those heavens, until the supports of the heavens loosen. A new cycle will come, they will remain until then. A cycle is ending. There... *wa sa'ada...* So these that ascend, the bones, for one cycle, they will become heavens and constellations. They will become. *Wa sa'ada a'qabu-ha* (And its successors ascended). And their successors will ascend. *Wa inhadarat fa yakunu minhā tilka al-jussatu al-ibdā'iyyah* (And it descended, and from it will be that Primary Corporeal Entity). And they will fall... thus from it will be... from it will be that Primary Corporeal Entity. The *nasut* of the *Jussa-i-Ibda'iyyah* is from the bones which remain there. And the sun will be... the sun will be that unique individual with the rank of oneness, the *Qa'im* among them, in the station of the First Originator. And the moon will be its *bab* (gate). Thus the moon will be its *bab*. *Al-mutasallim li's-suwari's-sā'idah wa bāqī-him sā'ir al-hudūd 'alā hādhā an-namat wa'n-nizām ta'qubu-hu fi'l-khidmah ilā an yusfa jami'u ajsāmi-him 'alā murūri'l-awqāt wa'l-a'sār* (The one who receives the ascending forms, and the rest of them are all the Hudud, upon this pattern and system, following him in service until all their bodies are purified over the passage of times and ages). Upon this pattern and system... Thus the moon will be its *bab*, the one who receives... the one who receives the ascending forms. And their remaining ones are all the *Hudood* on this pattern and system, who follow... that all those *Hudood* follow in service, until they are purified... all their bodies are purified over the passage of times and ages. *Wa lā yabqā minhā shay'un fī 'ālami'l-kawn wa'l-fasād* (And nothing of them remains in the world of generation and corruption). And nothing... not a single thing of them will remain in the world of generation and corruption. *Illā 'ā'idatan ilā mahalli's-safā wa dāri'l-baqā, 'azīzatan mahbūratan ghaniyyatan maghfūratan hayyatan bāqiyatan masrūratan* (Except returning to the abode of purity and the abode of eternity, honored, gifted, rich, forgiven, living, eternal, happy). Except that they will return... they will return to the abode of purity and the abode of eternity. Honored... and... *mahbur*, *khabar* means given... to whom it has been given. Rich, and forgiven, living, eternal, happy. *Wa li-mithli hādhā fal-ya'mali'l-'āmilūn* (And for the like of this, let the workers work). And for this example, the workers work. They work. May Allah join us with them and not separate us from them, and make us among their company, by the right of Muhammad and his pure family, may the blessings of Allah be upon them all. The *Jussa-i-Ibda'iyyah* that is going to appear, what will be gathered with it? The processes are for understanding. The *Jussa-i-Ibda'iyyah* that is to come, whose *khalifah* is it? It is the *khalifah* of the first *Jussa-i-Ibda'iyyah*. What is the first *Jussa-i-Ibda'iyyah* doing? It is preparing all the souls and forms. It is preparing them. For whom is it preparing them? For its progeny. That progeny... becomes the *Qa'im*. Then the *Qa'ims* gather at the *Qa'ims* of the cycles. The one of the cycle gathers at the *Qa'im* of the great cycle. The great cycle... that becomes a *bab* and connects with what? With the *Jussa-i-Ibda'iyyah*. The next one. The next one. Just as an Imam prepares for whom? For the progeny. For his progeny. In the same way, the *Jussa-i-Ibda'iyyah* of the past are preparing for the *Jussa-i-Ibda'iyyah* that is to come. All the forms and souls are gathered. After being gathered, with them, the vegetative souls have come into the *nasut*. The sensory souls have come into the form. Of whom? Of the *Jussa-i-Ibda'iyyah*. Now after that, these bones are ascending. Ascending, what happens? They come and become the holy *nasut* of the *Jussa-i-Ibda'iyyah*. They become the *nasut*. So all things are gathered in one place. In the 4 lakh cycle... Yes, after the 4 lakh cycle, when the purification... They have delayed in coming... they have delayed. Because of that, they came in the bones. The highest part is what? The soul. After that, what? The sensory soul. The highest is the form. After the form, the sensory soul, then the vegetative soul. Then the parts of the body. In the parts of the body too, there is a difference. One is at the station of the heart, one at the station of hearing, one at the station of sight. After that, then it is the rank of the bones. So all these come and ultimately, what is the *Jussa-i-Ibda'iyyah*? Thus, they are all gathered at the holy *Jussa-i-Ibda'iyyah*. So the *khuddam* from which the manifestation is going to happen, the heavens that will fall, will become dust, and from that, from the pits, the bones will be formed. The bones of the *Jussa-i-Ibda'iyyah* will be formed. The souls and forms will become. And the people of that time, their things will be attained by them. The point is that... there are such believers, respondents, and *Qa'ims*, the points of all of them are present where? With the *Jussa-i-Ibda'iyyah*. Sir, paradise for the soul is *Jannatu'l-Ma'wa*, *Suratu'l-Muntaha*. What is there for the body? For the body is the paradise of the *hadarat* (presences). The *hadarat*. The paradise of the *hadarat*. The paradise of the *hadarat* is what? A person lives with peace in the world and lives in comfort. This is one paradise for him. And those paradises of the *'aliyat* (lofty ones), in that paradise, what is there? There, the body does not go. Whatever goes there, the soul goes there. That is the paradise of the soul. But the body also experiences hardship, right? But the body also experienced hardship by fasting... There should be no hardship. What fasting? I mean, fasting, and... Fasting is not obligatory for him at that time. Fasting is from the obligations... I mean, in the state of choice, when... In the state of choice. There will be no question of hunger. And fasting will not be obligatory. The hardships will be removed. In those lofty paradises, fasting is not obligatory. When fasting is not obligatory, at that time a person wants to eat something, any fruit, he can eat it. There is so much... in that... the realm of the *hadarat* which has been described, there every kind of... scenery and joys and happiness will be there. The world's [troubles] are due to our mutual relations, due to social strife. There is no strife there. This is not a description of *kashf* (unveiling), but of the *hadarat*. Yes. The *kashf* is different. The realm of *kashf* is different. And in the *dawr-i-satr* (period of concealment) too, the stations that are there, in the *kashf* there are *hadarat*, that is also the same realm. There too, there is such happiness. Sir, this statement... And this figure, 7 planets and 12 constellations, is 19. Equal to the numerical value of *Bismillah al-Rahman al-Rahim*. The planets are seven, the constellations are twelve. Now the day that is coming, the 15th, what is it on the 15th? What day is it? It's the 15th... it's the 15th of the month. So the *tasbih* (rosary prayer) you know, the *tasbih* that was taught. The *tasbih* of the 100... *Astaghfirullāha yā Dhā'l-Jalāli wa'l-Ikrām*. The *tasbih* of the days. The *tasbih* of the days. In the *tasbih* of the days, it has been said, how many days are there? In a year, how many days are there? 365. 365. 354. 354, the Hijri year. 354. And if it's a leap year, then 355. How do you get 354? 30, 29, 30, 29... 12 times 30 is 360. Now subtract six days. The two... 354 days. If it's a leap year, then 355. 354 days. In 354 days, 100 days are the highest among them. The *tasbih* I told you about before. Which days are they? The first of Muharram. After that, then... the tenth day... the day of 'Arafah. The day of 'Arafah. Eid al-Fitr... Eid al-Adha. Then three days of *Ayyam al-Tashriq*. Seven. 18th Dhu'l-Hijjah. And what is it? That makes eight. And the ninth day is the day of the appearance of the *Qa'im*. The day of the *Qiyam*, the day of the *Qa'im's* appearance. The *tasbih* is of how many? 99 beads. The *tasbih* has 99 beads. 33, 33, 33. And the Imam is separate from the *tasbih*. So the Imam is understood. The *tasbih* of 99 is done. Now in that, 18 are separated. Which 18? The first... the first of Muharram. Tenth of Muharram. Then... first of Rajab. Then 15th of Rajab. The day is coming. The sixth day is the 15th of Rajab. And then after that, the 27th of Rajab. Then the 15th of Sha'ban. Six. After that, 17, 19, 21, 23 of Ramadan Sharif. Ten days. Yes, ten days. After that, Eid al-Fitr. Eleven. After that, then *Yawm Nuzulika*. Twelve. After that, then... 'Arafah, thirteen. 'Arafah, thirteen. Eid al-Adha, fourteen. And three days of *Ayyam al-Tashriq*. Seventeen. And 18th Dhu'l-Hijjah. Eighteen days are special. And that 18th is also a date, and the 18th day is the most excellent day. And in that too, the most... 18th which is *Yawm al-Ghadir*, is the most excellent day of the year. Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq, what does he say? What, could there be a day better than this? No, by God! No, by God! No, by God! three times he says. No, by God's oath, no, by God's oath, no, by God's oath.

The fourth *sadiq*, third *fasl*, from the first *bab*, from the fourth *sadiq*. *Wa is ḥad intahābi al-qawl ilā mā intahā fa-nurīdu an nashfa'a mā qasamahu min al-qawl bimā nazīdu fī bayānihi wa īẓāḥihi.*
No, *ashbah*.
*An nashfa'a mā qasamahu min al-qawl bimā nazīdu fī bayānihi wa īẓāḥihi.* (that we add to what was mentioned of the speech with what we add in its explanation and clarification).
And when our speech finished here, until it finished, so we intended that we...
So we intend that we...
...join it... to join it... *shafa'at* means to join. We join it with what preceded, what was previous from the speech, so that we may increase its explanation and its clarification.
*Fa-naqūlu inna fī kalām al-muta'arif 'ind ahl al-ẓāhir an lā budda 'ind al-mawt min mubashshir wa bashīr li-ahl al-khayr wa munkir wa nakīr li-ahl al-sharr wa humā malakān yaḥḍurān al-insān 'ind mawtihi.* (So we say that in the common speech among the people of the exterior, it is necessary at the time of death to have a *mubashshir* and a *bashir* for the people of good, and a *Munkar* and a *Nakir* for the people of evil, and they are two angels who are present with the person at the time of his death).
And... truly... the speech of the *'arif*-possessing people...
No, *inna fī kalām al-muta'arif* (indeed in the common speech)... In such a speech that is... that is accepted among each other. Among every... every sect, this speech is present. This *hadith* has come from the Prophet. *An-na fī kalām al-muta'arif* (that in the common speech).
*Ind ahl al-ẓāhir* (among the people of the exterior).
Among the *ahl al-ẓāhir* (people of the exterior). It is necessary... that it is not... *lā budda* (it is necessary)... that it is necessary at the time of death from a *mubashshir* and a *bashir* for the people of good, and *Munkar* and *Nakir* for the people of evil. They are the two *malak*s who are present with the person at his death, the person's death.
*Wa huwa qawlun ṣaḥīḥun sumi'a min ahl al-ḥaqq wa gubara 'an al-'ālam ḥaqīqatuhu.* (And it is a true saying, heard from the people of truth, and its reality was hidden from the world).
And that saying is true; it was heard from the people of truth, and it became hidden from the world, its reality. *wa gubara 'an al-'ālam ḥaqīqatuhu.*
*Wa aradnā an lā nukhlī... nukhalliya kitābanā hādhā 'an dhālik.* (And we intended not to leave our book empty of that).
And we intended that... that its reality... and we intended that we not keep this book empty... you will not keep our book empty... this, of that matter, of that matter, and its reality.
*Wa al-qawl fī dhālik inna kulla nāṭiq... inna nāṭiq al-dawr wa...*
No, *inna kulla nāṭiqa dawrin... illā... inna kulla nāṭiqa dawrin wa waṣiyyuhu humā malakān al-mushār ilayhimā fī 'aṣrihimā min mubashshir wa bashīr li-awliyā'ihimā wa munkir wa nakīr li-aḍdādihimā.* (The saying in that regard is that every *Nāṭiq* of a cycle and his *Waṣī*, they are the two angels referred to in their time as *mubashshir* and *bashir* for their friends [*awliyā'*] and *Munkar* and *Nakir* for their opponents [*aḍdād*]).
And the saying in that matter is that every *Nāṭiq* of the *dawr* and his *Waṣī*, they are the two angels who were pointed towards, in their era, as *mubashshir* and *bashir* for their beloved ones... *li-awliyā'ihimā* (for their friends), for their *awliyā'*, for their beloved ones, and *Munkar* and *Nakir* for their *aḍdād*, their opponents.
Meaning they are both the same personality, but they become *Munkar* and *Nakir* for the *aḍdād* and *mubashshir* and *bashir* for the *awliya'*.
Yes. For their *awliyā'*. Either these will come or those will come. Either *mubashshir* and *bashir* will come... if the end is with good and love, then in the form of *mubashshir* and *bashir*. And if that is the case, then *Munkar* and *Nakir*. *Munkar* and *Nakir* will come and tell them their secret: which station you are going to. *Mubashshir* and *bashir* will tell them which station of paradise, which one they are going to reach. *Wa kadhālik...*
*Wa kadhālik kullu imām al-zamān... wa ḥujjatihi fa-huwa mubashshir wa bashīr li-awliyā'ihi wa munkir wa nakīr li-aḍdādihimā.* (And likewise every Imam of the Time and his *Hujjat*, he is *mubashshir* and *bashir* for his friends [*awliyā'*] and *Munkar* and *Nakir* for their opponents [*aḍdād*]).
And in the same way, every Imam of the *zamān* and his *hujjat*, he is *mubashshir* and *bashir*... a matter is contained, a matter in every time and era.
*Wa li-dhālik qāla Amir al-Mu'minin... Yā Ḥārith Hamdān man yamut yaranī min mu'minin aw munāfiqin ajala ya'rifunī ṭarafahu wa a'rifuhu bi-ismihi wa lā... wa lākinnī... bi-ismihi wa al-kunā wa mā fa'alā... wa ḥaqīqat dhālik...* (And for that reason, Amir al-Mu'minin said... O Harith Hamdan, whoever dies sees me, be they a believer or a hypocrite, soon. His eye recognizes me, and I recognize him by his name and... but I... by his name and his *kunyahs*, and what the two of them did... And the reality of that...).
O Harith Hamdan, if...
What is this saying? It's a poem of Janab Ali `alayhissalatu wassalam`. It's a poem. *Yā Ḥārith Hamdān man yamut yaranī.* (O Harith Hamdan, whoever dies sees me). *ḥār* is actually *ḥārith*, and in Arabic, due to the need of the poetic meter, the *tha* etc. can be dropped. *Yā Ḥārith Hamdān* (O Harith of Hamdan). O Harith of Hamdan. *Man yamut yaranī* (whoever dies sees me). Whoever passes away will see me. From the believers... *min mu'minin*... whether he is a believer or a hypocrite, he will see me soon, soon. At the time of passing, he will definitely... and that is the form that appears from that holy *hadith*.
*Ya'rifunī ṭarafahu wa a'rifuhu.* (His eye recognizes me, and I recognize him).
He will know me... he knows me from his... from his eye... and I recognize him... I know him by his name and his *kunyahs* (patronymics) and what he did. *wa mā fa'alā* (and what the two of them did). And those two who did, *fa'alā*... meaning if a *mu'min* does it or a *munāfiq* does it, I know all of his state.
So, since... in the form of *mubashshir* and *bashir*... your form, one form from the *haykal* appears... *mubashshir* and *bashir*... or *Munkar* and *Nakir*. If he is a *munāfiq*, then *Munkar* and *Nakir*.
Since you know, that's why the hands and feet will give testimony... that he did this, he did that.
*Wa mā fa'alā* (and what the two of them did). What the two of them did: what he did, and what the *munāfiq* did.
*Wa ḥaqīqat dhālik an-na khayāla kulli maqāmin min nāṭiqin wa waṣiyyin wa imāmin fī waqti kulli wāḥidin minhum 'alayhim yuḥarriku 'umūd al-nūr alladhī huwa al-sārī min 'ālam al-quds al-muttaṣil bi-ṣūrat kulli waliyyin ṣāḥib al-zamān 'alayhi afḍal al-salām.* (And the reality of that is that the imagination/form of every station from the *Nāṭiq*, *Waṣī*, and Imam, at the time of each one of them, upon them, moves the Pillar of Light [*'umud al-nur*], which is the one that flows from the world of holiness, connected to the form of every friend [*wali*], the master of the time, upon him be the best of peace).
And the reality of this matter is that the *khayāl* (form/imagination) of every station, that the *khayāl* of every station from the *Nāṭiq* and the *Waṣī* and the Imam, at the time of each one of them, they move the *'umūd al-nūr* (Pillar of Light), such that it is the one that flows from the *'ālam al-quds* (world of holiness) and it is connected to the form of every *wali* of the *ṣāḥib al-zamān* (Master of the Time).
The explanation of *'umūd al-nūr* has come in *Akhbar al-Latifa* in great detail. How is the connection of *'umūd al-nūr*? *Bayna al-mubdi'i wa al-mubda'i kalimah* (between the Originator and the originated is a Word). *Mubdi'* and *mubda'*... between them is a *kalimah*. Who is *mubdi'*? The Creator of the universe. And who are *mubda'*? All the *mubda'* that exist. *Bayna al-mubdi'i wa al-mubda'i kalimah* (between the Originator and the originated is a Word). What is the *kalimah*? The *kalimah* of *Lā ilāha illā Allāh*. The light of the *kalimah* of *Lā ilāha*. The light of the *kalimah*. That exists. And from it is connected the *'umūd al-nūr*. The connection of *'umūd al-nūr* is from it. And all the forms that exist, up to the *'aql al-awwal* (First Intellect), its luminous form is also connected to that *kalimah* of *Lā ilāha*. What is above the *'aql al-awwal*? The *kalimah*. *Lā ilāha*. It is connected to the *mubdi'*. No one can go beyond the *mubdi'*. The light that descended from the *nūr* of the *mubdi'`, connected to the *'aql al-awwal*, that is called the *kalimah*. And that same is called the *'umūd al-nūr*. From it, all the forms, the good forms that exist, are connected to it. Like a beehive.
So that *'umūd al-nūr* was... so that *'umūd al-nūr*... has different centers. One center is of whom? The *'aql al-awwal*. Then the *'āshir*, then the Imam of the time, then the *'ayn a'ẓimah*, the Imam of the time. Those centers... here too there are centers of electricity... the biggest center, smaller centers. So from there, the Imam `alayhissalatu wassalam`'s *khayāl*, at the time of a person's death, gives motion to that light. And what happens? That form... *al-muttaṣil bi-ṣūrat kulli wali* (connected to the form of every friend)... that... from the form of every *wali`, it goes and connects.
*Khayāl kull maqām...*
*Khayāl kull...*
Their attention. `Tawajjuh` can be taken as the meaning of `khayal`.
*Fa-yatakhayyalu lil-muntaqil 'ind ākhir daqīqah min 'umrihi... min 'umrihi al-ilāhī wa 'amalihi al-ṣāliḥ shakhṣan nūrāniyyan fa-yasurru bihi wa yabtajidu bi-sababihi wa yaghtabiṭu 'ind mu'āyanatihi wa ya'lamu bi-ladhdhatihi an-nahu ṣā'irun ilā khayr wa yufāriqu al-waqt wa al-ḥīn.* (And so it is imagined by the one transitioning, at the last minute of his life... of his divine life, and his righteous deed, as a luminous person. So he is pleased by it, and he rejoices because of it, and he is delighted at seeing it, and he knows by its pleasure that he is headed toward good, and he departs from the time and the moment).
So it is imagined for the one who is passing away, near the last minute of his... his *'ilm* (knowledge), his knowledge, such as the divine *'ilm* and his righteous *'amal* (deed), a luminous person, a luminous person. So he becomes happy with it. So he is pleased by it, and he obtains happiness because of it and feels joy at seeing it, at seeing it. And he knows at that time that he is going towards good.
And... this happens with every... every believer, this *'amal* happens. And he leaves at that time and moment. At that time and moment.
*Wa dhālik huwa ṣūratuhu allatī iqtanat... wa dhālik huwa ṣūratuhu allatī iqtanat min walāyat ahl al-ḥaqq wa 'ulūmihim al-ilāhiyyah wa a'mālihim al-ṣāliḥah ma'a awliyā' Allāh ta'ālā.* (And that is his form, which he acquired from the friendship [*walāyah*] of the people of truth, their divine knowledges, and their righteous deeds with the friends of God, the Exalted).
And that is his form, that he made... he made it from the *walāyah* of *ahl al-ḥaqq* (people of truth) and their divine knowledges and their righteous deeds with the *awliyā'* of Allah ta'ala.
This *hum* pronoun... his deeds? Everyone's deeds?
*Wa dhālik huwa ṣūratuhu allatī iqtanat* (and that is his form which was acquired)... which was made from the *walāyah* of *ahl al-ḥaqq* and their divine knowledges... *ahl al-ḥaqq*'s, *'ulūmihim*, and their righteous deeds. *Wa a'mālihim*, and their... whatever *ahl al-ḥaqq* there were, their *walāyah*, their *'ilm* and *'amal*, because of that, the form that was made.
...because of their *'amal*... from the *walāyah* of... the *'amal* of the *awliyā'*... the *'amal* of *ahl al-ḥaqq*... because of love for *ahl al-ḥaqq*... the *'ilm*... *ahl al-ḥaqq*, meaning the one who is dying is also from *ahl al-ḥaqq*, no? *Min walāyat ahl al-ḥaqq*. All the *ahl al-ḥaqq* that there are, from their *walāyah* and *'ilm* and *'amal`, the form that was made.
*Wa bi-dhālik ramaza Mawlānā al-Ṣādiq 'alayhi al-salām wa awradahu 'anhu Sayyidunā al-Nu'mān qaddasa Allāhu rūḥahu fī Da'ā'im al-Islām ḥaythu qāl, qāla Mawlānā al-Ṣādiq 'alayhi al-salām idhā ba'atha Allāhu 'azza wa jall al-mu'min min qabrihi kharaja ma'ahu mithālun ḥasanun... mithālun ḥasanun... fa-idhā marra bi-tilka al-shadā'id qāla lā takhaf laysa 'alayka ba's.* (And with this, our master al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, alluded, and it was transmitted from him by our master al-Nu'man, may God sanctify his spirit, in *Da'a'im al-Islam*, where he said: Our master al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, said: When God, the Mighty and Majestic, raises the believer from his grave, a beautiful image emerges with him... a beautiful image... So when he passes through those hardships, it says: 'Do not fear, there is no harm upon you').
And on this matter, Mawlana Sadiq `alayhissalam` pointed, and he transmitted it, Sayyidna Nauman `qaddasa Allahu ruhahu`, and he narrated that matter, Sayyidna Nauman `qaddasa Allahu ruhahu` in his book `Da'a'im al-Islam`, where he said, our master Sadiq says that when God `azzawajal` raises... when he raises... when God `azzawajal` raises the believer from his grave, a... a *mithāl*, a good example, a good example will emerge with that believer. Meaning its form, a luminous form will be with him, its...
The luminous form which is its... that is its real *'āqā*. It remains as a supervisor over its body. It keeps an eye on every part of its body. It is an angel. *Wa idhā marra bi-tilka al-shadā'id* (And when he passes through those hardships)... And when he passes through the hardships, from the hardships of the grave, he passes through, *qāla lā takhaf* (it says: 'do not fear'). That *mithāl` says... the form says... `qāla...` that *mithāl` says, *lā takhaf*, 'do not fear, there is no... upon you... do not fear... `laysa 'alayka min ba's` (there is no harm upon you). There will be no difficulty upon you.
*Fa-lā yazālu al-mu'minu... yu'amminuhu wa yubashshiruhu ḥattā... yūridahu 'alá Allāh ta'ālā wa yuḥāsibuhu ḥisāban yasīrā.* (And the believer does not cease... it gives him security and gives him good tidings until... it brings him to God, the Exalted, and He will call him to account with an easy accounting).
So they will always remain... they will keep giving security, and they will keep giving good tidings until that one reaches... it will cause to reach... it, that *mithāl`, will cause him to reach Allah Ta'ala, God, the Exalted, and his account will be taken, an easy account.
On every part of the body, the luminous form's radiance occurs, and that is where its parts of the body, where do they reach? They keep progressing and reach their station.
And his account will be taken, an easy account.
*Thumma yamurru bihi ilá al-jannah... fa-yaqūl lahu al-mu'minu man anta raḥimaka Allāh wa qad wa'adtanī... fa-ṣadaqtanī wa ammantanī khawfī.* (Then it passes with him to Paradise... and the believer says to it: 'Who are you, may God have mercy on you? You promised me... and you were true to me, and you secured me from my fear').
So it will say to him, to the believer, that 'who are you? May Allah's mercy be upon you... for you promised me and you proved it true, and you proved it true. You had promised to give me security, you fulfilled that promise. `Wa ṣadaqtanī`, and you proved me true, and you gave me security from my fear, from my fear.
*Fa-yaqūlu...* So that *mithāl* will say, `anā khalqun min khalqi rabbī khalaqanī min al-surūr alladhī kunta tudkhiluhu 'alá al-mu'minīn.* (I am a creation from the creation of my Lord. He created me from the joy that you used to bring to the believers). I am a creation from the creations of Allah. He created me from the joy, such that you used to cause to enter it upon the believers. You used to make the believers' hearts happy, the work you used to do, the *'ilm* and *'amal` you used to practice. *Fa-anā asurruka al-yawm.* (So I am making you happy today). So I am making you happy today. That *mithāl` will say. That luminous form that is with him, it itself becomes an angel who takes it to all the stations. It protects its stations. Allah Ta'ala's decrees are such that no particle can go anywhere else. Whichever particle has a connection with whichever one, like a magnet, it pulls all its particles. They can't be scattered.
*Al-fasl al-rābi' min al-bāb al-awwal min al-ṣādiq al-rābi'.* (The fourth *fasl* from the first *bab* of the fourth *sadiq*). The fourth *fasl* from the first *bab* of the fourth *sadiq*.
*Fa-dhālika ḥaqīqatun mubashshir wa bashīr lil-waliyy... wa ammā al-ẓiddu... li-waliyy...* (So that is a reality, a *mubashshir* and a *bashir* for the friend. And as for the opposite... for the friend...).
This is the reality of *mubashshir* and *bashir* for the *wali*. And as for the opposite... *wa bashīr lil-waliyy* (and a *bashir* for the friend).
This is the reality of *mubashshir* and *bashir* for the *wali*. *Wa ammā al-ẓidd fa-inna al-magnāṭīs al-khabīth al-muẓlim alladhī huwa al-'uqdatān bi-ḥarakat al-maqām lahumā yuḥarrikān... bi-ḥarakat al-maqām lahumā... yuḥarrikān al-muhill al-iblīsī wa 'amalahu al-khabīth alladhī kāna ya'maluhu wa ya'taqiduhu fī ahl al-ḥaqq wa yukinnuhu lahum min al-'adāwah wa yuḍmiru fīhim min al-munāsabah wa al-bughḍ lahum wa al-a'māl al-khabīhah.* (And as for the opposite, indeed the evil, dark magnet, which is the two knots, by the movement of the station for them, they move... the satanic dissolver and his evil deed which he used to do and believe regarding the people of truth, and what he used to conceal for them of enmity, and what he used to harbor in them of dispute and hatred for them, and the evil deeds).
And as for the opposite, indeed that evil magnet... whose end was not with good. So that evil, dark magnet, such that it is the two *'uqdah*s (knots). The good magnet is which one? *'Umud al-nūr*. In opposition to it are the *'uqdatān*. The evil magnet. Such that they are the two *'uqdah*s, by the movement of the *maqām*... for them...
One was made for the good, and two were made for the evil.
They are two. In *'umūd al-nūr*, two were not mentioned, only one was mentioned.
This... its chain of the *'umūd al-nūr* is coming from very high up, from the *kalimah`. And these are just from the *'uqdatān`. The *'uqdatān`, where, how were the *'uqdatān` made? The head of the snake, that Allah Ta'ala made, `aflāk` (celestial spheres) were made. When *aflāk` were made, so those things which, in the world of light, went forward and then went forward and then took precedence (`sayṭanat`), satanic nature (*iblīsiyyat*) they adopted. First they were good, then... So for that reason, they were placed high up. They were not kept with the *saqar* (hellfire). Those high beings who repented but were inclined towards Shaytan, all their things were placed in the *'uqdatān`. And they were placed high up, due to wisdom. *'Āshir*`s intention. There are specific intentions of the *'āshir`. Because of those specific intentions of the *'āshir`, those *'uqdatān` were... the things of *saqar` are, but they are placed high up, under the sphere of the moon.
*Bi-qaṣdin min al-'ināyat al-ilāhiyyah.* (with an intention from the divine providence).
This is a specific intention. *'Āshir* is... there are only a few specific intentions. In that, this intention is also there, the *'uqdatān`.
And those two are the *'uqdatān`, by the movement of the *maqām` of the Imam `alayhissalam` for those two. For those two... the decree (`tadbir`) of the Imam is in effect on them. But Imam `alayhissalatu wassalam`, those who are his `aḍdād` (opponents), the things they... the bad deeds they have done, their requital is also granted by him. *yuḥarrikān... al-muhill al-iblīsī* (they move... the satanic dissolver). They give motion to his satanic *'ilm` (knowledge) and his evil *'amal` (deed) that he used to do, and believe about the `ahl al-ḥaqq` (people of truth), and what he used to conceal from them of enmity, and what he used to harbor in them from dispute and from hatred for them and evil deeds.
*Wa huwa ṣūratuhu allatī iqtanat min dhālik shay'an ba'da shay'in fa-yatakhayyalu lahu fī ākhir daqīqah min 'umrihi shakhṣan muẓliman mushawwahan 'alá abha' mā yakūnu ashwahan wa ashbahihi.* (And that is his form, which he acquired from that, bit by bit. And so it is imagined by him, in the last minute of his life, as a dark, disfigured person, in the most ugly and disfigured state possible).
And that is his form that was made from that, little by little. So it is imagined to him, a person, a dark person, disfigured, ugly, and more evil that he is, and more... because of its ugliness.
*Fa-yunkiruhu wa yufzi'uhu wa yuqalqiluhu wa yahūluhu thumma yanqaṭi'u 'anhu dhālik wa qad 'alima an-nahu min ahl al-sharr wa hādhā ḥaqīqat al-Munkar wa al-Nakīr.* (So he rejects it and it frightens him, and it agitates him and it horrifies him. Then that is cut off from him, and he has known that he is from the people of evil. And this is the reality of Munkar and Nakir).
So he dislikes it and it frightens him, and it gives him trouble, and it becomes a cause of horror for him. Then it is cut off from him, and he has known that he is from the people of evil.
*Wa bi-dhālik ramaza rasūl Allāh ṣalawāt Allāh 'alayhi wa 'alā ahlihi fi wa'ẓihi li-qays ibni 'āṣim fa-qāla yā qays innahu lā budda laka min qarīnin yudfanu ma'ak wa huwa ḥayyun wa tudfanu ma'ahu wa anta mayyitun.* (And with this, the Messenger of God, blessings of God be upon him and his family, alluded in his sermon to Qays ibn 'Asim, so he said: O Qays, indeed it is necessary for you to have a companion who will be buried with you while he is alive, and you will be buried with him while you are dead).
And on this matter, Rasulullah `salawatullah alayhi` pointed in his sermon to Qays ibn 'Āṣim, he said, O Qays ibn 'Āṣim, our master Qays ibn 'Āṣim, you advised him. In it, you said... And he said, O Qays, indeed it is necessary for you to have a companion who will be buried with you. He will be buried with you, and he is alive. And you will be buried with him and you are dead.
*Fa-in kāna karīman akramak wa in kāna la'īman aslamak.* (if he is noble, he will honor you, and if he is base, he will abandon you).
And if you are noble, then he will be gracious to you. And if you are base, *aslamaka* (he will abandon you), he will hand you over, to him.
*Thumma lā yuḥsharu illā ma'ak.* (then he will not be resurrected except with you). Then the resurrection will not be except with you.
That luminous form... the bad form that is, it will be with him. With him, the resurrection will be done. With his body, his resurrection will be.
*Wa lā tub'athu illā ma'ahu.* (and you will not be raised except with him). *Illā ma'ahu`, meaning with that companion, that companion who is... *Illā ma'ahu`, meaning with that companion, that companion.
*Wa lā tus'alu illā 'anhu.* (and you will not be asked except about him). And you will not be questioned except about him, why you made that form ugly. *Fa-lā taj'alhu illā ṣāliḥan.* (so do not make him except righteous). So do not make him except righteous. Make him righteous. `Ilm` and `amal`. Make your luminous form righteous through `ilm` and `amal`. `Zād-e ākhirat` (provisions for the hereafter), what is it called? The hereafter's provision. That same luminous form, which is higher than your self (`zāt`). Your self is in its own place, but the `ilm` and `amal` you do, that is higher than the self.
*Idhā kāna ṣāliḥan lam ta'nis illā bihi wa idhā kāna fāḥishan lam tawḥash illā minhu wa huwa 'amaluka.* (If he is righteous, you will not find comfort except in him, and if he is obscene, you will not feel terror except from him, and he is your deed).
If he is righteous, then you will not find comfort except in him. And if he is evil, then you will not feel terror except from him.
And he is your *'amal* (deed).
Meaning, if he is righteous, he will find comfort only with him. If he is evil, he will feel terror only with him. He will feel terror from him.
And he is your *'amal* (deed).
And for this reason, it was alluded...
There's a word missing. What have you written?
*Wa bi-dhālik ramaza...*
*Wa bihī ramaza Sayyidunā Ḥamīduddīn...*
It's missing.
Here, it's been written twice.
*Wa bihī ramaza Sayyidunā Ḥamīduddīn qaddasa Allāhu sawwabahu fī al-mashrab al-thālith min taṣawwur al-rābi' min rāḥat al-'aql ḥaythu dhikru al-ẓidd.* (And with this, our master Hamiduddin, may God rectify his reward, alluded in the third *mashrab* from the fourth *taṣawwur* of *Rāḥat al-'Aql*, where the opposite is mentioned).
*Fa-qāla wa tafsīru a'mālihi al-sayyi'ah ḥayawānan mu'dhiyan yu'dhīhi wa yurawwi'uhu.* (So he said, and the interpretation of his evil deeds is a harmful animal that harms him and terrifies him).
And in this regard, Sayyidna Hamiduddin `qaddasa Allahu sawwabahu` pointed in the third *mashrab*...
These are all the sayings of Sayyidna Hamiduddin that you have made easy. The sayings of Sayyidna Hamiduddin `qaddasa Allahu sawwabahu` are very profound (`mughlaq`). Regarding *Rāḥat al-'Aql`, I was reading with Sayyidna Ghulam Husain sahib, who came? It is written in your biographical accounts, about Sayyidna Ghulam Husain sahib. The Nawab Sahib of Rampur. He was a scholar of Arabic. He came. And came and said, "Mawlana, what book are you studying?" He said, "It's a book, `Rāḥat al-'Aql`." So he said, "Can I see it?" He said, "See it." For 15-20 minutes, he kept looking. Then he said, "I don't understand anything, what book is this?" He said, "The book is `Rāḥat al-'Aql` (Comfort of the Intellect), but for you, it is `Kulpat al-'Aql` (Agony of the Intellect)."
And towards that he pointed. And on this matter, Sayyidna Hamiduddin `qaddasa Allahu sawwabahu` pointed in the third *mashrab* of the fourth *sūr` from `rāḥat al-nafs`, where he mentioned the opposite, so he said, so its interpretation becomes... his evil deeds become... an animal, harmful, that gives him harm and makes him afraid.
His evil deeds become for him an animal, a harmful animal, and give him fear.
Yaqub, a pious... he had a very good habit. He would always come to the mosque to pray. Even if he was late, even if he got late, he would come to the mosque and pray. He was nearby, next door. Pneumonia happened in the end. A doctor came to him... A big doctor came, an Englishman... they came. Doctor? What does a doctor have to do with it? In front of me, I see Sayyidna Abdus-Salam Muqaddas. Sayyidna Abdullah sahib can't be seen, Sayyidna Abdullah sahib has appeared. He has come and is saying, "Your time has come, let's go." "Your time has come, let's go."

<!-- lecture 50 -->

(Fifth section, from the first chapter, from the fourth path, ninth section) ...from the sixth `bab`.

(Then, verily, this dark form, which separates from the souls of the bodies and their forms, the one that is) ... `al-`a'ilatun fi al-hawa` (`the one that wanders in the air`). `al-ja'ilatu`. `al-ja'ilatu fi al-hawa` (`the one that roams in the air`). Sometimes... and in the vile places, sometimes... and in the wide... dirty... dirty. Dirty, sometimes... flowing... towards the `barzakh`, which is dark and vile, which is the `uqdatan` (`the two knots`), and as the saying has preceded about it in what has come before, these mentioned places visit it in turns, and the empty valleys, and the terrifying wells. And they are the blameworthy jinn, who are punished during that, with what they deserve of the types of the subtle punishment... Each according to his measure.

Then this is that, the dark form... Then, verily, this dark form... Then this, the... Then this dark form leaves... No, `the one that leaves`. The one that leaves... It is an attribute. The one that leaves... the souls of the bodies. The souls of the bodies and their forms.

This dark form, how is it formed? From the knowledge and deeds that they did contrary to the commands of God, the knowledge they acquired. They acquired knowledge from such people from whom knowledge should not be acquired. They held enmity with the people of truth (`ahl-e-haqq`). So, this is a description of their dark form (`surat-e-zulmaniyyah`).

This dark form, which leaves the souls of the bodies... and their bodies. What did he say? What happens to their bodies? The form (`surat`) separates. And its station is the `uqdatayn` (`the two knots`). What happens to their soul (`nafs`)? The body expands in the grave. The soul expands within its body. Meaning, the soul, instead of progressing, instead of the soul going with the form, what happens? The soul spreads in the body, it becomes material, it acquires materiality. It becomes even more material. And what are the souls of the believers (`mo'minin`)? They progress with the form. This is the difference between the two.

The one that leaves... the souls of the bodies and their forms. `al-ja'ilah` (`the one that roams`). The one that does `jawlani` (roaming)... in the air. In the air, sometimes. And vile places... in vile places, sometimes... It says in the air they roam. They wander in the air. And in the vile places, sometimes. And in evil, vile places, sometimes... in vile places sometimes. The details of the vile have been told, at which places. At the place of the latrine, and all places where blood flows. Because what is blood, for us? Eating and drinking blood has been made forbidden. So they are inclined towards such things that are forbidden. Where wine is made, where filthy things are made, there they roam. Because they have an inclination for it.

And... in deep, wide wells, sometimes... they reach towards the `barzakh`... which are dark, vile. Like it is the `uqdatayn`. Reaching... The one that reaches (`sa'ilatin`) towards the `barzakh`... Towards the `barzakh`, which is dark (`muzlim`), which is vile (`khabis`), such as it is the `uqdatan`. The `barzakh`. What do they call `barzakh`? `Barzakh` is the path between paradise (`jannat`) and hell (`jahannum`). Now, where is their hell? `sakhrah`. Before reaching `sakhrah`, the station where they are is called `uqdatayn`. The forms (`surat`) reach `uqdatayn`. Now, their final destination to reach is `sakhrah`. The `barzakh` for that is `uqdatayn`. It is a quarantine station. A station built for staying a short duration, `uqdatayn`.

Is `uqdatayn` in the `barzakh` or in this world? For the punished (`mu`adhdhabin`), `uqdatayn` is the `barzakh`. The `mu`adhdhabin`, who will be punished in the future, their future punishment is to be given... they are in `uqdatayn`. Where is `uqdatayn`? Beneath the sphere of the moon. Now, from there... `barzakh` means a place to stay for a short time. Their final destination is where? `sakhrah`. Where they will remain until the `kawr-e-a`zam` (`Great Cycle`). And the `kawr-e-a'zam` is how much? Four hundred thousand `dawr` (cycles). Four hundred thousand `dawr`, in which each `dawr` is four hundred thousand years. That is their actual station. They have to come there. Before coming there, their forms are present in `uqdatayn`.

So before going to `uqdatayn`, they will pass through all these places? Or... They will pass through all the places. In the air sometimes... And in the vile... Or... just as he said, sometimes they roam in the air, sometimes in the vile places, sometimes in the... After that... towards the `barzakh`... After passing through all the places, then... then they have to go towards the `barzakh`. which is the `uqdatan`. Which is the `uqdatan`, and as the saying has preceded about it... As the saying was established before. So... they come in turns... to these mentioned... places. So... they come one after another. One after another, they come. In these places whose mention has been made. Meaning, passing through these places one by one. The forms, one by one... come. And the empty... And in the habitations which are empty... And the terrifying wells. `bir` means well. `muhawwishah` means terrifying wells. And they are the jinn who are given punishment... blameworthy, and are given punishment in the midst of that, which they were worthy of from the types of subtle punishment. Such a punishment that is a light punishment. They will be given it. Just as Mawla `Ali`... punished them. And they passed through various stations of punishment. Each according to his measure. Every person according to his capacity.

And it is necessary for every... And it is necessary. It is necessary that every Imam... calls them in his time... to Islam. Because that Imam, `alayhi al-salam` (peace be upon him), knows them, by their names and by their places. The incident that happened with Sayyidna `Ali`. With great detail, it is mentioned. He called each one by name. You are of this name, you are of this name, you are of this name. Not hidden from him is any... of their affair. Nothing is hidden. Nothing is hidden of any thing... from their affair. So whoever among them completes what is upon him of the lower punishment... and is permitted deliverance, he submits to the one who called... to the one who calls him and he repents and turns back... and he becomes one of the praiseworthy jinn (`jinn al-mahmudin`).

So they complete... among them, what is upon them of the lower punishment (`'adhab al-adna`). And... So the one who completes... yes. The person who completes from them what is upon him... of the lower punishment (`'adhab al-adna`). Then... then they are called. And permission is given to him... to him for deliverance... of the... What, from that lower punishment, his give-and-take was finished. Now he should return from it. Lower punishment... from `uqdatayn`, will they also come to `sakhrah` for the lower punishment? The lower punishment is... yes. In `uqdatayn` are the forms. The lower punishment is what? These are their bodies. And the forms are also... attached to the souls. With the souls... And permission is given to him for deliverance. `aslam` (`he submits`). He brings Islam (`islam lata hai`). To the one who, at that station, invited him. The one who invited him, for him, he brings Islam (`islam lata hai`). And he repents. And he repents and turns back. And he becomes one of the praiseworthy jinn (`jinn al-mahmudin`). And he becomes... from the jinn... praiseworthy. from the praiseworthy jinn. Meaning, from the blameworthy jinn (`jinn-e-madhmumin`) to the praiseworthy jinn (`jinn-e-mahmudin`), he has to pass through all this.

The blameworthy jinn used to be, before, the one whose end was not good. When his... a little bit that remains on him, its purification happens, and he accepts... the station of the `da'i` (inviter), he becomes one of the `jinn-e-mahmudin`. And he ascends, climbing to the sphere of the sun, from the side of the moon. And he is there as a servant (`khadiman`). `mustaqdimin`... `mustaqdimin`. Their station is that of the `mustaqdimin`, a glorious station. Sayyidna `Ali bin Sulayman` narrates, he said that... `[unclear]` Sayyidna... they went for `ziyarat` (visit). Where? To Sayyidna `Hasan Pir`. They went for `ziyarat`. From there, they were returning. They lost their way. You, Sayyidna `Hasan Khan` `sahib` were there. And they kept wandering and wandering until they saw... Sayyidna `Ali` `sahib` saw that some crow is coming from a distance. It is cawing. So you... no, you told Sayyidna `Hasan Khan` `sahib` to... climb that high... small hill... climb that small knoll. Go there and give the `adhan` (call to prayer). Or climb a tree and give the `adhan`. He went and gave the `adhan`. And with the giving of the `adhan`, some crow from a distance... cawing, it came. So you said that he is from the `jinn-e-mustaqdimin`. Follow him, we will reach the village. They walked on its path, and they reached the village where people were settled. So, in this, especially, the `jinn-e-mustaqdimin` are mentioned. And especially `jinn-e-mustaqdimin`... My grandmother used to say... When the river came here, the river came. So, where up to... water up to a man's height had filled up here. A full man's height of water had filled up. And Hazrat `Fathullah` `sahib-e-muqaddas` climbed... climbed up and gave the `adhan`. And with the giving of the `adhan`, slowly, slowly, slowly the water started to go down. The same way in Bombay, Hazrat `Ishaq` `sahib-e-muqaddas` had climbed on the `Jamani` building and given the `adhan`. A fire had broken out behind. Just as Hazrat `Nasrullah` `sahib-e-muqaddas` gave the `adhan`, a fire had broken out. And in our time, when we had gone for Hajj, there... what a glorious... The tent we were in... and in front of it... far away... it had burst. The gas cylinder had burst. And the whole... field of `Arafat` was completely on fire. And the whole... You were there at that time. You were there. At that time, of course... there was a stampede, everything. And the fire was coming towards us. We came out. The tent was left behind and we came out. And... gave the `adhan`. Gave the `adhan` with a loud voice. And with the giving of the `adhan`, the direction of the wind changed. The direction of the wind changed. And it went towards the mountains. And those who had fled to the mountains, they got trapped. They had climbed the mountains, many people. They got trapped in it. Where all... they went. They reached Makkah, some reached here, some reached there. Who was with us? You were. At that time, during Hajj. When the fire broke out. Were there any of the people sitting here? So always... yes? Maqbul... Maqbul, where... he had reached Makkah. So he stays as a servant (`khadim`). `mustaqdimin`... `mala'ikah` (`angels`)... are appointed for that time. And he is there as a servant (`khadiman`). So he stays there and serves. And he travels... he becomes from the group of serving angels (`mala'ikah`) in the circle of the sun... `mustaqdimin`... in the... in the... Where are they? In the sun. Their center is the sun. Who are entrusted with it... who are entrusted with it, which is... a hundred and forty thousand of them... The entrusted ones. They are entrusted with many affairs there. How many are they? `mustaqdimin`? A hundred and forty thousand. Among them are those who attract (`jadhibah`). `jadhibah`... Among them are those who attract. What ascends of the praiseworthy forms (`suwar al-mahmudah`). Those who attract. Good forms ascend, to attract them is their job. And among them are those who repel/push down (`dafi`ah`). And among them are those who repel. Who... What descends from it. Who are to be sent down to the world, they send them there. And among them are those who hold/restrain (`masikah`). And among them are those... who hold/restrain. For what travels within it. It travels in it. `jadhibah` (`attractors`), and `dafi`ah` (`repellers`), and `masikah` (`restrainers`). Because whenever one ascends from there... Because when one ascends... to there. Another is brought down from there in his place. One ascends, so in his place, another descends. The one who descends, it is not necessary that he goes to `sakhrah`. He comes to the world for service. He comes to become a believer. The one who is in the sun... one hundred and forty thousand... So when one descends, where does he descend to? To the world. So... So in a good state... to ascend? For ascending. For progressing. His service is complete. A hundred and forty thousand... and now in the world... he... good... He is born as a believer. Thus it is, forever and ever. Thus it is, forever and ever... in this way, always, forever.

The second chapter (`al-bab al-thani`) from the path... How many `surat` are there? One hundred and forty thousand. And what the Prophet said, how many prophets (`anbiya'`) are there? One hundred and twenty-four thousand. That is the number of prophets. This is... of whom? One hundred and forty thousand `mustaqdimin`. `suwarat-e-mustaqdimin`. So, a hundred and forty thousand... `[unclear]`. Munasabat... no, this... so that there is no confusion. So one hundred and forty thousand are `mustaqdimin`, and one hundred and twenty-four thousand are prophets. They are separate things. The second chapter (`al-bab al-thani`) ...from the fourth path... which contains... five sections (`fusul`). And from it, the first section. Whoever among these `mustakhdimin` (`those who are made to serve`) completes what is upon them of service there, is brought down from there to the earth, and it travels to a thing... from the edibles (`ma'kulat`) and drinkables (`mashrubat`). And... when it is complete, for these `mustakhdimin`, what is upon them of service... there... What does `mustakhdimin` mean? `mustakhdam`. `mustakhdam`. What does it mean? He has been taken forward. `khadama` means he served. `istakhdama` means... he wanted... he for whom service was done. `mustakhdam`. Its plural is `mustakhdamin`. So, the one who completes... from these `mustakhdamin`... what is obligatory upon him of service, there... he is brought down from there towards the earth and he reaches a thing from the edibles and drinkables. So he takes sustenance from it, which... he is worthy of... that sustenance be taken. That person has adopted this habit of eating? His parents' influence was there. His parents were like that at that time... his... his connection has not yet broken, so that is also apparent, but in the end, his fate will be good.

Then he appears at the time of union after that... of the child... of his... between the male organ of the `da'i` (`inviter`) and his wife... in a grade... as an ascension (`tarqiyatan`) for him in the stages of the fetus (`janin`) until he appears as a newborn, a complete (`kamil`) person... And he is raised until he reaches puberty (`hulm`). He is... absent near the `mulaqah` (`union`). And he appears near the `mulaqah`. Between... between the `nutfah` (`drop`) of the `da'i` and his wife, as a trustee (`damin`). And he progresses through its stages... of the fetus (`janin`). The stages of the fetus... of the fetus (`janin`). Until he appears as a newborn (`mawlud`), a complete (`kamil`) person. He is raised until he reaches puberty. He reaches... puberty (`bulugh`). Here until he reaches... puberty (`baligh`) he becomes. Then he is called and he responds... Then he is called, and he accepts. And he enters... the circle of the people of truth (`ahl al-haqq`). And he enters the circle of the people of truth. He can be born of a `Zayd` or of a `Zayd`, he can be born of anyone. But he will come to the people of truth. He will come to the people of truth. And he progresses... because his purification has been done. His service has been accepted. He progresses in the religious ranks (`maratib al-diniyyah`). And he progresses in the religious ranks. And he traverses them in the swiftest... of all swift ones and the nearest of them. And he cuts off... he completes the ranks. Then... he completes the ranks. Swiftly... from the swift. Any swift one... the one who progresses swiftly, even faster than him, his progress happens. And he becomes close to it. In the swiftest and closest duration. And he becomes from the people of high rank and lofty stations (`manazil al-samiyah`). And he becomes from the high rank... and the lofty stations. So there is no... upon him... the `nufus` (`souls`)... ever... So he does not have... for him... to return... to return... ever. Because he has fulfilled what was upon him of sins... and he repented and turned back and accepted... the `da'i Allah` (`caller of Allah`)... in the beginning and in the end. Because he has fulfilled what was upon him of sins, and he repented and turned back, and he accepted... the caller of Allah, in the beginning and in the end. In the beginning and in the end. In the beginning, in the `alam-e-nurani` (`world of light`), he accepted the covenant (`qawl`), and here too, his acceptance has happened. After being given the lower punishment, he was called. Then he came among the people of truth. So these two are the beginning and the end. He was made to serve, he served, he accepted. Now when he comes, he will be `clean slate` for so many days. And the reward for that will be that he will be given the `surat`, he will be given the sharpness (`hiddat`), he will be given the acceptance.

And he rendered what he was tasked with and stood by what was obligatory upon him and entered the sacred sanctuary and obeyed the Lord of the worlds (`Rabb al-`alamin`). And he performed... why did this happen? With such speed? Why did this speed come into him? Because he rendered what he was tasked with of service and he stood by... what was obligatory upon him. And he entered the sacred sanctuary (`haram-e-amin`) and he obeyed the Lord of the worlds. And whoever refuses and is arrogant and persists in his disobedience and stubbornness and his disbelief, he is made to tread the bridges of the lower, bodily punishment. And the one who... as he says, that on the platform of the world, various kinds of people are gathered. One are those who are going towards punishment, whose old states are such that they are to receive punishment. One are those who are `clean slate`... `clean slate` they have come. `Clean slate`... How? Now it is the realm of choice. Whether they accept or not. So they also stay there. Just as it was told before that an animal is one kind... all are animals, but in it some are `halal` (permissible) and some are `haram` (forbidden). What are `halal`? Those who will progress. `haram` are those who will descend. And in `halal` too, there are those who will become food for a believer. One `halal` is that which will become food for a disbeliever (`kafir`). Various kinds... on the platform of this world, every kind of person has come. Now here too, that... they have come. `mustakhdamin` have come. `mustakhdamin` have been presented with the call. They are presented with the call. Upon being presented with the call, if he is in that state where he has full choice, he has the choice whether to go the straight path or the crooked path. No one can pull him away from his choice. These people... straight `eid` will come or... they will come to `eid`. `mustakhdamin`... No, they will come on the straight path. As it is said here, that it will be presented to him. If he is on the straight path, then he will come to the staight path. In the realm of choice, no one can interfere.

These `suwarat-e-zulmah` (`dark forms`)... it is necessary for them that they... their progress will only happen by becoming `mustakhdam`. They pull them... So for pulling the `suwarat-e-zulmah`, that has been made. It is held in `uqdatayn`, right? This is a path. This thing is a path. The `suwarat-e-mustakhdamin`... in this form, finally their progress will happen. Yes, that is one... that is... the one who has accepted. The ones who will go into the lower punishment (`'adhab-e-adna`), they will progress only by becoming `suwarat-e-mustakhdamin`. They complete the lower punishment, they serve, then they are presented with the call. If they accept the call, then they become `mustakhdam`, their services are taken. Whoever goes into the lower punishment, will he progress by becoming `suwarat-e-mustakhdam`? No no. `suwarat-e-mustakhdam`... first it is said that the person whose end is not good, his `surat` (form) will go where? To `uqdatayn`. His body will go into the lower punishment. `uqdatayn` is... from `uqdatayn`, he will go into the lower punishment? From `uqdatayn`... `uqdatayn` is where the `surat-e-la`inah` (cursed forms) sit. Their station is where? Their station is `sakhrah`. `barzakh` is... `uqdatayn`. The `surat`... the `suwarat-e-la`inah`'s station. Their bodies appear in the world. When they complete the lower punishment, their bodies... and the time comes for them to return back, before `sakhrah`, they are presented with the call. If they accept the call, their `surat` from there moves towards servitude (`istikhdam`). And after doing `istikhdam`, again... when they come into the world, here too, the call is presented. If they accept, they go on the straight path. If they don't accept, then they go towards the punishment of `adna`. It is not necessary that their bodies... are purified? If their bodies are not purified, then they won't meet `[unclear]`. So the purification of the bodies will happen. Through `halal` animals they will get `[unclear]`. And whoever refuses and is arrogant... it is a big discussion. And for you, in this... how much time will it remain... in the service of `surat-e-mustakhdamin`? Where? In `surat-e-mustakhdamin`... As it has been told, until the `qiyam-e-qiyam`. Until the `qiyam-e-qa'im`. Until the `qiyam-e-qa'im` `alayhi al-salam`, they will remain there. Until the `qa'im` `alayhi al-salam`... for the accounting, everyone will be present. The accounting will happen. And from the sky, a fire will descend which will burn their bodies. Of whom? Of these enemies. And they... the mouth of `sakhrah`... from the mouth of `sakhrah`, they will enter `sakhrah`. And there, for how long will they remain? For one `kawr` they will remain in `sakhrah`. The lower punishment (`'adhab-e-adna`)... and those who will go before this... and the punishment of the peripheries (`atraf`) comes in which? It comes in the lower punishment. The lower punishment has two forms. One is in the seven `adrak` (levels of hell). And its final form is what? The punishment of the peripheries. Lower punishment. It is the lower punishment. And the great punishment (`'adhab-e-akbar`)... the punishment of `sakhrah` is the great punishment. After gathering from the punishment of the peripheries, at the time of the `qa'im` `alayhi al-salam`, there... you... will confront them, you will fight them, their bodies will be burned by fire, their `surat`... the fire will burn their `surat` too, and they will go from the mouth of `sakhrah`. And there, for one `kawr`, they will remain. That is the greater punishment (`'adhab-e-akbar`). And the lower punishment (`'adhab-e-adna`) has two types: one is the punishment of the `adrak`, the other is the punishment of the peripheries.

And whoever refuses and is arrogant... and persists in his disobedience and stubbornness and his disbelief, he is made to tread (`sulika bihi`) the bridges (`qanatir`) of the lower... the lower, bodily punishment (`'adhab al-adna al-jismani`). Until he completes... from it... and the `qa'im` stands... I mean, if he doesn't do it, he will go to `[unclear]`. That is the process... it will be repeated. Here, until he completes... that is, that state will come, the state of choice will come, it is necessary. That you have the choice, go this way or that way. And the `qa'im` stands... The `qa'im` stands, upon his mention be peace (`'ala dhikrihi al-salam`). And he is made to tread the greater punishment (`'adhab al-akbar`). As the saying has preceded about it... and to that... Sayyidna Zu`ayb alluded to in his `Risalat al-Nafs` (`Treatise on the Soul`), where he said: "And for them in every transition they make, there is a halt (`tawqifun`). If they repent, they return to a rank that is higher. And if they insist, they descend to the lowest rank, to the `kawr-e-a'zam` (`Great Cycle`), which is the product of three hundred and sixty thousand by its like."

And towards that, he has indicated... Sayyidna Zu`ayb, `'ala khususihi`, in the `Risalat al-Nafs`... where you said... "And for those people, in every transition... in which they move, they are halted (`tawqif`). They will be made to stop. That if they repent, they will return... to the rank... towards the rank which is... higher than it. And if they insist, they will be sent down to the lowest rank." Up to the `kawr-e-a'zam`. The `kawr-e-a'zam` will be completed. Which is that three hundred and sixty thousand years is the product... to be multiplied by its like. Three hundred and sixty thousand times three hundred and sixty thousand. Here, until he completes... `fi tawqifi man yurja'u minhu qabl tamam al-kawr` (`in halting the one from whom return is hoped for before the completion of the cycle`). And in halting... and in halting those from whom return is hoped for... who will return from it... before the completion of the `kawr`... the completion of the `kawr`. Allah Ta`ala said: "And We will surely make them taste (`wa-la-nudhiqannahum`) the lower punishment (`min al-`adhab al-adna`) short of the greater punishment (`dun al-`adhab al-akbar`)." And we will surely make them taste the lower punishment, which is less than the greater punishment, so that they may return (`la`allahum yarji`un`). So that, perhaps, they may return. Allah has said that in the lower punishment, they will be given several opportunities to return. This is the mercy of Allah. Towards that... Amir al-Mu'minin, `salawatullah `alayh`, alluded to with his saying... `wa-yathanuhum`... `wa-yathanuhum al-dawru fi madarij al-kawr` (`And the cycle will grind them in the stages of the cycle`). And towards this very matter, Amir al-Mu'minin, `salawatullah `alayh`, indicated in his saying... and the cycle will grind them... the cycle will grind them... in the stages of the cycle. They will be ground. And after being ground, they... will be completed. In every cycle, they will be presented with the call. If they return, then the lower punishment will be... but if they reach `sakhrah`, then there... from there... `lava` (`lava`) comes out of it. From `sakhrah`, `lava` comes out.

Who was running? What was explained? Today's day... fifteenth date, right? fifteenth, sixteenth, seventeenth are the middle days... the best of days. `ayyam-e-bid` (`the white days`). `ayyam-e-bid` are the thirteenth, fourteenth, fifteenth. We have a book, a narration of `Lakadhari`... Today's... `[unclear]`. Others should also read it so that... `Lakadhari`'s narration. That... came to Imam Ja`far al-Sadiq. And today the `tasbih` (`glorification`) that is mentioned... that how many days are there in a year? Three hundred and... fifty-four. Three hundred and fifty-four days. In three hundred and fifty-four days, how many days are distinguished? One hundred and... one hundred and forty? One hundred and fifty... One hundred... one hundred and fifty distinguished days. Which ones are they? Three months of... The first day... the first of Muharram. Then...

<!-- lecture 51 -->

... *zabar*, *zer*, *pesh*... they drop the word, they abandon it, they consume the words. In the Holy Qur'an, in the speech of Allah, by the time it reaches the servant, a change has occurred. That becomes a cause for sin.

*Bismillah al-Rahman al-Rahim. Sadaqa Allahu-l-'Adhim alladhi la ilaha illa huwa-r-Rahman-ur-Rahim.* (In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. The truth is from Allah, the Great, there is no god but Him, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful).

*Sadaqa Allah*. Allah has spoken the truth. Allah has spoken the truth, such that there is no god besides Him. He is *al-Rahman al-Rahim* (the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful), *Mannan* (the Bestower), *Karim* (the Generous). *Alladhi laysa kamithlihi shay'un* (He who, there is nothing like unto Him). Such that there is no example of Him in anything. *Wa huwa-s-Sami'-ul-'Alim* (And He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing). And He is the All-Hearing and the All-Knowing. *Wa ballaghat rusuluhu risalatihi...* *ballaghat*. *Wa ballaghat rusuluhu risalatihi wa nahnu 'ala dhalika min al-shahidin* (And His messengers delivered His messages, and we are among the witnesses to that). And His messengers delivered... delivered... and His messengers delivered... His messenger... messengers... His... *rusuluhu*. It is the *fa'il* (subject). *Wa ballaghat rusuluhu* (And His messengers delivered). And they delivered... And his messengers delivered... his messengers... his message... and we... This is the *fa'il*, the *maf'ul*... The *fa'il* has a *pesh*, the *maf'ul* has a *zabar*. And his messengers delivered his message, and we... On this matter, from among the witnesses... we are from among the witnesses. *Irghaman lil-jahidin* (in defiance of the deniers). *Irgham*... *irgham* means to crush the nose. Rebuking the deniers. Rebuking the deniers. Those who have denied, against them we say that they have denied in the wrong way. *Irghaman*, crushing the noses of the deniers.

*Allahumma-nfa'na bil-Qur'an al-'Adhim* (O Allah, benefit us with the Great Qur'an). Now he makes a prayer. The one completing the Holy Qur'an makes this prayer. *Allahumma-nfa'na bil-Qur'an al-'Adhim wa barik lana fi-l-ayati wa-dh-dhikr al-hakim* (O Allah, benefit us with the Great Qur'an and bless us in the verses and the wise remembrance). O Allah, grant us benefit from the Great Qur'an and grant us blessing from the verses and the remembrance which is wise. *Wa taqabbal minna qira'atana wa du'a'ana, ya Rabbi, ya Mawla, innaka anta-s-Sami'-ul-'Alim* (And accept from us our recitation and our supplication, O my Lord, O my Master, indeed You are the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing). And accept from us our reading and our supplications... O Lord, O our Master, indeed You are the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing. *Wa la tadrib bihi wujuhana ya Ilah al-'alamin* (And do not strike our faces with it, O God of the worlds). And do not strike... strike... strike our faces with it... our faces, O... O God of the worlds... *wa ya Khayr al-nasirin* (and O Best of helpers)... and O Best of helpers. *Allahumma-j'al... Allahumma-j'al al-Qur'ana rabi'a qulubina wa shifa'a sudurina wa dhahaba humumina wa ghumumina wa takfiran li-khatayana wa tamhisan li-dhunubina* (O Allah... O Allah, make the Qur'an the spring of our hearts, a healing for our chests, a remover of our worries and our sorrows, an atonement for our sins, and a purification for our wrongdoings). O Allah, make for us from this Qur'an... our hearts... Not for us. *Ij'al al-Qur'ana* (make the Qur'an). Make the Qur'an... Make... make the Qur'an for our hearts... the spring... spring... make it the spring of our hearts... Make the Qur'an the spring of our hearts... *wa shifa'a sudurina* (and a healing for our chests)... and for our hearts a healing... a healer in our chests... and a healer in our chests, and the remover of our worries and sorrows, and for our... our sins... and a remover for our sins... a remover... *wa tamhisan* (and a purification)... and a purifier for our... sins. *Wa sa'atan wa barakatan...* (And an expansion and a blessing...) And one who gives expansion and one who gives blessing... in our sustenance... with our sustenance... *sa'iqana wa qa'idana* (our driver and our leader)... our driver and our leader... *wa dallana wa dalilana ilayka* (and our guide and our proof towards You)... one who guides... guide... our proof towards You... towards You. *Wa ila jannatika jannat al-na'im* (And towards Your gardens, the gardens of bliss). And your gardens of bliss. *Wa darika dar al-salam ma'a-lladhina an'amta 'alayhim min al-nabiyyina wa-s-siddiqina wa-sh-shuhada'i wa-s-salihin wa hasuna ula'ika rafiqa* (And Your abode, the abode of peace, with those upon whom You have bestowed favor, of the prophets, the truthful, the martyrs, and the righteous. And excellent are those as companions). And to your abode, the abode of peace, with those people upon whom You have bestowed Your favor, from the prophets, the truthful, the martyrs, and the righteous. And they are the best of companions. What an excellent companion they are. *Dhalika-l-fadlu min Allahi wa kafa bi-Llahi 'alima* (That is the bounty from Allah, and sufficient is Allah as Knower). That is from the grace of Allah, and Allah is sufficient as a knower.

*Allahumma taqabbal minna khatm al-Qur'an, wa tajawaz 'anna ma kana minna fi tilawat al-Qur'an, min khata'in aw nisyanin aw tahrifi kalimatin 'an mawadi'iha aw taghyiri harfin aw taqdimin aw ta'khirin aw ziyadatin aw nuqsanin aw ta'wilin 'ala ghayri ma anzaltahu aw raybin aw shakkin aw ta'jilin 'inda tilawatihi aw sur'atin aw zayghin lisani aw wuqufin bi-ghayri waqfin aw idghamin bi-ghayri mudghamin aw izharin bi-ghayri bayanin aw maddin wa tashdidin aw hamzatin aw jazmin aw i'rabin bi-ghayri ma kana katabtahu minna 'ala-t-tamami wa-l-kamal* (O Allah, accept from us the completion of the Qur'an, and overlook what has come from us during the recitation of the Qur'an, from mistakes, or forgetfulness, or alteration of words from their places, or changing a letter, or putting something forward or back, or adding or omitting, or interpreting it other than how You revealed it, or doubt, or uncertainty, or haste during its recitation, or speed, or a slip of the tongue, or stopping where there is no stop, or merging without a place for merging, or making clear without a place for clarity, or [mistakes in] extension and emphasis, or *hamza*, or *jazm*, or vocalization other than how it was written by You, with completeness and perfection).

O Allah... accept from me... from us... the completion of the Qur'an... and whatever transgression has occurred from us... and overlook what has come from us... And forgive. Overlook... forgive... from us what has happened from us... what has happened from us in the recitation of the Qur'an... from mistakes... There are mistakes, there is error. And forgetfulness... from forgetfulness... forgetting... and from altering the words... *tahrif al-kalimah* (alteration of the word). From its place... or... it gets left out before. Changing the word. Now, many of the readers have recited, all... all of them have made mistakes in reading. In writing the Holy Qur'an... in the text, what... many people write in the text... they write something else entirely. They don't understand the meaning. Changes occur in the word of Allah. One must be especially careful that when saying the Holy Qur'an, or writing it, or speaking it, one should be extremely careful, as much as possible. Or in changing its letter, or in putting it forward, or putting it back, or in adding, or in taking away, or in interpreting... in doing *taqdim* (bringing forward), or putting it before, and *akhir* (putting it after). What was before is put after, what was after is put before. Or in adding, or if something is added. Or it is reduced. Like they read in Yasin, "Yasin..." [unclear]. It got added. It's an addition. It's a sin. In its virtue, it is said that "Yasin..." [unclear] is Yasin. They are making a prayer. It's a prayer. The words of prayers are different. The letters of the Holy Qur'an should not be changed. This is the issue. In it, *zabar*, *zer*, *pesh*, *hamza*, *jazm*, all of this. Now, most people don't even pronounce the *madd* correctly. What happens? They don't read the *madd*. The *madd*... what does *madd* mean? *Madd* means to pull... to stretch. To stretch. Where do we stretch? When does *madd* come? Two *alif*s. Two *alif*s. Two *alif*s. When the letter, the vowel letters... *alif*, *waw*, *ya*... with them, when an *alif* comes, then what happens? A *madd* comes. So that... what is the reason for that? To clarify the two. It becomes clear. Both letters become clear. The first letter becomes clear, and the last letter becomes clear. For instance, *ula'ika*. Why is the *la* stretched? After *la*, a *hamza* has come. A *hamza* has come. So it is *ula'ika*. *Yasha'u*. Why is it stretched? An *alif* has come. After the *alif*, a *hamza* has come. To make both the *alif* and the *hamza*... the *hamza* is also an *alif*, it is written in the form of a *hamza*. To clarify both of them... the *hamza* and the *alif* are written. Wherever a *madd* comes, you should look there. *Qa'idina*. A *hamza* has come, no? Before it, a *madd* has come. Before the *hamza*, when *alif*, *waw*, or *ya* come... what are the letters of *'illah*? *Alif*, *waw*... before the *hamza*, if *alif*, *waw*, or *ya* come, then a *madd* occurs there. It is clarified. Now, wherever it has come. Or in taking away, or in interpreting what has not been revealed, or in having doubt, or in having uncertainty, or in being hasty, or in reciting, or in being slow, or a slip of the tongue, or in stopping where there is no stop. Or stopping without there being a stop. Or in merging without there being a place to merge. Merging without a merged letter. Without merging it. Or in making clear without it being clear.
