The `Ruh Amin` has descended upon you. Sir, what is the difference between `Ruh` and `Nafs`? `Ruh` and `Nafs`. The two are synonymous, in many places they are used synonymously. But `nafs` is of several types, isn't it? One is `nafs al-namiyah` (the vegetative soul), one is `nafs al-hissiyah` (the sensory soul), one is `nafs al-natiqah` (the rational soul). And what is `Ruh`? `Amr Rabbi` (the command of my Lord). `Qul al-ruhu min amri Rabbi.` (Say: "The Spirit is of the command of my Lord.") Say, O Prophet, that the `Ruh` is the `amr` (command) of my Lord. Meaning that the `nafs al-natiqah`... whom does it attain? It does not attain the `nafs al-hissiyah` or the `nafs al-namiyah`. The first thing that the `nafs al-natiqah` attains, the divine supports (`ta'idat`) that descend from Allah Ta'ala, that is called `Ruh`. So, it means it is the `kamal al-awwal` (first perfection). `Ruh` is called... the `ta'idat` that are received, they are called `Ruh`. `Qul al-ruhu min amri Rabbi` (Say: "The Spirit is of the command of my Lord"). The `amr` of the Lord, when does it happen? When his end is with good (`khatima bil-khayr`). So his luminous form (`surat nuraniyyah`) is completed at that very time. In one sense, the `surat nuraniyyah` can also be called `Ruh`. So, is the departure of the `nafs` from the body death, or is the departure of the `Ruh` from the body death? The `nafs`'s departure from the body. The `nafs`'s. The `Ruh` is the `amr`. Because we... about the `Ruh`... `amr Rabbi`... in common parlance, we do not differentiate between `Ruh` and `Nafs`. But Allah Ta'ala has differentiated. `Ya ayyatuha al-nafsu al-mutma'innah.` (O soul at peace.) There the word `nafs` is used. And here, `qul al-ruhu min amri Rabbi` (Say: "The Spirit is of the command of my Lord"). The `Ruh` is from the `amr` of the Lord. The state of sleep, when Allah Ta'ala says that your... `nufus`... `ruhu`... that souls are taken... that is a state of the `nafs`. It is a state of the `nafs`. `Wa-qawluhu 'alayhis salam...` (And his statement, peace be upon him...) `Al-Fasl al-thani min al-bab al-thalith min sawabit al-'adad.` (The second section of the third chapter from *Sawabit al-'Adad*.) `Wa-qawluhu 'alayhis salam: fa-li-jahalatihi bi-mubtadi'ihi wa-awliya'ihi yuridu bihi al-ḍidd alladhi huwa ghayru 'arifin billahi ta'ala wa-la bi-ḥududihi, salamu Allahi 'alayhim, al-muḍiḥina li-'ulum al-tawḥid wal-tanzih wal-tajrid, wal-mu'arrifina lahu fi kayfiyyat al-ibtida' wa-ḥaqiqat al-ma'ad wa-intiha'ih.` (And his statement, peace be upon him: "So, because of his ignorance of his Originator and His friends," he intends by it the opposite, who is one who is not a gnostic of Allah, the Exalted, nor of His `hudud`, peace of Allah be upon them, who clarify the sciences of `tawhid`, `tanzih`, and `tajrid`, and who make Him known in the manner of the beginning, the reality of the return, and its end.) From his statement, peace be upon him, that ignorance... with his `mubtada`... because of his ignorance, with his `mubtada`, and with his `wali`... his `awliya`. So he intends by that... he means the `didd` (opposite), that he is not one who recognizes Allah Ta'ala, nor His `hudud`, upon whom be the peace of Allah. Those `hudud` who clarify... who clarify... the sciences of `tawhid`, `tanzih`, and `tajrid`. Who know... what do you call `tawhid`, `tanzih`, and `tajrid`? What does `tawhid` mean? In every `hadd`, you... Allah is... to consider Allah as one. No, but rather... we cannot understand Allah, neither as one, nor two, nor three. The `hudud` that Allah Ta'ala has created, all of them are unique in their essence. Every `hadd`... no `hadd` can be similar to another `hadd`. If they become similar, then the hierarchy will not be established. Every `hadd`... there is a difference between every `hadd` and another `hadd`. So, He has created all the `hudud` as unique. This is the meaning of `tawhid`. And what does `tanzih` mean? The attributes... to declare Him transcendent from all attributes. We cannot understand Him. And what does `tajrid` mean? To strip away... to strip away every quality from... `ijad al-zawat` (the creation of beings). The state of `ijad al-zawat` is not in anyone except the `Mubdi' al-Awwal`. These three things. `ijad al-zawat` is not in anyone. And those `hudud` who clarify the sciences of his `tawhid`, `tanzih`, and `tajrid`, and who acquaint one with Him regarding His initial state, and the reality of the hereafter, and its end. `Wa-qawluhu: fa-sara 'aduwwan li-rabbihi, yuridu bil-rabbi huna imama al-zaman.` (And his statement: "So he became an enemy to his Lord," he intends by "the Lord" here the Imam of the Time.) And the statement that... so he becomes an enemy of his Lord. By "Lord" here, they mean Imam of the Time... his Imam of the Time. `Wa-qawluhu: wa-idda'a li-nafsihi ma la yastaḥiqqu, yuridu al-shirk fi maqdari dhalika al-imami wa-da'wa rutbatihi, fa-huwa imam al-zalalati wa-ra'is al-jahalati, kama qala Allahu ta'ala: wa-ja'alnahum a'immatan yad'una ila al-nar, wa-yawm al-qiyamati la yunṣarun.` (And his statement: "And he claimed for himself what he does not deserve," he intends partnership in the station of that Imam and the claim to his rank. So he is the Imam of error and the chief of ignorance, as Allah, the Exalted, said: "And We made them leaders inviting to the Fire, and on the Day of Resurrection they will not be helped.") And his statement... and he claims for his `nafs` that which he is not worthy of, nor is it befitting him. By this, he means partnership in the station of the Imam, and the claim to his rank. So he is the Imam of error and the chief of ignorance. As Allah Ta'ala said, "And We made them leaders who invite to the Fire. And on the Day of Resurrection, their help will not be done." `Wa-yantariddu hadha al-qawlu fi jami'i aḍdad al-maqamat wa-aḍdad ḥududihi jami'an, 'alihim wa-danihim.` (And this statement applies to all the opposites of the stations and the opposites of all of His `hudud`, the high among them and the low among them.) `yantaridu` means... `tarada` means to drive away. `intarada` means it went on, it applied. It went further. `intarada`, from the form `infa'ala`. `Wa-yantariddu hadha al-qawl fi jami'i al-aḍdad.` The form `infa'ala` has... there are seventeen forms. In them... so in the form `infa'ala`, it is said that in it there is only a subject (`fa'il`), there is no object (`maf'ul`) in it. `Intarada`. `Intaqala`, what does it mean? He transferred. Does it need an object? There is a subject, but there is no object. `Intaqala`, he transferred. `Infa'ala`, he was affected. It doesn't need an object. Similarly, `intarada`. Similarly, what? `inhazama`. What do we say? The prayer we recite? `wa-hazama al-ahzaba wahdah` (And He alone defeated the confederates). It should be `hazama`. `Wa-hazama al-ahzaba`. `hazama` means He made them flee. He made the groups flee. `wa-inhazama`, this, how did it come? The entire `kalimat`... when I looked into it and researched, I found that the word `inhazama` is not with it. Because `inhazama` cannot have an object. In the form `infa'ala`, there is no... `infataha`, it opened. When it opened, it doesn't need an object. `inqalaba`. `inqalab`. From it comes `inqilab` (revolution). `inqalaba` means it changed. There will be a subject, but it will not have an object. In the form `infa'ala`, this quality is created, that it does not have an object. Because it is intransitive (`lazim`), it is not transitive (`muta'addi`). `yantaridu` is the same. `intarada`. And this statement applies to all the opposites of the stations and the opposites of all of His `hudud`, the high among them and the low among them. Their high and their low. `Wa-qawluhu 'alayhis salam: wa-idha faraqa al-'alama bi-jismihi, sara shayṭana nafsihi, yuridu bi-nafsihi dhalika al-taṣawwur al-khabith alladhi kana yataṣawwaruhu min 'ada'i imami zamanihi wa-ḥududi dinihi, wa-khulumihi al-zulmaniyyah, wa-af'alihi al-qabiḥah, li-anna al-mufariqa minhu huwa hadha al-taṣawwur la ghayr, wa-huwa yusamma nafsan shayṭaniyyatan, kama tusamma taṣawwur ahl al-ḥaqqi nafsan malakiyyatan, 'ala ma sabaqa bihi al-sharḥ wal-qawl.` (And his statement, peace be upon him: "And when he departs the world with his body, he becomes the shaitan of his own soul," he intends by "his soul" that evil conception that he used to form from the enmity of the Imam of his time and the `hudud` of his religion, and his dark qualities and his ugly deeds. Because the departing entity from him is this conception and nothing else, and it is called a satanic soul, just as the conception of the People of Truth is called an angelic soul, according to what has preceded in the explanation and the statement.) And his statement, peace be upon him, "And when he departs from the world with his body, he becomes the shaitan of his `nafs`." By `nafs`, he intends... the speaker intends that evil conception that he used to form from the enmity of the Imam of his time and the `hudud` of his religion, and his dark qualities and his ugly deeds. Because the one who departs from him is this `tasawwur` and not anything else. It is the `tasawwur`, the `nafs` is in his body. And it is named a satanic soul, just as the conception of the People of Truth is named an angelic soul, as has been explained before. `Wa-amma nafsuhu al-ḥissiyyah, fa-ghayru mufariqatin li-jismihi, wa-li-dhalika qala 'alayhis salam: wa-nafsuhu la yufariqu jismihu, isharatan ila al-ḥissiyyati allati la tufariqu jismihu, bal tastaḥilu bi-istiḥalatihi ila al-hadd al-sharif.` (As for his sensory soul, it does not depart from his body, and for that reason, he, peace be upon him, said: "And his soul does not leave his body," as an allusion to the sensory soul which does not leave his body, but rather transforms with his transformation towards the noble rank.) And as for his sensory `nafs`... a very important point that you should all keep in mind regarding the definition of the sensory `nafs`. All the things of a person that are spread in the world, his bodies (`ajsam`)... the things of the bodies are spread in the world. From them, one thing that has to develop is what is called the vegetative soul (`nafs al-namiyah`). Where does it come from? The vegetative soul comes from the moon (`qamar`). From the sphere of the moon (`falak al-qamar`). Its center is the sphere of the moon. The vegetative soul. It descends and combines with the sperm-drop from the mother and father, and when it settles as a sperm-drop in the womb, then the connection of the vegetative soul is established with that sperm-drop. Until then, it was an extract (`sulalah`), and after that, what happened? It settled as a sperm-drop. That is... that is called the vegetative soul. It... for nine months, the vegetative soul remains in the mother's womb and develops. Until... when he... comes into the world, then through the rays of the sun, he obtains the sensory soul (`nafs al-hissiyah`). This vegetative soul and sensory soul both become one, as has been explained. They become one. Becoming one, they develop. Until, when he accepts the `ahd-e sharif` (noble covenant), then at the time of accepting the `ahd-e sharif`, what happens to him? He obtains the rational soul (`nafs al-natiqah`). Where does the rational soul come from? Where is its center? `Mujrima`. There are three centers. The center of the vegetative soul is the moon, the center of the sensory soul is the sun, and the center of the rational soul is `Mujrima`. So when a person passes away, then from his knowledge and actions, the thing he prepares, his sensory `nafs`... who is the preparer? The sensory `nafs` along with the vegetative `nafs`. These two are preparing his luminous form. That `surat nuraniyyah` is called... when he passes away, the `surat nuraniyyah` separates, and the sensory `nafs` and the vegetative `nafs`, to the extent that it had followed the rational `nafs`, it takes that portion and the `surat nuraniyyah` ascends. And the rest is left in his grave. This is the process of nature. For everyone, according to how he has lived his life in the world. Someone has more vegetative `nafs`, someone has less, someone has something, someone has something else. All of them ascend. Where? To their `hadd-e 'ali`. They remain adjacent (`mujawar`) to his `hadd-e 'ali`, meaning with his `surah`... they merge. `Mumazaj`. Why does this happen? That if the `nafs` of the `hadd-e 'ali` ever goes astray, then there is a possibility of it separating. And why do they merge with his `hadd`? If the `hadd-e 'ali` goes astray, then what happens? His evil `nafs` becomes corrupt, and his `surah`, because it has become good, and Allah Ta'ala does not waste good, He removes it from there. From his `nafs`... he separates it. The `nafs` becomes separate, the `surat nuraniyyah` becomes separate. This whole process has been explained. And for the opposite, what is it? His `surah` becomes separate... the satanic `surah` becomes separate. His `nafs` falls and joins with the body. This is the condition explained for him. The `nafs` has both, the vegetative `nafs` is there and the sensory `nafs` is there. `Wa-amma nafsuhu al-ḥissiyyah.` (As for his sensory soul.) And as for his... sensory `nafs`, why was the feminine gender used? The `nafs`... the word `nafs` is feminine. In Arabic, `nafs` is feminine. As for his sensory `nafs`... in Arabic, the rules of masculine and feminine are strange. There is a verse of some poet that says: By calling the sun (`shams`) feminine and the moon (`qamar`) masculine, the greatness of the sun has not diminished. The sun is feminine, the moon is masculine. By the sun being called feminine and the moon being called masculine, the greatness of the sun has not diminished in any way. It's a very good verse. `Wa-li-dhalika qala 'alayhis salam: wa-nafsuhu la yufariqu jismihu, isharatan ila al-ḥissiyyati allati la tufariqu jismihu, bal tastaḥilu bi-istiḥalatihi ila al-hadd al-sharif.` (And for that reason, he, peace be upon him, said: "And his soul does not leave his body," as an allusion to the sensory soul which does not leave his body, but rather transforms with his transformation towards the noble rank.) It transforms with its transformation, meaning to obtain the rank... to obtain the `zawat`. In order to obtain the noble rank. `Wa-qawluhu: wa-habaṭa ila asfal al-safilin, yuwaswisu bil-ghawayah fi ṣudur al-nas, yuridu bi-dhalika anna mufaraqata hadhihi al-ṣurat al-khabithah li-jismiha wa-nafsiha wa-masiraha tatilu bayna al-falaki wal-ard, fa-hiya ta'taridu kulli min yasma'uha wa-yu'ayinuha bi-ḥalat mufaraqatiha li-jismiha wa-nafsiha.` (And his statement: "And he descends to the lowest of the low, whispering error into the breasts of men," he intends by that that the departure of this evil form from its body and its soul, and its journey, wanders between the celestial sphere and the earth. So it presents itself to everyone who hears it and sees it in the state of its departure from its body and its soul.) `Wa-qawniha mun'ifan wa-ṭaratan yamza'u man yara-ha bi-hay'ati insanin wa-ṭaratan saniyyatan fi hay'at shayṭanin yuzayyin qabiḥa af'alihi wa-aqbahihi wa-qawlihi...` (And its being `mun'ifan`, and at times startling whoever sees it in the form of a human, and at other times in the form of a shaitan, beautifying the ugliness of its deeds and its most ugly [deeds] and its speech...) And the statement of the speaker... and he falls to the `asfal al-safilin`. He whispers temptations with misguidance into the hearts of people. By this, the speaker intends that the departure of this evil `surah` from its body and `nafs`, and its journey, it roams between the sphere of the moon and the earth. And it presents itself to everyone who hears and sees it in a state of separation from its body and `nafs`. And its being a `mun'ifan`. And at times it startles whoever sees it in the form of a human, and at other times in a satanic form, making its evil and most evil deeds seem beautiful. `Wa-qawlan liman yara-ha bi-hay'ati jinniyyatin aw jinniyyin, wa-ṭaratan fi tara'iha fil-nawm li-amthaliha min ahl al-nufus al-khabithah, fa-yuhi ilayhi ma waswasat-ha lahu fima yujrihi min al-ḥaqqi wa-ahlihi, wa-ṭaratan min ittihadiha bi-aḥadi al-ajsadi al-khabithah al-muzlimah, wa-qawniha yantiqa 'ala lisanihi bil-kufriyyat wal-fawahishi wal-ḥawadithi al-ka'inat.` (And as a statement to whoever sees it in the form of a female jinn or a male jinn, and at times in its appearance in sleep to its likes from among the people of evil souls, so it inspires it with what it whispered to it concerning what it carries of [enmity towards] the truth and its people, and at times from its union with one of the evil, dark bodies, and its being such that it speaks on its tongue with blasphemies, abominations, and future events.) And the statement that... and as a statement to whoever sees it, that he saw a female jinn or a male jinn. And at times, seeing it in a dream... its likes, from among the people of evil souls, so it gives them revelation about the whispers it casts into them, about what distances them from the truth and its people, and from its connection with one of the evil, dark bodies, and its being such that it speaks through his tongue with blasphemies, abominations, and future events (`hawadith al-ka'inat`). `Al-Fasl al-thalith min al-bab al-thalith min sawabit al-'adad.` (The third section of the third chapter from *Sawabit al-'adad*.) `Wa-yaqulu man yasma'u nutqahu fil-umuri al-ka'inati wal-fawahishi wal-kufriyyat: huwa ṣadiqun fi jami'i ma yantiqa bihi wa-yukhbiru 'anhu.` (And he who hears its speech concerning future events, abominations, and blasphemies says: "He is truthful in all that he speaks and informs of.") So, it is said... he says... so he says, the one who hears... its speech (`nutq`). Its speech about matters (`umuri al-ka'inah`). That he is... `suwarat al-khabithah` (evil forms)...

<!-- lecture 55 -->

...*thalis min al-bab al-thalis min suradiq al-rabi'* (the third [section] from the third gate from the fourth pavilion). The third chapter, from the third gate, from the fourth pavilion. *fa yaqulu man yasma'u nutqahu fi 'l-umur al-ka'inat wa 'l-fawahish wa 'l-kufriyat, wa sadiqun fi jami'i ma yantiqu bihi wa yukhbiru 'anhu.* So, it is said... He says. *Fa yaqulu*. So, he says. So he says, who hears... who hears its... its `nutq` (speech), its voice... जो... the `surat qabihah` (ugly forms) that are there, who did `sidq` (were truthful) in their own matters during their time, they spoke true things... because of that, they are given the reward that they speak about the matters of existence (`umur-e ka'inat`), which turn out to be true. So, who hears... he says, who hears its `nutq` (speech) regarding matters of existence (`umur-e ka'inat`) and indecencies (`fawahish`)... and indecencies and acts of disbelief (`kufriyat`), that he is truthful... he is truthful in all the things he speaks of and gives news of. *wa kadhalika ma yura 'anhu fi 'l-nawm* (and likewise what is seen from him in sleep). And likewise, what is seen... is seen of him in his sleep. Sir, these things that people say about the future, these are the `tadbirat` (plans/arrangements) of the Imam al-Zaman. How do they have this `kashf` (unveiling)? They are `khaba'is` (vile beings); how can good things be unveiled to them? No, for them... they do not have physical constraints (`jismaniy qaid`), do they? They have freedom. Indeed, that is correct. They, in their... their `arwah` (spirits) have freedom. The `arwah-e khabisah` (vile spirits) have freedom. They use it. And they descend upon some thing, and there they speak their things... they also state true things. Along with `kufr` (disbelief), they also state true things. Because of that, people think that this... this person who is speaking is truthful. But the `tadabir` (plans/arrangements) of the Imam al-Zaman are such pure `tadabir`... inside them there are `qisasat` (retributions), are there not? The `qisasat` that are there, because of that... they are also given a reward. In the service of their Imam, they had said truthful things, so they have to get a reward for that too, no? The `qisasat` have to be fulfilled. They are given a reward for that, a good dealing (`husn-e mu'amalat`) is done with them. *wa kadhalika ma yura*... And likewise, what is seen of him in sleep. *fa yakunu dhalika sababan li-halakihi* (so that becomes a cause for his destruction). So it becomes... that becomes a cause for his destruction... for his destruction... and the destruction of others... and the destruction of those other than him... `mimman ta'allama min amthalihi` (from those who learned from the likes of him)... from the likes of him... `ahl al-i'tiqadat al-fasidah` (the people of corrupt beliefs). From those people... from those people who obtained... his knowledge... from those like him... from the help of corrupt beliefs. The corruptly-believing. See, this is... these `arwah-e khabisah` (vile spirits) descend in a state of sleep. And they say such things, some of which are true. So people think that this is a miracle (`karamat`), these are miracles. *fa yakunu bi-dhalika...* `Halak`. `Halaki`. Whose destruction? The `arwah-e khabisah` (vile spirits)... `sababan li-halakihi` (a cause for his destruction). `wa halaki`... `halaki`, his, that person's who is giving the news. The `ruh-e khabisah` (vile spirit) will be destroyed anyway. And along with it, the other people who... on their saying, will follow, they too... their belief (`i'tiqad`) will become corrupt. Those who listen and act upon it, their beliefs are corrupt. The truth is a different thing, but to believe that truth to be true and walk on it is wrong. They say both things... `nutquhu fi umur al-ka'inat` (his speech on matters of existence). That is, they speak about matters of existence, and they also commit indecencies (`fuhush`) and acts of disbelief (`kufriyat`). Both things are mixed up. And so people think that since they have spoken the truth, then the other things must also be true. How many things are there which... later on, those things turned out to be false. How many things turned out false. There is destruction in following them. There is destruction. We have been told: *'ati'ullaha wa 'ati'u 'l-rasula wa uli 'l-amr* (Obey Allah, and obey the Messenger, and those in authority). Obey Allah, obey the Messenger, and whomever the command was given to, obey him. This is your straight path. `Sirat al-mustaqim` is this. *fa yakunu bi-dhalika ishtidadu 'adawatihi li-ahl al-haqq* (so by that is the intensification of his enmity for the people of truth). So from that becomes... becomes from that... the severity... his enmity for the people of truth. *wa a'zamu li-bughdihi wa akdadu li-bughdihi* (and greater for his hatred and more confirmed for his hatred). And the confirmation of his hatred... greater confirmation for it. And the one who confirms his hatred... the one who confirms... `hadha huwa 'l-iha'u wa 'l-waswasatu wa 'l-ghawayah` (this is the [evil] inspiration, and the whispering, and the misguidance). So this is that... so this is that... to reveal (`wahi karna`)... to reveal (`wahi karna` is a form of evil inspiration)... and to create doubt (`waswasah dalna`)... and to misguide (`gumrah karna`)... to misguide. That is why... *qul a'udhu bi-Rabbi 'l-falaq... qul a'udhu bi-Rabbi 'n-nas, min sharri 'l-waswasi 'l-khannas, alladhi yuwaswisu fi suduri 'n-nas* (Say: "I seek refuge in the Lord of the daybreak"... Say: "I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind, from the evil of the whisperer who withdraws, who whispers into the breasts of mankind"). Behind the scenes, humans do it and jinn do it too. Both. From both, always... refuge has been sought in the `Qul` (Say, referring to the Surahs). *thumma innahu yazdadu ithman wa awzaran wa shaytanatan wa kufran wa bu'dan, min jumlat iqamatihi muttahidan bi-hadha 'l-bayt al-khabith al-muzlim* (then he indeed increases in sin and burdens, and satanism and disbelief and distance... during his entire stay, united with this vile, dark house). So certainly he increases... he increases his sin... and... and... and burdens (`bojh`), and satanism, and disbelief, and distance. During the entire time of his stay, when he remains with him, he keeps doing all these things. Who? The jinn that descends. *muttahidan bi-hadha 'l-bayt al-khabith.* Those people who are against the Rasuls, who state the command of `ulul amr` (those in authority), he is also a partner with them. In inciting them... in spreading their `da'wat` (call)... in spreading the call of `ghayr-e haqq` (non-truth). While being united with this vile, dark house (`bayt-e khabith muzlim`)... *fa 'inda mufaraqatihi lahu wa masirihi fi ufuq al-barzakh al-falakiyy al-muzlim alladhi huwa 'l-'uqdatan, wa huma magnatisuhu 'l-khabith al-muzlim al-jadhibah lahu, yazdadu shaytanatan wa bu'dan* (so upon his separation from him and his journey to the horizon of the dark celestial `barzakh`, which is the two knots, and they are its vile, dark magnet that attracts it, it increases in satanism and distance). So... upon its separation from it... from it... its... its... when it leaves that jinn... and its reaching... and its reaching the horizon of the dark celestial `barzakh`, which is... those two are the two knots (`'uqdatan`). And those two are its magnet... for it... which is vile... vile and dark... that which attracts it... for it... its satanism increases... and its distance. Then when they go back, their satanism increases even more. Sir, these `arwah-e khabisah` (vile spirits), are there any places where they cannot be? For example, the honored Ka'bah, the radiant Madinah... or are they dominant over everything? No, no. Inside the honored Ka'bah... there, angels descend. But around the honored Ka'bah there are many places. Their station is `amyal`. `Amyal` it is. There... there they consider it their station. `Mil` (mile marker) is there, no? `Mil`. And where there is fast running... a place for fast running. Safa and Marwah. Near the idols. When they throw pebbles, at that place... is their center. So that means they can be everywhere? There is no place where they cannot be? In the Ka'bah it is not mentioned, but at Safa and Marwah... In the Ka'bah it is not mentioned... `waswasah` (whisperings) do come, sir. Yes? `Waswasah` and such things do come. `Waswasah` and such things do come, but their... their center is not mentioned there. That they move away from there. It is where angels descend. So, what that means is that... in the court of the Imam of the time, too, they might be able to be there? If, for example... Yes? The Imam of the time, when our... they tell us... where you also grace with your presence, they can be there too? No, there... there, no. The places... the special places are there. `Amyal` are there. Vile places are there. There... their existence is there. Not in the `hadarat` (presences). They are not in the `hadarat`. `wa yajtami'u min dhalika bi-amthalihi` (and he gathers from that with his likes). Meaning, they increase... the two knots (`'uqdatan`)... They increase their satanism and their enmity. The magnet that is with the two knots... because of going there, do they increase? When they come out of the body and reach there, their vileness (`khabasat`) increases. He says that when... when they become separate, they roam (`jawlani karte hain`) in this world. After roaming, they descend upon some person. And through him, they make many things be said. That person... in people, he increases his enmity. He increases distance from the truth. When they leave his body... the time for whispering (`waswasah`) is over for them, so where do they reach? The two knots (`'uqdatan`). In the two knots, their... their enmity becomes firmly rooted (`rasikh`) in them. `wa yajtami'u bi-dhalika bi-amthalihi min sufara' al-khabith al-sabiqah 'alayhi wa 'l-warid 'alayhi` (and he gathers thereby with his likes from the preceding vile envoys and those who come upon him). And they gather there... with his likes... from the vile envoys (`khabith sufara'`) who preceded... and who come upon him. `fa yazdaduna bi-ijtima'ihim shaytanatan wa kufran wa bu'dan wa nukran` (so they increase by their gathering in satanism, disbelief, distance, and denial). And they increase from their gathering in satanism, disbelief, distance, and denial (`nukr`). `thumma yanhadiruna ila 'l-ard wa yasiruna ila 'l-qamat al-alfiyyah` (then they descend to the earth and proceed to the thousand-year stature). And then they fall towards the earth and become... reach the thousand-year stature. `wa hina'idhin yakununa shayatin bi 'l-fi'l` (and at that point they become devils in actuality). And at that time they become... they become devils (`shaytan`) in actuality (`bi 'l-fi'l`). Until now, they were devils in potential (`shayatin bi 'l-quwwah`). They used to act through someone else. Now they themselves become devils (`shayatin`), becoming `bi 'l-fi'l` (in actuality), and manifest in the world. Sir, what was said earlier, that they speak, so... through someone's `nutq` (speech)... they enter someone (`warid ho jate hain`). The one they enter... he also becomes bad. They put `waswasah` (whispering) in him. That's how it is. They put `waswasah` in him. Then after that, they reach the two knots (`'uqdatan`). From the two knots, they then descend upon the earth. So... like soothsayers (`kahana`) and so on... who do `nutq`... Whoever it is, whoever it is. Whoever speaks against the truth (`ghayr-e haqq`), their connection is established with them. Whoever speaks against the People of Truth (`Ahl-e Haqq`), whoever goes against the People of Truth (`Ahl-e Jadd`), they descend upon them. To the extent that their time to leave comes. So this has been lessened (`mukhaffaf kar diya`), meaning from the two knots (`'uqdatan`), these people are not going into the `sakhrah` (rock of punishment) and so on... the punishments... No, `sakhrah` is yet to come. After the Qa'im `alayhissalatu wassalam`, they will go. For now, they have to manifest among humans. And pay their dues (`badle chukana`). They are in the form of a sorcerer (`sahir`), in the form of a `khandar` (`[unclear]`), in the form of a murderer (`qatil`). They have to fulfill their retributions (`qisasat`). After that, at the end of the `dawr` (cycle), when the Qa'im `alayhissalatu wassalam` appears, they will be manifested there. There will be a confrontation (`muqabalah`), and in it, they will be finished. `wa tazdadu waswasatuhu wa ghawayatuhu wa sadduhum` (and his whispering and his misguidance increase, and their blocking). And their whisperings and their misguidance and their blocking increase... `wa sadduhum 'an aksar al-'awalim 'an al-hidayah` (and their blocking of most of the worlds from guidance). And their blocking of most of the worlds... from guidance. They prevent them from gaining guidance. Understand its process. When any living human, in their worldly life, opposes the truth (`haqq`), then what will be his... what process has been told? His... his `surah khabisah` (vile form) which he had created will become separate from him. His `nafs` (soul) will spread throughout his body. His `surah` (form) will do what? It will roam in the world. And that... its job is what? That wherever there are such gatherings that are against the People of Truth (`Ahl-e Haqq`), it will help them. It will incite them to oppose the truth. That is their job. And when their time is up, what happens? They go to the two knots (`'uqdatan`). And there their satanism increases. Whispering (`waswasah`). Then from there they descend into the world. At what time? When an Imam appears. To take their retributions (`qisasat`). They fulfill their retributions. `ka-man taqaddama min azdad awliya' Allah 'alayhim al-salam` (like those who preceded from the opponents of the Friends of Allah, peace be upon them). Like the people who... were advanced... from the opponents of the Friends of Allah (`awliya' Allah`), upon them be peace. `wa hadhihi 'l-rutbah al-ka'inuna fiha ha'ula'i 'l-shayatin hiya asfal al-safilin` (and this rank in which these devils are is the lowest of the low). And this rank in which they are, these devils, is the lowest of the low (`asfal-e safilin`). `li-annaha la rutbata tahtaha wa la akhbatha minha` (because there is no rank beneath it, nor anything viler than it). Because there is no rank beneath it, nor is there anything more vile than it. `Hamana 'llahu 'anha bi-muwalat awliya'ihi wa ajarana 'llahu min nafasatihim wa hamazatihim. Innahu 'ala kulli shay'in qadir` (May Allah protect us from it through the love of His Friends, and may Allah give us refuge from their evil breaths and their evil suggestions. Indeed, He is powerful over all things). May Allah protect us... from them... from them... by means of the love of the Friends of Allah (`awliya'`), and may He give us refuge... may Allah give us refuge from their breaths (`nufus`)... evil suggestions (`phoonk`)... and from their poking (`chubhana`)... poking... from their evil breaths (`nafasat`)... `nafas` means to spit/breathe evil. From their spitting. `wa hamazatihim` (and their evil suggestions). And from their... `hamazat` will have to be looked up. From their inciting... to incite... something like that. `innahu 'ala kulli shay'in qadir` (indeed, He is powerful over all things). `Al-fasl al-rabi' min al-bab al-thalis min suradiq al-rabi'` (The fourth chapter from the third gate from the fourth pavilion). The fourth chapter, from the third gate, from the fourth pavilion. `wa min qawlihi salamullah 'alayhi fi hadhihi 'l-risalah` (and from his saying, peace of Allah be upon him, in this treatise)... `wa idha balaghati 'l-anfus al-'asiyah akhiran...` `wa idha balaghati 'l-anfus al-'asiyah akhira 'adhra' al-silsilah al-mu'addah li-'adhabiha, ghasat biha mala'ikat al-'adhab, wa zabanaha malik al-ghadban` (and when the disobedient souls reach the last of the links of the chain which is prepared for their punishment, the angels of punishment plunge into it with them, and the wrathful angel drives them). `fa 'lamma qala`... (so when he said...) And as he said... Your saying, may Allah's peace be upon you... in this treatise... so when he reached... `sahib risalah` (the author of the treatise) is gracing us with his presence. So when they reach... So they reach the evil... evil souls (`nufus`)... disobedient (`'asiyah`)... disobedient souls (`na-farman nufus`)... in the final... final link of the chain... in the chain... meaning in the seventh chain they reach. `al-mu'addah li-'adhabiha` (which is prepared for their punishment). Which one is the final one? Which one is it? `ma'dan`... mineral realm. `al-mu'addah li-'adhabiha` (which is prepared for their punishment). Which has been prepared for their punishment. So they are covered... the angels of punishment cover them... and `zabanaha malik al-ghadban` (the wrathful angel drives them). And drives away... and they drive (`hankate hain`)... they drive them... and drive... drive (`hankana`); `zabana` means to drive (`hankana`), to drive and take away. They are taken away by the wrathful angel. `fa 'ttahadat biha lata'if al-'adhab` (so the subtleties of punishment unite with it). So they become united... with it... the subtleties of punishment. `wa 'nhadarat biha ila surat al-zulmah bi-mujarradiha` (and it descends with them to the form of darkness in its pure state). And they throw... throw with it... to the form of darkness in its pure state (`bi-mujarradiha`). It becomes... and they become... complete darkness. `bi-mujarradiha` (in its pure state), meaning the body is not included in it. It becomes pure (`mujarrad`) darkness. `fa tatara'a laha fi dhatiha` (so there appears to it, in its essence). It is shown to them... in their own essence. `kullama lahazat nafsuha ashkhass silsilat allati salakat fiha wa ju'ilat biha` (whenever its soul perceives them, the figures of the chain in which it traversed and was placed). Whenever its soul perceives... the figures of the chain... in which they were made to walk... in which... and were placed in it. `wa amwaj jahannam wa marratan tarfa'uha ila wahj al-athir` (and the waves of Hell, and at times it raises it to the heat of the ether). And the waves of Hell... and the waves of Hell raise... raise it... towards the heat... towards the heat of the `athir` (ether). This `athir`... the heat of `athir` is also fire. `athir` is what? The sphere of fire (`kura-e nar`) which is there. `wa marratan tahbutu...` *fi dhatiha kullama lahazat nafsuha* means... they see... `fi dhatiha kullama...` `bi-mujarradiha...` what did he say... `fa-tatara'a laha fi dhatiha`... Sir, these punishments they are going through... `jahannam`, `sakhrah`, and this and that... so the evils they had done, the sins they had committed, are they being absolved of them, or the wrong intentions they had... Both intention (`niyat`) and action (`a'fal`) are in it. Intention and action. Meaning, when... They made the intention, and they put that intention into action. They tormented the People of Truth (`Ahl-e Haqq`). They gave trouble to the People of Truth. For the sake of their caliphate (`khilafat`) and money and wealth and government, they committed murders. What all did they do? Meaning all things, when they are finished, when their punishments are finished, it means the enmity will also be gone, everything, just as... at the first perfection (`kamal-e awwal`)... in the state of the first perfection, as their essence was, will they remain like that? Or... They will be given a choice (`ikhtiyar diya jayega`). Whether you want to come to the right path or the wrong path. But what is their essence (`zat`) like? Is there evil in their essence? Or has it been finished after going to `sakhrah` and coming back? The `tasawwur` (conception/ideation)... its origin was the `tasawwur`. The `tasawwur` is finished in the punishments. Yes. After that, the `nafs`... the evil `nafs` remains. The `nafs` that is there, it comes into the world. Now it is given the choice whether to go here or go there. Then a new series starts for it. In the world of choice (`ikhtiyari 'alam`). So "clean slate" means that from the `nafs`, everything which... from the punishments... it gets freedom. Its punishments are completed. Now after that, it is given a choice. Along with the punishments, the evil that is in the essence (`zat`) is also... that is also finished. That is also finished. Because its `nafs`... where is it? It is spread in the body. Yes. Its `nafs` is spread in the body. And its `nafs` and body are made to pass through different perceptions (`adrak`). To the point that it burns in the punishment of `jahannam`. This final... after going to the final stage, these are its punishments? Yes, the final stage... after the final stage... there are the punishments of the peripheries (`atraf`). But this... `wa-ju'ilat biha wa-amwaj jahannam marratan...` It is burned in the fire, so this is after the mineral stage. What has been said? `rawh wa 'l-narr`. The seven stages have to be passed through. In this, there are many people who are criminals (`mujrim`), they return from two stages, from three stages. They come back. Those who are very, very bad people, they reach the final stage. From there are the punishments of the peripheries (`atraf`). `rub'-e maskun` (the inhabited quarter)... west, east, north, south... it is punished from there. From there, the Qa'im `alayhissalatu wassalam`... they are present before him. What form do they have? Their souls (`nufus`) and their bodies (`ajsam`). They are in the world, the `nufus` and `ajsam`. They are present. After being present, you will pass judgment. And their `suwarat` (forms) which are there, fire will descend from them. It will be related to their body (`jism`) and soul (`nafs`), and they will go towards the `sakhrah`. So they will go after the punishments of the peripheries (`atraf`). The punishments of the peripheries come first. That is... that punishment is called the lesser punishment (`'adhab al-adna`). There are two kinds of lesser punishment. One is the punishment of the seven chains, and the punishment of the seven peripheries. And then... both are the lesser punishments. Then the Qa'im `alayhissalatu wassalam`... they will come to his court. From there, the fire of their `suwarat` (forms) will descend. And those `suwarat`... their `surah` (form)... their bodies will be burned by it. And that `sakhrah`... they will go through its mouth. And that `surah zulmaniyyah` (dark form) does not have permanence (`baqa nahin hai`). This point should be remembered. The `surah nuraniyyah` (luminous form) has permanence. Permanence means its existence (`wujud`) is not there? Its existence is not there. It was created... it was created through a wrong method. Like there is truth (`haqq`). Truth is. Truth has permanence. And what is untruth (`nahqq`), it has become untruth due to the distance from truth. `al-sharru la asla lahu fi 'l-ibtida'` (Evil has no origin in the beginning). Evil... in its origin, there is no root. Does a lie have permanence? Who has permanence? Truthfulness. Truth. What is a lie called? Distance from truth. So the real thing is truth. Now as you get closer to truth, where will the lie go? It will be finished. It won't remain. So this is... the fundamental thing we have is that darkness (`zulmat`) does not have permanence. It is a self-created thing... a thing created by you. It will gradually be destroyed. And who has permanence? Light (`nur`) has it, truth (`haqq`) has it. These things have permanence. They will always remain. But even with permanence, it is not eternal (`da'imi`). The truthfulness. It is not eternal. To truthfulness too, and to light too. Truthfulness has eternal permanence. I mean, a... a life expectancy... that it starts from here and will end here. Truth is always there. Two plus two is four. Now if someone says two plus two is five, someone will say it is six, someone will say it is seven. Now the one saying seven is further away. The one saying six is less far. And the one saying five is less far than that. And the one saying four, that is the truth. That is the matter. The same is the case with light and darkness. Now here there is light. The light behind the lamp is `nur`. Now the further you go away, darkness will increase there. So darkness is not the original thing. The original thing is not darkness. Darkness is the name for distance from light. When you come close to light, darkness will automatically... darkness will not remain. So now these... they remain in the two knots (`'uqdatan`). And there are many people who... the `athir` (ether)... the sphere of `athir`, which is the sphere of fire (`kura-e nar`), they are punished by its heat. `wa marratan tahbutu ila bard al-zamharir` (and at another time, they fall to the cold of Zamharir). And sometimes they fall... they fall towards the cold of `zamharir`. `zamharir`... he is talking about them... he is talking about these souls (`nufus`). `wa marratan tahbutu ila`... they fall towards the cold of `zamharir`. Their forms and souls... `wa marratan tahbutu`... they fall towards the cold of `zamharir`. A cold region. `wa 'l-shayatin tahtalitu biha` (and the devils mingle with it). And the devils (`shayatin`)... are with them. `wa 'l-mala'ikah tarjumuha bi 'l-shuhub min thughur al-'adhab` (and the angels stone it with meteors from the frontiers of punishment). And the angels... and the angels stone them... they stone them with meteors (`shihab`) from the frontiers of punishment (`'azab ke thughur`). From the frontiers of punishment. The piercing stars... `idha 's-sama'u 'nshaqqat, wa adhinat li-Rabbiha wa huqqat` (When the sky is split asunder, And has harkened to her Lord, and it is fit). `wa tarmiha duhuran min kulli janib` (and they cast them away, repulsed from every side). And they are thrown... repulsed, from every side. They want to reach such stars where... the luminous stars, but they are driven away from there by piercing flames (`shihab-e saqib`). `wa la yazalu kadhalika da'buhum ma damati 's-samawatu wa 'l-ard tarjufu` (and their condition will not cease to be thus so long as the heavens and the earth tremble). And they always remain in this same condition, as long as the heavens and the earth tremble and shake. `wa min qawlihi salamullah 'alayhi: wa idha balaghati 'l-anfus al-'asiyah akhira 'adhra' al-silsilah al-mu'addah li-'adhabiha` (and from his saying, peace of Allah be upon him: "and when the disobedient souls reach the last of the links of the chain which is prepared for their punishment"). `isharah minhu ila akhir al-naw'ayn min anwa' al-'adhab` (a sign from him to the end of the two types of punishment). When they reach the evil souls (`anfus-e kharab`) in the final link of the chain, then they are prepared... for their punishment. It is a sign that from it... towards the end of the two types... of the types of punishment with which... punishment has been given to them. `li-anna 'l-silsilah hiya 'l-adrak al-sab'ah allati yu'azzabu fihi 'l-'usat bi-anwa' al-'adhab` (because the chain is the seven stages in which the disobedient are punished with types of punishment). Because that chain... because that chain is of the seven stages, such that the disobedient (`na-farman`) are punished in it with various types of punishment. `wa yalbasuna fi kulli naw'in min anwa'iha sakina qamisan` (and they wear in every type of its types a thick shirt). And they wear, in every type... type... from its types... a thick shirt. `kama sabaqa bihi 'l-qawl` (as was previously stated). As was stated before... `wa hadha huwa 'l-'adhab al-adna` (and this is the lesser punishment). This... `allati dhakarahu 'llahu ta'ala fi kitabihi 'l-'aziz: khudhuhu fa-ghulluhu thumma 'l-jahima salluhu thumma fi silsilatin dhar'uha sab'una dhira'an fa-slukuhu` (which Allah the Exalted mentioned in His Mighty Book: "Seize him and shackle him. Then into the Hellfire, cast him. Then into a chain whose length is seventy cubits, insert him."). And this is the lesser punishment (`'azab-e adna`) which Allah the Exalted has mentioned where... He has said in His Mighty Book... seize him, grab him... and... when their death occurs... `fa-ghulluhu` (then shackle him). So put shackles on him... put shackles on him. Then... then... burn him in Hell (`jahannam`). Then burn him in Hell. Then... then take him... in a chain... in a chain... whose links are seventy... seventy... seventy links. Drive (`chalao`) him... drive him. What was mentioned earlier, the `wahj al-athir` and `bard-e zamharir`... so after the punishments of the peripheries (`atraf`)... the peripheries were not mentioned. Only the seven stages were mentioned. No, from there... they descend from above... the meteors (`suwarat`) descend from above. So the punishments of the peripheries (`atraf`) and these seven stages (`saat adrak`), is it in between? No, its process is separate, isn't it? That is it, that the `surah` (form)... what process has been described for the `surah`? The `surah`... the evil `surah` (`surah-e kharab`) that there is, after leaving, it roams (`jawlani karti hai`) in the world. And it creates corruption (`kharabi`). With the people of enmity (`'adawat`), it joins. It increases their enmity. And from there, what happens? Where does it reach? It reaches the two knots (`'uqdatan`). Yes. And it remains in the two knots. And at the time when it has to descend, when it is time to take retributions (`qisasat`), then it descends in the time of some Imam. It takes its retributions. Then it returns to its place in the two knots. This happens. After that, their souls (`nufus`) and their forms (`suwarat`)... they come into the worldly punishments. The soul and the body... The soul and the body. Because the soul (`nafs`) and the body have become one, haven't they? Their `nafs` has become a `nafs-e hissiya jism` (sensory, physical soul). The `surah` went to the two knots. The remaining... the remaining are the soul (`nafs`) and the body (`jism`). They are there. They are in the `dawr` (cycle) of the world. They are punished. The seven chains... and the punishments of the peripheries (`atraf`), they are put into them. After that, when the Qa'im `alayhissalatu wassalam` appears, then there is a confrontation (`muqatilah`). In the confrontation, then their bodies (`na'sh`) are lying there. And the believers complain that from this... bad things are being created. So you pray. Fire from the heavens... from their forms... the fire of their forms descends. It burns their souls and bodies. And that, becoming ash, enters `sakhrah` through the gates (`abwab`) of `sakhrah`. This is the process described. Its process is separate. Of the `nufus`. And the meeting (`ijtima'`) of the `suwarat` and `nufus` happens when? At the coming of the Qa'im. `wa qawluhu salamullah 'alayhi: ghasat biha mala'ikat al-'adhab... yudillu dhalika 'ala annahu ba'da hudurihim bayna yaday al-Qa'im 'ala dhikrihi 'l-salam wa hisabihi iyyahum wa tashkhisihi li-kulli suratin ma laha li-ahli dawrihi wa tabkitihi iyyahum 'ala 'l-ifsad wa 'l-ta'nif wa 'l-ta'nif thumma qatlihim wa 'stihalatuhum bukharan wa su'uduhum ila ufuq al-'uqdatan wa masiruhum tahta 'l-sakhrah allati hiya asfal al-safilin` (and his saying, peace of Allah be upon him: "The angels of punishment plunge into it with them"... this indicates that this is after their being present before the Qa'im, peace be upon his mention, and his judging them, and his particularizing for every form what is for it for the people of its cycle, and his rebuking of them for their corruption and harshness, and harshness, then their being killed, and their transformation into vapor, and their ascent to the horizon of the two knots, and their journey under the Sakhrah, which is the lowest of the low). And your saying, may Allah's peace be upon you... The angels of punishment give them a `ghota` (plunge)... it indicates that this is after their being present before the Qa'im `alayhissalam` and your reckoning of them and your specifying for every form what is its due for the people of its `dawr`, and your rebuking (`sarzanish karna`) them for their corruption (`nafarmani`)... and their harshness (`ta'nif`), and your killing them, and their changing into vapor (`bukhar`), and their ascending to the horizon of the two knots (`ufuq-e 'uqdatayn`), and their going (`masir`) under the `sakhrah`, such that it is the lowest of the low (`asfal-e safilin`). And your saying, may Allah's peace be upon you... `taslim al-'uqdatayn wa ash'at Zuhal wa 'l-Mirrikh lahum ila 'l-sakhrah` (the handing over of the two knots and the rays of Saturn and Mars to them towards the Sakhrah). And the handing over of the two knots, and the rays... the rays of Saturn and the rays of Mars... for them... towards the `sakhrah`. The names Zuhal and Mirrikh are mentioned, through them, those rays reach there. Where the Sun (`shams`), Moon (`qamar`), Venus (`zohra`), and Mercury (`'atarud`) have no access. `thumma masiruhum fi wasat al-sakhrah, mu'adhdhabina fiha ma damati 's-samawatu wa 'l-ard... wa huwa madda 'l-qawl al-a'zam alladhi huwa thalathumi'at alfin wa sittun alfan sana, madrubah fi mithliha` (Then their journey into the middle of the Sakhrah, being punished therein as long as the heavens and the earth endure... and this is the extent of the Greatest Cycle, which is 360,000 years, multiplied by its like). Then their going (`masir`) into the middle of the `sakhrah` (`wasat-e sakhrah`). Being punished (`'azab diye gaye`), being punished in it as long as the heavens and the earth endure... and this is the duration of the Great Cycle (`qawl-e a'zam`). Which is... how many are the cycles of the Great Cycle? 360,000 years. 360,000. 360,000. Solar. From a lunar perspective, 400,000. `Ajarana 'llahu min dhalika bi-haqqi Muhammadin wa alihi 'l-tahirin, salawatullah 'alayhim ajma'in` (May Allah protect us from that by the right of Muhammad and his pure progeny, the blessings of Allah be upon them all). May Allah protect us from that by the right of the Prophet and the Prophet's pure progeny, peace of Allah be upon them all.

*mabda-maad*, the third chapter, third *bāb*, fourteenth *fusūl*... *Wa-ammā qawluhu, wa-zabanahā mālik al-ghazbān* (And as for his saying, and *mālik al-ghazbān* repelled it)... *Wa-ammā qawluhu... Wa-ammā qawluhu, wa-zabanahā mālik al-ghazbān* (And as for his saying, and *mālik al-ghazbān* repelled it). And this, your saying, that *mālik al-ghazbān* repel... *ṣāḥib al-rasāʾil* (the author of the epistles)... *ṣāḥib al-rasāʾil* who is... Maulānā Ahmad... Maulānā Ahmad, *ṣāḥib al-rasāʾil*. Which number Imam is he? Ninth. Who is the seventh? Maulānā Muhammad bin Ismāʿīl. After him, Maulānā ʿAbdullāh. Then Maulānā Ahmad. The ninth. *Wa-ammā qawluhu* (And as for his saying)... And who is after him? Maulānā ʿAbdullāh, Maulānā Ahmad, Maulānā... Maulānā Husain. *Wa-ammā qawluhu* (And as for his saying). And this, your saying, that they repel *suwarāt* (forms)... *wa-zabanahā*... they push it away. *Dafa* means to repel. And they push away... *mālik al-ghazbān*. *Fa-hādhihi ishāratun ilā al-ʿaql al-ʿāshir* (And this is an indication to the Tenth Intellect). The angels who are the angels of wrath, they are. *Wa-hādhihi ishāratun ilā... ilā al-ʿaql al-ʿāshir* (And this is an indication to... to the Tenth Intellect). So, this is to indicate towards the Tenth Intellect (*ʿaql-e ʿāshir*), *alladhī huwa al-mudabbir li-jamīʿ ʿālam al-ṭabīʿah* (who is the administrator of the entire world of nature). Such that he is the administrator for the entire world of nature. *Wa-al-mālik lahā* (And the owner of it), and he is the owner for those forms (*suwarāt*). *Wa-al-murattib li-kulli shayʾin minhā fīh* (And the arranger of everything from it in it). *Murattib*... *Wa-al-murattib li-kulli shayʾin minhā* (And the arranger of everything from it). People do not differentiate in this: *murattib* and *murattab*. *Murattib* means the one who arranges. *Murattab* means that which has been arranged. One is the *fāʿil* (agent), the other is the *mafʿūl* (object). *Wa-al-murattib... wa-al-murattib li-kulli shayʾin minhā fī martabatihi* (And the arranger of everything from it in its rank). And the one who arranges every thing from those forms in their rank. *Wa-huwa ghazbān ʿalā kulli ʿāṣin li-llāhi taʿālā* (And he is wrathful against every sinner against God, the Exalted). And he is the one who becomes wrathful... This is probably *ghazabān* (wrathful one). *Huwa al-ghazabān* (He is the wrathful one). See what is written in it... *Ghazbān*. *Wa-huwa al-ghazbān*. And he is the one who becomes wrathful against every sinner who is for Allah, the Exalted, and for the friends of Allah (*awliyāʾ Allāh*), peace be upon all of them. *Wa-huwa bāb ʿālam al-quds* (And he is the gate to the world of sanctity), and he is the gate for the world of sanctity. *Kamā anna al-shams bāb ʿālam al-ṭabīʿah* (Just as the sun is the gate to the world of nature), just as the sun is the gate for the world of nature. *Wa-kamā anna hujjat tilka al-maqām bāb dīnī* (And just as the *ḥujjah* of that station is a religious gate), and just as the *ḥujjah* of every Imam, he is the religious gate (*bāb-e dīnī*). *Wa-huwa al-mushār ilayhi bi-Riḍwān al-khāzin al-jinān* (And he is the one indicated by Riḍwān, the treasurer of the gardens of paradise). And he is the one indicated... towards him... it is indicated towards him by *Riḍwān*, who is the treasurer of the gardens of paradise (*khāzin-e jinān*). Who is the treasurer of the heavens. There are two in this: *Riḍwān* and *mālik al-ghazbān*. *Mālik al-ghazbān* is for those people who commit sins, who are disobedient. And *Riḍwān* is for the righteous souls (*nufūs-e ṣāliḥah*). *Idh ilayhi intihāʾu* (Since to him is the end...). Both are also towards the *ʿāshir* (Tenth Intellect)... they are the servants of the *ʿāshir*. *Idh ilayhi... idh ilayhi intihāʾu kulli nafs ṣāliḥah* (Since to him is the end of every righteous soul). Whereas towards him is the end of every righteous soul. *Wa-qad yusammā al-shams allatī bāb al-ṭabīʿah* (And the sun, which is the gate of nature, is sometimes named). And it was named from the sun... *wa-qad yusammā* (and it is sometimes named)... and the sun is given the name... by *Riḍwān*, in the same way. In the same way. *Li-annahā maghnāṭīs* (Because it is a magnet)... *Ayḍan li-annahu maghnāṭīs kulli shayʾin maḥmūd* (Also because he is a magnet for every praiseworthy thing). Because he is a magnet for every praiseworthy thing. All good things go towards the sun. And all bad things go towards Saturn (*Zuḥal*) and Mars (*Mirrīkh*). For this reason, we have those... the times have been fixed. What auspicious time do we look for? What do we look for in an auspicious time? We look at the hour (*sāʿat*). In that itself, the hours begin. So, on Friday, whose hour begins? The day of Friday (*yawm al-Jumʿah*)? The first hour is of Venus (*Zuhrā*). The first hour is Venus, after that then... after Venus... after Venus, what star comes? Mercury (*ʿAṭārid*), then the Moon (*Qamar*). The Moon, then after the Moon, the hour of Saturn (*Zuḥal*) begins. Then... then of Jupiter (*Mushtarī*), then of Mars (*Mirrīkh*). They ask the time after seeing all the hours. We are to say it after reciting *Bismillah*. *Li-anna maghnāṭīs kulli shayʾin maḥmūd* (Because it is a magnet for every praiseworthy thing). And... and because that sun is a magnet for every praiseworthy thing. *Wa-ilayhā maṣīr al-nufūs al-rūḥiyyah* (And to it is the destination of the spiritual souls). And towards it is the arrival of the spiritual souls. *Al-marḍiyyah* (the pleased ones), those who are pleased, *ʿalayhā* (upon it), towards it, upon it. *Wa-ilayhā maṣīr nufūs ahl al-ẓāhir al-ṣāliḥah* (And to it is the destination of the souls of the people of the *ẓāhir* who are righteous). And towards that same sun is the arrival of the souls of the people of the *ẓāhir* who are pious. *Al-khayyarah* (the good ones), those who possess goodness. *Wa-qad yaqaʿu ayḍan ism mālik al-ghazbān ʿalā Zuḥal, innahu al-mutawallī li-ihbāṭ nufūs al-ʿuṣāt ilā taḥt al-ṣakhrah bi-ashʿatihi wa-ashʿat al-ʿuqdatayn* (And the name *mālik al-ghazbān* also falls upon Saturn, for he is the one in charge of causing the souls of the sinners to fall beneath the rock by its rays and the rays of the two nodes). And it occurs in this... in the same way... the name *mālik al-ghazbān* occurs upon Saturn. Because he is the one in charge of the falling of the souls... for making them fall. What is the word for falling? *Habṭ*. For making fall, *aḥbaṭa*. Because he is going to be the master... for causing the souls of the sinners to fall, beneath the rock. By its rays and the rays of the two nodes. *Wa-qawluhu salāmu-llāhi ʿalayhi, wa-ṣārat zulmatan bi-mujarradihā, ishāratun ilā kawniha fī wasṭ al-ṣakhrah* (And his saying, peace of God be upon him, and it became a darkness in its disembodiment, an indication to its being in the middle of the rock). And of your saying, peace be upon you... the saying of *ṣāḥib al-rasāʾil*... and that darkness becomes... in its disembodiment... they are empty of body... it indicates its being in the middle of the rock. And their arrival there... and their arrival there, becoming darkness. *Tataqallā fī al-ʿadhāb al-alīm* (They burn in the painful torment). They burn in the painful torment. Now he is explaining the saying of the *ṣāḥib al-rasāʾil*. *Wa-qawluhu yutarāʾā lahā* (And his saying, it appears to it...). This is after arriving. What torments befall them there. *Wa-qawluhu yutarāʾā lahā fī dhātihā kullamā ahḍarat nafsahā ashkhaṣ al-silsilati allatī salakat fīhā* (And his saying, there appears to it, in its essence, whenever its soul presents itself, the persons of the chain in which it traversed). And this saying of yours, that it appears... it appears to them... it appears to them in their essence, as much as they see their own soul. The persons of the chain, such that they walked in it. *Wa-juʿilat bihā ʿinda...* (And it was made by it near...). And they were made in it... and they were made in it... to be near, in the middle of the rock, in severe torment. Meaning, those old things, talks, come to their memory. Which series did they belong to, whatever it may be. *Innahā maʿa mā hiya fīhi dhākirah taḥaqquqan li-dhālika al-ʿadhāb al-adnā alladhī salakat fīhi wa-jamīʿu atrabiha, thumma kawnuhum ilā al-ʿadhāb al-akbar baʿda dhālik* (Indeed, along with what it is in, it is remembering, as a realization of that lower torment in which it traversed and all of its peers, then their being [destined] for the greater torment after that). Along with it... with the confirmation that they... along with that, in it, they are remembering. ...that torment... the lower torment (*ʿazāb-e adnā*), such that they walked in it. The lower torment through which they had passed... the lower torment they passed through... all that they remember in the rock. They and all their companions. Then their being [destined] for the greater torment (*ʿazāb-e akbar*) after that. Meaning, the greater torment also comes to mind. The talk of the greater torment will come later. How they passed through the chain of the lower torment and how they came into the greater torment, all that reminds them. That itself is a torment, to remember. *Wa-inna jamīʿa mā salakū fīhi wa-uṣilū ilayhi bi-ʿiṣyānihim li-al-maqāmāt al-ʿāliyah wa-ḥudūdihim salāmu-llāhi ʿalayhim ghayru ghāʾibin ʿanhā jamīʿu dhālik* (And indeed, all that they traversed in and were brought to through their disobedience to the lofty stations and their *ḥudūd*, peace of God be upon them, none of that is absent from it). And indeed, all those who traversed in it and reached it because of their disobedience to the lofty Imam and his *ḥudūd*, peace of God be upon all of them... *ghayru ghāʾibin ʿalayhā jamīʿu dhālik* (none of that is absent from them), that which is to be absent is not upon them, all of it. All of that... they retain the memory of what kinds of torments they have passed through. *Wa-qawluhu, wa-amwāj jahannam marratan tarfaʿuhā ilā baḥr al-athīr, wa-marratan tahbuṭu bihā ilā bard al-zamharīr, ishāratun minhu, ṣalawātullāhi ʿalayhi, ayḍan ilā tadhakkurihim kawnahum fī nāḥiyat al-shimāl allatī hiya markaz al-zamharīr, wa-nāḥiyat al-junūb allatī hiya markaz al-athīr, wa-maṣīrihim ilā hunālika baʿda istīfāʾihim ʿadhāb al-adrāk* (And his saying, 'And the waves of Hell, one time, raise it up to the sea of ether, and another time, bring it down to the cold of *zamharīr*,' is an indication from him, God's blessings be upon him, also to their remembering their being in the northern direction which is the center of *zamharīr*, and the southern direction which is the center of ether, and their journeying to that place after they have fully received the torment of the cycles). And your saying... and the waves of Jahannam... This is the saying of *ṣāḥib al-rasāʾil*. *Wa-amwāj jahannam...* (And the waves of Hell...). The waves of Hell... the waves of Hell, one time they rise... sometimes... sometimes they raise them up... raise them up... towards the sea of ether (*athīr*). ...to the heat of the ether. ...and sometimes they make them fall... towards the cold of *zamharīr*. They take the forms to the cold of *zamharīr*. It is an indication from him... an indication from the *ṣāḥib al-rasāʾil*... in the same way, towards their remembering... their being in the northern direction, which is the center of *zamharīr*. The north is the center of *zamharīr*, the sphere of extreme cold. There, what... they remember how they went there, how... yes. And the southern direction... and the south... towards... this is before the advent of the *qāʾim*, the lower torment (*ʿadhāb al-adnā*). The seven links of the chain and... the torment of the four directions. This is the lower torment. After that is the torment of the rock (*ṣakhrah*), that is the greater torment (*ʿadhāb al-akbar*). As is the preceding saying. North Pole and South Pole. Yes. North Pole and South Pole. Both are tortured... [unclear]. Like how for six months it is... it remains, doesn't it... six months... six months the sun shines, six months cold... the sun... the sun shines for six months, at that time... [unclear]. No... the south... of June... no... in the north there is *zamharīr* and in the south is... is the center of ether, isn't it... the center is ether... northern and southern... which is the center of ether. Hmm. So it doesn't mean summer and winter... The southern direction, which is the center of ether. His saying is that for six months it is winter, for six months it is summer. So... I understand this to mean that the heat... the things from there are turned over here. Meaning... there is a *tawlif*... the animals from there come here, the animals from here go there. It was mentioned in... what was it... in which magazine was it... how... the migratory birds... *wa-al-shayāṭīn tahwī māhā* (and the devils fall with it)... and the devils... *wa-qawluhu, wa-al-shayāṭīn tahwī māhā, tāratan ilā... ishāratun... ishāratun ilā ʿulamāʾihim wa-ruʾasāʾihim al-muḍillīna lahum, al-mawkūlīna māhum bi-hādhī al-ʿadhābāt al-karīhah* (And his saying, 'And the devils fall with it, sometimes to...', an indication... an indication to their scholars and their chiefs who lead them astray, who are entrusted with them in these loathsome torments). And from this saying, and the devils... they encompass it... no, they fall with it. They fall with it. Indicating... towards the scholars... their scholars and their chiefs who are... who lead them astray, and who are to be with them in these loathsome torments. *Qawluhu salāmun...* The meaning of *shayāṭīn* (devils) is taken as their scholars and chiefs. *Tahwī māhā*... *Qawluhu salāmu-llāhi ʿalayhi, wa-al-malāʾikatu tarjumuhā bi-shuhub al-ʿadhāb, wa-huwa mā yasrī ilayhim min al-laʿnāt al-ʿuqūl al-mujarradah fī kulli waqtin wa-ḥīnin, wa-min tajdīd al-ʿadhāb wa-shiddat al-an... ʿindamā yaʿinnu dhikruhum wa-dhikr ruʾasāʾihim fa-yalʿanuhum al-ḥudūd wa-al-muʾminūn wa-yanshurūna masāwīhim wa-yadʿūna ʿalayhim wa-lā yarjumūn... wa-lā yarḥamūna fa-yashtaddu ʿalayhim al-ʿadhāb wa-yatajaddadu idh al-ḥudūd hum al-malāʾikah bi-l-quwwah* (His saying, peace of God be upon him, 'And the angels stone it with the meteors of torment,' which is what flows to them from the curses of the disembodied intellects at every time and moment, and from the renewal of the torment and the severity of the... when their mention and the mention of their chiefs arises, so the *ḥudūd* and the believers curse them and they spread their vices and they pray against them and do not stone... and do not show mercy, so the torment intensifies upon them and is renewed, since the *ḥudūd* are angels in potentiality). And from your saying... peace be upon him... and the angels stone it... with the torment... and it is what... flows towards them from the curses... of the disembodied intellects... every... at every time and moment, and from... the renewal of the torment and the severity of the pain... when... their mention arises and the mention of their chiefs... so the *ḥudūd* and the believers curse them and they spread their vices, and they pray against them and do not show mercy... so the torment intensifies upon them and is renewed. Since the *ḥudūd*... are the angels in potentiality. And from your... saying... from Allah's saying, peace be upon you... and the angels stone... those forms with the meteors of the torment. They stone with the torment of the stars. It is stoning (*rajm*). The shooting stars (*shihāb-e thāqib*) fall, so in the world, what... the torment that is to be given, the shooting stars also descend upon them, he is saying. *Shihāb* (meteor). And it is what flows to them... and it flows to them... there is a universe, a world. They fall from above. Where and where do they strike the shooting stars, what is it, it is in the hands of the *mudabbir* (administrator). And it flows to them... to those forms... from the curses of the disembodied intellects. *Wa-mā yasrī ilayhim min laʿnāt al-ʿuqūl al-mujarradah* (And what flows to them from the curses of the disembodied intellects). Those who... they send towards them, from the curses... of the disembodied intellects, at every time... and at every moment... *ʿuqūl mujarradah* means... intellects that are disembodied, that have become pure and clean from the body. In which there is no materiality. Those intellects. Who are entrusted with the task of sending torment upon them, they send them torment from the curses. They send torment from the curses of the disembodied intellects. Yes. And from the renewal of the torment. And from the renewal of the torment and the severity... *ʿindamā yaʿinnu dhikruhum* (when their mention arises)... When their mention arises... *wa-dhikr ruʾasāʾihim* (and the mention of their chiefs)... and the mention of their chiefs arises... *fa-yalʿanuhum al-ḥudūd wa-al-muʾminūn* (so the *ḥudūd* and the believers curse them)... so the *ḥudūd* and the believers curse them. When the *ḥudūd* and the believers pray against them, curse them, then the effect of that is there, he is saying. That accepts their curse. This is... in the world, the... the disembodied intellects... It is from the effect of that that this... the torment of the shooting stars descends. The torment of shooting stars descends and other torments also descend. The disembodied intellects also send torment, and the *ḥudūd* and the believers, when they curse them, then that torment befalls them. So the *ḥudūd* and the believers curse them. *Fa-yalʿanuhum al-ḥudūd wa-al-muʾminūn, wa-yanshurūna masāwīhim* (So the *ḥudūd* and the believers curse them, and they spread their vices). And they spread the faults of those people. *Wa-yadʿūna ʿalayhim* (And they pray against them). And they pray against them... for them. And they do not show mercy. *Fa-yashtaddu ʿalayhim al-ʿadhāb* (So the torment intensifies upon them). The torment intensifies upon them... the torment intensifies upon them. *Wa-yatajaddadu* (And it is renewed). And it becomes new. *Idh al-ḥudūd hum al-malāʾikah bi-l-quwwah* (Since the *ḥudūd* are angels in potentiality). Because the *ḥudūd* are angels in potentiality. *Wa-yakūnu... wa-yakūnu bi-dhālika saryān ashʿat al-shams bi-shiddat ḥarr al-athīr* (And by that there is the flowing of the rays of the sun with the intensity of the heat of the ether). So by this cause, there is... the flowing... of the sun... of the rays. *Wa-ashʿat al-qamr bi-shiddat bard al-zamharīr* (And the rays of the moon with the intensity of the cold of *zamharīr*). *Wa-hum al-malāʾikah bi-l-quwwah* (And they are angels in potentiality). And they are angels in potentiality. In the same way... meaning this sun and moon... towards the sun and moon... yes... towards the *ḥudūd*... he is also saying for the *ḥudūd*. *Al-ḥudūd hum al-malāʾikah bi-l-quwwah* (The *ḥudūd* are angels in potentiality). *Wa-ayḍan li-anna al-athīr alladhī yaqaʿu ʿalā ḥarārat al-shams wa-al-zamharīr ʿalā bard al-qamar* (And also because the ether which falls upon the heat of the sun, and the *zamharīr* upon the cold of the moon). Because it occurs... upon the rays of the sun, and the *zamharīr* upon the rays of the moon. *Wa-qawluhu ʿalayhi al-salām, wa-yurmā bihā duḥūran min kulli jānib, ishāratun ilā ibrāzihā ilā hādhihi al-biqāʿ al-khabīthah al-muʿaddah li-ʿadhābihā wa-tazyīlihā min arḍ al-maskūnah allatī hiya bi-l-iḍāfati ilā tilka al-biqāʿ al-khabīthah al-karīhah jannatun muzakhrafah, ajāranā Allāhu wa-jamīʿa ikhwāninā minhā bi-ḥaqqi muḥammadin wa-ālihi al-ṭāhirīn* (And his saying, peace be upon him, 'And they are pelted with it, being driven off from every side,' is an indication to their being brought forth to these filthy plains prepared for their torment, and their removal from the inhabited land, which, in relation to those filthy, loathsome plains, is a decorated paradise. May God protect us and all our brethren from it, by the right of Muhammad and his pure progeny). And... this... your saying, peace of God be upon you, and they pelt... those filthy forms... from every side... while being driven away from every side. It indicates towards... the open place... to make them appear... their arriving... at these filthy plains which have been prepared... prepared for the torment, their torment. And their removal... and to remove them from the earth... from the inhabited land, which is their... dwelling place. Such that it, in relation to... in relation to those filthy, loathsome plains, is a paradise that has been decorated. The place where they are living today, the inhabited place, it is a paradise in comparison to those places where they are going to go. Which are the places of lower torment, and this... the torment of the rock. What happens ahead, God the administrator knows. What does Janab Iqbal say? *Khirad kya hai, chirāgh-e rahguzar hai, ke jis se ādmī rawshan basar hai. Darūn-e khānah hangāme hain kya kya, chirāgh-e rahguzar ko kya khabar hai.* (What is intellect? It is a lamp for the path, by which man's sight is illuminated. What tumults are there inside the house? What does the lamp for the path know?) What does it mean? Intellect. What is intellect? It is a lamp for the path. What does it mean? Intellect. *Khirad* means intellect. What is intellect? It is a lamp. It is not a lamp for the house. Rather, it is... a lamp to come from the path, to... to leave the house, or to come into the house from outside. There should be a lamp on some paths so that a person can come into the house with ease. *Khirad kya hai, chirāgh-e rahguzar hai, ke jis se ādmī rawshan basar hai.* (What is intellect? It is a lamp for the path, by which man's sight is illuminated). One gets light. Inside the house... inside the house, *hangāme hain kya kya* (what tumults are there), *chirāgh-e rahguzar ko kya khabar hai* (what does the lamp for the path know)? Yes. Now, I had the opportunity to see a narration in *Salūnī*. That... Maulānā Amīr al-Mu’minīn, *ʿalayhi al-salātu wa-al-salām*, when... at what time you... became the *wālī* (ruler), you arrived... and you led the prayer. So, you led the Fajr prayer. So... *Sabbih isma rabbika...* (Glorify the name of your Lord...). You recited that Surah. *Sabbih isma rabbika al-aʿlā alladhī khalaqa fa-sawwā wa-lladhī qaddara fa-hadā...* (Glorify the name of your Lord, the Most High, Who created and proportioned, and Who destined and [then] guided...). You recited that. After that, on the second day, you arrived, and you recited the same Surah. On the third day, you recited, it was the same Surah. For one month, you kept reciting the same Surah. So people asked, "You... don't you... perhaps you don't remember any other Surah, that you are reciting *Sabbih isma rabbika al-aʿlā*?" So you said, "Look. What is in it? At the end of it, what is there? ...*Qad aflaḥa man tazakkā wa-dhakara isma rabbihi fa-ṣallā bal tuʾthirūna al-ḥayāta al-dunyā wa-al-ākhiratu khayrun wa-abqā innā hādhā la-fī al-ṣuḥuf al-ūlā, ṣuḥufi ibrāhīma wa-mūsā.* (He has certainly succeeded who purifies himself, and mentions the name of his Lord and prays. But you prefer the worldly life, while the Hereafter is better and more enduring. Indeed, this is in the former scriptures, the scriptures of Abraham and Moses). *Innā hādhā la-fī al-ṣuḥuf...* (Indeed, this is in the scriptures...). Whatever has been stated, this is in the ancient scriptures which are the scriptures of Abraham and Moses. Yes. All these scriptures of Abraham and Moses, all the prophets were given them in inheritance, and I have received them in inheritance from the Prophet. I have received them in inheritance from the Prophet. And in those scriptures of Abraham and Moses, the things that are of the inheritance, I am acquiring them. I am acquiring them. And that is why I recite it continuously, because in it... the wonders that Abraham and Moses have... it is great. You understood? I have been searching for it for a long time. It must have been copied. Six copies must have been made.
